research_biochemistry_chemistry_set.name: biochemistry
research_biochemistry_chemistry_set.description: Researching the chemical properties of dangerous blood from mutated creatures.  It also gives a slight insight into the vulnerabilities these substances cause to the monsters.

research_biochemistry_chemistry_set_basi.name: biochemistry
research_biochemistry_chemistry_set_basi.description: Researching the chemical properties of dangerous blood from mutated creatures.  It also gives a slight insight into the vulnerabilities these substances cause to the monsters.

prac_athletics_beg.name: athletics (beginner)
prac_athletics_beg.description: Practice some basic calisthenics like pushups, squats, dips and crunches.

prac_parkour.name: parkour
prac_parkour.description: Practice parkour using a complex obstacle course.

prac_athletic_form.name: athlete's form (expert)
prac_athletic_form.description: Improve your athletic form using workout equipment.

prac_master_athletic_form.name: athlete's form (master)
prac_master_athletic_form.description: Refine your athletic form with a high-intensity workout.

prac_dextrous_paws.name: practice your new fingers
prac_dextrous_paws.description: You've kept your fingers and thumbs but they're a bit different now.  You'll need practice to use them properly.

prac_computer_beg.name: computer (beginner)
prac_computer_beg.description: Practice the basics of using a computing device.

prac_computer_int.name: computer (intermediate)
prac_computer_int.description: Practice using the command line, writing and running scripts making use of common algorithms and data structures.

prac_computer_adv.name: computer (advanced)
prac_computer_adv.description: Practice the use of software exploits to gain elevated privileges on computer systems.

prac_soldering.name: electronics soldering
prac_soldering.description: Practice soldering and de-soldering wires and electronic components.

prac_elec_circuit.name: electrical circuit design
prac_elec_circuit.description: Practice designing and building simple electrical circuits, such as a battery-powered motor or light bulb, and measuring their properties to understand the flow of current.

prac_elec_semiconductors.name: semiconductor circuits
prac_elec_semiconductors.description: Practice prototyping circuits using transistors for switching or amplifying electrical signals.

prac_elec_integrated_circuits.name: integrated circuits
prac_elec_integrated_circuits.description: Practice building electronic circuits using standard IC chips for voltage regulation, timing, logic, and simple processing.

prac_fletching.name: fletching
prac_fletching.description: Practice fletching by modifying, studying and testing the aerodynamics of some arrows or bolts.

prac_carving.name: carving
prac_carving.description: Practice carving different forms and shapes in a piece of wood.

prac_carpentry_basic.name: basic carpentry
prac_carpentry_basic.description: Practice basic carpentry by cutting, shaping and uniting some planks or sticks with nails.

prac_welding_beg.name: welding (beginner)
prac_welding_beg.description: Practice welding and separating some small metal sheets to one another in some simple forms and designs.

prac_welding_adv.name: welding (advanced)
prac_welding_adv.description: Practice welding, separating and giving form to some metal sheets in intricate patterns and complicated designs.

prac_redsmithing.name: redsmithing (beginner)
prac_redsmithing.description: Practice the basics of redsmithing by working copper into some simple forms and designs.

prac_redsmithing_adv.name: redsmithing (advanced)
prac_redsmithing_adv.description: Practice the more advanced techniques of redsmithing by working bronze into different and complex forms and designs.

prac_blacksmithing.name: blacksmithing
prac_blacksmithing.description: Practice working metal into some simple but useful forms and designs.

prac_armorsmithing.name: armorsmithing
prac_armorsmithing.description: Practice working metal into the form of various armor pieces, and test their articulation with you using some cotton for padding along with the armor pieces.

prac_bladesmith.name: bladesmithing
prac_bladesmith.description: Practice working metal into the form of useful blades of all sizes and designs, grind them until you learn how much is too much.

prac_toolsmithing.name: manual tooling
prac_toolsmithing.description: Practice working metal into the complex forms and designs of several tools like hammers and screwdrivers.

prac_hardening.name: quenching & hardening
prac_hardening.description: Practice heating steel to its critical temperature, and using different quenching techniques to achieve various hardening effects.

prac_quenching.name: tempering
prac_quenching.description: Practice heating chunks of steel and quickly cooling them down with water, and then, to reduce brittleness and restore ductility, heating them again to maximize its properties.

prac_machining_lathe_aluminum.name: lathe turning (aluminum)
prac_machining_lathe_aluminum.description: Practice turning aluminum bar stock into basic parts.

prac_machining_lathe_steel.name: lathe turning (steel)
prac_machining_lathe_steel.description: Practice turning steel bar stock into basic parts.

prac_machining_mill_steel.name: vertical milling (steel)
prac_machining_mill_steel.description: Practice various milling techniques using steel bar stock.

prac_machining_mill_aluminum.name: vertical milling (aluminum)
prac_machining_mill_aluminum.description: Practice various milling techniques using aluminum bar stock.

prac_health_care_beg.name: bandaging (beginner)
prac_health_care_beg.description: Practice bandaging imaginary wounds while making sure your bandage won't fall off during activities.

prac_health_care_int.name: bandaging (advanced)
prac_health_care_int.description: Practice bandaging different limbs and less accessible parts of your body using both hands and each of your hands alone.

prac_mechanics_basic_hydraulics.name: basic mechanics - hydraulics
prac_mechanics_basic_hydraulics.description: Practice basic mechanics by using a pre-Cataclysm edutainment set.  Learn about hydraulics.

prac_mechanics_basic_robotics.name: basic mechanics - robotics
prac_mechanics_basic_robotics.description: Practice basic mechanics by using a pre-Cataclysm edutainment set.  Learn about robots.

prac_mechanics_basic_engine.name: basic mechanics - engines
prac_mechanics_basic_engine.description: Practice basic mechanics by using a pre-Cataclysm edutainment set.  Learn about engines.

prac_melee_beg.name: melee (beginner)
prac_melee_beg.description: Swing around a weapon-shaped object to try and get a feel for what fighting might be like.  It's difficult without any instruction to guide you, but hopefully this practice will help you to swing at your enemies without falling on your face or panicking too much.

prac_melee_int.name: melee (intermediate)
prac_melee_int.description: Practice the basics of combat with the guidance of a manual or prior knowledge.  Even without a sparring partner you can practice your footwork, form, and flow drills to help avoid overswinging and stumbling.

prac_cutting_beg.name: cutting (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg.description: Practice some of the basics of combat with cutting weapons, such as how to keep your edge lined up and how to not chop your own leg off.

prac_cutting_int.name: cutting (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int.description: Practice your edge alignment and cutting form by slashing soaked rolled-up paper on a stand.  It's not quite tatami mats but you don't have the luxury of historical accuracy.

prac_bashing_beg.name: bashing (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg.description: Practice the basics of fighting with bludgeons, both purpose-made and impromptu.  Learn how to apply your leverage, maximize kinetic energy, and to swing for the fences without tearing your shoulder out of its socket.

prac_bashing_int.name: bashing (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int.description: Practice the handling of very top-heavy and weighty bludgeons.  Learn how to swing fast, accurately, with force, and without throwing yourself for a loop.  You'll need a reinforced training dummy to not break it into splinters with such heavy weaponry, though.

prac_dancing.name: dancing
prac_dancing.description: Practice some dancing moves with your imaginary partner.

prac_dodge_beg.name: dodge (beginner)
prac_dodge_beg.description: Practice your dodging with some side hops, backsteps, and maybe a somersault or two to learn why you shouldn't somersault in a fight.  Without someone attacking you to actually dodge all you can practice is footwork, but hopefully it'll help prevent you tripping over your shoelaces in a panic.

prac_unarmed_beg.name: unarmed (beginner)
prac_unarmed_beg.description: Do a bit of shadowboxing as practice just in case you're left without a weapon versus the undead.  There's not much you can learn without someone to correct your mistakes, though.

prac_unarmed_int.name: unarmed (intermediate)
prac_unarmed_int.description: Learn how to throw a punch with the help of a punching bag or training dummy.

prac_cutting_beg_long_sword.name: long swords (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_long_sword.description: Drill the fundamentals of using a longsword.

prac_cutting_int_long_sword.name: long swords (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_long_sword.description: Hone your skills with a longsword against a dummy.

prac_cutting_beg_great_sword.name: great swords (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_great_sword.description: Practice swinging your great sword against an imaginary opponent.

prac_cutting_int_great_sword.name: great swords (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_great_sword.description: Practice using your sword's momentum to your advantage against a dummy.

prac_cutting_beg_bionic_sword.name: bionic swords (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_bionic_sword.description: Get a feel for the weight, balance, and length of your bionic sword.

prac_cutting_int_bionic_sword.name: bionic swords (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_bionic_sword.description: Practice fighting with your bionic sword against a dummy.

prac_cutting_beg_great_axe.name: great axes (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_great_axe.description: Drill keeping the proper form while swinging a heavy axe.

prac_cutting_int_great_axe.name: great axes (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_great_axe.description: Engage in advanced exercises and drills using a heavy axe.

prac_cutting_beg_hand_axe.name: hand axes (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_hand_axe.description: Practice your chopping motions against an imaginary assailant.

prac_cutting_int_hand_axe.name: hand axes (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_hand_axe.description: Practice advanced methods of using a hand axe in combat, such as pommel strikes and backswings.

prac_bashing_beg_great_hammer.name: great hammers (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_great_hammer.description: Work on handling the weight of your great hammer while swinging it.

prac_bashing_int_great_hammer.name: great hammers (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int_great_hammer.description: Practice your strikes with a great hammer, crushing the dummy without throwing yourself off balance.

prac_bashing_beg_flail.name: flails (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_flail.description: Practice swinging a flail around and drill your endurance by keeping your flail in motion for long periods of time.

prac_bashing_int_flail.name: flails (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int_flail.description: Refine your understanding of the fine art of crushing skulls with a flail and a dummy.

prac_bashing_beg_mace.name: maces (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_mace.description: Work at swinging a mace around and making it land where you want.

prac_stabbing_beg_spear.name: spears (beginner)
prac_stabbing_beg_spear.description: Practice the basics of spears, the most popular melee weapon throughout history.  Learn the footwork, how to thrust with power, where to place your hands, and the right way to hold the damn thing.  Dominant hand back, non-dominant forward!

prac_stabbing_int_spear.name: spears (intermediate)
prac_stabbing_int_spear.description: Practice advanced spear moves and accurate thrusts against a training dummy.  It's not glamorous, but spears were the workhorses of armed combat for millennia with good reason.

prac_stabbing_beg_thrust.name: long thrusting swords (beginner)
prac_stabbing_beg_thrust.description: Practice switching between different ways of gripping your sword.

prac_stabbing_int_thrust.name: long thrusting swords (intermediate)
prac_stabbing_int_thrust.description: Drill yourself in using your sword as a thrusting weapon against a dummy.

prac_bashing_beg_rifle.name: rifle CQC (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_rifle.description: Practice striking with your long gun.

prac_bashing_int_rifle.name: rifle CQC (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int_rifle.description: Practice your muzzle thump and buttstroke against a dummy.

prac_bashing_beg_pistol.name: pistol CQC (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_pistol.description: Practice safely swinging your pistol around like a club.

prac_bashing_int_pistol.name: pistol CQC (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int_pistol.description: Pistol whip a dummy repeatedly until you've got it down.

prac_stabbing_beg_knife.name: knives (beginner)
prac_stabbing_beg_knife.description: Practice the brutal art of shanking the shit out of something until it dies.  Learn the form, where and how to stab to avoid your knife glancing off bone, and whether you should actually hold the knife in reverse grip.  (It depends.)

prac_stabbing_int_knife.name: knives (intermediate)
prac_stabbing_int_knife.description: Get in touch with your inner commando and practice some advanced knife-fighting techniques on a training dummy.

prac_stabbing_beg_shiv.name: shivs (beginner)
prac_stabbing_beg_shiv.description: You wouldn't think it, but there is more to stabbing someone with something small and pointy.  Practice shanking an imaginary enemy where it hurts most.

prac_stabbing_int_shiv.name: shivs (intermediate)
prac_stabbing_int_shiv.description: Practice shanking the ever living hell out of a dummy to hone your accuracy and grip while you gut someone.

prac_bashing_beg_baton.name: batons (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_baton.description: Practice the basics of using a baton or small club in combat.

prac_bashing_int_baton.name: batons (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int_baton.description: Train your backswing, overhead strike, and up strike against a dummy.

prac_cutting_beg_med_sword.name: medium swords (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_med_sword.description: Footwork is key, practice dancing around an imaginary opponent with your sword.

prac_cutting_int_med_sword.name: medium swords (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_med_sword.description: Perform solo drills to practice advanced techniques, such as feints and moulinet cuts.

prac_cutting_beg_short_sword.name: short swords (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_short_sword.description: Practice putting your weight behind your strike, cutting through an imaginary enemy.

prac_cutting_int_short_sword.name: short swords (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_short_sword.description: Practice drills in delivering quick and precise strikes against a dummy.

prac_bashing_beg_staff.name: quarterstaves (beginner)
prac_bashing_beg_staff.description: Practice swinging your staff, getting used to the balance and weight.

prac_bashing_int_staff.name: quarterstaves (intermediate)
prac_bashing_int_staff.description: Practice using your staff against a dummy, familiarizing yourself with its length.

prac_stabbing_beg_fencing.name: fencing (beginner)
prac_stabbing_beg_fencing.description: Practice the basics of the noble art of fencing.  Learn how to angle your body, aim your lunges, and parry pretend swords.  Not that the undead are using swords.  Hopefully.

prac_stabbing_int_fencing.name: fencing (intermediate)
prac_stabbing_int_fencing.description: Further develop your footwork and timing by fighting against a dummy.  En garde!

prac_cutting_beg_claw.name: claw weapons (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_claw.description: Practice the basics of fighting with a clawed weapon by shadowboxing while using them.

prac_cutting_int_claw.name: claw weapons (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_claw.description: Practice your strikes against a dummy, focusing on speed, accuracy, and power.

prac_cutting_beg_hooking.name: hooking weapons (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_hooking.description: Practice tripping an imaginary enemy with the hook of your weapon in between swings.

prac_cutting_int_hooking.name: hooking weapons (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_hooking.description: Train by hooking a dummy and knocking it to the ground while practicing your footwork.

prac_stabbing_beg_polearm.name: polearms (beginner)
prac_stabbing_beg_polearm.description: Practice slicing and stabbing with your polearm against an imaginary opponent.

prac_stabbing_int_polearm.name: polearms (intermediate)
prac_stabbing_int_polearm.description: Perform solo exercises against a dummy to train your distance management and endurance with a polearm.

prac_cutting_beg_bionics.name: bionic weapons (beginner)
prac_cutting_beg_bionics.description: Perform basic fighting drills to learn to fight with your new bionic weapons.

prac_cutting_int_bionics.name: bionic weapons (intermediate)
prac_cutting_int_bionics.description: Drill advanced methods of using your bionic weapons, with the help of a dummy.

prac_whipping_beg.name: whips (beginner)
prac_whipping_beg.description: Practice the basics of fighting with whips by swinging one around.  Familiarize yourself with the length and accuracy of your unwieldy choice of weapon.

prac_whipping_int.name: whips (intermediate)
prac_whipping_int.description: Improve your accuracy with a whip by attempting to extinguish a candle without damaging the wax.

prac_throw_beg.name: throwing (beginner)
prac_throw_beg.description: Practice your throwing by throwing something and trying to hit a spot on the wall.

prac_archery_beg.name: archery (beginner)
prac_archery_beg.description: Practice firing unfletched arrows at a spot on the wall.

prac_crossbow_beg.name: crossbows (beginner)
prac_crossbow_beg.description: Practice firing unfletched bolts at a spot on the wall.

prac_archery_int.name: archery (intermediate)
prac_archery_int.description: Practice the best ways of firing fletched arrows into a target.  Requires a decent quality bow.

prac_crossbow_int.name: crossbows (intermediate)
prac_crossbow_int.description: Practice the best ways of firing fletched bolts into a target.  Requires a decent quality crossbow.

prac_archery_form.name: expert archer's form
prac_archery_form.description: Improve your archery form by quickly and smoothly drawing a bowstring.

prac_master_archery_form.name: master archer's form
prac_master_archery_form.description: Refine your archery form by drawing and holding a heavy bow.

prac_marksmanship_beg.name: marksmanship (beginner)
prac_marksmanship_beg.description: Practice your shooting by dry firing a gun.

prac_handguns_beg.name: handguns (beginner)
prac_handguns_beg.description: Practice your shooting by using a set of practice targets and a laser aiming module.

prac_rifles_beg.name: rifles (beginner)
prac_rifles_beg.description: Practice your shooting by using a set of practice targets and a laser aiming module.

prac_shotgun_beg.name: shotguns (beginner)
prac_shotgun_beg.description: Practice your shooting by using a set of practice targets and a laser aiming module.

prac_smg_beg.name: submachine guns (beginner)
prac_smg_beg.description: Practice your shooting by using a set of practice targets and a laser aiming module.

prac_launch_beg.name: launchers (beginner)
prac_launch_beg.description: Use a compressed air launcher to safely practice aiming trajectories.

prac_speech_beg.name: social (beginner)
prac_speech_beg.description: Practice speaking in front of a mirror or in front of a device with a front-facing camera to improve your poise and eloquence and project confidence.

prac_speech_int.name: social (intermediate)
prac_speech_int.description: Practice advanced persuasion and negotiation techniques while acting out both sides of a dialogue in front of a mirror or in front of a device with a front-facing camera to improve your poise and eloquence and project confidence.

prac_unmute_bird.name: relearn ape chirps
prac_unmute_bird.description: Debase your beautiful new voice with trying to imitate human speech.  Still more enjoyable than trying to make them sing, in any case.

prac_unmute_ceph.name: relearn human speech
prac_unmute_ceph.description: Your mantle struggles, and you need to contort your throat in ways that strain even your new, flexible form.  Still, having a shoal is preferable to going it alone.

prac_unmute_gastropod.name: relearn human speech
prac_unmute_gastropod.description: You don't have any teeth to stop airflow, and with your new tongue even closing your mouth feels unnaturally cramped.  However, rubbing different areas of your radula makes for an interesting cacophony - that might be a solution, if only you get the pitch just right.

prac_unmute_insect.name: relearn human speech
prac_unmute_insect.description: Maybe you could rub your chitin together?  No, the apes need their vowels.

prac_unmute_slime.name: relearn human speech
prac_unmute_slime.description: Couldn't you use some pheromones?  A packet of injected slime rewiring their brain?  Anything less demeaning than trying to ape the apes.

prac_knapping.name: basic knapping
prac_knapping.description: Practice basic knapping by hammering some rocks into rough shapes.

prac_knapping_speed.name: speed knapping
prac_knapping_speed.description: Practice more advanced knapping by shaping some rocks into precise forms and shapes.

prac_knitting.name: knitting
prac_knitting.description: Practice knitting whatever comes to your mind, from simple forms to elaborate and rich designs.

effect.u_message: You admire your designs and find happiness in your advancements in the field of knitting.

false_effect.u_message: You contemplate your designs but fail to see any artistic value in them.  At least you learnt something.

prac_closures.name: garment closures
prac_closures.description: Practice the principles of garment closures by sewing some buttons and similar fasteners to some cotton patches.

prac_closures_waterproofing.name: fabric waterproofing
prac_closures_waterproofing.description: Practice the principles of sealing garments and fabric against water by making a basic waterproof layer from plastic sheets duct taped together, you will need some water and a rag.

prac_polymerworking.name: advanced polymer sewing
prac_polymerworking.description: Practice cutting and sewing together advanced polymers like Kevlar or Nomex.

prac_elastics.name: stretch fabric
prac_elastics.description: Practice the use of stretch fabric in clothing by making and modifying some basic garment forms with Lycra patches.

prac_quilting.name: fabric quilting
prac_quilting.description: Practice the beautiful art of quilting by efficiently sewing a pair of padded sheets together in different patterns.

prac_leather_beg.name: leatherworking (beginner)
prac_leather_beg.description: Practice basic leatherworking skills by cutting and punching holes in leather, and stitching together leather patches.

prac_leather_adv.name: leatherworking (advanced)
prac_leather_adv.description: Practice the correct cut and sewing of big leather patches in clothing making, using your knowledge to give it practical forms.

prac_chitinworking.name: chitinworking
prac_chitinworking.description: Practice the use of chitin as an armor component by shaping and attaching several pieces together.

prac_articulation.name: joint articulation
prac_articulation.description: Practice the making of articulated joints in clothing by sewing some gloves and other basic cloth joints with several layers of cotton patches for rigidity.

constr_glass_wall_door.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_metal_gate.pre_note: Must be between ordinary, concrete, brick, or rock walls to function, and at least one wall must have an adjacent mechanical winch.

constr_chaingate.pre_note: Needs to be supported on both sides by fencing, walls, etc.

constr_chickenwire_gate.pre_note: Needs to be supported on both sides by fencing, walls, etc.

constr_palisade_gate.pre_note: Must be between palisade walls to function, and at least one wall must have an adjacent rope & pulley system.

constr_screen_door.pre_note: Needs to be supported on both sides by fencing, walls, etc.

constr_screened_porch_wall.pre_note: Needs to be supported on both sides by fencing, walls, etc.

constr_dirtfloor.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_floor.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_floor_primitive.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_jackhammer_resin_cage.pre_note: Your power tool is effective at cutting through the resin cage, but it's still a hard process.  Mi-go structures are dangerously hot -- you'll likely need to take breaks outside.

constr_mine_resin_cage.pre_note: This is a slow, hard process that could be accelerated with power tools.  Mi-go structures are dangerously hot -- you'll likely need to take breaks outside.

constr_scrap_floor.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_metal_gangway.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_wooden_gangway.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_stooking_spot.pre_note: Mark a spot to stack cut grain for drying outdoors.  Once placed, put unrotten undried grain stalks on the stooking spot and examine it to get started.

constr_training_dummy_heavy.pre_note: Needs diggable terrain to secure it.

constr_training_dummy_light.pre_note: Needs diggable terrain to secure it.

constr_hammock.pre_note: Can be deconstructed without tools.  Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_hammock_net.pre_note: Can be deconstructed without tools.  Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_hanging_meathook.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_rope_tackle_hoist_supported.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_brick_oven_finisher.pre_note: Carve a thick wooden door for the brick oven.

constr_brick_oven_finisher_metal.pre_note: Weld together a metal door for the brick oven.

constr_rootcellar.pre_note: You need a deep pit to construct a root cellar.

constr_mechanical_winch.pre_note: Must be adjacent to ordinary, concrete, brick, or rock wall that is itself adjacent to a metal gate in order to open said gate.

constr_palisade_pulley.pre_note: Can be deconstructed without tools.  Must be adjacent to a palisade wall that is itself adjacent to a palisade gate in order to open said gate.

constr_palisade_pulley_wood.pre_note: Can be deconstructed without tools.  Must be adjacent to a palisade wall that is itself adjacent to a palisade gate in order to open said gate.

constr_deconstruct_simple.pre_note: Certain terrain and furniture can be deconstructed without any tools.

constr_crafting_spot.pre_note: Mark a spot for crafting.  Crafting tasks next to this tile will automatically use this location instead of attempting to craft in your hands, with the usual crafting speed penalty for working on the ground.  Does not prevent using a proper workbench, if available.  Deconstruct or smash to remove.

constr_firewood_source.pre_note: Firewood or other flammable materials on a nearby tile marked in this way may be used to automatically refuel fires.  This will be done to maintain light during long-running tasks that require it such as crafting or reading, but not (for example) if you are simply waiting nearby.

constr_practice_target.pre_note: Mark a spot for target practice.  Firing will automatically target the first practice target location found in gun range, if no enemies are around.

constr_brick_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_concrete_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_flat_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_log_sod_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_metal_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_metal_flat_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_resin_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_shingle_flat_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_thatched_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_treated_wood_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_wood_roof.pre_note: Must be supported directly from below or on at least two sides.  May need a 'room' supporting a roof directly below.

constr_glass_wall.pre_note: Must be supported on at least two sides.

constr_concrete_ramp_high.pre_note: Build a concrete ramp leading to the next z-level above, and the corresponding ramp down leading from the z-level above to this level.  It must be built next to a low end of a ramp to allow moving between z-levels in both directions.

constr_concrete_ramp_low.pre_note: Build a concrete ramp leading to the next z-level above, and the corresponding ramp down leading from the z-level above to this level.  The high end of a ramp must be built adjacent to allow moving between z-levels in both directions.

constr_earth_ramp_high.pre_note: Build an earth ramp leading to the next z-level above, and the corresponding ramp down leading from the z-level above to this level.  It must be built next to a low end of a ramp to allow moving between z-levels in both directions.

constr_earth_ramp_low.pre_note: Build an earth ramp leading to the next z-level above, and the corresponding ramp down leading from the z-level above to this level.  The high end of a ramp must be built adjacent to allow moving between z-levels in both directions.

constr_scaffolding_pipe_up.pre_note: Constructs scaffolding on the tile and provides a platform on the Z level above.

remove_scaffolding_pipe_down_above_updow.pre_note: Removes down scaffolding from directly above the construction tile.

boating_license.name: Boating License
boating_license.description: You've trained in how to pilot marine craft, as well as general boating and swimming safety.

driving_license.name: Driving License
driving_license.description: You got your driving license and know how to drive a car, change the oil and tires, and other basics.

simple_home_cooking.name: Simple Home Cooking
simple_home_cooking.description: You've been living on your own long enough that you know how to cook basic dishes and feed yourself.

computer_literate.name: Computer Literate
computer_literate.description: Either through school, your job, or from your family, you've learned the basics of how to use a computer.

social_skills.name: Social Skills
social_skills.description: You've spent a significant portion of your life living among other people and are familiar with social norms.  You know how to talk with other people, and how to convey your emotions and understand those of others.

high_school_graduate.name: High School Graduate
high_school_graduate.description: You've graduated from high school and thus know a little bit about applied science and electronics.

mundane_survival.name: Mundane Survival
mundane_survival.description: You've managed to survive modern life in a first world country.  Through your ordeals you've learned how to treat scrapes and bruises, and how to assemble basic furniture.

heroin_addict.name: Heroin Dependence
heroin_addict.description: The last thing you remember was meeting God behind the local Foodplace.  Then people started eating each other.  This doesn't feel like a fever dream.

smoker.name: Nicotine Dependence
smoker.description: Your coworkers always muttered when you had to duck outside every hour for a smoke, but it ended up saving your life when things got bad.  You'll need to find a steady supply of nicotine if you want to keep the cravings at bay.

crackhead.name: Crack Cocaine Dependence
crackhead.description: Cocaine.  It is, indeed, a helluva drug.  You blew your money on some rocks, and before you knew it you were turning tricks behind the local pharmacy just to score a little more.  Where are you going to get your fix now?

benzos_addict.name: Sedative Dependence
benzos_addict.description: You got hooked on dangerous sedative medication.  Or, maybe a prescription spiraled out of control.  Either way, it's time to face the music.  Maybe you can wean yourself off, assuming a zombie doesn't get you first…

tweaker.name: Amphetamine Dependence
tweaker.description: You're not entirely sure what happened last night, but you woke up on the floor and everything has completely gone to shit.  The only thing running through your head, though, is where you're gonna find your next hit.

pillhead.name: Painkiller Dependence
pillhead.description: After a bad accident, you became hooked on the opiates prescribed to you for the pain.  With the pharmacies shut down and your dealers turned undead, satisfying those cravings just got a lot more difficult.

alcoholic.name: Alcohol Dependence
alcoholic.description: One drink became two, two became too many, and before long you were only able to find solace at the bottom of a bottle.  God-damn, you need a drink.

sleepingpillhead.name: Sleeping Pill Dependence
sleepingpillhead.description: You'd been having trouble falling asleep, so you started taking prescription sleep meds.  Now you can hardly seem to fall asleep at all without them, and you'll need plenty of rest to face the days ahead.

caffiend.name: Caffeine Fiend
caffiend.description: Caffeine gave you life and without it you are nothing.  Your dependence upon it was so extreme that you can barely function in its absence and you've done lasting psychological harm to yourself.  You'd better find a steady supply, and fast.

caffeine_junkie.name: Caffeine Dependence
caffeine_junkie.description: Coffee was your faithful companion every morning, and without it you feel like a zombie.  Thanks to all the actual zombies shambling about, getting your caffeine fix will be much harder now.

cosplay.name: Cosplay
cosplay.description: You liked to make your own costumes and wear them to various conventions.  Now that everyone is dead or dying, maybe this will be useful for something else.

lockpicking.name: Lockpicking (Beginner)
lockpicking.description: Whether it was for fun, innocent utility, or criminal intent, you learned the basics of how to silently pick locks.  Now, being able to get into secured places just got a lot more useful.

lockpicking_expert.name: Lockpicking (Expert)
lockpicking_expert.description: Maybe you're a certified locksmith, a career burglar, or an intense hobbyist.  Regardless, you've spent so long picking locks you could pop most open in under a minute easy, with the right tools.

parkour.name: Parkour
parkour.description: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.

camping.name: Camping
camping.description: You enjoyed camping in the vast wilderness as a means of escaping the pace of modern life.  The wilderness isn't filled with people, so it must be safe.  Right?  It must be.

bushcraft.name: Bushcraft
bushcraft.description: You take camping to a whole new level.  You have spent nights and weekends surviving in the wild with just a knife to aid you.  Maybe this skill for self-sufficiency can keep you safe.

hobby_heli_pilot.name: Piloting
hobby_heli_pilot.description: You're probably one of the last people alive who knows how to safely operate a flying vehicle.  It remains to be seen whether you'll live long enough to make use of that skill.

loves_books.name: Reading
loves_books.description: You love reading, but you never seemed to have enough time.  Maybe the Cataclysm is a blessing in disguise.

chem_cooking.name: Chemical Cooking
chem_cooking.description: Perhaps you produced illicit chemicals for your own consumption, or to sell to others.  Or maybe you're just a real nerd about chemistry.  In any case, you know your way around a Periodic Table.

archery.name: Archery (Beginner)
archery.description: You've used a bow before and maybe taken a class or two.  You won't be pulling off any trick shots but at least you can usually get an arrow to fly forward instead of spinning off to the side.

archery_expert.name: Archery (Intermediate)
archery_expert.description: You enjoy nocking back an arrow and hearing it whistle through the air.  If you can get the proper gear together and stay on-target, you'll have a good, quiet alternative to using guns.

archery_master.name: Archery (Expert)
archery_master.description: You're a modern day Robin Hood and probably have hella back muscles.  Perhaps you're an Olympic archer in training or maybe you're descended from the longbowmen of old.  In either case, sniping zombie heads should be as easy as pinning apples to trees for you.

swimming_beginner.name: Swimming (Beginner)
swimming_beginner.description: You can swim.  Probably not very well, and you won't break any speed records, but, you CAN swim.

swimming.name: Swimming (Intermediate)
swimming.description: You're a strong swimmer, and you're pretty sure zombies aren't.  You can't swim forever, but it's certainly an advantage over the undead.

swimming_expert.name: Swimming (Expert)
swimming_expert.description: You're an excellent swimmer and may be part fish.  Plus, all that swimming has left you in great shape.  There aren't any zombie sharks in the water, right?

baseball_beginner.name: Baseball (Beginner)
baseball_beginner.description: You used to play baseball, occasionally.  Maybe you were on your school team growing up, but it was never a focus of yours.  Hopefully you can still remember how to use a bat when your life depends on it.

baseball.name: Baseball (Intermediate)
baseball.description: You got the stance, you got the grip, you got the game.  Swinging at a zombie's head is close enough to swinging at a baseball… right?

baseball_pitcher.name: Baseball Pitcher (Expert)
baseball_pitcher.description: You're accustomed to striking out poor batters at the plate and can probably throw a mean knuckleball.  Now you get to practice your fastball, but perhaps with rocks or grenades this time.

baseball_expert.name: Baseball (Expert)
baseball_expert.description: You didn't quite make it into the big leagues, but you were close.  Now it's time to go for the grand slam or you'll be dealing with worse than a strike out.

wrestling_beginner.name: Wrestling (Beginner)
wrestling_beginner.description: Maybe you've taken a few classes at a gym somewhere, or used to be on the youth team, or maybe you just liked to rough-house with your friends or family growing up.  You're not entirely unused to grappling, but you're hardly an expert.

wrestling.name: Wrestling (Intermediate)
wrestling.description: While not the type of wrestler to use folding chairs as weapons, you have experience wrasslin' and tusslin' with others out on the mat.  There's no referees around to see, but hopefully your skills will help you avoid getting pinned by the undead.

wrestling_expert.name: Wrestling (Expert)
wrestling_expert.description: You were likely on the 100+ wins list back in school and maybe you're a collegiate wrestler or you're using it as part of something like MMA.  Considering how grabby those zombies are, you should get plenty of use out of your skills.

vid_games.name: Video Gaming
vid_games.description: You loved immersing yourself in virtual worlds through video games.  Now you're faced with real survival horror, and no extra lives.

trapping.name: Trapping
trapping.description: You liked to trap little wild animals such as mice and other rodents.  This skill could be useful for working with more deadly devices, if you're creative enough.

dodgeball.name: Dodgeball
dodgeball.description: Dodging fast-moving balls as though your life depended on it was fun.  Dodging zombies isn't as fun, but your life certainly depends on it.

amateur_electronics.name: Electronic Tinkering
amateur_electronics.description: You found unexpected solace while soldering components to circuit boards.

diy_crafts.name: DIY Crafting (Intermediate)
diy_crafts.description: You spent much of your time making useful things out of bits and bobbles.

diy_crafts_expert.name: DIY Crafting (Expert)
diy_crafts_expert.description: Whether due to circumstances forcing ingenuity or just an unhealthy fascination with tinkering you're a certified MacGyver with a very wide range of fabrication knowledge.  You could probably make a functioning cannon out of a paper clip and some bubble gum.

cooking_beginner.name: Cooking (Beginner)
cooking_beginner.description: You can cook well enough that you didn't have to live on instant noodles and takeout, but you've only really learned the bare minimum.

cooking.name: Cooking (Intermediate)
cooking.description: You enjoyed cooking for yourself and others.  The grocery stores are closed for good, so you might need to start getting creative with your recipes.

cooking_expert.name: Cooking (Expert)
cooking_expert.description: You're an excellent chef capable of making delicious meals out of almost anything and have a wide array of culinary knowledge.  Sadly, the undead would rather eat you than your meals.

cheesemaking.name: Cheesemaking
cheesemaking.description: The art of producing the finest quality cheeses has been passed down through your family for generations.  How useful these skills will be in the apocalypse remains to *brie* seen.

canning_food.name: Home canning
canning_food.description: Whether it was something practiced in your family or something you took it up to extend the shelf life of your groceries, you know how to preserve produce and meat in cans or mason jars.  With the electricity down and refrigerators dead, saying your skills could come in handy is an understatement.

paintball.name: Paintball
paintball.description: Pretending to shoot at your friends has always been fun.  Now you can do it for real.

plinking.name: Plinking
plinking.description: You enjoyed target plinking with your airsoft pistol.  You're a good shot, but you'll need a real gun for it to matter.

skeet_shooting.name: Skeet Shooting
skeet_shooting.description: Where the skeet go, your shot follows.  Throw enough pellets downrange, and you'll at least hit something.

public_speaking.name: Public Speaking
public_speaking.description: You are an incredibly social individual, with the projection and vocabulary to make people listen.

street_fighting.name: Street Fighting (Intermediate)
street_fighting.description: You've been in quite a few fights in the street.  You can throw and dodge a punch better than most.

street_fighting_expert.name: Street Fighting (Expert)
street_fighting_expert.description: Maybe you're the muscle of some criminal gang, maybe you're a bouncer at a club, or maybe you're just a huge asshole.  You've constantly been getting into fights with strangers on the streets for most of your life, and somehow you ain't dead yet, so you must be doing something right.

knife_throwing.name: Knife Throwing
knife_throwing.description: You learned how to throw knives before the world ended, a skill that can be deadly in the right situation.

sewing.name: Sewing (Intermediate)
sewing.description: You are quite good at sewing torn clothes back together, and have even made your own clothes a few times.

sewing_expert.name: Sewing (Expert)
sewing_expert.description: Despite modern technology making career tailors obsolete you've spent much of your life hand-making clothing of all sorts, whether for historical purposes or to sell as artisanal goods.  Too bad you can't stitch the holes in reality closed.

fencing.name: Fencing (Intermediate)
fencing.description: You were in a fencing club, and you weren't too shabby with a saber.  If you can get your hands on a real sword, you'll be a formidable fighter.

fencing_expert.name: Fencing (Expert)
fencing_expert.description: You've spent so long practicing your fencing you wouldn't look out of place in the Renaissance dueling with ne'er-do-wells and rapscallions.  En Garde!

car_fan.name: Motorsports
car_fan.description: You're a big fan of cars and other things that go vroom, whether it's fixing them or driving them.  You may not be a professional, but you know your way around an engine.

racing.name: Racing
racing.description: You're a real speed demon in anything with an engine!  Pulling off hairpin turns at high speeds is a difficult skill to master but you can drift with the best of them.

kickboxing_beginner.name: Cardio Kickboxing
kickboxing_beginner.description: You've trained in non-combat kickboxing at a gym as a way to exercise.  While you were taught the moves, you've never sparred or fought anything more dangerous than a falling punching bag.  Whether you can remember your training when push kick comes to jab is up to you.

martial_training.name: Martial Arts
martial_training.description: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, or Pankration.

self_defense.name: Self-Defense
self_defense.description: You have taken some self-defense classes at a local gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Kickboxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.

shaolin.name: Shaolin Kung Fu
shaolin.description: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.

blackbelt_hobby.name: Black Belt
blackbelt_hobby.description: You've been doing martial arts for years and have earned the coveted black belt in a martial art of your choice.

melee_training.name: Melee Training (Intermediate)
melee_training.description: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Bōjutsu, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pencak Silat, or Sōjutsu.

melee_training_expert.name: Melee Training (Expert)
melee_training_expert.description: Despite firearms making traditional melee weapons largely obsolete, you have extensive experience fighting in hand-to-hand combat with tools of war.  Maybe it was full-contact HEMA or SCA sparring, or maybe you're just a badass commando with a machete.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Bōjutsu, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pencak Silat, or Sōjutsu.

gourmand.name: Fine Dining
gourmand.description: You loved going to all kinds of restaurants and experiencing everything the world of culinary arts had to offer.  Nowadays, those chefs are all dead, so it'll be up to you to recreate the joys of your past.

gourmand_alt.name: Competitive Eating
gourmand_alt.description: You were a professional eater before the Cataclysm and frequently participated in eating contests.  Thanks to your training, you can eat huge amounts of food without getting sick, and while eating forty hot dogs in ten minutes might not be too useful in the apocalypse, your fortitude might help you survive off food other survivors would pass over.

marathon_runner.name: Marathon Running
marathon_runner.description: You ran the Boston Marathon every year.  That conditioning should make you better equipped than most in avoiding the dead.

hates_books.name: Book Hating
hates_books.description: Reading is for nerds!  You've managed to make hatred of the written word a central part of your identity.  Or, perhaps, you have a barrier that makes books additionally challenging and frustrating for you.  Whatever the reason, boring books are more boring, and you can't have fun by reading books.

meatarian.name: Butchering
meatarian.description: You absolutely love meat, and dislike eating fruits and vegetables.  Your particular tastes have turned you into a decent amateur butcher.

vegetarian.name: Vegetarian Foraging
vegetarian.description: You have been a vegetarian for so long that eating meat makes you feel sick.  You like to supplement your diet with wild plants and mushrooms foraged in the woods.

skating.name: Skating
skating.description: You are skilled in maneuvering on skates.  You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while you're wearing rollerskates or rollerblades.

arts_and_crafts.name: Arts and Crafts
arts_and_crafts.description: You loved doing crafts at home.  Now, you might want to channel those skills into making more practical things.

car_rebuilding.name: Car Restoration
car_rebuilding.description: Spending time every weekend in your garage working on an old classic car was your favorite pastime.  You never finished the car, but at least you learned a little over the years.

trickster.name: Practical Jokes
trickster.description: Pranks and physical jokes are a passion of yours, from the setup right through to playing innocent at the end.

modelling.name: Modeling
modelling.description: You were deep into the fashion scene, keeping up on the latest trends and even modeling clothes yourself.  Having style and good looks is just as, if not more, important to you than practicality.

pottery.name: Pottery
pottery.description: You're a master of throwing on the potter's wheel, able to shape clay into whatever shape you need.

handloading.name: Handloading
handloading.description: You figured you could save money on ammo by learning to make your own.  Now that the factories are shut down, your abilities just went from handy to lifesaving.

game_mastering.name: Tabletop Gaming
game_mastering.description: As the Game Master, you've guided players' journeys through dungeons and fortresses.  Now, you're the last member of your party.

ham_radio_operator.name: Ham Radio
ham_radio_operator.description: You whiled your nights away using, building, and repairing old ham radios.  Now you have no one to talk to. But you won't give up hope, and maybe your electronics knowledge can help you somehow.

golfing.name: Golf
golfing.description: The backswing's a breeze, and your drive could get skulls into the green if you tried.

cyclist_beginner.name: Cyclist (Beginner)
cyclist_beginner.description: Whether through regular commuting, or just riding for the joy of it, you're no stranger to bicycles.

cyclist_intermediate.name: Cyclist (Intermediate)
cyclist_intermediate.description: You've shed gallons of sweat, and more than a little blood, riding the streets and trails as a cyclist.

cyclist_expert.name: Cyclist (Expert)
cyclist_expert.description: You've honed the fitness and form of a professional bicycle racer.  When you're riding, your wheels are like an extension of your body.

basketball_beginner.name: Basketball (Beginner)
basketball_beginner.description: You used to shoot some b-ball outside of the school… at least, until a couple of corpses who were up to no good started making trouble in your neighborhood.

basketball.name: Basketball (Intermediate)
basketball.description: Your ability to play point or post will beat the undead in overtime.

basketball_expert.name: Basketball (Expert)
basketball_expert.description: You can sink 3-pointers all day, and dribble around the most determined defenders.

football_beginner.name: Football (Beginner)
football_beginner.description: You'd occasionally play touch or flag football at the park, but never got too serious about it.

football.name: Football (Intermediate)
football.description: You're no stranger to throwing the ol' pigskin and taking a few tackles.  Hopefully your skills in dodging defenders will help you charge through the hordes of undead.

football_expert.name: Football (Expert)
football_expert.description: You played college ball, ya know.  You could have gone pro if the world hadn't ended.

soccer_beginner.name: Soccer (Beginner)
soccer_beginner.description: You used to kick a ball around with your friends, having fun together.  Though it may not be the case anymore.

soccer.name: Soccer (Intermediate)
soccer.description: Your fondness for the beautiful game shows with your flairs, skills and tackles.  Whether you can go past the backline of the undead is a question yet to be answered.

soccer_expert.name: Soccer (Expert)
soccer_expert.description: You were on trial at a professional club, ready to get a contract.  What a great opportunity for you, if only your coaches were still alive.

shooter_beginner.name: Shooting (Beginner)
shooter_beginner.description: You've been to a gun range once or twice and maybe took a firearm safety class.  At the very least, you're confident you can point the gun in the correct direction.

shooter.name: Shooting (Intermediate)
shooter.description: You liked going to the local gun range and shooting at some targets or blasting cans off of fence posts with a variety of firearms.  Maybe if you just imagine targets on those undead, this could help.

redcross.name: First Aid
redcross.description: You've got training and some experience in dealing with urgent injuries.  In the absence of any medical professionals, that'll have to do.

trap_shooting.name: Trap Shooting
trap_shooting.description: You loved the smell of gunsmoke and blowing ceramic discs out of the sky.  Your future will likely involve shooting things a little fleshier than clay pigeons.

back_yard_grilling.name: Backyard Grilling
back_yard_grilling.description: You enjoyed inviting the neighborhood to a backyard cookout on the weekends.  You, of course, were the grill master.

carpentry.name: Carpentry
carpentry.description: With enough time and materials, you could make a boat from scratch.  These undead can't swim, right?

luthier.name: Woodworking - Luthier
luthier.description: You've learned woodworking in the field of making musical instruments.  You'll be able to create musical instruments in the Cataclysm.

home_improvement.name: Home Improvement
home_improvement.description: You'd fix up any holes and appliances in your own home with nothing but your two hands and some elbow grease.  You did it to save money on repairmen, but now it seems you'll do it to save your life.

machinist_beginner.name: Machinist (Beginner)
machinist_beginner.description: You can cut metal, and drill holes without snapping your tools in the process.  At least the undead don't care about quality control.

fishing.name: Fishing
fishing.description: A quiet day at the lake would be a welcome break from the hordes.  Though, now that you think about it, the fish have been acting strangely vicious lately too.

gunsmithing.name: Home Gunsmithing
gunsmithing.description: You could have been the next Browning, if not for the those pesky corpses walking around.  It's time to test for accuracy.

roller_derby.description: Being able to body your way through the pack is always useful, whether your opponent is living or rotting.
roller_derby.name: Roller Derby

hockey.name: Roller Hockey
hockey.description: Your time in the rink has taught you that sometimes the best way forward is straight through whoever's trying to block you.

frying.name: Deep Frying
frying.description: You'd have been a hit at the county fair, but you're cooking for one now.

homebrewer.name: Homebrewing
homebrewer.description: Your white lightning could knock out an elephant, but you're drinking alone now.

coaching.name: Sports Coaching
coaching.description: They tore apart your team, but you're determined to keep the team spirit alive.

gardening.name: Gardening
gardening.description: Your green thumb will come in handy when the grocery stores are overrun.

ropemaking.name: Ropemaking
ropemaking.description: Your knots are strong, whether they're made from cloth or natural cordage.

backpacking.name: Backpacking
backpacking.description: You enjoyed trekking on long trails in nature with all your necessities strapped to your back.

trivia.name: Trivia
trivia.description: You loved learning and sharing interesting facts about many different topics.  None of them are useful anymore, but your strong memory certainly is.

scrapart.name: Scrap Art
scrapart.description: You spent hours welding discarded scrap into large and intricate designs.  Some said you were just welding junk into bigger junk.  You call it art.

moshing.name: Moshing
moshing.description: You went to loud concerts and spent your time in the mosh pits.  Now that everything's gone to hell, the whole world is your mosh pit.

fireperformance.name: Fire Performing
fireperformance.description: Whether you twirled, spun, juggled, or ate it, your manipulation of flaming objects was impressive and terrifying to behold.

socialdance.name: Social Dancing
socialdance.description: You loved meeting new people on the dance floor.  These zombies aren't terribly friendly, but they're ready to tango!

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.description: You make a habit of clearing your thoughts and finding your center, even amidst the chaos of the world.

vagabond.name: Vagabond
vagabond.description: Circumstance left you wandering the world, alone.  Now there is nothing to go back to, even if you wanted to.  Perhaps your experience in fending for yourself will prove useful in this new world.

unemployed.name: Survivor
unemployed.description: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.

obsolete_academic.name: Obsolete Academic
obsolete_academic.description: Be it algebraic structures or the social lives of finches, you devoted your life to lecturing others on something that won't keep you warm, intact, or fed in the coming days.

video_blogger.name: Video Blogger
video_blogger.description: You made a career out of creating and commentating video content and posting it on various platforms.  Now most of your fans are dead, alongside your equipment.  Maybe you didn't cultivate the most practical skillset through your career, but you have learned a thing or two about troubleshooting software and getting people to listen to you.

sheltered_survivor.name: Sheltered Survivor
sheltered_survivor.description: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter.  You've spent the past months eating canned food, reading books, and tinkering.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.

sheltered_militia.name: Sheltered Militia
sheltered_militia.description: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter with your collection of guns.  You've spent the past months eating canned food and practicing your aim.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.

tailor.name: Tailor
tailor.description: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live very long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.

chef.name: Chef
chef.description: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with your trusty butcher knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.description: You spent most of your adult life in a butcher shop.  Your trusty knife has seen many different creatures and you know how to butcher them.

churl.name: Churl
churl.description: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.

labtech.name: Lab Technician
labtech.description: Thanks to years of study and hard work in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of scientific inquiry.  Only one question remains: can you undo the very Cataclysm your colleagues helped create?

engineer_chem.name: Chemical Engineer
engineer_chem.description: You know your way around the periodic table and can name ten different industrial processes that involve any given chemical, but that did not prevent the prospect of employment from looking bleak for you.  Fortunately, the Cataclysm might just be the thing to save you from a dead end job.

mechanic.name: Home Mechanic
mechanic.description: You've always loved cars, and there's nothing like getting under the hood and fixing it yourself.  You've kept ahold of some handy tools for the job, and at least now you'll never want for parts.

engineer_mech.name: Mechanical Engineer
engineer_mech.description: You've always loved machines, and have extensively incorporated them into your career.  Not long after receiving your degree, you seem to be the one being subjected to a stress test, and it remains unclear if you will retain your structural integrity.

scoundrel.name: Scoundrel
scoundrel.description: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  How much longer will they hold out?

beekeeper.name: Beekeeper
beekeeper.description: You used to be a professional apiarist, building and maintaining beehives.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.

baseball_player.name: Baseball Player
baseball_player.description: You played with the local team.  You're the only one left, but now you can use your trusty bat for another purpose.  Home run!

basketball_player.name: Basketball Player
basketball_player.description: Your first major game was abruptly canceled when zombies stormed the court.  Quick feet and good reflexes meant you were among the lucky few to escape the stadium alive.

football_player.name: Football Player
football_player.description: Your epic touchdown was ruined when your coach's guts were torn out by undead fans.  Now you're first pick in the apocalypse draft.

true_foodperson.name: True Foodperson
true_foodperson.description: You are the true Foodperson.  Some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  The mask has become your face, you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

cyclist.name: Professional Cyclist
cyclist.description: You were a promising cyclist with a bright career in front of you before this all happened.  Perhaps you'll never get to participate in the grand tours now, but as the saying goes, life is like riding a bicycle: you've got to keep moving.

major-general.name: Major General
major-general.description: You worked your way up through the ranks from a no-name private to a big shot major general, respected and decorated.  On the downside, years of desk duty have left your shooting skills rusty, and all the medals in the world won't protect you now.

marine.description: You are one of the few and the proud: a member of the US Marine Corps.  Now that military command has collapsed in on itself as far as you can tell, you suppose that it falls to you to carry the memory of the Corps forward into the future.  Semper fi.

sailor.name: Navy Sailor
sailor.description: You're a sailor of the US Navy, and spent the last few years working shipside aboard an aircraft carrier.  Though you're trained in combat, maintenance of the vessel has been your primary duty.  After some event beyond your understanding, the carrier has become a floating graveyard in the middle of nowhere.  This is going to take more than a cup of coffee and a monkey wrench to fix.

diver_navy.name: Navy Diver
diver_navy.description: You were a member of a Naval Special Warfare diving group, a skilled soldier adept at underwater infiltration and marine combat.  You were suiting up for a practice dive when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on was somehow flung from the Yellow Sea to who knows where.  You seem to be the only one who survived with your sanity intact, but it's not safe to stay here.  At least you're already dressed to abandon ship.

veteran.name: Military Veteran
veteran.description: After being discharged from the armed forces, you were sent to a veterans' hospital for treatment.  Just when you thought you'd overcome your traumas and readjusted to civilian life, the world has come to an end and your worst nightmare has become a reality: life in an endless battlefield.

recruit.name: Military Recruit
recruit.description: Joining the military has been your dream for years.  You finally got in, just in time for your training to get interrupted by some sort of national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.

combat-mechanic.name: Combat Mechanic
combat-mechanic.description: Early in your military career, you were hand-picked for extra training in the mechanic's trade, keeping the armor running.  It's been years since you last touched a rifle, and the dead men are marching again…

combat-engineer.name: Combat Engineer
combat-engineer.description: Your job was simple: Keep the army moving.  You built bridges, you built roads, you destroyed fortifications, and you cleared mines.  It has been years since you last handled a rifle in basic training; now might be the time to dust off those skills.

nco.name: Non-Commissioned Officer
nco.description: You're a veteran of several peacekeeping missions.  You led your squad as a sort of parental figure, and they relied on you to give orders and keep them alive.  You failed them.  And now you're alone.

rifleman.name: Rifleman
rifleman.description: When you were young, you dreamed of being a soldier.  War is hell and hell is war, but you never thought it would be this bad.

seal_sniper.name: Navy SEAL Marksman
seal_sniper.description: Recruited into the ranks of the US Navy's Special Warfare forces as a designated sniper, your training in precision marksmanship and maritime operations was extensive.  As a proficient soldier and combative in all respects, you provided overwatch and long-range elimination services in the line of duty.  Now, with naval command imploding and your spotter MIA, your skills with a rifle and covert operations are the only things standing between you and the Cataclysm.

seal.name: Navy SEAL
seal.description: You were a member of the SEALs; a key component of the US Navy's special forces and a proficient combatant in both maritime and ground operations.  'The only easy day was yesterday', and with the chain of command in ruins, you may fulfill your final mission in any way you see fit.

specops.name: Special Operator
specops.description: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.

maid.description: You were hired to take care of the housekeeping for a wealthy family.  Naturally, when things got bad, they all took off on a family vacation to somewhere unknown, leaving you to your fate.

captive.description: You were following a road at night, trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  You followed, hoping they were friendly, but suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in this strange place… are you even on Earth anymore?

rescuer.description: You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  Now the atmosphere in these twisting corridors grows heavy, and you don't feel quite so confident anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue soon.

medic.name: Medical Resident
medic.description: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience and just a handful of first-aid supplies.  You just hope it will be enough if 'physician, heal thyself' turns out to be more literal than you expected.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: You were a patient-facing doctor practicing general or specialized medicine.  While your bedside manner might not get you far in this new world, your medical skills will certainly help.

pharmacist.name: Pharmacist
pharmacist.description: You were a pharmacist working in a community pharmacy.  No simple pill-pusher, you have a plethora of knowledge of drug preparation, biochemistry, and biology.  With your trusty mortar and pestle, you hope to grind the undead to a pulp.

gangster.name: Gangster
gangster.description: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  Shame he got himself smoked.  No problem; the world's always got a place for someone with your kind of talents.

security.name: Security Guard
security.description: You had a boring, underpaid job watching cameras and patrolling hallways, but things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous.  You have some useful equipment, but you've never had any call to use it until now.

groundskeeper.name: Landscaper
groundskeeper.description: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left except your tools and expertise.

homemaker.name: Nursing Assistant
homemaker.description: You went on providing in-home care for the elderly even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…

survivalist.name: Survivalist
survivalist.description: Living off the land, far from civilization, is nothing new to you.  The only difference is all the monsters that suddenly want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile… except that your canteen's run out!

homeless.name: Hobo
homeless.description: Society drove you to the fringes and left you with no home, no family, no friends.  But for all the crap thrown your way, you're still breathing.  For now.

heli_pilot.name: Helicopter Pilot
heli_pilot.description: You got your pilot's license and earned a living ferrying businessmen and tourists around.  The Cataclysm has grounded you for now, but the sky still calls to you…

k9_cop.name: K9 Officer
k9_cop.description: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended, and none of that matters anymore.  Your loyal dog is still at your side, though, ready to face the Cataclysm with you.

horse_cop.name: Mounted Police Officer
horse_cop.description: You have spent many long years forging a bond with your equine companion, from running down common thugs, to entertaining kids when you ride on by.  The Cataclysm is upon you, but at least you have each other.

dog_lover.name: Dog Lover
dog_lover.description: You spent your days running around with your faithful dogs by your side.  When the world ended, you grabbed your companions along with some of their things to protect them.  The zombies could be nearby, but at least your canine friends won't have to worry about the rain.

crazy_cat_lady.description: Everyone is dead?  Oh well, it doesn't matter; it's not like you got along with people much anyway.  Your beloved cats are all the friends you need!

cop.name: Police Officer
cop.description: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to come to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even exist anymore?

detective.name: Police Detective
detective.description: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your latest homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now your prime suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You could really use a smoke.

swat.name: SWAT Officer
swat.description: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

swat_heavy.name: SWAT CQC Specialist
swat_heavy.description: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you were given special training and became an expert in close-quarters combat.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

sniper_police.name: Police Sniper
sniper_police.description: Your skill as a sharpshooter served you well in the line of duty, protecting the innocent with a single, well-placed bullet.  Now your own life is on the line, and you can't afford to miss if you don't want to end up as something's dinner.

riot_police.name: Riot Control Officer
riot_police.description: The riots were brutal, even before the dead rose and started to devour the living.  The line you were holding broke.  It was only through a bit of luck and a lot of head-bashing that you got away in one piece, and the worst is yet to come.

cop_motor.name: Motorized Police Officer
cop_motor.description: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to ride to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you had to abandon your motorcycle to escape.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents doesn't exist anymore?

salesman.description: They said you'd sell your own mother for a dollar.  How dare they!  You've been around the block a few times, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!

modern_archer.name: Modern Archer
modern_archer.description: A great fan of the archers of old, but at the same time a follower of the latest trends in archery.  You always tried to keep up with the times, acquiring a takedown bow as well as several accessories to complement it.  You can only hope all the training you did with them can help you survive in this trying times.

bow_hunter.name: Bow Hunter
bow_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and quickly developed a talent for archery.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

crossbow_hunter.name: Crossbow Hunter
crossbow_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and crossbow hunting was always your favorite.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty crossbow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along, though most of your bolts were lost during the escape.

shotgun_hunter.name: Shotgun Hunter
shotgun_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and one year you got a shotgun for your birthday.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

rifle_hunter.name: Rifle Hunter
rifle_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you fancy yourself a crack shot.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

conversion_hunter.name: Big-Bore Hunter
conversion_hunter.description: You always harbored a passion for hunting and a particular fondness for big-bore rifle calibers and affordable conversion kits.  Whether it was their cost-effective nature or the simple, testosterone-amplifying notion that you could retool your rifle to belt out .50-caliber bullets, you preferred them for your hunting trips.  Now, with your converted rifle in hand, you fancy that there isn't any game too large for you to take down.

hillbilly.description: You n' yer kin always figured shit would hit the fan some day, but never like this!  When they turned on you, you grabbed yer gun and a six pack, and hauled ass in the family truck.

construction_worker.description: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did plenty of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help rebuild?

trucker.name: Trucker
trucker.description: You once ruled the road in your big rig.  When the riots hit, you hopped in and drove it to safety.  Now it's just you and your truck against the world.

car_survivor.name: Rideshare Driver
car_survivor.description: You love driving, and decided to start making some money doing it.  On your way to pick up a customer, a riot broke out around you.  You took a long detour to safety, only to find yourself somewhere unfamiliar.

emt_firefighter.name: Paramedic Firefighter
emt_firefighter.description: On your way to respond to an emergency call, you nearly drove straight into a riot in the city.  Turning off of the burning, debris-covered streets, you took a long detour only to find yourself lost.  That call will have to wait - you're in an emergency of your own now.

handymanservice.description: Employed by a large company, you performed installation and troubleshooting services at the homes of ungrateful luddites.  Driving back from your last call, you were suddenly swarmed by what you believed to be angry rioters.  You veered off onto an old, neglected side road to escape, only to find yourself lost and low on gas.

bus_driver.name: Bus Driver
bus_driver.description: You made a living driving kids to and from school, a career choice you regretted almost every day.  None of the brats were at their normal stops, and the noise of your bus quickly attracted hordes of zombies.  You escaped, but now you've gotten lost.  At least you're getting a break from the hellish screams of children, though you're starting to hear new ones…

cop_car.name: Police Interceptor
cop_car.description: An on-duty officer, you received the call and were ready to respond to the robbery.  It all went to shit, your backup got eaten, and you were lucky to escape with your life and patrol car.

militia_car.name: Militia
militia_car.description: You and a group of like-minded individuals built a hideout in the woods from which to launch looting raids in a jury-rigged pickup.  The last run went bad, and now all your comrades are dead.  Every breath you take now is an act of rebellion against the cruelty of this doomed world.  Do not let that flame of hope perish inside you.

park_ranger.name: Park Ranger
park_ranger.description: Your days of patrolling the park and protecting people and wildlife from each other have taught you many useful skills.  After finding a gruesome scene at a campsite and getting no response when you radioed for help, you stockpiled as many supplies as possible and set out in your pickup looking for answers.

lumberjack.description: You have your trusty wood axe, and you're okay.  You felled trees before the world ended, and you suspect the undead aren't nearly as tough.
