fastfoodcook.name: Fast Food Cook
fastfoodcook.description: The diners at the fancy burger joint where you worked were even more irritable and unreasonable than usual today.  You showed them the meaning of fast food… by running for your life!

electrician.name: Electrician
electrician.description: Small businesses often hired you for electrical work.  You were halfway through your latest job when the whole power grid went dead.

engineer_ee.name: Electrical Engineer
engineer_ee.description: Fresh out of college, you were quite eager to get some practical engineering experience and leave your mark on the world, one solder joint at a time.  Now, you are not even sure if the complete failure of the power grid makes your field obsolete or all the more necessary.

hacker.name: Computer Hacker
hacker.description: Caffeine pills and all-nighters in front of a computer screen made you an expert at writing and cracking code.  The power's gone out, and suddenly your elite skills seem significantly less useful.  At least there's no one stopping you from your dream of breaking into a military mainframe now.

backpacker.name: Backpacker
backpacker.description: For the past few years you've been traveling the world, sightseeing and living off your parents' trust fund.  You came home to find the world in ruins, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.

student.name: Student
student.description: Just an average student, you find yourself facing a test you never studied for, and the stakes are a bit higher than geometry.  Maybe there'll be something useful in one of these books you've been lugging around all year.

svictim.name: Shower Victim
svictim.description: You just stepped out of a nice, hot shower to find the world had ended.  You've got some soap, along with the most massively useful thing ever… a towel.

biker.name: Biker
biker.description: You spent most of your life on a motorcycle, out on the open road with your club.  Now they're all dead.  Time to ride or die.

dancer.name: Ballroom Dancer
dancer.description: Things got a little weird on your way to your weekly dance class.  Zombies don't seem to know how to dance, but you're not about to let them step on your toes.

patient.name: Patient
patient.description: When the diagnosis came back positive, you made a vow: to fight for your life, and to never give in to despair.  Now is the time to renew that vow.

mutant_patient.name: Unwilling Mutant
mutant_patient.description: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.  You are determined to live on, if only to spite them for what they did to you.

mutant_volunteer.name: Volunteer Mutant
mutant_volunteer.description: Your dreams of becoming a mutant superhero through genetic alteration may have fallen a bit short, but the scientists say you're ready.  It's time for a field test.

hitchhiker.name: Hitchhiker
hitchhiker.description: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.description: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living selling your catches and running trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: You ran into trouble coming out of class at your community college's metalsmithing program, but despite the havoc you've managed to keep ahold of some of the equipment you were carrying.

jeweler.name: Jeweler
jeweler.description: You were an independent artisan, who made gorgeous rings and pendants for the people who afforded your services.  You doubt the market for your work has fared well after the end of the world, but perhaps your proficiency with fine tools and metals will come in handy somehow.

clown.description: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There are precious few balloon animals in your future now.

lost_sub.name: Lost Submissive
lost_sub.description: In the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own, with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there are no safewords in the apocalypse.

senior.name: Senior Citizen
senior.description: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.

otaku.name: Otaku
otaku.description: After many late nights with friends watching anime and eating snacks, you decided to make the trip to the premier anime convention in the Northeast.  Now zombies are eating everyone, and even worse, the convention is canceled!  At least you were ready in case your costume tore.

spouse.description: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!

punkrockgirl.description: All those wicked songs about the apocalypse have come to life.  Brutal!  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!

firefighter.name: Firefighter
firefighter.description: As a first responder, you were a direct witness to the gut-wrenching horrors of the apocalypse.  Separated from most of your equipment and your unit while on call, you were forced to fight your way to safety with little more than your trusty iron and your bunker gear to protect you.

skaboy.description: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie.  Now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.

postman.name: Mail Carrier
postman.description: Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays you from the swift completion of your appointed rounds, but nobody said anything about zombies.

convict.name: Convict
convict.description: Your trial was contentious, but ultimately you found yourself behind bars.  The Cataclysm has offered you a chance to escape, but freedom may come with a steep price.

hardened_convict.name: Hardened Convict
hardened_convict.description: Most of your adult life has been spent in prison doing hard time.  It's been rough but you've learned a few tricks to keep them on their toes.  Time to see how tough these zombies are.

death_row_convict.name: Death Row Convict
death_row_convict.description: You were a serial killer, ready to walk the green mile, but in a twist of fate you're one of the few still alive.  True death comes only from your hands, so you're in for a job.

convict_assassin.name: Undercover Assassin Convict
convict_assassin.description: You were given a target, a mission, but killing your mark seems to have become much more difficult now.  Your employer cut contact with you and now you have to make do with what you have.

convict_embezzler.name: Embezzler
convict_embezzler.description: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, but guess what?  They're dead, and you're not.

convict_drugs.name: Meth Cook
convict_drugs.description: You clawed your way out of poverty by selling products everyone wanted, and they had the nerve to put you in jail for it.  Too bad you can't sell drugs to zombies.

convict_political.name: Political Prisoner
convict_political.description: You did your best to expose what was going on in those labs, but they caught you and threw you in prison on trumped-up charges to silence you.  Clearly, they should have listened.

convict_ratman.description: You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.

burglar.name: Burglar
burglar.description: This could be your lucky break.  Plenty of loot to be pilfered, and no cops to be seen.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?

lawyer.name: Lawyer
lawyer.description: The jury were in the palm of your hand, but after the defendant tried to eat your brain, you were forced to flee the courtroom in disgrace.  Now nobody seems to care about your objections.

priest.name: Pastor
priest.description: Armageddon has come!  You did everything you could to protect your community, but it appears that prayers were not enough.  Now that they are all dead, you should probably find something more tangible to protect you.

c_priest.description: For your entire time as a servant of God, you helped, protected and listened to your parish faithful.  But these days, the Book of Revelation is starting to feel less metaphorical, and your parish turned against you.  Now all you can do is pray for the intercession of the saints.  Mary, Mother of God, pray for us!

shinto_priest.name: Kannushi
shinto_priest.description: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.

bhikkhu.description: Your life was simple at the Vihara, doing household chores and meditating.  Your Sangha wanted to attain liberation from suffering, now their rotting corpses will suffer forever.

imam.description: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you; now they come to eat your brains.

rabbi.name: Rabbi
rabbi.description: You were davening Shacharit in shul when the Cataclysm struck.  You had always taught that God will restore life to the dead after Moshiach has come, but not like this!

guru.name: Guru
guru.description: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.

preacher.name: Traveling Preacher
preacher.description: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast, and the undead don't seem particularly moved by your sermons.

blackbelt_novice.name: Novice Martial Artist
blackbelt_novice.description: You've decided today is the day to take your first lesson at the local dojo.  You'll be great at it, you're sure of it.

blackbelt_intermediate.name: Martial Artist
blackbelt_intermediate.description: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!

blackbelt.name: Black Belt
blackbelt.description: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.

pizzaboy.description: You were delivering the last pizza of the night to one of your common patrons when hungry zombies attempted to make a meal out of you.  Fleeing for safety, you find yourself with only your wits and some leftover pizza.  And they didn't even leave a tip!

paperboy.description: You set out this morning to deliver the news of the apocalypse.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.description: A patch of soil, some water, and sunlight were all you ever needed; why should things be any different now?  With a handful of seeds and your trusty hoe, it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.

national_guard.name: National Guardsman
national_guard.description: The government activated your National Guard unit to deal with the growing epidemics.  Despite your best efforts, you were unable to form up before all communications ceased and you found yourself alone among the dead.

winter_scavenger.name: Hardened Scavenger
winter_scavenger.description: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself amidst the ruins of civilization.  Whether through force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.

winter_army.name: Military Holdout
winter_army.description: You must have paid attention to your survival training in boot camp; otherwise, you would never have lived long enough to outlast the chain of command and find yourself in this predicament.  The only mission now is to survive.

mall_cop.name: Mall Security
mall_cop.description: You spent dull nights guarding the local mall against teen hooligans and petty thieves.  Your job training didn't provide any terribly useful skills, but you do have your trusty stun gun, baton, and pocket knife.

naturalist.name: Naturalist
naturalist.description: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.description: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.

description.male: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.
description.female: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.

description.male: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.
description.female: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.

skaterkid.description: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

skaterkid_board.description: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

jdelinquent.name: Juvenile Delinquent
jdelinquent.description: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.

jr_survivalist.name: Survivalist Jr.
jr_survivalist.description: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive.

dodgeball_player.name: Dodgeball Player
dodgeball_player.description: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.

science_club_mem.name: Science Club Member
science_club_mem.description: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.

av_club_mem.name: A/V Club Member
av_club_mem.description: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.description: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.

photojournalist.name: Photojournalist
photojournalist.description: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.

gym_teacher.name: Gym Teacher
gym_teacher.description: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.

miner.name: Miner
miner.description: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…

demolition_expert.name: Demolition Expert
demolition_expert.description: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.

parkour_practitioner.description: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running FOR your life.

tourist.name: Tourist
tourist.description: This seemed like a great place for a vacation, but you're starting to regret ever leaving home.  You came here to get a taste of New England, but New England keeps trying to get a taste of you!

naked.name: Naked and Afraid
naked.description: The apocalypse has caught you completely naked!  Maybe you were robbed, maybe you were at a nudist beach, or maybe you just enjoy the feeling of liberation brought by the wind touching your skin.  Whatever the reason, you lack clothes in a time when everyone wants a piece of you.

zoo_keeper.name: Zoo Keeper
zoo_keeper.description: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.

urban_samurai.name: Urban Samurai
urban_samurai.description: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, with your funny hair and odd Japanese clothes.  Little of this concerned you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.

fencer.name: Competitive Fencer
fencer.description: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.

politician.name: Career Politician
politician.description: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.

rancher.name: Rancher
rancher.description: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.

roadie.name: Roadie
roadie.description: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.

musician.name: Musician
musician.description: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.

kit_survivor.name: Kitted Survivor
kit_survivor.description: You saw a sign at the local mall advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now it's all you have.

gunslinger.name: Wild West Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.

frat.description: You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.

mil_marksman.name: Military Marksman
mil_marksman.description: You like to think of yourself as a sniper, but really you're just infantry with a bigger gun.  That said, a big gun is a definite advantage now.

mil_auto_rifleman.name: Military Automatic Rifleman
mil_auto_rifleman.description: You were trusted with a big-ass, belt-fed machine gun and plenty of ammo to lay down suppressing fire for your team.  Now that it's going to be much harder to resupply, you should probably be more selective with the ol' spray-and-pray.

mil_grenadier.name: Military Grenadier
mil_grenadier.description: There's no kill like overkill, and not many people in this world can boast that they have a grenade launcher and know how to use it.  Just try not to blow yourself up, that would be really embarrassing.

mil_breacher.name: Military Breacher
mil_breacher.description: Doors and windows everywhere dare not speak your name.  You're going to be breaking into buildings for supplies rather than combat operations now, but the principle is about the same.

mil_sniper.name: Military Sniper
mil_sniper.description: You're a crack shot with a rifle, and the farther you can stay away from zombies, the better.  The only thing stopping you is limited ammo, so you should try to find a place to restock sooner or later.

mil_hacker.name: Military Hacker
mil_hacker.description: 'Hacker' is a silly pop-culture name, popularized by Hollywood and people with little to no knowledge of what your job entails.  You prefer 'Electronic Warfare Specialist,' though nobody's really left to make the distinction.

mil_undercover.name: Undercover Operative
mil_undercover.description: You've been tailing your target for months, and now he's a zombie.  So much for that lead.  Command isn't responding to your calls for an evac, so you'll have to make do with what you have on you.

mili_pilot.name: Military Pilot
mili_pilot.description: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.

emt.name: EMT
emt.description: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.

paramedic.name: Paramedic
paramedic.description: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.

mili_medic.name: Combat Medic
mili_medic.description: You were on the front lines when everything happened, patching up the wounded and providing support.  But they wouldn't stop coming.  Now you're on your own.

relief_volunteer.name: Relief Volunteer
relief_volunteer.description: You were a member of a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping out where help was needed.  When the riots happened, you were eager to lend a hand.  But you had to cut your plans short when everyone was less interested in handouts, and more interested in eating you.

super_biker.description: You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!

hazmat_unit.name: Hazmat Unit
hazmat_unit.description: You were deployed to autopsy one of the rioters showing feral behavior before being put down.  When they got back up, you knew this was out of your pay grade.

local_drug_dealer.name: Drug Dealer
local_drug_dealer.description: You were about to make your biggest sale yet, but when you met the buyer he tried to bite you.  To top it off, it seems that this wasn't some sort of bad trip, as the whole town tried going for your throat too.

mafia_boss.name: Mafia Boss
mafia_boss.description: Born into poverty, you joined one of the organized crime families to make a living.  There, you quickly made it to the top and became the boss.  The government was building a RICO case against you, but doomsday arrived first.  Your crew is gone, but your past life has prepared you for a world where violence is common currency.

paranormal_investigator.name: Paranormal Investigator
paranormal_investigator.description: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.

birder.name: Bird Watcher
birder.description: You were at your favorite park looking at the robins when the Cataclysm struck.  Now all you have are your binoculars and a lot of trivia about local birds to share with any survivors you may find.

portal_traveler.name: Portal Traveler
portal_traveler.description: You were abducted from your home, taken hostage, and used as a test subject in a lab.  For the last test, you were dressed in strange clothes and put in a room where you started to feel… different.  You lost consciousness and woke up somewhere unfamiliar.

ninja.description: You are obsessed with the techniques and aesthetics of the ninja, so you practiced your movements, dressed all in black, and spent big bucks to acquire some tools of the trade.  Some may question your historical authenticity, but you're perfectly happy living out your fantasy regardless.

cheerleader.name: Cheerleader
cheerleader.description: Your last cheerleader routine ended abruptly after your partners switched sides to the undead team.  Let's hope your quick reflexes and flexibility help you to find new members for the squad.

patriot.name: Patriot
patriot.description: You are a true American patriot, dressed with star-spangled clothing from head to toe.  The government has fallen, but the nation lives on with its people.

prepped_patriot.name: Prepped Patriot
prepped_patriot.description: Does the American dream still exist?  Well, recent events have put that to the test.  Does it still proudly live in your beating heart?  Yes.  Yes, it does.  A patriot to the bitter end, you've readied yourself to go toe to toe with the Cataclysm that would seek to do harm to your darling USA.  That is to say, you grabbed your gun… and nothing more.  God bless America, soldier.

cowboy.name: Cowboy
cowboy.description: You liked to spend your days taking care of the horses and cows, searching the perimeter of the ranch on your steed and looking out for anything suspicious, that's why you managed to escape in time when shit hit the fan.

tourist_swimmer.name: Tourist Swimmer
tourist_swimmer.description: You were looking forward to a nice, relaxing day at the beach.  You had to run when some lunatics tried to rip your head off and play beach volleyball with it, but at least you managed to grab your bag on the way out.

professional_swimmer.name: Professional Swimmer
professional_swimmer.description: After much practice you were sure the next competition would be your big break, but your rivals started killing each other and you had to escape with only your competition gear on you.  Will your athleticism alone be enough to keep you alive?

surfer.name: Surfer
surfer.description: You went to ride the waves, but the waves ended up riding you instead when a putrid hand appeared from underwater and grabbed you by the ankle.  You had to ditch your surfboard in favor of a kickboard, and now you'll fight every day to stay ahead of the wave of the undead.

lifeguard.name: Lifeguard
lifeguard.description: Your job was to safeguard the lives of everyone at the beach, but when the swimmers started drowning each other, you knew the situation was out of your hands.

diver.name: Diver
diver.description: You were exploring below the waves close to shore when you noticed something weird on the nearby beach, you decided to swim away when you heard the screams.

captain_inflatable.name: Ship Captain
captain_inflatable.description: You were the captain of your small ship, making a living by ferrying divers and tourists across the waves.  The last excursion went bad after your passengers tried to mutiny, but you managed to escape.  Will you ever sail the open ocean again?

hitman.description: You did the wet work for a gang, mafia, or whatever person had enough money.  You were no trained assassin, but you know how to shoot a gun and get out of dodge quickly.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: You were the best undercover agent they had, with a mission so vital that you had to take it even with the riots going on.  Your target seems to have turned feral as well as your contact, you are all alone now.

old_vet.name: Old Veteran
old_vet.description: You've been through hell once before.  Hopefully those weekend range trips have kept your skills sharp.

urbex.name: Urban Explorer
urbex.description: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next excursion when the end of the world hit.  You suppose that pretty much every building could be considered abandoned now.

officeworker.name: Office Worker
officeworker.description: You felt years of your life being sapped away, slaving at your computer as you subsisted on a daily pot of coffee, microwave burritos and an endless supply of crumpled paper to toss.  Perhaps the Cataclysm is a refreshing change of pace…

rv_hunter.name: RV Hunter
rv_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting and traveling; so when you scraped enough money, you bought yourself an old RV, a gun, and hit the road.  You've been all over the country, hunting for good game.  Unfortunately the country is all over this time, and even more unfortunately you've lost your ol' reliable in the chaos.  Now you gotta find a new reliable.

heist_driver.name: Heist Driver
heist_driver.description: For as long as you can remember, you have lived a double life: a normal driver by the day and a heist driver in the night.  Now there are no cops and no law, but even after the Cataclysm, you drive.

explosive_ordnance_disposal.name: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technician
explosive_ordnance_disposal.description: Ever since you were a child you were fascinated with explosives and all things that go boom.  As soon as you turned 18 you joined the army to become an EOD technician.  While out on a call about a potential explosive in the neighboring county, your team was overrun by hordes of the undead.  You are alone, with nothing but your precious training, gear and love of explosives.

mma_fighter.name: Mixed Martial Artist
mma_fighter.description: You've spent plenty of time training to become the next big thing.  But now it looks like you will be fighting your life from now on.  At least that training won't go to waste!

FBI.name: FBI Special Agent
FBI.description: As a member of the FBI, you dealt with crime that crossed state lines.  You had gotten the go-ahead to make the biggest bust of your career; before you kicked down the door, you yelled "FBI, open up!" and then the sky broke open.

futile_fighter.name: Futile Fighter
futile_fighter.description: The cataclysm may have caught you off guard, but you're not going down without a fight!

mutant_patient_none.name: Human Mutant
mutant_patient_none.description: You were the control case in the scientists' experiments - after they were done playing God with you, they injected some kind of drug that made you normal again.  Unfortunately, you know this world is no longer a place for normality.  Will you embrace the changes once again?

mutant_patient_fish.name: Fish Mutant
mutant_patient_fish.description: You have become a creature from the deep, like a monster from a cheap horror flick.  Only, it is far too real.

mutant_patient_spider.name: Spider Mutant
mutant_patient_spider.description: Forget about great responsibility - after everything that's been done to you, it's a miracle you don't have eight eyes.

mutant_patient_lupine.name: Wolf Mutant
mutant_patient_lupine.description: Being cooped up in here has been awful.  You need friends, and your fellow mutants aren't good company.  Hopefully once you escape, you'll find a pack to take you in.

mutant_patient_beast.name: Beast Mutant
mutant_patient_beast.description: It's not clear exactly what kind of beast you became, but that's not important anymore.  All that matters is the hunt.

mutant_patient_insect.name: Insect Mutant
mutant_patient_insect.description: Alike to The Fly, you are now a disturbing mix of human and bug.  But, bugs are nothing if not tenacious - and so shall you be.

mutant_patient_feline.name: Feline Mutant
mutant_patient_feline.description: Considering that you always complained about Mondays, this was probably inevitable.  Too bad you can't eat lasagna to complete the fit.

mutant_patient_trog.name: Subterranean Mutant
mutant_patient_trog.description: Your large, glowing eyes and starkly pallid skin suggest you have become some kind of cave creature.  The thought of the surface terrifies you, but anything is better than here.

mutant_patient_medical.name: Medical Mutant
mutant_patient_medical.description: Initially, the changes didn't seem obvious.  But then the psychological disorders began to manifest.  No matter; your body will survive anything.

mutant_patient_bird.name: Avian Mutant
mutant_patient_bird.description: The free skies of the surface seem so far away now.  Will you ever spread your wings again?

mutant_patient_bear.name: Ursine Mutant
mutant_patient_bear.description: The experiments turned you into a hulking beast of fur and muscle.  It took a while to stop bonking your head on doorways, but that's the least of your problems now.

mutant_patient_mouse.name: Mouse Mutant
mutant_patient_mouse.description: One might think being shrunk down to the size of a child might be an issue in this world of violence.  Well, you'll prove them wrong!  You just have to be… craftier.

mutant_patient_rabbit.name: Rabbit Mutant
mutant_patient_rabbit.description: All the world will be your enemy, and when they catch you, they will kill you.  But first, they must catch you…  Be cunning, and full of tricks, and you shall never be destroyed.

mutant_patient_elfa.name: Sylvan Mutant
mutant_patient_elfa.description: At first it seemed like you were turning into a plant.  But now, your form calls to mind an elf, or perhaps a dryad.  Hopefully there are still pristine forests out there.

mutant_patient_plant.name: Plant Mutant
mutant_patient_plant.description: Mutation has turned you into a bizarre mix of tree and human.  While you're slower than you used to be, you're sturdy as an oak.

mutant_patient_lizard.name: Lizard Mutant
mutant_patient_lizard.description: It's a good thing you always thought dinosaurs were cool, considering you've practically become one.  Hopefully you don't also go extinct.

mutant_patient_cow.name: Bovine Mutant
mutant_patient_cow.description: You've mutated into a minotaur, though unlike Asterios you've no hunger for human flesh, or any meat for that matter.  Still, you'll plow through anyone who gets in your way.

mutant_patient_rat.name: Rat Mutant
mutant_patient_rat.description: Once you're free of this place, you'll be able to make all the rules.  Have all the cheese you want.  Hopefully the normal humans will tolerate your rather unsightly appearance…

mutant_patient_cephalopod.name: Cephalopod Mutant
mutant_patient_cephalopod.description: It was hard enough to adjust to having tentacles instead of arms and legs; now the world's coming to an end, too.  At least your annoying neighbors won't bother you anymore.

mutant_patient_chiropteran.name: Chiropteran Mutant
mutant_patient_chiropteran.description: When power flickered, you didn't mind the dark.  But mutants down here don't make for a great community, and you yearn to see the night-sky.

evacuee.name: Evacuee
evacuee.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.

refugeecenter.name: Refugee Center
refugeecenter.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have made your way to a refugee center.

exodiicastle.name: Strange Castle
exodiicastle.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and made your way to the wilderness.  You were expecting this area to be uninhabited, but instead you see a large castle guarded by strange robots.  At the entrance stands a sign, it reads "Traders Come Well Avaunt"

friend_liam.name: Friends to the End
friend_liam.description: You and your friends always talked about what you'd do when the world ended… now it's come true, and you've made your way to a remote cabin your friend Liam always said to head for.  It's been a hell of a journey.  You hope Liam and the others made it in one piece.

squatter.name: Squatter
squatter.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in an abandoned building.  Unfortunately, while you're the only one here now, you are definitely not the first person to be here, and in its current state this building no longer seems nearly as secure as one might have hoped.

missed.name: Missed
missed.description: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.

largebuilding.name: Large Building
largebuilding.description: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a large building full of the risen dead.

surrounded.name: Surrounded
surrounded.description: You've attracted the attention of living dead in some way, now they're all around you and you'll likely have to fight through them if you want to escape.

isolationist.name: Safe Place
isolationist.description: You've found a safe place away from the cities and devoid of the living dead.  Looks like you're on your own…

infected.name: Infected
infected.description: In the chaos and panic of the evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.

hunted_start.name: Challenge - Hunted
hunted_start.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.  The only escape is for one of you to die.

hunted_forever_start.name: Challenge - Hunted Forever
hunted_forever_start.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, they have been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight them, but each time one falls another takes its place.  The only escape is for you to die.

fungal_start.name: Challenge - Fungal Infection
fungal_start.description: You feel spores crawling beneath your skin.  It's only a matter of time.

fire.name: Burning Building
fire.description: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.

BastionFortStart.name: Challenge - Unliving History
BastionFortStart.description: New England is dotted with old forts from the Revolutionary War, and many of them are still standing.  When things started getting really bad, it seemed like a natural place to hole up for a while, and it turns out that many, many other people had the same idea.  The peace didn't last long.  Now everyone else is undead, and you're trapped inside the walls with them.  The single entrance being a tight choke point is looking a lot less useful now…

bad_day.name: Challenge - Really Bad Day
bad_day.description: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, surrounded by fire, and sick with the flu.  This day went downhill really fast.

medieval.name: Challenge - Medieval Peasant
medieval.description: Som nigromancie hath brought yow hidder!  Ye have only the hoose on youre legges and the knyf at youre syde and youre prayeres to Marie moder of God.

lab_cargo_staff_1.name: Challenge - Trans-Coast Logistics Concourse
lab_cargo_staff_1.description: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the facility's evacuation.  You'd better find your lanyard with your badge before the automated defenses notice that you don't have one.

lab_cargo_mutant.name: Challenge - Trans-Coast Logistics Mutant
lab_cargo_mutant.description: You were an experimental subject confined to a government black site.  While you were luckier than your fellow mutants, remaining somewhat human, you still bear many scars of the scientists' experiments.  Unfortunately, the facility has fallen to chaos, and everyone is either dead or insane, and you don't know where you can get a keycard to bypass the defense turrets and escape.

bordered.name: Challenge - Bordered
bordered.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  While evacuating, you noticed a mysterious sky-high wall in the distance, seemingly cutting off travel in every direction around you.

ambushed.name: Ambush
ambushed.description: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.

summer_advanced_start.name: The Next Summer
summer_advanced_start.description: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.

faction_camp_start.name: Brave New World
faction_camp_start.description: It's been a year since the apocalypse, and winter is fast approaching.  You and your company have managed to gather up enough supplies to finally settle down somewhere, away from the death and destruction.  Life has been hard for you, but in your heart you still hold a vision of a bright future lying ahead.

alone.name: Sheltered
alone.description: When the apocalypse broke out, you were evacuated to a small underground bunker.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the dangers of the unknown find you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the Cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.

patient.name: Challenge - Abandoned
patient.description: Sickly and frail, you have spent most of your life in the patient's ward of various hospitals.  When your current one was evacuated, you were considered a lost cause and left behind.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.

prisonbreak.name: Prison
prisonbreak.description: When the Cataclysm happened, you were convicted or working in a prison.  Now the inmates and guards alike have turned into mindless horrors and joined forces… you might need to expedite your escape plans.

alcatraz.name: Challenge - Island Prison
alcatraz.description: You were convicted or working in a high-security prison before the Cataclysm.  Unfortunately, you're still in it, so you need to figure out how to escape.  It's located on a remote island to boot; you'll eventually need to escape that also.

migo_prisoner.name: Challenge - Mi-Go Camp
migo_prisoner.description: You have found yourself in the most alien place you've ever seen.  The hot, humid air and the organic appearance of the structure make you feel like you're trapped inside a giant creature.  Whatever it is, you need to get out of here before They find you.

mutant.name: Experiment
mutant.description: You have been heavily experimented upon for the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the Cataclysm struck, you escaped the lab and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.

foodplace.name: The Mascot Rises
foodplace.description: Business had been bad — for some reason, weeks of rioting, an evacuation order, and the sky breaking with alien shadows prompted a downturn in foot traffic, even among Foodplace's chain restaurants.  As an employee, upon evacuation being declared, you disregarded company orders to lock up your outlet and, along with another survivor, opted to close yourselves within the breakroom to recuperate and plan your next move.  Will Foodplace's delicious food™ be enough to placate the horde of hungry customers banging at the door?

last_delivery.name: The Last Delivery
last_delivery.description: As the world was falling apart around you, something shook you out of your stupor: a phone call on Foodplace's excellent delivery service line.  It was the most incoherent babbling you've ever heard, but it was undeniably the biggest order you've seen in your years working at Foodplace, and that merits respect.  While you can't fix the tears in reality, this you can do!  You're not sure of much anymore, but one thing is certain: that delicious food™ is going to get delivered if it's the last thing you do!

last_flight.name: Last Flight
last_flight.description: Once it became clear that the world was ending you took to the skies, hoping that your flying skills could lead you to safety.  You found no standing safe zones, and when your fuel ran out, were forced to land in open field.

wilderness.name: Wilderness
wilderness.description: You find yourself among trees.  The screaming and moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.

beach_day.name: Beach day
beach_day.description: You do not remember why you went there but now you are at the beach.  It is nice to look at the waves and forget about the End Times.

heli_crash.name: Helicopter Crash
heli_crash.description: While being transported to a different military base, the pilot lost control of the helicopter and crashed in the middle of nowhere.  You seem to be the only survivor.

Mine_bottom.name: Challenge - Bottom of a Mine
Mine_bottom.description: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.

overrun.name: Challenge - Overrun
overrun.description: Despite all the soldiers, guns, and barbed wire, the military base you were in was overrun by the dead.  Everyone was ordered to fall back to the armory, but during all the chaos you got lost and you are now stuck in the warehouse by yourself.  You are not sure if anyone made it to the armory, or if you are the last one alive.

presort.name: Crazy Party
presort.description: You'd been unsurprised when your vacation — a hastily arranged holiday to a remote resort to maintain distance from the riots — had been put out of its misery when state-wide evacuation was ordered after weeks of worsening violence, and the complex had been placed on a shortlist for civilian gathering sites.  After days of waiting for a non-existent rescue and refugees bringing tales of monsters and the dead, the remaining staff had taken steps to keep spirits up, and last evening, they did that in the best way they knew — hosting a party.  Considering that it lured scores of zombies, you could probably classify that decision as a 'road to literal hell paved with good intentions.'

car_crash.name: Challenge - Car Crash
car_crash.description: You decided the open road would be a better prospect than the zombie-filled cities.  While en route to your destination, you were involved in a crash that totaled your vehicle.  Injured and alone, you'll need to think fast if you want to survive.

strong_portal_storm.name: Challenge - Splintering Reality
strong_portal_storm.description: You found yourself alone in an open field when reality began to heave and crack all around you.  You need to find shelter, and fast.

strong_portal_storm_base.name: Challenge - Stronger Portal Storms
strong_portal_storm_base.description: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be quite strong.

quick_portal_storm_base.name: Challenge - Frequent Portal Storms
quick_portal_storm_base.description: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be more frequent.

portal_dependent.name: Challenge - Portal Dependent
portal_dependent.description: You were caught in a huge and unstable portal storm, and were utterly unprotected from the full force of its effects.  You're on the tail end of the storm now, and while you've survived, you feel… different.

trapped_in_labyrinth.name: Challenge - Labyrinth Bound
trapped_in_labyrinth.description: During the worst of the portal storms you found yourself exposed, and existence as you knew it folded in upon itself.  You now find yourself lost in another world.  You're not sure if you'll ever be able to return.  But, there is something in the distance.  A green light?  Atop a metal spire?  Perhaps there is somewhere safe, there.

Mansion.name: Challenge - Mansion Escape
Mansion.description: You were living the high life when the world ended, surrounded by riches and eating well every day.  Now you've woken up, alone and drugged, in a room of your mansion that you don't recognize.  As you fight to remain conscious, you hear heavy footsteps nearby.  Time to get the hell out of here.

infested_shelter_start.name: Challenge - Compromised Shelter
infested_shelter_start.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  However, the people you came with started to turn and now they're out for your flesh!  You've holed up in the basement for now, but sooner or later you have to make for the door… and fast!

aircraft_carrier_start.name: Challenge - Aircraft Carrier
aircraft_carrier_start.description: You were on a mission off the coast of North Korea when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on suddenly and inexplicably found itself in the middle of a lake.  You have no idea where you are or what's happened, but you have more important things to worry about: everyone else aboard seems to have become violently insane.  It might be time to abandon ship.

golden_years.name: Golden Years
golden_years.description: After a lifetime of hard work, you managed to settle down in a posh retirement community.  You saw the riots on the news but assumed they would have no reason to attack some harmless old folks.  That assumption was proven wrong by a group of lunatics breaking in, leaving you no choice but to deal with them personally.  Welcome to your golden years.

nuclear_plant_start.name: Challenge - Emergency Shutdown
nuclear_plant_start.description: When the Cataclysm happened, you were working in a nuclear power plant.  Now you're trapped inside, surrounded by the shambling bodies of what used to be your coworkers.  The reactor's shut down, but you don't know if there's been a radiation leak and you need to get away from here fast before you find out the hard way.

close_encounter_start.name: Challenge - Close Encounter
close_encounter_start.description: You don't know what it was but you managed to lose it for the time being.  Now you are injured, surrounded and the building is on fire.  You hope you have some time before it returns to finish the job.

camp_attack_start.name: Surrounded in the Dark
camp_attack_start.description: You were camping in the wild to let things back home cool off.  One night strange noises closed in on you and you were attacked.  You managed to get away but can feel things moving in the dark.

lone_survivor_start.name: Lone Survivor
lone_survivor_start.description: You are the only one that made it.  Everyone else died nearby.  You have to get out of here!

rock_hard_place_start.name: Challenge - Between a Rock and a Hard Place
rock_hard_place_start.description: You were trying to scavenge for supplies, and now some rough group of bandits has dragged monsters in with them where you were hiding!

shattered_sky_start.name: Challenge - Shattered Sky
shattered_sky_start.description: From up here, you watched it all fall apart.  The sky cracked and indescribable alien shapes writhed in the clouds.  The horizon has returned to normal, but you still see shadows moving in the corner of your eye and feel them calling you.

hunted_alot_start.name: Challenge - Hunted by the Dead
hunted_alot_start.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, the air around you has felt different, like you pissed off whatever is causing the Cataclysm.  Now zombie hordes will approach you everywhere you go, regardless of whether they see you or not.

low_profile_start.name: Low Profile
low_profile_start.description: You heard the global, worsening news and saw the nightmare in the cities firsthand — a situation that prompted you to jump from low-rent motel to cheap trailer, trying to outrun the madness.  While only you know where you'd planned to go, when you heard the government's last broadcast and realized 'no help was coming,' you resolved to raise a dejected toast and sink to the bottom of a bottle for as long as you could.  What happened in the following days of drunken stupor is an enigma.  What you do know, is that it's time to see how much of the world there's left to return to.

mass_quarantine_start.name: Mass Quarantine
mass_quarantine_start.description: When FEMA camps ran out of space the authorities used what was left of their manpower to round up people at gunpoint.  The stadiums they forced everyone into did nothing to slow down the madness and it spread like wildfire.  You managed to slip away from the worst violence but you are now surrounded and need to escape quickly!

road_start.name: Middle of Nowhere
road_start.description: During your escape you got lost and ended up at the wrong location.  Get your bearings and make a plan.  You'll need it.

sewer_start.name: Challenge - Lost Underground
sewer_start.description: When the riots came to your home, you ran underground and hid.  Now days later you are lost and hear movement echoing in the dark.

last_stand_start.name: Challenge - Last Stand
last_stand_start.description: Together with some others you decided to take up arms against the horde.  Now you are reconsidering whether that was a wise choice.

a_moonlit_night_start.name: A Moonlight Night
a_moonlit_night_start.description: You've been holed up in your basement ever since the Cataclysm happened a little over a week ago, but now you've run out of food and have been forced to go on a supply run on this fateful moonlit night.  You see zombies all around you, but thankfully, most of them can't seem to see as well in moonlight as you do.

MARTIAL_ARTS4.name: Venom Mob Protege
MARTIAL_ARTS4.description: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_NONE.name: Artificial facial hair: none
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_NONE.description: You have no hair on your face, it is shaven or simply untouched by the presence of hair.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_GOATEE.name: Artificial facial hair: goatee
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_GOATEE.description: You have a short beard at the tip of your chin.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CIRCLE.name: Artificial facial hair: circle beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CIRCLE.description: You have a mustache and a short beard, that both form a circle around your lips.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_ROYALE.name: Artificial facial hair: royale beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_ROYALE.description: You have a mustache and a short beard forming a patch under your lips.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_ANCHOR.name: Artificial facial hair: anchor beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_ANCHOR.description: You have a mustache and a beard starting with a strip going down from the bottom lip, then tracing the jaw lines.  It looks a bit like an anchor, thus the name.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SHORTBOXED.name: Artificial facial hair: short boxed beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SHORTBOXED.description: You have a mustache and a short beard with trimmed sides.  Thin patches connect them both, forming a 'box' around the lips, thus the name.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHEVRON.name: Artificial facial hair: chevron mustache
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHEVRON.description: You have a mustache that covers your entire top lip.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_3DAYSTUBBLE.name: Artificial facial hair: 3-day stubble
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_3DAYSTUBBLE.description: You have a short trimmed mustache and beard imitating a 3-day stubble.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_HORSESHOE.name: Artificial facial hair: horseshoe
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_HORSESHOE.description: You have a mustache with patches going down the chin from both ends, thus the name.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_MUSTACHE.name: Artificial facial hair: original mustache
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_MUSTACHE.description: You have a mustache with shortened ends, that covers only the skin above your upper lip.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_MUTTONCHOPS.name: Artificial facial hair: mutton chops beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_MUTTONCHOPS.description: You have long sideburns that connect to your mustache, with the tip of the chin shaven clean.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_GUNSLINGER.name: Artificial facial hair: gunslinger beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_GUNSLINGER.description: You have a horseshoe mustache and disconnected sideburns.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRIP.name: Artificial facial hair: chin strip
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRIP.description: You have a short beard in a form of a vertical patch under your bottom lip.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_CURTAIN.name: Artificial facial hair: chin curtain
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_CURTAIN.description: You have a full beard without a mustache, restricted to the chin, sometimes called a 'lion's mane'. Much like Abraham Lincoln's beard.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRAP.name: Artificial facial hair: chin strap
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRAP.description: You have a beard along the jaw lines, circling the chin, and no mustache.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD.name: Artificial facial hair: beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD.description: You have a mustache and a long beard, both formed by allowing free growth of hair, with no particular styling.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_HANDLEBAR.name: Artificial facial hair: handlebar mustache
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_HANDLEBAR.description: You have a mustache with long flared out ends.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_NECKBEARD.name: Artificial facial hair: neckbeard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_NECKBEARD.description: You have a beard formed from hair grown on neck below the chin line.  No mustache included.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_PENCIL.name: Artificial facial hair: pencil mustache
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_PENCIL.description: You have a very thin mustache just above the line of the upper lip.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SHENANDOAH.name: Artificial facial hair: shenandoah
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SHENANDOAH.description: Long full beard with no mustache, popular among Amish community, often with two pointed ends.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SIDEBURNS.name: Artificial facial hair: sideburns
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SIDEBURNS.description: You have patches of hair in front of your ears, that normally would connect your hair with the beard, but they are here by themselves.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SOUL_PATCH.name: Artificial facial hair: soul patch
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_SOUL_PATCH.description: You have a little bit of hair in the dip under your lower lip, and no other facial hair whatsoever.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_TOOTHBRUSH.name: Artificial facial hair: toothbrush mustache
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_TOOTHBRUSH.description: Charlie Chaplin used to have this short patch of hair just under the nose, but then that other guy used it as a characteristic, and it became unwelcome.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_VANDYKE.name: Artificial facial hair: Van Dyke
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_VANDYKE.description: You have a handlebar mustache with a chin strip or a small goatee.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_WALRUS.name: Artificial facial hair: walrus
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_WALRUS.description: You have a long thick mustache, overshadowing your lips, that somewhat resembles the facial hair of a walrus.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_ZAPPA.name: Artificial facial hair: The Zappa
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_ZAPPA.description: You have a wide soul patch and a full mustache that extends a bit downwards at the corners of your lips.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_LONG.name: Artificial facial hair: long beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_LONG.description: You have a long beard, that goes down to your chest.  Somewhat reminiscent of Santa's mustache.

ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_VERY_LONG.name: Artificial facial hair: very long beard
ARTIFICIAL_FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_VERY_LONG.description: You have a very long beard, that goes down to your waist, like wise old mentors have.

HUMAN_ADDONS.name: No Extras
HUMAN_ADDONS.description: You don't have any tails, whiskers, horns, or miscellaneous extra bits.

HUMAN_ACCLIMATIZATION.name: Human Acclimatization
HUMAN_ACCLIMATIZATION.description: Your temperature tolerance is more or less normal for a human.

HUMAN_APPEAL.name: Human Appeal
HUMAN_APPEAL.description: Your attractiveness would be considered unremarkable by the average human.

HUMAN_EARS.name: Human Ears
HUMAN_EARS.description: You have human ears and hearing.

HUMAN_HEALING.name: Human Healing
HUMAN_HEALING.description: You heal as fast as most humans do in this new world.

HUMAN_IMMUNITY.name: Human Immunity
HUMAN_IMMUNITY.description: Your immune system is more or less normal for a human.

HUMAN_METABOLISM.name: Human Metabolism
HUMAN_METABOLISM.description: Your digestive system and cardio health are standard for a human.

HUMAN_MIND.name: Human Mind
HUMAN_MIND.description: Your mind and brain chemistry are not mutated.

HUMAN_MOUTH.name: Human Mouth
HUMAN_MOUTH.description: You have a human mouth with human teeth.

HUMAN_SLEEP.name: Human Rest
HUMAN_SLEEP.description: You sleep a normal amount for a human.

HUMAN_SKIN.name: Human Skin
HUMAN_SKIN.description: You have human skin and no distinct smell.

HUMAN_VOICE.name: Human Voice
HUMAN_VOICE.description: Your voice doesn't sound especially abnormal.

EXODII_WRATH.name: Exodii Wrath
EXODII_WRATH.description: Makes sure all the exodii mobs shoot you on sight.

CBM_Interface.name: Standard Neurobionic Interface
CBM_Interface.description: You have a matrix in your central nervous system that acts as a universal control and installation bus for compact bionic modules.

NL_CBM_Interface.name: AltarOS Neurobionic Interface
NL_CBM_Interface.description: You have a matrix in your central nervous system that acts as a universal control and installation bus for compact bionic modules.

Hub01_CBM_Interface.name: Hub 01 Neurobionic Interface
Hub01_CBM_Interface.description: You have a matrix in your central nervous system that acts as a universal control and installation bus for compact bionic modules.  You also have a USB port installed behind your ear.

CBM_Interface_brain_lesion.name: Minor brain lesion
CBM_Interface_brain_lesion.description: You have a minor brain lesion and some leftover metal in your brain - the remnants of removing and reinstalling a CBM interface.

CBM_Interface_brain_lesion_2.name: Major brain lesion
CBM_Interface_brain_lesion_2.description: You have a major brain lesion and lots of leftover metal in your brain - the remnants of removing and reinstalling a CBM interface.  Twice.  Smart move.

EXODII_CYBERFRAME_GENERIC.name: Exodii-style cyborg
EXODII_CYBERFRAME_GENERIC.description: Your body has been reduced to your nervous system, sensory organs, core skeleton and musculature, and other critical internal meat-bits.  It can now only exist inside of an Exodii Cyberframe.

EXODII_CYBERFRAME_LARGE.name: Bulky Bionics
EXODII_CYBERFRAME_LARGE.description: Your Exodii Cyberframe is so large that you won't fit through very small spaces, and you cannot wear most normal-sized clothing and armor.

EXODII_BODY_1.name: Exodii cyborg framework - style 1a
EXODII_BODY_1.description: Your nervous system, sensory organs, and other critical internal meat-bits are shielded in an armored bipedal walker frame.  The armored plating is tough, but its bulkiness limits the sort of equipment you can wear.

EXODII_BODY_1b.name: Exodii cyborg framework - style 1b
EXODII_BODY_1b.description: Your nervous system, sensory organs, and other critical internal meat-bits are shielded in a very human-like bipedal walker frame.

EXODII_BODY_2.name: Exodii cyborg framework - style 2a
EXODII_BODY_2.description: Your brain and some of your organs are shielded in a shiny gold bipedal walker frame.

BIONIC_ARM_BASIC_LEFT.name: Bionic Arm (left)
BIONIC_ARM_BASIC_LEFT.description: Your left arm and hand have been replaced by advanced bionic prosthetics, controlled by an implanted neurobionic interface.  They more or less function like normal limbs, but they no longer bleed or feel discomfort, and are very modestly armored.  However, they cannot heal on their own and need power to operate.

BIONIC_ARM_BASIC_RIGHT.name: Bionic Arm (right)
BIONIC_ARM_BASIC_RIGHT.description: Your right arm and hand have been replaced by advanced bionic prosthetics, controlled by an implanted neurobionic interface.  They more or less function like normal limbs, but they no longer bleed or feel discomfort, and are very modestly armored.  However, they cannot heal on their own and need power to operate.

BIONIC_ARM_BASIC_BOTH.name: Bionic Arms
BIONIC_ARM_BASIC_BOTH.description: Both of your arms and hands have been replaced by advanced bionic prosthetics, controlled by an implanted neurobionic interface.  They more or less function like normal limbs, but they no longer bleed or feel discomfort, and are very modestly armored.  However, they cannot heal on their own and need power to operate.

BIONIC_LEG_BASIC_LEFT.name: Bionic Leg (left)
BIONIC_LEG_BASIC_LEFT.description: Your left leg and foot have been replaced by advanced bionic prosthetics, controlled by an implanted neurobionic interface.  They more or less function like normal limbs, but they no longer bleed or feel discomfort, and are very modestly armored.  However, they cannot heal on their own and need power to operate.

BIONIC_LEG_BASIC_RIGHT.name: Bionic Leg (right)
BIONIC_LEG_BASIC_RIGHT.description: Your right leg and foot have been replaced by advanced bionic prosthetics, controlled by an implanted neurobionic interface.  They more or less function like normal limbs, but they no longer bleed or feel discomfort, and are very modestly armored.  However, they cannot heal on their own and need power to operate.

BIONIC_LEG_BASIC_BOTH.name: Bionic Legs
BIONIC_LEG_BASIC_BOTH.description: Both of your legs and feet have been replaced by advanced bionic prosthetics, controlled by an implanted neurobionic interface.  They more or less function like normal limbs, but they no longer bleed or feel discomfort, and are very modestly armored.  However, they cannot heal on their own and need power to operate.

DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE_PLUS.name: Debug Clairvoyance
DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE_PLUS.description: Being able to see through walls and the floor is clearly for dev purposes only.

DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE.name: Debug Clairvoyance Super
DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE.description: Much bigger range than the other Debug Clairvoyance trait.  Unsure which one to use?  Use them both!  You can see all the bugs with this one.

DEBUG_NIGHTVISION.name: Debug Night and Map Vision
DEBUG_NIGHTVISION.description: Grants flawless night vision and the ability to see all of the overmaps without having to reveal them manually.  As such, you can clearly see that this is for dev purposes only.

DEBUG_MIND_CONTROL.name: Debug Mind Control
DEBUG_MIND_CONTROL.description: Mind the bugs, would you kindly?

DEBUG_PHASE_MOVEMENT.name: Debug Phase Movement
DEBUG_PHASE_MOVEMENT.description: You can walk anywhere, do anything.  Neither walls nor gravity can stop you.

DEBUG_CLOAK.name: Debug Invisibility
DEBUG_CLOAK.description: If you see this, you'd best be debugging something.

DEBUG_SPEED.name: Debug Speed
DEBUG_SPEED.description: With this, you'll be fixing those bugs faster than ever!

DEBUG_STAMINA.name: Debug Stamina
DEBUG_STAMINA.description: Your energy to squash bugs is endless!

DEBUG_CARDIO.name: Debug Cardio
DEBUG_CARDIO.description: You can run, but you'll never run out of breath.

DEBUG_HP.name: Debug 9000 HP
DEBUG_HP.description: If you need to survive the deadliest bug attacks.

DEBUG_HP_REGEN.name: Debug Regeneration
DEBUG_HP_REGEN.description: Heal yourself from this stupid bug attacks.

DEBUG_LS.name: Debug Life Support
DEBUG_LS.description: Holds hunger, thirst, and sleepiness stable.  You can debug all year long with this one!

DEBUG_NOTEMP.name: Debug HVAC
DEBUG_NOTEMP.description: Temperature and weather won't bug you.

DEBUG_LIGHT.name: Debug Light
DEBUG_LIGHT.description: You start to emit a light, so you can debug in the darkest nights.

DEBUG_CS.name: Debug Crafting Speed
DEBUG_CS.description: Craft the bug out 50 times faster.

DEBUG_CNF.name: Debug Crafting Virtuoso
DEBUG_CNF.description: Crafting failures won't bug you any more.

DEBUG_HS.name: Debug Hammerspace
DEBUG_HS.description: Crafting and construction requirements bugger off with this one.  Apply with care.

DEBUG_BIONICS.name: Debug Bionic Installation
DEBUG_BIONICS.description: Lets you instantly install torsion ratchets for your eight legs.

DEBUG_MUTATE.name: Debug Genetic Instability
DEBUG_MUTATE.description: You just can't wait to turn into a bug!  Triggers a mutation using the normal mutation rules (requiring primer but no catalyst) every five seconds.

DEBUG_MANA.name: Debug Mana
DEBUG_MANA.description: To cast bug killing spells.  Also increase the cast speed of spells.

DEBUG_MANA_FURNACE.name: Debug Mana Furnace
DEBUG_MANA_FURNACE.description: Using mana to incinerate all bugs, activate to start burning.

transform.msg_transform: You start using mana to burning bugs.

DEBUG_MANA_FURNACE_active.name: Debug Mana Furnace (ON)
DEBUG_MANA_FURNACE_active.description: You're burning mana like crazy to burn of all bugs, also making you glow softly.

transform.msg_transform: You stop incinerating bugs with mana.

DEBUG_NOSCENT.name: Debug Deodorizer
DEBUG_NOSCENT.description: Smell that bug?  Smell's certainly not coming from you!

DEBUG_SILENT.name: Debug Silent Walk
DEBUG_SILENT.description: Be vewwy vewwy quiet.  We're hunting bugs.

MUT_DEBUG_FREE_DODGES.name: Debug Free Dodges
MUT_DEBUG_FREE_DODGES.description: You'll never get tired of testing dodges!

DEBUG_ONLY_HEAD.name: Debug No Torso
DEBUG_ONLY_HEAD.description: They said college costs an arm and a leg, they sure weren't kidding!

DEBUG_BIG_HEAD.name: Debug Big Head
DEBUG_BIG_HEAD.description: They said college what make me smart, this is a lot to lug around!

DEBUG_NO_ENCUMBRANCE.name: Debug No Encumbrance
DEBUG_NO_ENCUMBRANCE.description: Wear 20 shirts.  It's the end of the world, you can do what you want.

LS_Passcode_0.name: Passcode: Thief's Pass
LS_Passcode_0.description: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, it just looks like a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself is your own face, with a clever smirk.

LS_Passcode_1.name: Passcode: Circle of Wings
LS_Passcode_1.description: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, it just looks like a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself looks like bird wings, circling around themselves in an ouroboros-like shape.

LS_Passcode_2.name: Passcode: Hard Nails
LS_Passcode_2.description: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, it just looks like a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself is of a stylized hand dragging its fingernails down a piece of sheet metal, leaving five deep gouges.

LS_Passcode_3.name: Passcode: Laughing Man
LS_Passcode_3.description: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a password, not a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself is of a handsome man's face, laughing.  At first glance it appears charming and friendly, but the longer you examine it, the more it appears to be inhumanly cold and cruel.  It fills you with a feeling of dread that seems to originate from outside your own mind.

LS_Passcode_string_dimension.name: Passcode: KÁ!
LS_Passcode_string_dimension.description: There's a sound etched into your mind.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, though how you know this isn't clear.  The sound is KÁ!

variants.name: Eye color: blue
variants.description: You have blue eyes.

variants.name: Eye color: brown
variants.description: You have brown eyes.

variants.name: Eye color: hazel
variants.description: You have hazel eyes.

variants.name: Eye color: amber
variants.description: You have amber eyes.

variants.name: Eye color: gray
variants.description: You have gray eyes.

variants.name: Eye color: green
variants.description: You have green eyes.

SKIN_DARK.name: Skin tone: dark brown
SKIN_DARK.description: You have a dark brown skin tone.

SKIN_LIGHT.name: Skin tone: light
SKIN_LIGHT.description: You have a light peach skin tone.

SKIN_MEDIUM.name: Skin tone: light brown
SKIN_MEDIUM.description: You have a light brown skin tone.

SKIN_PINK.name: Skin tone: rose
SKIN_PINK.description: You have a rosy pink skin tone.

SKIN_TAN.name: Skin tone: bronze
SKIN_TAN.description: You have a bronze or tan skin tone.

FACIAL_HAIR_NONE.name: Facial hair: none
FACIAL_HAIR_NONE.description: You have no hair on your face, it is shaven or simply untouched by the presence of hair.

FACIAL_HAIR_GOATEE.name: Facial hair: goatee
FACIAL_HAIR_GOATEE.description: You have a short beard at the tip of your chin.

FACIAL_HAIR_CIRCLE.name: Facial hair: circle beard
FACIAL_HAIR_CIRCLE.description: You have a mustache and a short beard, that both form a circle around your lips.

FACIAL_HAIR_ROYALE.name: Facial hair: royale beard
FACIAL_HAIR_ROYALE.description: You have a mustache and a short beard forming a patch under your lips.

FACIAL_HAIR_ANCHOR.name: Facial hair: anchor beard
FACIAL_HAIR_ANCHOR.description: You have a mustache and a beard starting with a strip going down from the bottom lip, then tracing the jaw lines.  It looks a bit like an anchor, thus the name.

FACIAL_HAIR_SHORTBOXED.name: Facial hair: short boxed beard
FACIAL_HAIR_SHORTBOXED.description: You have a mustache and a short beard with trimmed sides.  Thin patches connect them both, forming a 'box' around the lips, thus the name.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHEVRON.name: Facial hair: chevron mustache
FACIAL_HAIR_CHEVRON.description: You have a mustache that covers your entire top lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_3DAYSTUBBLE.name: Facial hair: 3-day stubble
FACIAL_HAIR_3DAYSTUBBLE.description: You have a short trimmed mustache and beard imitating a 3-day stubble.

FACIAL_HAIR_HORSESHOE.name: Facial hair: horseshoe
FACIAL_HAIR_HORSESHOE.description: You have a mustache with patches going down the chin from both ends, thus the name.

FACIAL_HAIR_MUSTACHE.name: Facial hair: original mustache
FACIAL_HAIR_MUSTACHE.description: You have a mustache with shortened ends, that covers only the skin above your upper lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_MUTTONCHOPS.name: Facial hair: mutton chops beard
FACIAL_HAIR_MUTTONCHOPS.description: You have long sideburns that connect to your mustache, with the tip of the chin shaven clean.

FACIAL_HAIR_GUNSLINGER.name: Facial hair: gunslinger beard
FACIAL_HAIR_GUNSLINGER.description: You have a horseshoe mustache and disconnected sideburns.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRIP.name: Facial hair: chin strip
FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRIP.description: You have a short beard in a form of a vertical patch under your bottom lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_CURTAIN.name: Facial hair: chin curtain
FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_CURTAIN.description: You have a full beard without a mustache, restricted to the chin, sometimes called a 'lion's mane'. Much like Abraham Lincoln's beard.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRAP.name: Facial hair: chin strap
FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRAP.description: You have a beard along the jaw lines, circling the chin, and no mustache.

FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD.name: Facial hair: beard
FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD.description: You have a mustache and a long beard, both formed by allowing free growth of hair, with no particular styling.

FACIAL_HAIR_HANDLEBAR.name: Facial hair: handlebar mustache
FACIAL_HAIR_HANDLEBAR.description: You have a mustache with long flared out ends.

FACIAL_HAIR_NECKBEARD.name: Facial hair: neckbeard
FACIAL_HAIR_NECKBEARD.description: You have a beard formed from hair grown on neck below the chin line.  No mustache included.

FACIAL_HAIR_PENCIL.name: Facial hair: pencil mustache
FACIAL_HAIR_PENCIL.description: You have a very thin mustache just above the line of the upper lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_SHENANDOAH.name: Facial hair: shenandoah
FACIAL_HAIR_SHENANDOAH.description: Long full beard with no mustache, popular among Amish community, often with two pointed ends.

FACIAL_HAIR_SIDEBURNS.name: Facial hair: sideburns
FACIAL_HAIR_SIDEBURNS.description: You have patches of hair in front of your ears, that normally would connect your hair with the beard, but they are here by themselves.

FACIAL_HAIR_SOUL_PATCH.name: Facial hair: soul patch
FACIAL_HAIR_SOUL_PATCH.description: You have a little bit of hair in the dip under your lower lip, and no other facial hair whatsoever.

FACIAL_HAIR_TOOTHBRUSH.name: Facial hair: toothbrush mustache
FACIAL_HAIR_TOOTHBRUSH.description: Charlie Chaplin used to have this short patch of hair just under the nose, but then that other guy used it as a characteristic, and it became unwelcome.

FACIAL_HAIR_VANDYKE.name: Facial hair: Van Dyke
FACIAL_HAIR_VANDYKE.description: You have a handlebar mustache with a chin strip or a small goatee.

FACIAL_HAIR_WALRUS.name: Facial hair: walrus
FACIAL_HAIR_WALRUS.description: You have a long thick mustache, overshadowing your lips, that somewhat resembles the facial hair of a walrus.

FACIAL_HAIR_ZAPPA.name: Facial hair: The Zappa
FACIAL_HAIR_ZAPPA.description: You have a wide soul patch and a full mustache that extends a bit downwards at the corners of your lips.

FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_LONG.name: Facial hair: long beard
FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_LONG.description: You have a long beard, that goes down to your chest.  Somewhat reminiscent of Santa's mustache.

FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_VERY_LONG.name: Facial hair: very long beard
FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD_VERY_LONG.description: You have a very long beard, that goes down to your waist, like wise old mentors have.

well_distributed.name: Well Distributed Gear
well_distributed.description: You are wearing equipment that helps to distribute weight allowing you to carry more.

HEADBUMPS.name: Head Bumps
HEADBUMPS.description: You have a pair of bumps on your skull.

HORNS.name: Horns
HORNS.description: You have a pair of small horns on your head.  They allow you to make a weak piercing headbutt attack, but prevent the use of most rigid headwear.

HORNS_CURLED.name: Curled Horns
HORNS_CURLED.description: You have a pair of large curled horns, like those of a ram.  They allow you to make a strong bashing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing any headwear.

HORNS_POINTED.name: Pointed Horns
HORNS_POINTED.description: You have a pair of long, pointed horns, like those of an antelope.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

ANTLERS.name: Antlers
ANTLERS.description: You have a huge rack of antlers, like those of a moose.  They allow you to make a weak headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

SHORTER_FINGERS.name: Stubby Fingers
