SHORTER_FINGERS.description: Your fingers have shrunk a bit relative to the rest of your hand.  It's not too bad, but it does make manipulating objects a bit more difficult.

LONGER_FINGERS.name: Extended Fingers
LONGER_FINGERS.description: Your fingers have grown relative to the rest of your hand.  This has no in-game effect.

PAWS.name: Paws
PAWS.description: Your hands have fused into quasi-paws.  Fine manipulation is a challenge: permanent hand encumbrance of 10, difficulty with delicate craftwork, and your gloves don't fit.  But they handle water better and bear weight well, allowing you to move on all fours when crouching and unarmed.

msg_on.text: You drop down on all fours.

msg_off.text: You come out of your quadrupedal posture.

PAWS_RAT.name: Dextrous Paws
PAWS_RAT.description: Your hands have elongated and look a bit more like paws.  Fortunately you still have your thumbs, though fine manipulation might be a bit more difficult and you'll have a harder time with firearms.

PAWS_LARGE.name: Broad Paws
PAWS_LARGE.description: Your paws are much larger now.  Manual dexterity is difficult: you have a penalty to your grip and manipulation scores, serious problems crafting, and can't wear gloves.  In return, though, you can swim better and move on all fours when crouching and unarmed.

msg_on.text: You drop down on all fours.

msg_off.text: You come out of your quadrupedal posture.

SLIME_HANDS.name: Slime Hands
SLIME_HANDS.description: The skin on your hands is now a mucous membrane that produces a thick, acrid slime.  Attacks using your hand will cause minor acid damage.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

BENDY1.name: Stretchy Limbs
BENDY1.description: Your limbs seem to have a little more 'give' to them.  +1 Dexterity.

BENDY2.name: Rubbery Limbs
BENDY2.description: Your limbs are significantly more flexible than any pathetic human arm or leg.  +3 Dexterity, -2 Strength.

BENDY3.name: Pseudolimbs
BENDY3.description: Your pseudopod-like limbs can fit into anything!  You also suffer reduced penalties to attacking while prone.  +4 Dexterity, -4 Strength.

INTERSTICE_LIMBS.name: Stretched Limbs
INTERSTICE_LIMBS.description: You limbs and digits are all slightly stretched, but otherwise function like normal.

ARACHNID_ARMS.name: Arachnid Limbs
ARACHNID_ARMS.description: There's the last two limbs you were expecting.  Unfortunately, you still can't coordinate them, so you're getting in your own way.  A lot.

ARACHNID_ARMS_OK.name: Arachnid Arms
ARACHNID_ARMS_OK.description: You have four handsome limbs, and then those mutant 'hand' and 'foot' things.  They probably aren't worth concealing.

INSECT_ARMS.name: Insect Limbs
INSECT_ARMS.description: You've *finally* sprouted a pair of arms from your midsection.  They flail more or less uncontrollably, making you feel rather larval.

INSECT_ARMS_OK.name: Insect Arms
INSECT_ARMS_OK.description: It's good having all your arms.  Though they're too thin to block or punch, you can fold them inside human-shaped gear if need be.

WEBBED.name: Webbed Hands
WEBBED.description: Your hands are heavily webbed, reducing your Dexterity by 1 and causing problems with gloves.  However, you can swim much faster.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

PAWS_LITTLE.name: Little Paws
PAWS_LITTLE.description: Your hands have elongated and look a bit more like paws.  It makes fine manipulation a little more difficult, and you'll have a harder time with firearms, but you can still probably manage.  Plus, they allow you to move on all fours when crouching and unarmed.

msg_on.text: You drop down on all fours.

msg_off.text: You come out of your quadrupedal posture.

CRUSTACEAN_CLAW.name: Giant Pincer
CRUSTACEAN_CLAW.description: Instead of your right hand, you now have a giant claw resembling ones found on crabs.  It's really not good at being a human hand, but you can use it in melee combat to deal massive damage.

NAILS.name: Long Fingernails
NAILS.description: Your fingernails are long and sharp.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.

TALONS.name: Large Talons
TALONS.description: Your index fingers have grown into huge talons.  After a bit of practice, you find that this does not affect your dexterity, but allows for a deadly unarmed attack.  They also prevent wearing gloves.

RAP_TALONS.name: Toe Talons
RAP_TALONS.description: You have grown large, curved, and wickedly sharp talons in place of your big toes.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your movement.  Unfortunately, they do prevent wearing footgear.

CLAWS.name: Claws
CLAWS.description: You have claws on the ends of your fingers.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.

CLAWS_RAT.name: Gnarled Claws
CLAWS_RAT.description: Your claws have grown tougher and slightly gnarled.

CLAWS_ST.name: Stainless Claws
CLAWS_ST.description: Your paws are bone, muscle, and claw with a thin layer of skin and fur.  They might as well be made of stainless steel.

CLAWS_RETRACT.name: Retractable Claws
CLAWS_RETRACT.description: You have claws on the ends of your fingers, and can extend or retract them as desired.  Gloves will still get in the way, though.

CLAWS_RETRACT_active.name: Extended Claws
CLAWS_RETRACT_active.description: Sharp claws are extending from the end of your fingers.

ARMS_BAT.name: Leathery Arms
ARMS_BAT.description: You have grown large membranes of skin on your arms, partly covering your wrist and little finger and linking to the webbing in between your fingers.  They're a challenge to fit into normal clothing, and are less dextrous on account of the extra bulk.

WINGS_BAT.name: Bat Wings
WINGS_BAT.description: Most of your fingers have grown to tremendous length, becoming a broad pair of leathery wings.  This allows you to arrest a fall or glide from a ledge if you aren't too weighed down, but naturally impedes your fine motor skills.  They even keep you warm when you sleep.

WINGS_STUB.name: Wing Stubs
WINGS_STUB.description: You have a pair of stubby little wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  They can be wiggled at will, but are useless.

WINGS_BIRD.name: Bird Wings
WINGS_BIRD.description: You have a pair of large, feathered wings.  Your body is too heavy to be able to fly, but if you're not too weighed down, you might be able to glide from a ledge or lessen the impact of a fall.

WINGS_BUTTERFLY.name: Butterfly Wings
WINGS_BUTTERFLY.description: You have a very large pair of brightly-colored, very beautiful wings.  They can't lift you, and they make balancing tricky, but they certainly catch air and attention!

WINGS_INSECT.name: Insect Wings
WINGS_INSECT.description: A large pair of translucent wings grow from your back.  They are too small to lift you, but if you're not weighed down, they can help a bit if you fall.  You can flutter them quickly to improve your move speed, but this is noisy and tires you out.

WINGS_INSECT_active.name: Insect Wings (Buzzing)
WINGS_INSECT_active.description: You're fluttering your wings as fast as you can.  This doesn't generate enough lift to move you, but it does increase your movement speed.  If you're not burdened, you can fall short distances without harm.

TAIL_STUB.name: Stubby Tail
TAIL_STUB.description: You have a short, stubby tail, like a rabbit's.  It serves no purpose.

TAIL_LONG.name: Long Tail
TAIL_LONG.description: You have a long, graceful tail, like that of a big cat.  It improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_THICK.name: Thick Tail
TAIL_THICK.description: You have a long, thick, lizardlike tail.  It helps you balance a bit but also makes a serviceable whip.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_CLUB.name: Club Tail
TAIL_CLUB.description: You have a long tail that ends in a heavy, bony club.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful bashing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_STING.name: Spiked Tail
TAIL_STING.description: You have a long tail that ends in a vicious stinger.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful piercing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_FLUFFY.name: Fluffy Tail
TAIL_FLUFFY.description: You have a long, fluffy-furred tail.  It greatly improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_CATTLE.name: Cattle Tail
TAIL_CATTLE.description: You have a long tail with a tuft on the end.  You find yourself instinctively swatting away flies with it, though it's not as effective at balancing you as you'd like.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_RAPTOR.name: Raptor Tail
TAIL_RAPTOR.description: Formed from a network of interlocking bones, a long tail has mutated from the base of your spine, with ossified tendons assisting in keeping the limb stiff and rigid.  A plume of lengthy feathers sprouts from the reptilian flesh along your new tail, drawing the eye.  While it is useless in combat and prevents you from wearing non-fabric pants, you find it's pretty handy for maintaining your balance.

TAIL_FIN.name: Tail Fin
TAIL_FIN.description: You have a fin-like tail.  It allows you to swim more quickly, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

TAIL_RAT.name: Rodent Tail
TAIL_RAT.description: You have a long but hairless tail.  It's a pretty effective balancing aid, but does look, uh, ratty.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_RABBIT.name: Rabbit Tail
TAIL_RABBIT.description: Your stubby tail has become fuzzy and more round, but doesn't seem to serve any purpose.

STRONG_LEGS.name: Strong Legs
STRONG_LEGS.description: Your legs have gained muscle mass to propel you across any terrain.

LEGS_BAT.name: Bow-legged
LEGS_BAT.description: Your lower limbs have shortened and splayed, slowing your bipedal movement.  As long as you're not wielding anything and you've got both wings, you're able to crawl quickly and quietly when you run or crouch.

msg_on.text: You hunch forward to crawl quickly on folded wings.

msg_off.text: You rise up to walk like a human.

RABBIT_FEET.name: Rabbit Feet
RABBIT_FEET.description: Your feet have grown into strong and large rabbit feet.  This makes your kicks pack a little more oomph.  Emphasis on little.  It also offers some warmth and allows you to move quickly across snow, and the lucky part is but superstition.  The downside is you are unable to wear shoes.

HOOKED_TOES.name: Hooked Toes
HOOKED_TOES.description: Your feet have grown into strong, curved claws.  They won't fit into normal shoes and are not much help in combat, but they allow you to climb most vertical surfaces with ease.  You can even cling to walls you glide into!

WEBBED_FEET.name: Webbed Feet
WEBBED_FEET.description: Your feet are heavily webbed, allowing you to swim faster if you aren't wearing footwear.

ANIMAL_FEET.name: Digitigrade Legs
ANIMAL_FEET.description: The heels of your feet have shifted up off the ground in a rather animalistic fashion, reducing your carry weight limit and preventing you from wearing shoes.  These hind feet are a bad match for human arms, but could pair well with matching forepaws.

msg_on.text: You drop down on all fours.

msg_off.text: You assume a less bestial posture.

PADDED_FEET.name: Padded Feet
PADDED_FEET.description: The bottoms of your feet are strongly padded.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes, and your steps are significantly quieter, as added tissue dampens the noise.

HOOVES.name: Hooves
HOOVES.description: Your feet have fused into hooves.  This allows you to perform a powerful kicking attack, provides natural armor, and removes the need to wear shoes; however, you cannot wear normal shoes.  Reduces wet effects.

LEAPING_LEGS.name: Leaping Legs
LEAPING_LEGS.description: You've gained a strong ability to leap from a standing position.

LEAPING_LEGS2.name: Crushing Leap
LEAPING_LEGS2.description: You've gained a strong ability to leap a significant distance from a standing position and crush whatever you land on.

SCUTTLE.name: Scuttle
SCUTTLE.description: Your hook-shaped feet curl inward to grip the ground, allowing you to easily walk along the bottom when you're underwater.  They're also a bit quicker at climbing over obstacles, even on dry land.

CRAB_LEGS.name: Crab Legs
CRAB_LEGS.description: You have four prong-tipped legs, splayed out and articulated like a crab's.  They're a little quieter than human feet.

BIRD_LEGS.name: Avian Legs
BIRD_LEGS.description: Your legs and feet have become bird-like, with long talons arranged three ahead and one behind.  They probably won't fit in human shoes, but they're perfect for gripping onto precarious perches.

ARM_TENTACLES.name: Tentacle Arms
ARM_TENTACLES.description: Your arms have transformed into tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  Reduces penalties for attacking while prone and somewhat decreases wet penalties.

attacks.attack_text_u: You slap %s with one of your tentacles!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s slaps %2$s with one of their tentacles!

attacks.attack_text_u: You rake %s with one of your tentacles!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s rakes %2$s with one of their tentacles!

ARM_TENTACLES_4.name: 4 Tentacles
ARM_TENTACLES_4.description: Your arms have transformed into four tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  You can make up to 3 extra attacks with them, and you suffer reduced penalties to attacking while prone.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.

attacks.attack_text_u: You slap %s with one of your tentacles!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s slaps %2$s with one of their tentacles!

attacks.attack_text_u: You rake %s with one of your tentacles!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s rakes %2$s with one of their tentacles!

ARM_TENTACLES_8.name: 8 Tentacles
ARM_TENTACLES_8.description: Your arms have transformed into eight tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  You can make up to 7 extra attacks with them, and suffer reduced penalties to attacking while prone.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.

attacks.attack_text_u: You slap %s with one of your tentacles!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s slaps %2$s with one of their tentacles!

attacks.attack_text_u: You rake %s with one of your tentacles!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s rakes %2$s with one of their tentacles!

LEG_TENTACLES.name: Leg Tentacles
LEG_TENTACLES.description: Your legs have transformed into six tentacles.  This decreases your speed on land by about 20%, makes your movement silent, increases your swimming speed and reduces wet penalties, but you can't use footwear any more.  Fortunately the lack of footwear does not reduce your speed, and your tentacles do not need splints to heal should they become critically damaged.

LEG_TENT_BRACE.name: Tentacle Bracing
LEG_TENT_BRACE.description: Your lower tentacles have developed suckers, perfect for walking along lake beds and ocean floors.  They make land movement marginally more tiring, do a good job of keeping you set in place.

CLAWS_TENTACLE.name: Tentacle Rakes
CLAWS_TENTACLE.description: Your upper tentacles have grown large, hook-barbed rakes on the ends.  They're quite vicious, but really aren't suited for fine manipulation.

HEAD_INSECT.name: Dragonfly Head
HEAD_INSECT.description: You remember having tiny, unassuming eyes condemned into cramped slits in your face.  No more.  Since your last molt your eyes take up most of your head, giving you inhuman reaction speed at the cost of fine vision.  You wouldn't want to cover up too much of the view, however.

THINSKIN.name: Thin-Skinned
THINSKIN.description: Your skin is fragile.  Cutting and bashing damage is slightly increased for you.

THICKSKIN.name: Thick-Skinned
THICKSKIN.description: Your skin is tough.  Cutting and bashing damage is slightly reduced for you.  There's a small chance you don't cut yourself on sharp terrain.

SKIN_PEELING.name: Peeling Skin
SKIN_PEELING.description: Your skin keeps peeling in big flakes, like you're recovering from a bad sunburn.  Oddly, it doesn't hurt at all.

SPARSE_SCALES.name: Sparse Scales
SPARSE_SCALES.description: Your skin has toughened and grown thin, flexible scales in some places, acting as natural armor.

SCALES.name: Scales
SCALES.description: Your skin has toughened further and your scales have grown to cover most of your body.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

THICK_SCALES.name: Thick Scales
THICK_SCALES.description: Your skin has grown thick and leathery and a set of heavy green scales has grown to cover most of your body, acting as natural armor.  Further, bony scutes cover your extremities, offering additional protection there.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

SLEEK_SCALES.name: Sleek Scales
SLEEK_SCALES.description: A set of very flexible and slick scales has grown to cover your toughened skin.  These act as decent natural armor, improve your ability to swim, and make you difficult to grab.  Mostly reduces wet effects.

SKIN_ROUGH.name: Goosebumps
SKIN_ROUGH.description: You have goosebumps that never seem to go away.  Are they getting bigger?

DOWN.name: Down
DOWN.description: You shan't need to migrate south with your layer of down.  It's even better with no apes around to kill you for it!

FEATHERS.name: Feathers
FEATHERS.description: Iridescent feathers have grown to cover your entire body, providing a marginal protection against attacks and minor protection from cold.  They also provide a natural waterproofing.

HIRSUTE.name: Hirsute
HIRSUTE.description: Your body hair is growing in thicker than it used to.  It's almost like you're going through a second puberty or something.

LIGHTFUR.name: Lightly Furred
LIGHTFUR.description: Light fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing marginal protection against attacks and slight protection from cold.

FUR.name: Furry
FUR.description: Thick black fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing minor protection against attacks, and considerable protection from cold.

LUPINE_FUR.name: Gray Fur
LUPINE_FUR.description: Dense gray fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing noticeable protection against attacks, and considerable protection from cold.

LUPINE_FUR_SUMMER.name: Summer Coat
LUPINE_FUR_SUMMER.description: Your entire body is covered in dense fur, but it's thinned out a bit for the summer, which may provide some relief from the heat at the cost of physical protection.

URSINE_FUR.name: Shaggy Fur
URSINE_FUR.description: Your fur has grown out and thickened, providing great protection from attacks as well as considerable insulation.

URSINE_FUR_SUMMER.name: Scruffy Fur
URSINE_FUR_SUMMER.description: You've lost your fluffy undercoat for the summer.  This feels a lot better in the heat, but it's less protective and looks a little bedraggled.

FELINE_FUR.name: Sleek Fur
FELINE_FUR.description: You've grown sleek fur, providing minor protection against attacks, and some protection from cold.

LYNX_FUR.name: Lynx Fur
LYNX_FUR.description: Your fur has grown out significantly around your cheeks and neck, providing excellent protection from attacks.

RABBIT_FUR.name: Rabbit Fur
RABBIT_FUR.description: Your fur keeps you covered in winter, maintaining heat and allowing you to better tolerate cold temperatures.

SKIN_RASHY.name: Rashy Skin
SKIN_RASHY.description: You've developed a persistent skin rash.  Sometimes it's fine, other times it itches like hell.

PATCHSKIN1.name: Jumbled Skin
PATCHSKIN1.description: Your skin has mutated into an amalgamation of fur and scales.

PATCHSKIN2.name: Patchwork Skin
PATCHSKIN2.description: Your skin has mutated into an amalgamation of thickened fur, scales, and more.

PATCHSKIN3.name: Patchwork Armor
PATCHSKIN3.description: Your skin has warped into a highly protective but inconsistent medley of chitin, scales, fur, and bone.

SPINES.name: Spines
SPINES.description: Your skin is covered with fine spines.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive moderate damage.

QUILLS.name: Quills
QUILLS.description: Your body is covered with large quills.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive significant damage.

BARBS.name: Assault Barbs
BARBS.description: Some of the quills on your arms have become quite loose.  By flinging your arms, you can fire off these quills as projectiles.

ranged_mutation.message: You fire off some of your quills.

SKIN_SMOOTH.name: Smooth Skin
SKIN_SMOOTH.description: Your skin has lost some of its color and taken on a smooth, papery texture.  This slightly reduces wet effects, but also makes you a little more vulnerable to cuts and scrapes.

CHITIN.name: Epicuticle
CHITIN.description: Your epidermis has turned into a thin, flexible layer of chitin.  It provides decent physical protection.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

CHITIN_MOLTED.name: Epicuticle (Molted)
CHITIN_MOLTED.description: Your epidermis has turned into a thin, flexible layer of chitin.  Newly molted, it feels a little tender, but it's still tough and leathery.

CHITIN2.name: Chitin Carapace
CHITIN2.description: You've grown a chitin exoskeleton, much like that of an insect.  It provides considerable physical protection, and make your punches hit a little harder.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

CHITIN2_MOLTED.name: Chitin Carapace (Molted)
CHITIN2_MOLTED.description: You've recently molted, and your chitin exoskeleton is still soft and vulnerable.

CHITIN3.name: Sclerotin Plate
CHITIN3.description: You've grown a sclerotin exoskeleton, akin to an organic suit of platemail.  It provides excellent physical protection and makes your punches hit harder, but reduces your Dexterity by 1 and encumbers all body parts but your eyes and mouth.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

CHITIN3_MOLTED.name: Sclerotin Plate (Molted)
CHITIN3_MOLTED.description: Your exoskeleton bears thick plates of chitin which have not fully sclerotized.  They won't provide good protection until they've had time to harden.

CHITIN_FUR.name: Hairy Chitin
CHITIN_FUR.description: You've developed some sort of hair growing out of your chitin.  It's a bit warmer than not having hair.

CHITIN_FUR2.name: Furred Chitin
CHITIN_FUR2.description: Your chitin hair has thickened and spread across your body.  It provides minor warmth and helps you sense nearby vibrations.

CHITIN_FUR3.name: Furred Plate
CHITIN_FUR3.description: Your thick exoskeleton boasts a fine coat of hairs that put feline whiskers to shame.

CRUSTACEAN_CARAPACE.name: Crustacean Carapace
CRUSTACEAN_CARAPACE.description: Your body is covered with a thick, near impenetrable, vividly-colored carapace.  It provides unmatched physical protection and even some protection from corrosive chemicals, but reduces your dexterity by 2 and encumbers all body parts except your eyes.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

CRUSTACEAN_CARAPACE_MOLTED.name: Crustacean Carapace (Molted)
CRUSTACEAN_CARAPACE_MOLTED.description: You're covered in a great chitin carapace which reduces your Dexterity by 1, however it has recently molted and will offer poor protection until it has time to harden.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

CAMO1.name: Colorful Skin
CAMO1.description: Your skin is covered in shifting patterns of dots, lines, and swirls.  This is outside of your control and does not help your stealth.  In fact, it makes you more noticeable.

CAMO2.name: Camouflage Skin
CAMO2.description: Your can change your skin patterns to match your environment, somewhat increasing your stealthiness.

JAUNDICE.name: Jaundice
JAUNDICE.description: It's subtle, but your skin has definitely taken on a sickly yellow-green hue.

PLANTSKIN.name: Phelloderm
PLANTSKIN.description: Your skin is light green and has a slightly woody quality to it.  This provides armor and helps you retain moisture, resulting in less thirst.  Greatly decreases wet penalties.

BARK.name: Protective Bark
BARK.description: Your skin is coated in a light bark, like that of a tree.  This provides powerful armor and makes you nearly waterproof.

BARK2_a.name: Shifting Bark (Distributed)
BARK2_a.description: Your warped bark can be shifted in function, and is currently spread evenly.  Activate to better protect your torso, at the cost of other areas.

transform.msg_transform: Your bark ripples across your body, repositioning at a cellular level.

BARK2_b.name: Shifting Bark (Consolidated)
BARK2_b.description: Your warped bark can be shifted in function, and is currently consolidated on your torso.  Activate to shift your bark into a lattice, increasing bulk but providing better protection for the entire body.

transform.msg_transform: Your bark ripples across your body, repositioning at a cellular level.

BARK2_c.name: Shifting Bark (Latticed)
BARK2_c.description: Your warped bark can be shifted in function, and is currently expanded into a sturdy lattice.  Activate to collapse the lattice, returning to an evenly distributed form.

transform.msg_transform: Your bark ripples across your body, repositioning at a cellular level.

VULNERABLECHILL.name: Cold Intolerance
VULNERABLECHILL.description: You fare worse than most in colder climates and are more bothered by lower temperatures.  Note that while it will take less cold and exposure for you to suffer the effects of frostbite, you aren't any worse at dealing with the symptoms.

STRONGER_VULNERABLECHILL.name: High Cold Intolerance
STRONGER_VULNERABLECHILL.description: You are now even more bothered by the cold and it is easier for you to freeze or to even get chilly.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.

RESISTCHILL.name: Cold Tolerance
RESISTCHILL.description: You fare better than most in colder climates and are less bothered by lower temperatures.  Note that while it will take more cold and exposure for you to suffer the effects of frostbite, you aren't any better at dealing with the symptoms.

STRONGER_RESISTCHILL.name: High Cold Tolerance
STRONGER_RESISTCHILL.description: You are now even less bothered by the cold and it is harder for you to freeze or to even get chilly.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.

VULNERABLEWARM.name: Heat Intolerance
VULNERABLEWARM.description: You fare worse than most in warmer climates and are more bothered by hotter temperatures.  Note that while it will take less heat and exposure for you to suffer the effects of sunstroke, you aren't any worse at dealing with the symptoms.

STRONGER_VULNERABLEWARM.name: High Heat Intolerance
STRONGER_VULNERABLEWARM.description: You are now even more bothered by the heat and it is easier for you to overheat or even sweat.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.

RESISTWARM.name: Heat Tolerance
RESISTWARM.description: You fare better than most in warmer climates and are less bothered by hotter temperatures.  Note that while it will take more heat and exposure for you to suffer the effects of sunstroke, you aren't any better at dealing with the symptoms.

STRONGER_RESISTWARM.name: High Heat Tolerance
STRONGER_RESISTWARM.description: You are now even less bothered by the heat and it is harder for you to overheat or even sweat.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.

RESISTCHILL_RESISTWARM.name: Temperature Tolerance
RESISTCHILL_RESISTWARM.description: You are now not at all bothered by the heat and it is harder for you to overheat or freeze at all.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.

INTERSTICE_RESISTCHILL_RESISTWARM.name: Ambient Resilience
INTERSTICE_RESISTCHILL_RESISTWARM.description: You are less sensitive to hot and cold, but you can still freeze and overheat.

INTERSTICE_RESISTCHILL_RESISTWARM_2.name: High Ambient Resilience
INTERSTICE_RESISTCHILL_RESISTWARM_2.description: Your body can handle extreme temperatures much better, but you can still freeze and overheat.

INTERSTICE_AURA.name: Penumbral Interstitium
INTERSTICE_AURA.description: Your cells operate under different rules.  While you still need to breathe, you are otherwise extremely resistant to the thermal and chemical insults of the so-called universe.

INTERSTICE_RESONANCE.name: Resonant
INTERSTICE_RESONANCE.description: Your physiology plays by different rules, and it seems the universe has noticed.

INTERSTICE_RESONANCE_2.name: Outsider
INTERSTICE_RESONANCE_2.description: Your physiology plays by different rules.  The universe will notice you in your former homeworld.

INTERSTICE_RESONANCE_3.name: Deeply Incongruent
INTERSTICE_RESONANCE_3.description: Your physiology plays by different rules, and it has caught the attention of something.

QUICK.name: Quick
QUICK.description: You're just generally quick!  You get a 10% bonus to action points.

DEFT.name: Deft
DEFT.description: While you're not any better at melee combat, you are better at recovering from a miss, and will be able to attempt another strike faster.

FAST_REFLEXES.name: Fast Reflexes
FAST_REFLEXES.description: You have fast reflexes, allowing you to dodge attacks more easily.

FLEET.name: Fleet-Footed
FLEET.description: You can move more quickly than most, resulting in a 15% speed bonus on sure footing.

FLEET2.name: Road-Runner
FLEET2.description: Your legs are extremely limber and fast-moving.  You move 30% faster on flat surfaces.

SLOWRUNNER.name: Slow Footed
SLOWRUNNER.description: You can't move as fast as most, resulting in a 15% speed penalty on flat ground.

LIGHTSTEP.name: Light Step
LIGHTSTEP.description: You make less noise while walking.  You're also less likely to set off traps.

GOODCARDIO.name: Indefatigable
GOODCARDIO.description: Whether due to exercise and good diet, or due to a natural propensity to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much less readily than others.  Your cardio fitness and maximum stamina are higher than usual.

GOODCARDIO2.name: Hyperactive
GOODCARDIO2.description: Your body's efficiency is like that of a tiny furnace, greatly increasing your cardio and stamina.

BADCARDIO.name: Languorous
BADCARDIO.description: Whether due to lack of exercise and poor diet, or due to a natural disinclination to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much more readily than others.  Your total cardio fitness and stamina are lower than normal.

BADKNEES.name: Bad Knees
BADKNEES.description: Whether due to injury or age, your knees aren't particularly strong or flexible.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down more than normal.

REALLYBADKNEES.name: Stiff Knees
REALLYBADKNEES.description: Your knees never bend.  Period.  Stiff as a metal pole.  Pray that your journey doesn't involve stairs or slightly uneven terrain.

TOUGH_FEET.name: Tough Feet
TOUGH_FEET.description: The bottoms of your feet are tough, and you are accustomed to going barefoot.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes.

STRONGBACK.name: Strong Back
STRONGBACK.description: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 35%.

BADBACK.name: Bad Back
BADBACK.description: You simply cannot carry as much as people with a similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is reduced by 35%.

PACKMULE.name: Packmule
PACKMULE.description: You pack things very efficiently!  You can retrieve things from containers 10% faster.

DISORGANIZED.name: Disorganized
DISORGANIZED.description: You are terrible at organizing and storing your possessions.  You retrieve things from containers 10% slower.

GOODHEARING.name: Good Hearing
GOODHEARING.description: Your hearing is better than average, and you can hear distant sounds more easily.

BADHEARING.name: Poor Hearing
BADHEARING.description: Your hearing is poor, and you may not hear quiet or far-off noises.

DEAF.name: Deaf
DEAF.description: You're not able to hear anything, and as such you're not able to talk to NPCs.

TOUGH.name: Tough
TOUGH.description: It takes a lot to bring you down!  You get a 20% bonus to all hit points.

TOUGH2.name: Durable
TOUGH2.description: You can shrug off almost anything!  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.

TOUGH3.name: Unbreakable
TOUGH3.description: Nothing can break you!  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.

FLIMSY.name: Flimsy
FLIMSY.description: Your body can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 25% lower than usual.  Your weakness is apparent and makes you less intimidating.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

FLIMSY2.name: Frail
FLIMSY2.description: Your body breaks very easily.  Its maximum HP is 50% lower than usual.  Your weakness is apparent and makes you less intimidating.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

FLIMSY3.name: Fragile
FLIMSY3.description: Your body is extremely fragile.  Its maximum HP is 75% lower than usual.  Your weakness is apparent and makes you less intimidating.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

GLASSJAW.name: Glass Jaw
GLASSJAW.description: Your head can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 20% lower than usual.  Your apparent fragility makes you less intimidating.

FASTHEALER.name: Fast Healer
FASTHEALER.description: Your wounds and broken limbs heal quicker than usual.

FASTHEALER2.name: Very Fast Healer
FASTHEALER2.description: Your wounds and broken limbs heal very quickly.

SLOWHEALER.name: Slow Healer
SLOWHEALER.description: Your wounds heal a little slower than most.  Your HP whilst asleep, as well as your broken limbs, heal at 75% of the regular rate.

SLOWHEALER2.name: Poor Healer
SLOWHEALER2.description: Your health recovery is severely impaired.  Your HP whilst asleep, as well as your broken limbs, heal at 33% of the regular rate.

SLOWHEALER3.name: Imperceptive Healer
SLOWHEALER3.description: Wounds are incredibly dangerous to you, as they barely heal at all.  Your HP whilst asleep, as well as your broken limbs, heal at 10% of the regular rate.

NOHEAL.name: Irreparable
NOHEAL.description: Whatever caused the end of the world affected you in a horrible way.  Your wounds will never heal on their own and your broken limbs will never mend.

POISRESIST.name: Poison Resistant
POISRESIST.description: Your system is rather tolerant of poisons and toxins, and most will affect you less.

INFRESIST.name: Infection Resistant
INFRESIST.description: Your immune system is particularly good at resisting infections.  You have an increased chance for bad wounds and infections to heal on their own, and only suffer reduced penalties from them.

INFIMMUNE.name: Infection Immune
INFIMMUNE.description: Your bloodstream has developed antibiotic properties.  Your wounds will never become infected.

DISRESISTANT.name: Disease Resistant
DISRESISTANT.description: It's very unlikely that you will catch ambient diseases like the cold or flu.

DISIMMUNE.name: Disease Immune
DISIMMUNE.description: Your body is simply immune to diseases.  You will never catch an ambient disease.

MASOCHIST.name: Pain Driven
MASOCHIST.description: Although you still suffer the negative effects of pain, it also brings a unique pleasure to you.

PAINRESIST.name: Pain Resistant
PAINRESIST.description: You have a high tolerance for pain.

MORE_PAIN.name: Pain Sensitive
MORE_PAIN.description: For some reason, things always seem to hurt you more.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 25%.

MORE_PAIN2.name: Hyperalgesia
MORE_PAIN2.description: Your body experiences pain out of proportion to the physical causes.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 50%.

MORE_PAIN3.name: Extreme Hyperalgesia
MORE_PAIN3.description: Your body reacts cripplingly to any source of pain.  Pain dealt to you is doubled.

XXXL.name: Weight: XXXL
XXXL.description: You gained an awful lot of weight before the Cataclysm.  Whatever the reason, now that mobility is key to survival, your bloated figure presents an additional danger.  You need to lose weight or die trying.

XS.name: Weight: XS
XS.description: You lost an awful lot of weight before the Cataclysm.  Whatever the reason, now that food is not always close at hand, your skeletal figure presents an additional danger.  You need to gain weight or die trying.

VERY_SHORT.name: Very Short
VERY_SHORT.description: You are significantly shorter than the general population.  You can't carry quite as much as a person of average height and you need special accommodations to drive a car, but otherwise being little isn't too much of a bother.

VERY_TALL.name: Very Tall
VERY_TALL.description: You are significantly taller than the general population.  This leaves you with high blood pressure, a big appetite, and some minor health concerns, but you can carry a bit more than normal.

NIGHTVISION.name: Night Vision
NIGHTVISION.description: You possess natural night vision, and can see further in the dark than most.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

NIGHTVISION2.name: High Night Vision
NIGHTVISION2.description: You can see incredibly well in the dark!  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

NIGHTVISION3.name: Full Night Vision
NIGHTVISION3.description: You can see in pitch blackness as if you were wearing night-vision goggles.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

MYOPIC.name: Near-Sighted
MYOPIC.description: Without glasses, your seeing radius is severely reduced!  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of glasses.

HYPEROPIC.name: Far-Sighted
HYPEROPIC.description: Without reading glasses, you are unable to read anything, and take penalties on melee accuracy and electronics/tailoring crafting.  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of reading glasses.

MESOPIC.name: Mesopic
MESOPIC.description: You find it difficult to see very far in bright light.  On its own, this doesn't necessarily make you any better in the dark.

EAGLEEYED.name: Scout
EAGLEEYED.description: You're an excellent navigator and your ability to recognize distant landmarks is unmatched.  Your sight radius on the overmap extends beyond the normal range.

INTERSTICE_VISION.name: Tenebrous Sight
INTERSTICE_VISION.description: Useless things like light have no bearing on your ability to navigate the universe.

INTERSTICE_VISION2.name: Ontological Sight
INTERSTICE_VISION2.description: You've become attuned to the folds and gaps in the world and you now detect nearby creatures through them.

UNOBSERVANT.name: Topographagnosia
UNOBSERVANT.description: Focal brain damage has rendered you incapable of recognizing landmarks and orienting yourself in your surroundings, severely crippling your sight radius on the overmap.

HEAVYSLEEPER.name: Heavy Sleeper
HEAVYSLEEPER.description: You're quite the heavy sleeper.  Noises are unlikely to wake you up.

HEAVYSLEEPER2.name: Very Heavy Sleeper
HEAVYSLEEPER2.description: You could probably sleep through a firefight.

SLEEPY.name: Sleepy
SLEEPY.description: You need sleep more often, but still spend most of your time awake.

SLEEPY2.name: Very Sleepy
SLEEPY2.description: You find yourself needing to sleep quite often.  You'll spend about half of your time in or around a bed.

WAKEFUL.name: Less Sleep
WAKEFUL.description: You need less sleep than the average person.

WAKEFUL2.name: Very Little Sleep
WAKEFUL2.description: You don't sleep often.  But when you do, you need very little of it.

WAKEFUL3.name: Tireless
WAKEFUL3.description: You defend the realm all night and all day.

EASYSLEEPER.name: Accomplished Sleeper
EASYSLEEPER.description: You have always been able to fall asleep easily, even when sleeping in less than ideal circumstances.

EASYSLEEPER2.name: Practiced Sleeper
EASYSLEEPER2.description: Your body's demanding energy needs mean you can fall asleep just about anywhere.

ALBINO.name: Albino
ALBINO.description: You lack skin pigmentation due to a genetic problem.  You sunburn extremely easily, and typically use an umbrella and sunglasses when going out in the sun.

ASTHMA.name: Asthmatic
ASTHMA.description: You will occasionally need to use an inhaler, or else suffer severe physical limitations.  However, you are guaranteed to start with an inhaler.

SEASONAL_ALLERGIES.name: Seasonal Allergies
SEASONAL_ALLERGIES.description: You tend to get hay fever, especially in springtime.  Antihistamines are your friend.

WOOLALLERGY.name: Wool Allergy
WOOLALLERGY.description: You are badly allergic to wool, and cannot wear any clothing made of the substance.

NO_CBM_INSTALLATION.name: Oversensitive System
NO_CBM_INSTALLATION.description: While it doesn't cause you any problems in daily life, your immune system and body chemistry are overly sensitive to foreign implants.  You cannot have any CBMs installed.

CHEMIMBALANCE.name: Chemical Imbalance
CHEMIMBALANCE.description: You suffer from a minor chemical imbalance, whether mental or physical.  Minor changes to your internal chemistry will manifest themselves on occasion, such as hunger, sleepiness, narcotic effects, etc.

WEAKSCENT.name: Weak Scent
WEAKSCENT.description: Your scent is quite weak.  Animals that track your scent will do so with more difficulty.

SMELLY.name: Strong Scent
SMELLY.description: Your scent is particularly strong.  It's not offensive to humans, but animals that track your scent will do so more easily.

SMELLY2.name: Smelly
SMELLY2.description: You smell awful.  Monsters that track scent will find you very easily, and humans will react poorly.

HUNGER.name: Fast Metabolism
HUNGER.description: You require more food than most people, but recover stamina slightly faster.

HUNGER2.name: Very Fast Metabolism
HUNGER2.description: You need about twice as much food as the average human to maintain your expanded cardiovascular and respiratory systems.  On the plus side, it doesn't take you much time to recover from any strenuous activity.

HUNGER3.name: Extreme Metabolism
HUNGER3.description: You consume three times as much food as the average human to maintain your truly superhuman endurance.

THIRST.name: High Thirst
THIRST.description: Your body dries out easily; you need to drink more water.

THIRST2.name: Very Thirsty
THIRST2.description: Ugh, out of water already?  You need about twice the fluids of an average human.

THIRST3.name: Extremely Thirsty
THIRST3.description: You dry out seriously quickly, requiring three times as much liquid to stay hydrated.

TINYSTOMACH.name: Tiny Stomach
TINYSTOMACH.description: Either as the result of a lifesaving surgery, or as a congenital defect, your stomach is much smaller than usual.  You'll have to eat your food in small servings during the day, rather than one or two large daily meals.

STRONGSTOMACH.name: Strong Stomach
STRONGSTOMACH.description: You are less likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up despite this, you won't suffer any residual nausea.

WEAKSTOMACH.name: Weak Stomach
WEAKSTOMACH.description: You are more likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.

NAUSEA.name: Nausea
NAUSEA.description: You feel nauseated almost constantly, and are more liable to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  You can, if desired, think yourself into vomiting, too.

VOMITOUS.name: Vomitous
VOMITOUS.description: You have a major digestive disorder.  Though it causes you to vomit frequently, you have found that you can trigger your vomit reflex on demand, too.

VEGETARIAN.name: Meat Intolerance
VEGETARIAN.description: You have problems with eating meat.  It's possible for you to eat it, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from it.

VEGAN.name: Vegan
VEGAN.description: You're very strictly vegan, eating animal products is out of the question, even if it means death.  You also can't bear to wear clothing made of animal products, such as leather or fur.

MEATARIAN.name: Hates Vegetables
MEATARIAN.description: You have problems with eating vegetables.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

ANTIFRUIT.name: Fructose Intolerance
ANTIFRUIT.description: Eating fruits always causes your stomach to ache.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

LACTOSE.name: Lactose Intolerance
LACTOSE.description: You, like 75 percent of the world, cannot tolerate milk or milk based products.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

ANTIJUNK.name: Junkfood Intolerance
ANTIJUNK.description: Something in those heavily processed foods doesn't agree with you.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

ANTIWHEAT.name: Grain Intolerance
ANTIWHEAT.description: You have a rare allergy that prevents you from eating wheat.  It's possible for you to eat wheat-based products, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

CANNIBAL.name: Cannibal
CANNIBAL.description: For your whole life you've been forbidden from indulging in your peculiar tastes.  Now the world's ended, and you'll be damned if anyone is going to tell you that you can't eat people.

STRICT_HUMANITARIAN.name: Strict Humanitarian
STRICT_HUMANITARIAN.description: You're convinced that these things that look vaguely human from elsewhere are definitely not people.  Therefore it's okay to eat them, right?

PROJUNK.name: Sweet Tooth
PROJUNK.description: You have a soft spot for processed foods, and gain a morale bonus from eating them.

PROJUNK2.name: Sugar-Loving
PROJUNK2.description: You *adore* the taste of junk food, and find it preferable to everything else!

GOURMAND.name: Gourmand
GOURMAND.description: You eat faster, and can eat and drink more, than anyone else!  You also enjoy food more; delicious food is better for your morale, and you don't mind unsavory meals as much.  Activate to skip prompt for overeating.

LIGHTEATER.name: Light Eater
LIGHTEATER.description: Your metabolism is a little slower, and you require less food than most.

PICKYEATER.name: Picky Eater
PICKYEATER.description: You're a very picky eater.  You refuse to eat any food that tastes bad unless you're starving.

TABLEMANNERS.name: Rigid Table Manners
TABLEMANNERS.description: You've been taught proper table manners from your early childhood on; now, you can't even think about eating without being seated at a table and taking your time.  Eating without a table and chair frustrates you, but eating like a civilized person gives you a bigger morale bonus.

NONADDICTIVE.name: Addiction Resistant
NONADDICTIVE.description: Whether due to a lifetime of exposure or through simple willpower, it's harder for you to become addicted to substances, and easier to rid yourself of these addictions.

ADDICTIVE.name: Addictive Personality
ADDICTIVE.description: It's easier for you to become addicted to substances, and harder to rid yourself of these addictions.

TOLERANCE.name: Substance Tolerance
TOLERANCE.description: You can handle intoxicants well.  Their effects clear up more quickly for you.

LIGHTWEIGHT.name: Lightweight
LIGHTWEIGHT.description: Alcohol and drugs go straight to your head.  You suffer the negative effects of these for longer.

CLUMSY.name: Clumsy
CLUMSY.description: You make more noise while walking.  You're also more likely to set off traps.

JITTERY.name: Jittery
JITTERY.description: When very hungry or under the effects of stimulants, you may find your hands shaking uncontrollably, severely reducing your Dexterity.

SCHIZOPHRENIC.name: Kaluptic Psychosis
SCHIZOPHRENIC.description: Ever since the sky first broke, you have felt unwell, your head split by alien thoughts.  You will periodically suffer from delusions, ranging from minor effects to full visual hallucinations.  Some of these effects may be controlled through the use of antipsychotics.

NARCOLEPTIC.name: Narcoleptic
NARCOLEPTIC.description: You randomly fall asleep without any reason.

PSYCHOPATH.name: Uncaring
PSYCHOPATH.description: You don't feel any strong feelings for your fellow man.

PYROMANIA.name: Pyromaniac
PYROMANIA.description: You have an unhealthy obsession with fire, and you get anxious if you don't light them every now and then or stand near them often.  However, you gain a mood bonus from doing so.

INSOMNIA.name: Insomniac
INSOMNIA.description: You have a hard time falling asleep, even under the best circumstances!

WAYFARER.name: Wayfarer
WAYFARER.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, traveling with vehicles is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.

COMPUTER_ILLITERATE.name: Computer Illiterate
COMPUTER_ILLITERATE.description: You just never really figured out how to use those infernal devices.  You cannot use computer terminals and cannot raise the computer skill above 0.

PACIFIST.name: Pacifist
PACIFIST.description: You don't like thinking about violence.  Your combat skills advance much slower than usual, and you feel more guilt about killing.

BRAWLER.name: Brawler
BRAWLER.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, using ranged weapons is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.

GUNSHY.name: Gun-Shy
GUNSHY.description: Using a firearm is off limits, due to personal philosophy or a traumatic event.  You can still use bows and slings.

HOARDER.name: Hoarder
HOARDER.description: You don't feel right unless you're carrying a bunch of stuff.  You want to always have the right tool for every occasion, whether that's a knife, a gas mask, fresh water, a crowbar, or jelly babies.  If you can't be well stocked, then even carrying junk helps keep the horrible thoughts quiet.  Xanax can help control this anxiety.

INATTENTIVE.name: Inattentive
INATTENTIVE.description: You never paid attention to your surroundings and specifically to people around you.  You can't judge the intent of critters you see.

SPIRITUAL.name: Spiritual
SPIRITUAL.description: You've always felt that there is more to the world than we can see.  Whether driven by religious beliefs or philosophical interest, you find great inspiration in studying holy texts and experiencing mystical things.

NYCTOPHOBIA.name: Nyctophobia
NYCTOPHOBIA.description: You are terribly afraid of the dark.  You refuse to enter very dark areas.  If you somehow still happen to stay in dark areas, you suffer from various detrimental mental and physical effects.

SQUEAMISH.name: Squeamish
SQUEAMISH.description: You can't even think about putting filthy clothes on yourself, especially from zombies' corpses.

OUTDOORSMAN.name: Outdoorsman
OUTDOORSMAN.description: You are accustomed to being exposed to the elements.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.

NOMAD.name: Nomad
NOMAD.description: You're too adventurous for your own good.  The more time you spend somewhere, the unhappier it makes you to be there.

NOMAD2.name: Antsy
NOMAD2.description: You can't bear to stay still for long.  Your morale will suffer unless you constantly explore new territory.

NOMAD3.name: Restless
NOMAD3.description: Spending any amount of time in familiar places makes you miserable.  Must.  Keep.  Moving.

GOODMEMORY.name: Good Memory
GOODMEMORY.description: You have an exceptional memory, and find it easy to remember things.  This makes it easier to apply your theoretical knowledge when learning skills.  However, you don't benefit as much as other people from dropping a subject for a while and will thus end up learning slower.

FORGETFUL.name: Forgetful
FORGETFUL.description: You have a hard time remembering things.  Your skills will erode slightly faster than usual, it's harder for you to apply your book-learning to the real world, and you have trouble keeping your story straight when lying.

LOVES_BOOKS.name: Bookworm
LOVES_BOOKS.description: There's nothing quite like the smell of a good book!  Books are more fun (or less boring) for you!

HATES_BOOKS.name: Hates Books
HATES_BOOKS.description: Reading is for nerds!  Boring books are more boring, and you can't have fun by reading books.

FASTREADER.name: Fast Reader
FASTREADER.description: You're a quick reader, and can get through books a lot faster than most.

SLOWREADER.name: Slow Reader
SLOWREADER.description: You're a slow reader, and it takes you longer to get through books than most.

ILLITERATE.name: Illiterate
ILLITERATE.description: You never learned to read!  Books and computers are off-limits to you.

FASTLEARNER.name: Fast Learner
FASTLEARNER.description: You have a flexible mind, allowing you to learn skills much faster than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

SLOWLEARNER.name: Slow Learner
SLOWLEARNER.description: You are slow to grasp new ideas, and thus learn things more slowly than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

SAVANT.name: Savant
SAVANT.description: You tend to specialize in one skill and be poor at all others.  You advance at half speed in all skills except your best one.  Note that combining this with Fast Learner will come out to a slower rate of learning for all skills.

OPTIMISTIC.name: Optimist
OPTIMISTIC.description: Nothing gets you down!  You savor the joys of life, ignore its hardships, and are generally happier than most people.

BADTEMPER.name: Bad Temper
BADTEMPER.description: Things just keep getting you down.  You tend to be unhappy, and it takes some doing to cheer you up.

MOODSWINGS.name: Mood Swings
MOODSWINGS.description: Your morale will shift up and down at random, often dramatically.

SEASONAL_AFFECTIVE.name: Seasonal Affective Disorder
SEASONAL_AFFECTIVE.description: You tend to have bouts of depression during the fall and especially winter.  Taking antidepressants can help.

PRETTY.name: Pretty
PRETTY.description: You are a sight to behold.  People who care about such things will react more kindly to you.

UGLY.name: Ugly
UGLY.description: You're not much to look at.  People who care about such things will react poorly to you.

BEAUTIFUL.name: Beautiful
BEAUTIFUL.description: You're a real head-turner.  Some people will react well to your appearance, and most people have an easier time trusting you.

BEAUTIFUL2.name: Very Beautiful
BEAUTIFUL2.description: You are a vision of beauty.  Some people will react very well to your looks, and most people will trust you immediately.

BEAUTIFUL3.name: Glorious
BEAUTIFUL3.description: You are incredibly beautiful.  People cannot help themselves due to your charms, and will do whatever they can to please you.

DEFORMED.name: Deformed
DEFORMED.description: You're slightly deformed.  Some people will react badly to your appearance.

DEFORMED2.name: Badly Deformed
DEFORMED2.description: You're hideously deformed.  Some people will have a strong negative reaction to your appearance.

DEFORMED3.name: Grotesque
DEFORMED3.description: Your visage is disgusting and liable to induce vomiting.  People will not want to interact with you unless they have a very good reason to.

DEFORMED_INTERSTICE.name: Gloam Presence
DEFORMED_INTERSTICE.description: Something about you and your muted features darkens minds and moods.  People will be very unwilling to engage with you.

LIAR.name: Skilled Liar
LIAR.description: You have no qualms about bending the truth, and have practically no tells.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much easier for you.

TRUTHTELLER.name: Truth Teller
TRUTHTELLER.description: When you try to tell a lie, you blush, stammer, and get all shifty-eyed.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much more difficult for you.

SOCIAL1.name: Extrovert
SOCIAL1.description: You don't mind being alone, but you get a slight mood boost from being around friends.

SOCIAL2.name: Sociable
SOCIAL2.description: You are a social creature.  Spending time with friends will improve your mood, but if you're alone too long, you'll start to feel unhappy.

ASOCIAL1.name: Introvert
ASOCIAL1.description: You can tolerate others, but you prefer to be alone.  Spending time by yourself will boost your mood slightly.

ASOCIAL2.name: Loner
ASOCIAL2.description: You'd really rather be by yourself.  Being alone will improve your mood, but spending too much time around other people can grate on your nerves.

CHANGING.name: Changing
CHANGING.description: You shouldn't see this.  This makes you mutate.

THRESH_FISH.name: Aquatic
THRESH_FISH.description: Ninety percent of the planet, and it's yours to explore.  And colonize.  And enjoy.  What was that about a surface?

THRESH_SLIME.name: Aqueous
THRESH_SLIME.description: What was that old advertisement?  'Paint the planet'?  That might be a good long-term goal, but for now…

THRESH_SPIDER.name: Arachnid
THRESH_SPIDER.description: Well, maybe you'll just have to make your own worldwide web.

THRESH_BATRACHIAN.name: Batrachian
THRESH_BATRACHIAN.description: A perfect ambush predator, if only there were less competition.

THRESH_URSINE.name: Bear
THRESH_URSINE.description: So the humans died; what's the worry?  Now they won't ruin the woods.

THRESH_BEAST.name: Beast
THRESH_BEAST.description: It's about time you grew out.  Now that you've matured, it is time to make something of yourself.

THRESH_BIRD.name: Bird
THRESH_BIRD.description: You're sure you'll fly someday.  In the meantime, there are still nests to build.

THRESH_CATTLE.name: Bovine
THRESH_CATTLE.description: Civilization collapsed?  Great!  You and your kin will never have to worry about a slaughterhouse again.

THRESH_CEPHALOPOD.name: Cephalopod
THRESH_CEPHALOPOD.description: Strange aeons, true, but Death seems to be slacking, and you are doing just fine.

THRESH_CHIMERA.name: Chaos
THRESH_CHIMERA.description: You can't tell what you are anymore.  Everything and yet nothing, like you weren't meant to exist.  But you do, and you're a force, no matter what happens.  Unlocks gaining post-threshold traits from most other mutation categories.

THRESH_CHIROPTERAN.name: Chiropteran
THRESH_CHIROPTERAN.description: You long for a colony, the cover of darkness, and a meal on the wing.

THRESH_CRUSTACEAN.name: Crustacean
THRESH_CRUSTACEAN.description: Who needs skin when you can have a hard carapace?

THRESH_MOUSE.name: Diminutive
THRESH_MOUSE.description: So much food, everywhere!  And nobody's even guarding it anymore!  These are good times.

THRESH_FELINE.name: Feline
THRESH_FELINE.description: Stalking prey, eating well, and lying in the sun.  Mmm, all you could ever desire.

THRESH_ELFA.name: Fey
THRESH_ELFA.description: You are the tree under which humankind will shelter during these dark times.

THRESH_GASTROPOD.name: Gastropod
THRESH_GASTROPOD.description: You feel bad for all the creatures that don't carry their home on their backs.

THRESH_INSECT.name: Insect
THRESH_INSECT.description: It would be good to be a queen, having workers constantly servicing your every need… but how would you keep them in line?

THRESH_RABBIT.name: Lagomorph
THRESH_RABBIT.description: You really want to eat some carrots.  Welcome to the Lagomorpha family.

THRESH_LIZARD.name: Lizard
THRESH_LIZARD.description: You sometimes look back on your days before your tail came in.  But you're better now.

THRESH_PLANT.name: Plant
THRESH_PLANT.description: Well, you still have those other walking flowers--and the mushrooms, too--to deal with.  But you'll manage.

THRESH_ALPHA.name: Prime
THRESH_ALPHA.description: You're the perfect candidate to tidy this mess.

THRESH_MEDICAL.name: Prototype
THRESH_MEDICAL.description: After all those experiments, what's a few more, hmm?

THRESH_RAPTOR.name: Raptor
THRESH_RAPTOR.description: The chance to undo not one but TWO extinction events.  You're confident you'll do fine.

THRESH_TROGLOBITE.name: Subterranean
THRESH_TROGLOBITE.description: Not much point to rebuilding up in that horribly bright, roofless wasteland.  Now that you've become accustomed to your new digs, there's the beginning of a great empire right here, underground.

THRESH_RAT.name: Survivor
THRESH_RAT.description: Hey.  Civilization fell.  You're still around.  'Rat' just isn't respectful.

THRESH_LUPINE.name: Wolf
THRESH_LUPINE.description: You're the perfect candidate to lead a pack.

THRESH_INTERSTICE.name: Interstitial
THRESH_INTERSTICE.description: You're still here, mostly.  But you have seen the other places, and part of you lives in the cracks between those realities.

ROBUST.name: Robust Genetics
ROBUST.description: Your genome has rapidly adapted to the Cataclysm and can handle the strain of mutation better.  Taking different kinds of mutagen won't result in more defective mutations than normal.

UNSTABLE.name: Genetically Unstable
UNSTABLE.description: Your DNA has been damaged in a way that causes you to continually develop more mutations.

CHAOTIC.name: Genetic Chaos
CHAOTIC.description: Your body alters itself rapidly, and without your intervention or conscious control.

CHAOTIC_BAD.name: Genetic Downward Spiral
CHAOTIC_BAD.description: The events of the Cataclysm have damaged your DNA beyond repair.  You mutate frequently, all mutations you receive (from any source) are negative, and your instability is rapidly growing out of control.

RESISTANT_GENETICS.name: Resistant Genetics
RESISTANT_GENETICS.description: Your body eats up lesser mutagens faster than normal.  Exotic and esoteric mutagens will still affect you normally.

RESTRICTED.name: Restricted Genetics
RESTRICTED.description: Your genome has become an impregnable fortress to lesser genetic deviations.  You are no longer able to mutate traits that are outside of the Alpha category nor regress to unremarkable humanity.  Any other mutations that you previously developed are safe for now.

MAKAYLA_MUTATOR.name: Catastrophic Mutation
MAKAYLA_MUTATOR.description: Exposure to portal storms and related phenomena causes you to mutate in a mostly predictable fashion.

MUTAGEN_AVOID.name: Mutagenic Aversion
MUTAGEN_AVOID.description: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to those mutagen and purifier things, you can't bear the thought of ever using them again!

HEMOVORE.name: Hemovore
HEMOVORE.description: You can still eat other food, but you crave the taste of blood over everything else.  Without a steady supply or some kind of iron supplement, you're prone to developing anemia.

HERBIVORE.name: Herbivore
HERBIVORE.description: Your body's ability to digest meat is severely hampered.  Eating meat has a good chance of making you vomit it back up; even if you manage to keep it down, its nutritional value is greatly reduced.

SAPIOVORE.name: Sapiovore
SAPIOVORE.description: The hairless apes make as good eating as any other meat.

CARNIVORE.name: Carnivore
CARNIVORE.description: Your body's ability to digest fruits, vegetables, grains and nuts is severely hampered.  You cannot eat anything besides meat.  While your vitamin C needs are lowered, it's still needed and can be found often in organ meat.

CARNIVORE_FAKE.name: Imitation Carnivore
CARNIVORE_FAKE.description: Fake mutation to allow post-threshold Ursine mutants access to mutations normally gated behind Carnivore.  This is not meant to be visible in-game.

SAPROVORE.name: Saprovore
SAPROVORE.description: Your digestive system is specialized to allow you to consume decaying material.  You can eat rotten food, albeit for less nutrition than usual.

EATPOISON.name: Intestinal Fortitude
EATPOISON.description: Your guts have developed the ability to handle the toxic elements of mutated flesh.  Mostly.

EATDEAD.name: Eater Of The Dead
EATDEAD.description: Your digestion has evolved further.  In addition to mutated meat, you can also stomach the tainted and long-dead flesh of zombies… if you can stand the taste, of course.

GROWL.name: Growling Voice
GROWL.description: You have a growling, rough voice.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.

SNARL.name: Snarling Voice
SNARL.description: You have a threatening snarl in your voice.  Persuading NPCs will be near impossible, but threatening them will be much easier.

HISS.name: Hissing Voice
HISS.description: You hiss when speaking.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.

SCREECH.name: Screeching Voice
SCREECH.description: Your voice sounds like a bird trying to imitate a human.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.

CROAK.name: Croaking Voice
CROAK.description: You have a low, croaking voice, like an aged grandparent.  Persuading NPCs will be easier, but threatening them will be more difficult.

BOOMING_VOICE.name: Booming Voice
BOOMING_VOICE.description: You know how to project your voice.  You are able to shout much louder than the average person.

SHOUT3.name: Howler
SHOUT3.description: You frequently let out a piercing howl.

RADIOGENIC.name: Radiogenic
RADIOGENIC.description: Your system has somewhat adapted to radiation.  While irradiated, you will actually heal slowly, converting the radiation into hit points.  This doesn't stop you from getting radiation sickness.

RADIOPHILE.name: Radiophile
RADIOPHILE.description: Your flesh has developed a unique reaction to radiation that lets you sense when ambient radiation is abnormally high.  Turn off to ignore messages.

RADIOACTIVE1.name: Minor Radioactivity
RADIOACTIVE1.description: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit low levels of radiation, which slowly contaminates the world around you.

RADIOACTIVE2.name: Radioactivity
RADIOACTIVE2.description: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit moderate levels of radiation, which contaminates the world around you.

RADIOACTIVE3.name: Severe Radioactivity
RADIOACTIVE3.description: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit heavy levels of radiation, making your surroundings unlivable.

COLDBLOOD.name: Heat Dependent
COLDBLOOD.description: Your muscle response is dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 5 (2.8) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C).  This sluggishness helps you conserve energy, however.

COLDBLOOD2.name: Very Heat Dependent
COLDBLOOD2.description: Your muscle response is highly dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 3 (1.7) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C), but your slow metabolism requires much less energy.

COLDBLOOD3.name: Cold Blooded
COLDBLOOD3.description: You are cold-blooded and rely on heat to keep moving.  Your lose 1% of your speed for every 2 (1.1) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C), resulting in less calorie usage.

COLDBLOOD4.name: Ectothermic
COLDBLOOD4.description: Your body has become permanently cold-blooded.  Your speed lowers or raises 1% for every 2 (1.1) degrees below or above 65 F (18.3 C).  You eat much less than you otherwise would.

LARGE.name: Inconveniently Large
LARGE.description: You have grown noticeably taller and broader.  Much of it is useful muscle mass (Strength +2), but you find it throws off your balance and you get in your own way (+10 torso and arm encumbrance).

LARGE_OK.name: Large
LARGE_OK.description: You carry your rugged body with the dignity you deserve.  Strength +2.

HUGE.name: Freakishly Huge
HUGE.description: You have grown even more massive, to the point where you cannot usefully fit into human-sized clothing or vehicles.  Much of it is powerful muscle mass (Strength +4), but it's a real pain to haul around.

HUGE_OK.name: Huge
HUGE_OK.description: Your cardiovascular system has caught up with your muscular physique, so who needs pathetic human cars?  Strength +4.

MUT_TOUGH.name: Resilient
MUT_TOUGH.description: You can survive injuries that would incapacitate humans: you get a 20% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

MUT_TOUGH2.name: Solidly Built
MUT_TOUGH2.description: Not much scares you.  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

MUT_TOUGH3.name: TAAANK
MUT_TOUGH3.description: You can simply take the punishment from lesser beings and keep going.  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

STR_UP.name: Strong
STR_UP.description: Your muscles are a little stronger.  +1 Strength.

STR_UP_3.name: Extremely Strong
STR_UP_3.description: Your muscles are much stronger.  +4 Strength.

STR_UP_4.name: Insanely Strong
STR_UP_4.description: Your muscles are noticeably bulging.  +7 Strength.

INTERSTICE_POSTURE.name: Languid Posture
INTERSTICE_POSTURE.description: Your connective tissues are weakening.  -1 Strength.

INTERSTICE_POSTURE_2.name: Loosened Anatomy
INTERSTICE_POSTURE_2.description: Your connective tissues and joints are unnaturally lose, leaving you nimble.  -1 Strength, +1 Dexterity.

DEX_UP.name: Dextrous
DEX_UP.description: You are a little nimbler.  +1 Dexterity.

DEX_UP_3.name: Extremely Dextrous
DEX_UP_3.description: You are nimble and quick.  +4 Dexterity.

DEX_UP_4.name: Insanely Dextrous
DEX_UP_4.description: You are much nimbler than before.  +7 Dexterity.

DEX_INTERSTICE.name: Liminal Stride
DEX_INTERSTICE.description: You are just passing through these places.  They present no distractions or resistance.  You move much easier, particularly over obstacles and through tight spaces.

INT_UP.name: Smart
INT_UP.description: You are a little smarter.  +1 Intelligence.

INT_UP_3.name: Extremely Smart
INT_UP_3.description: You are much smarter, and your skull bulges slightly.  +4 Intelligence.

INT_UP_4.name: Insanely Smart
INT_UP_4.description: Your skull bulges noticeably due to your impressive brain.  +7 Intelligence.

INT_ALPHA.name: Prime Intelligence
INT_ALPHA.description: You understand almost everything about which you think, with minimal effort.

INT_SLIME.name: Distributed Neurology
INT_SLIME.description: Your brain has evolved beyond human imagination.  You'll show them the REAL meaning of 'gray goo'!

PER_UP.name: Perceptive
PER_UP.description: Your senses are a little keener.  +1 Perception.

PER_UP_3.name: Extremely Perceptive
PER_UP_3.description: Your senses are much keener.  +4 Perception.

PER_UP_4.name: Insanely Perceptive
PER_UP_4.description: You can sense things you never imagined.  +7 Perception.

PER_INTERSTICE.name: Perceptual Overreach
PER_INTERSTICE.description: You see all the colors of space.  It is maddening and confusing.  +12 Perception, -3 intelligence.

PER_SLIME.name: Sensory Disintegration
PER_SLIME.description: Your sense organs are all over the place: eyes extending and retracting, 'ears' of various shapes migrating about, and taste & smell are uncontrollable.  The world is a horrible mixup.  Ugh!

PER_SLIME_OK.name: Distributed Senses
PER_SLIME_OK.description: You can now extend and reabsorb sensory organs at will, and can therefore ignore most shocks that would overwhelm lesser beings.

SLIMEMIND.name: Slimewave
SLIMEMIND.description: You can communicate with your extant mass without physical contact, absorbing knowledge from nearby friendly slime.

MUTE.name: Mute
MUTE.description: Trait that makes it impossible to say anything.

NL_MUTE.name: Mute (Dimensional Jaunt)
NL_MUTE.description: Something is rendering you incapable of speech.

MUTE_BIRD.name: Mute (Bird)
MUTE_BIRD.description: Your mouth and larynx have changed dramatically, rendering you incapable of human speech.  With enough practice you could relearn imitating their weird ape chirps, but it will take time.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>

MUTE_BIRD_OK.name: Speech Mimicry (Bird)
MUTE_BIRD_OK.description: Your throat cramps, your beak twitches, but you can speak human again if you want.

MUTE_CEPH.name: Mute (Cephalopod)
MUTE_CEPH.description: Your beak and new lungs have diverged too much from your human form to be capable of human speech.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>

MUTE_CEPH_OK.name: Speech Mimicry (Cephalopod)
MUTE_CEPH_OK.description: Contorting your voice to match your surroundings is just as necessary as changing your color, even if learning it was a pain.

MUTE_GASTROPOD.name: Mute (Snail)
MUTE_GASTROPOD.description: Just losing your teeth would have been an adjustment, but with your new tongue human speech is straight-up impossible.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>

MUTE_GASTROPOD_OK.name: Speech Mimicry (Snail)
MUTE_GASTROPOD_OK.description: Fine control of your radula was hard to learn, but now that you mapped out which calcified not-tooth on there makes what pitch you can open your mouth and…speak.  Yes, let's call it speaking.

MUTE_INSECT.name: Mute (Insect)
MUTE_INSECT.description: Your mandibles already made speech hard, but now that you don't even have a tongue…<color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>

MUTE_INSECT_OK.name: Speech Mimicry (Insect)
MUTE_INSECT_OK.description: Using all this new anatomy cramps you up, and there's spittle flying everywhere, but you can manage short sentences of whistling almost-words.

MUTE_SLIME.name: Mute (Slime)
MUTE_SLIME.description: Your mouth is gone.  Oh, wait, there's one, isn't there?  If only it stopped moving around you might start to relearn something like human speech.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>

MUTE_SLIME_OK.name: Speech Mimicry (Slime)
MUTE_SLIME_OK.description: Each word its own custom bubble under your membrane, waiting for its turn to pop.  It sounds like something small and furry drowning in sourdough, but if you manage to convince somebody to listen to you they will probably understand.

ADRENALINE.name: High Adrenaline
ADRENALINE.description: If you are in a very dangerous situation, you may experience a temporary rush which increases your speed and strength significantly.

ADRENALINE2.name: Combat Adaptation
ADRENALINE2.description: When you are in great danger you may flip a chemical switch in your brain and for a cost in hunger, fatigue, and thirst your nervous system will process things around you slightly faster.  Giving you better reaction times that you can pay for later if you survive.

ACIDPROOF.name: Acidproof
ACIDPROOF.description: Your mutated flesh is immune to the damaging effects of acid.

ACIDBLOOD.name: Acid Blood
ACIDBLOOD.description: Your body has developed a wonderful defense mechanism.  Instead of normal blood, you bleed a strong molecular acid which will damage any creature foolish enough to harm you.

PHEROMONE_MAMMAL.name: Mammal Pheromones
PHEROMONE_MAMMAL.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones which put mammals at ease.  They will be less likely to attack or flee from you.

PRED1.name: Culler
PRED1.description: You've had a revelation: by killing the weaker creatures, who would only die anyway, you preserve resources for those better able to survive.  You are less bothered by the deaths of others: their own weakness invited these fates upon them.

PRED2.name: Hunter
PRED2.description: Your brain has a lot more in common with a predatory animal than a human, making it easier to control misplaced reactions to the death of your prey.  Your combat skills are becoming instinctual, helping you turn theory into practice.

PRED3.name: Predator
PRED3.description: You consider yourself something other than human and no longer empathize with them.  Combat comes naturally to you, but your critical thinking, so characteristic to these creatures, suffers.

PRED4.name: Apex Predator
PRED4.description: Your mind and brain have adapted to your new place in the world: as one on top of the food chain.  You can effortlessly master combat skills, but your critical thinking has atrophied further.

EATHEALTH.name: Hyper-Metabolism
EATHEALTH.description: Your particular metabolism allows you to burn calories at a prodigious rate to regenerate tissues in a matter of minutes; this is, however, a very wasteful process.  Activate to start healing.

transform.msg_transform: Your hyper-metabolism starts burning up calories.

EATHEALTH_active.name: Hyper-Metabolism: burning
EATHEALTH_active.description: You're burning calories like crazy to heal your wounds.

SNOUT.name: Snout
SNOUT.description: Your face and jaw have begun… changing.  Masks and such fit OK, but you're noticeably mutated.

MINOTAUR.name: Bovine Snout
MINOTAUR.description: Your face resembles that of a bull, with a significant snout.  It looks fearsome but makes it difficult to find gear that covers your face.

BOVINE_BULK.name: Bovine Bulk
BOVINE_BULK.description: Your flesh has become dense with fat and muscle.  This makes you harder to take down, but also a poor swimmer.

BOVINE_BULK2.name: Bull Roids
BOVINE_BULK2.description: Your bulk has rendered you a veritable living wall.  Be careful around water though; while you're as sturdy as a rock, you'll sink like one too.

DENSE_BONES.name: Dense Bones
DENSE_BONES.description: Your bones are particularly dense and durable.  Your tougher frame grants 5% more HP and 15% more carry capacity plus bashing attacks injure you less, but your higher weight makes attacking and moving 5% slower.  Also, dodging and swimming are harder.

RUMINANT.name: Ruminant
RUMINANT.description: Your digestive system is capable of digesting cellulose and other rough plant material.  You can eat underbrush and shrubs by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.

GRAZER.name: Grazer
GRAZER.description: You're accustomed to eating plants directly, and can get nutrition from grass as well as underbrush and shrubs.  Eat either one by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.

URSINE_EARS.name: Ursine Ears
URSINE_EARS.description: Your ears have grown longer and rounder, much like those of a bear.  You can hear things a little farther away.

MUZZLE_BEAR.name: Ursine Muzzle
MUZZLE_BEAR.description: Your jaw and nose have extended into a bearish muzzle.  You could bite with it, and it looks impressive, but it prevents wearing mouthgear.

URSINE_EYE.name: Ursine Vision
URSINE_EYE.description: Your visual processing has shifted: though you can see better in the dark, you're nearsighted in the light.  Maybe glasses would help.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

FAT.name: Fat Deposits
FAT.description: You've put on some additional weight around your body.  It slows you down a little, but helps your swimming and warmth.

HIBERNATE.name: Hibernation
HIBERNATE.description: You've developed the ability to stockpile calories and then sleep for extended periods of time.

CANINE_EARS.name: Canine Ears
CANINE_EARS.description: Your ears have extended into long, pointed ones, like those of a canine.  They enhance your hearing, allowing you to hear at greater distances.

LUPINE_EARS.name: Lupine Ears
LUPINE_EARS.description: Your hearing has evolved further and is now on par with that of wolves.  You can hear things significantly farther away.

MUZZLE.name: Lupine Muzzle
MUZZLE.description: Your jaw and nose have extended into a wolfish muzzle.  It lends itself to biting in combat and looks impressive, but prevents wearing mouthgear.

MANSBESTFRIEND.name: Man's Best Friend
MANSBESTFRIEND.description: Man's oldest and most well known friends are all Lupines.  Somehow you've mutated something that reminds other survivors of your more domestic relatives.  A softer edge around the eyes, maybe.

PACK_HUNTER.name: Pack Hunter
PACK_HUNTER.description: Puny as they may seem, a hunter needs a pack, and some of those hairless bipeds may yet prove some worth.  You continue to gain combat skills at an elevated rate, and maintain a level of critical thinking that supports cooperation.

PERSISTENCE_HUNTER.name: Persistence Hunter
PERSISTENCE_HUNTER.description: You can pursue prey for miles and miles at a variety of paces until they stop from exhaustion.

PERSISTENCE_HUNTER2.name: Extreme Persistence Hunter
