PERSISTENCE_HUNTER2.description: You can pursue prey for days until they literally die from exhaustion.  It's too bad zombies don't fatigue either.

FEL_EYE.name: Feline Eyes
FEL_EYE.description: Your eyes have mutated; now you have slit pupils, and they glitter in the light, much like a cat's.  This is visually striking, but it isn't helping you see at night.

FEL_NV.name: Feline Vision
FEL_NV.description: Your optic nerves and brain caught up with your eyes.  Now you can see pretty well at night.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

WHISKERS.name: Whiskers
WHISKERS.description: You have a handsome set of whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge very slightly.

FELINE_EARS.name: Feline Ears
FELINE_EARS.description: Your ears have extended into long, pointed, velvety ones, like those of a feline.  You find it easier to tune in on sounds from afar.

SABER_TEETH.name: Saber Teeth
SABER_TEETH.description: Your fangs have grown extremely large and incredibly sharp.  They make it impossible to wear mouthgear and difficult to eat… but leave nasty wounds when you bite.

FELINE_LEAP.name: Pounce
FELINE_LEAP.description: You've gained a strong ability to leap a short distance from a standing position with little preparation time.

FELINE_FLEXIBILITY.name: Feline Flexibility
FELINE_FLEXIBILITY.description: Your muscles, joints, and the movement center of your brain have changed internally somewhat, allowing you to traverse obstacles with ease.

HATES_WATER.name: Hates Water
HATES_WATER.description: You really hate getting your fur all wet.  This increases morale penalties for being wet, and you will get them even when wearing appropriate clothing.

RABBIT_EARS.name: Rabbit Ears
RABBIT_EARS.description: Your ears have grown into tall and flexible rabbit ears.  They're are slender and enhance your hearing beyond the normal range.

RABBIT_NOSE.name: Rabbit Nose
RABBIT_NOSE.description: Your nose has morphed into a cute bunny nose, along with the snout.  It's extremely twitchy too.

INCISORS.name: Incisors
INCISORS.description: Your big teeth have grown in.  Folks had best show some more respect.

MUZZLE_RAT.name: Rodent Muzzle
MUZZLE_RAT.description: Your face and jaw have extended, giving you an alert and attentive appearance.

MOUSE_EARS.name: Rodent Ears
MOUSE_EARS.description: Your ears are huge, round, and gray!  They're rather fascinating, and help you hear from a much greater distance.

SMALL.name: Little
SMALL.description: You've noticeably shrunk in size.  You're able to move with increased litheness, but your smaller stature prevents you from carrying as much.

SMALL2.name: Tiny
SMALL2.description: You're only half as tall as you used to be!  The weight of things you once found easy to carry is now unbearable, clothes are now twice as encumbering for you unless you refit them (since you're half their size), and your hit points are heavily reduced.  However, your movement is silent, and your dodge skill is a little higher.

SMALL_OK.name: Unassuming
SMALL_OK.description: You've mastered your tiny form!  Item encumbrance and carry weight penalties are reduced, and you've learned to use your increased nimbleness to offset your reduced capacity to absorb damage.

WHISKERS_RAT.name: Wiry Whiskers
WHISKERS_RAT.description: You have a set of prominent rodent-like whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge slightly.

CRAFTY.name: Crafty
CRAFTY.description: By making the most of your small stature, you can avoid the notice of all but the most perceptive creatures, and your speed is greatly increased.

NO_THIRST.name: Metabolic Rehydration
NO_THIRST.description: Your body gets everything it needs from the food that you eat!  You no longer need hydration from fluids.

BURROW.name: Burrowing
BURROW.description: Your dextrous paws and long teeth allow you to dig through dirt and rubble with ease.

BURROWLARGE.name: Burrowing
BURROWLARGE.description: Your tough paws allow you to dig through dirt and rubble with ease.

MET_RAT.name: Rapid Metabolism
MET_RAT.description: You require more resources than most, but heal more rapidly as well.  Provides weak regeneration even when not asleep.

MUZZLE_LONG.name: Reptilian Muzzle
MUZZLE_LONG.description: Your face and jaws are a shorter version of those found on alligators.  They look NASTY--as do the bite wounds they can inflict--but prevent wearing mouthgear.

MUZZLE_RAPTOR.name: Dromeosaur Muzzle
MUZZLE_RAPTOR.description: Your face has drastically mutated, with the bones of your jaws having extended forth into a long, tapered snout.  The palate of your mouth is considerably vaulted, with curved, serrated teeth lining your saurian maw and reptilian scales covering your muzzle's exterior.  While paleobiology has evidently not evolved with mouth gear in mind (making such items unwearable), the bite wounds you can now inflict promise the ferocity of long-dead beasts.

FORKED_TONGUE.name: Forked Tongue
FORKED_TONGUE.description: Your tongue is forked, like that of a reptile.  This has no effect.

LIZ_EYE.name: Reptilian Eyes
LIZ_EYE.description: Your eyes have mutated, with a brilliant iris and slitted pupil similar to that of a lizard.  This is visually striking, but doesn't seem to affect your vision.

LIZ_IR.name: Reptilian IR
LIZ_IR.description: Your optic nerves and brain have mutated to catch up with your eyes, allowing you to see in the infrared spectrum.

REGEN_LIZ.name: Reptilian Healing
REGEN_LIZ.description: Your broken limbs mend themselves without significant difficulty in addition to your already-quick healing.  You do not require splints for broken limbs.

BLOODLETTER.name: Bloodletter
BLOODLETTER.description: Your saliva contains powerful anticoagulants.  If you have a bite attack, it will prolong the bleeding of most animals, including humans and the undead.  It may be less effective against insects and stranger creatures.

BLOODFEEDER.name: Bloodfeeder
BLOODFEEDER.description: Your craving for blood borders on obsession.  You need the stuff too much to care about whether it came from a human, and your body can filter out most of the toxins in mutant blood.

ECHOLOCATION.name: Echolocation
ECHOLOCATION.description: You've learned how to hunt without sight.  Activate this mutation to make a quiet chirp that can reveal obstacles and enemies by its echo.

SLIT_NOSTRILS.name: Slit Nostrils
SLIT_NOSTRILS.description: You have a flattened nose and thin slits for nostrils, giving you a lizard-like appearance.  This makes breathing slightly difficult and increases mouth encumbrance by 10.

LEAFNOSE.name: Leaf Nose
LEAFNOSE.description: Your nose is upturned, ridged and flared out into a leaf shape that humans will likely find unsightly.  On the plus side, thermoreceptors in your nostrils allow you to smell heat as long as you can breathe.

BATEARS.name: Bat Ears
BATEARS.description: Your broad, pointed ears are like radar dishes.  You can hear even the slightest sounds at great distance, and are less likely to be deafened by loud noises.

FANGS.name: Fangs
FANGS.description: Your teeth have grown into long, sharp fangs.  If your mouth is uncovered, you'll sometimes bite your enemies.

FANGS_VAMPIRE.name: Vampire Fangs
FANGS_VAMPIRE.description: Your teeth are so sharp, you can use them to shave the fur from your victims before you feed.  What's more, anticoagulants in your saliva will keep their blood flowing long after it should have clotted.

ARM_FEATHERS.name: Feathered Arms
ARM_FEATHERS.description: Your forearms are covered by long, stiff feathers.  While they are impressive to look at and resistant to water and other contaminants, they always get in the way and you hate it when they get filthy.

LIGHT_BONES.name: Light Bones
LIGHT_BONES.description: Your bones are very light.  This enables you to move and attack 10% faster, but also reduces your carrying weight by 20% and makes bashing attacks hurt a little more.

HOLLOW_BONES.name: Hollow Bones
HOLLOW_BONES.description: You have Avian Bone Syndrome--your bones are nearly hollow.  Your body is very light as a result, enabling you to move and attack 20% faster, but also frail; you can carry 40% less, and bashing attacks injure you more.

BIRD_EYE.name: Avian Eyes
BIRD_EYE.description: Your vision has become particularly acute: you suspect you could pick out zombies much farther away.  Perception +2, as well as increased vision and reaction limb scores.

GIZZARD.name: Gizzard
GIZZARD.description: You seem to get full faster now, and food goes through you more rapidly as well.

BEAK.name: Beak
BEAK.description: You have a beak for a mouth.  You can use it to peck at your enemies, but it is impossible for you to wear mouth gear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

BEAK_PECK.name: Woodpecker Beak
BEAK_PECK.description: Pecking at prey is part of your daily routine now.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

BEAK_HUM.name: Hummingbird Beak
BEAK_HUM.description: Though your beak's not suitable for pecking, those flowers out there are a good source of energy.  Examine them to feed.

GASTROPOD_EXTREMITY1.name: Muscle Consolidation
GASTROPOD_EXTREMITY1.description: Your extremities have gained strength but lost fine motor skills.  -1 Dexterity +2 Strength.

GASTROPOD_EXTREMITY2.name: Rasping Tongue
GASTROPOD_EXTREMITY2.description: You've developed an extremely long and mobile tongue capped with teeth.  You may use it to attack your enemies and pull them towards you.

GASTROPOD_EXTREMITY3.name: Harpoon Tongue
GASTROPOD_EXTREMITY3.description: Your tongue has increased its length and mobility.  You may use it to pull your enemies towards you.

GASTROPOD_FOOT.name: Gastropod Foot
GASTROPOD_FOOT.description: Your legs have consolidated into a single muscular 'foot' that goes up into your belly.  You move about a fourth of your previous speed and can no longer wear pants or shoes, on the other hand you make significantly less noise.  In addition to being harder to knock down, you can move through sludge-covered surfaces easily.

GASTROPOD_BALANCE.name: Gastropod Balance
GASTROPOD_BALANCE.description: By pushing your whole 'foot' against the ground you are able to move across rough terrain without losing your 'footing'.  You're also able to cling to the ground underwater, allowing you to move along the bottom more easily.

MUCUS_SECRETION.name: Mucus Secretion
MUCUS_SECRETION.description: You once had a significant other call you slimy, now you exemplify that.  It covers everything you come into contact with but now you can move through slime you didn't create with ease.

MUCUS_SECRETION2.name: Acidic Secretion
MUCUS_SECRETION2.description: Your mucus has developed an acidic component that seems to soften your prey up.  When attacking unarmed, sometimes your slime will hit your target as well.

SNAIL_TRAIL.name: Snail Trail
SNAIL_TRAIL.description: You've developed some ability to control your slime emissions.  As a result of this you can leave trails of slime anywhere you walk.

SLIME_SPRAY.name: Slime Spray
SLIME_SPRAY.description: You exude slime from your pores.  You can spread that slime on an opponent in melee range.

SHELL.name: Shell
SHELL.description: You have grown a thick shell over your torso, providing excellent armor, but you cannot wear anything on your torso.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

SHELL2.name: Roomy Shell
SHELL2.description: Your protective shell has grown large enough to accommodate--if need be--your whole body.  Activate to pull your head and limbs into your shell, trading mobility and vision for warmth and shelter.

SHELL3.name: Nacreous Shell
SHELL3.description: Your protective shell has developed increased strength and hardness and a mother of pearl sheen.

EYEBULGE.name: Bulging Eyes
EYEBULGE.description: Your eyes bulge out several inches from your skull.  This does not affect your vision in any way.

EYESTALKS1.name: Intermediate Eyestalks
EYESTALKS1.description: Your eyes barely protrude from your head on tentacles, preventing the use of any rigid eyewear.  On the plus side, you can have additional awareness, but sometimes your vision goes wonky as your brain tries to process the new angles.

EYESTALKS2.name: Eyestalks
EYESTALKS2.description: Your eyes protrude from your head on flexible tentacles, preventing the use of any eyewear.  On the plus side, you can see in two directions at once, and they automatically retract to reduce damage.

EYESTALKS_RIGID.name: Rigid Eyestalks
EYESTALKS_RIGID.description: You have compound eyes on rigid stalks that can fold back against your head to protect them from danger.  This gives you better all-around vision and allows you to see underwater, but interferes with eyewear.  Your vision and reaction limb scores are also increased.

FROG_EYES.name: Frog Eyes
FROG_EYES.description: Your eyes bulge noticeably out of your face, and you are able to move them much more freely than before.  You can see movement and close objects clearly, but you have trouble picking up distant details in the light.  Instead of eyelids they are covered by a translucent, protective membrane that blocks irritants and water.  It allows you to sleep with your eyes open!  Activate to cause the approach of hostile creatures to wake you up.

PHEROMONE_AMPHIBIAN.name: Amphibian Pheromones
PHEROMONE_AMPHIBIAN.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones, identifying you as a friend to many species of amphibian.  Amphibians will attack you much less.

WIDE_MOUTH.name: Wide Mouth
WIDE_MOUTH.description: You have an unsettlingly wide mouth, like a frog.  This looks hideous, but allows you to swallow your food whole.

LONG_TONGUE.name: Lolling Tongue
LONG_TONGUE.description: Your tongue has lengthened and often extends far beyond your mouth.  This has no effect.

LONG_TONGUE2.name: Whipping Tongue
LONG_TONGUE2.description: You've developed an extremely long and mobile tongue.  You may use it to pull your enemies towards you.

VOMITSTOMACH.name: Stomach Cleanse
VOMITSTOMACH.description: You have gained the ability to invert your stomach outside your body to quickly eliminate toxins, and are more likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up because of this, you won't suffer any residual nausea.

DIRTSLEEPER.name: Earth Sleeper
DIRTSLEEPER.description: You always sleep better surrounded by earth.

STRONGKNEES.name: Strong Knees
STRONGKNEES.description: Your knees are strong and capable of angles that you couldn't imagine previously.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down less than normal.

AMPHIBIAN.name: Amphibious
AMPHIBIAN.description: You're as comfortable in water as on land, and your body has adapted around that fact.  Your base swimming speed is greatly increased, and weight will hinder you much less while swimming.

WATERSLEEP.name: Aqueous Repose
WATERSLEEP.description: Falling asleep underwater is easy for you, and you spend less time asleep when you rest there.  You can also eat underwater, though you can't drink.

msg_try.text: You lay beneath the waves' embrace, gazing up through the water's surface…
You settle into the water and begin to drowse…

FRESHWATEROSMOSIS.name: Freshwater Osmosis
FRESHWATEROSMOSIS.description: Your gills and skin are highly permeable to moisture, and you can hydrate your body through osmosis.  While submerged in fresh water, any thirst you might have will be slaked.

ELECTRORECEPTORS.name: Electroreceptors
ELECTRORECEPTORS.description: A network of jelly-filled electroreceptors, like that of a shark, have grown throughout your face and nose.  They are very sensitive to magnetic fields, allowing you to see robots and creatures charged with electricity through walls, but being shocked will seriously mess you up.

MEMBRANE.name: Nictitating Membrane
MEMBRANE.description: You have a set of clear lenses which lower over your eyes while underwater, allowing you to see as though you were wearing goggles.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

SEESLEEP.name: Lidless Eyes
SEESLEEP.description: Like a true fish, your eyes lack eyelids, and are instead covered by a translucent, protective membrane that blocks irritants and water, and provides minor armor.  It also allows you to sleep with your eyes open!  Activate to cause the approach of hostile creatures to wake you up.

GILLS.name: Gills
GILLS.description: You've grown a set of gills in your neck, allowing you to breathe underwater.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

SHARKTEETH.name: Shark Teeth
SHARKTEETH.description: Your teeth have grown incredibly sharp, and have calcified even further.  In addition to letting you eat much faster, you can use them as a lethal natural weapon, as long as your anatomy favors it.  They also grow very fast, and you harmlessly shed them more or less at random.

TOXICFLESH.name: Toxic Flesh
TOXICFLESH.description: Your flesh is highly poisonous, and creatures that bite you will receive a nasty surprise.

CEPH_EYES.name: Cephalopod Eyes
CEPH_EYES.description: Your eyes still bulge, yet your pupils look different somehow.  Water doesn't seem to cause any trouble at all, though.

CEPH_VISION.name: Cephalopod Vision
CEPH_VISION.description: Your brain has caught up with your eyes.  You can see much better in the dark, but sunlight seems much brighter now.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

CEPH_MIND.name: Cephalopod Mind
CEPH_MIND.description: Your mind has been altered in such a way that you now find it very difficult to understand humans.  Your capability to persuade and lie to them suffers slightly, even if it is mitigated by your intelligence.  In addition, while you find it much easier to learn by doing now, the plasticity of your psyche means you forget skills much faster.

INTERSTICE_MIND.name: Apathy of the Outer Dark
INTERSTICE_MIND.description: Your mind has been altered in such a way that you now find it very difficult to relate to or understand humans, the things they know, and the things they care about.  You are no longer bothered by much, but your ability to persuade, lie, and retain human knowledge is diminished.

GILLS_CEPH.name: Cephalopod Gills
GILLS_CEPH.description: You've grown a set of gills, running from your neck up behind your ears.  They allow you to breathe underwater and slightly increase wet benefits.

INK_GLANDS.name: Ink Glands
INK_GLANDS.description: Several ink glands have developed in your gill structure.  When active, they will spray defensive ink and blind an attacker in an emergency.

MOUTH_FLAPS.name: Mouth Flaps
MOUTH_FLAPS.description: Skin tabs and odd flaps of skin surround your mouth.  They don't affect your eating, but are unpleasant to look at.

MOUTH_TENTACLES.name: Mouth Tentacles
MOUTH_TENTACLES.description: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

BIOLUM0.name: Reflex Photophore
BIOLUM0.description: A photophore has grown from your head.  You can't consciously control it, and it might start to shine in response to your emotions or your physiological state.

BIOLUM1.name: Weak Photophore
BIOLUM1.description: A photophore has grown from your head; you can make it glow softly.  This will make you very visible in the dark, ideal for attracting a partner during mating season.

BIOLUM2.name: Photophore
BIOLUM2.description: You can make your photophore glow brightly.

BIOLUM3.name: Bioluminescent Flare
BIOLUM3.description: You can spit a wad of bioluminescent goo several meters away.  There it will light up its surroundings until it dissipates.

INSECT_RESERVOIR.name: Bulging Reservoir
INSECT_RESERVOIR.description: You develop a reservoir of fluids that bulges out of your abdomen.  Your body has adapted to containing extra liquids in event of shortfalls.

BOMBADIER_BLAST.name: Bombardier Beetle Blast
BOMBADIER_BLAST.description: You have an ability to spray boiling water on your enemies at melee distance.  This will drastically increase your thirst.  Without an extra reservoir you would quickly dehydrate yourself.

attacks.attack_text_u: You spray %s with a boiling chemical mixture!
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s sprays %2$s with a boiling chemical mixture!

PHEROMONE_INSECT.name: Insect Pheromones
PHEROMONE_INSECT.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones, identifying you as a friend to many species of insects.  Insects will attack you much less.

COMPOUND_EYES.name: Compound Eyes
COMPOUND_EYES.description: Your eyes are compound, like those of an insect.  This increases your reaction time, but your fine detailed vision isn't as acute.

ANTENNAE.name: Antennae
ANTENNAE.description: You have a pair of antennae.  They allow you to detect the presence of monsters up to a few tiles away, even if you can't see or hear them, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

MANDIBLES.name: Mandibles
MANDIBLES.description: A set of insect-like mandibles have grown around your mouth.  They allow you to eat faster and provide a slicing unarmed attack.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

PROBOSCIS.name: Proboscis
PROBOSCIS.description: You've gotten rid of that terribly imprecise mouth and now imbibe your food like a proper person.  Chewing was tiresome anyway.

CF_HAIR.name: Urticating Hairs
CF_HAIR.description: Significant amounts of your hairs have loosened.  If some creature tries to attack you, your assailant is quite likely to get fine, bristly chitin in an irritating spot; it doesn't carry your venom but it will be distracting.

FANGS_SPIDER.name: Folding Fangs
FANGS_SPIDER.description: You have developed deadly extensible fangs, allowing you to bite quickly or ensure your venom goes home, as desired.

POISONOUS.name: Venomous
POISONOUS.description: Your body produces a potent venom.  Cutting or stabbing attacks from mutations have a chance to poison your target.

POISONOUS2.name: Strongly Venomous
POISONOUS2.description: Your venom has become particularly strong.  You're confident that your bites or other cutting/stabbing natural attacks will take your target down quickly.

WEB_WALKER.name: Web Walker
WEB_WALKER.description: Your body excretes very fine amounts of a chemical which prevents you from sticking to webs.  Walking through webs does not affect you at all.

msg_try.text: These thick webs support your weight, and are strangely comfortable…
You try to sleep, but the webs get in the way.  You brush them aside.

WEB_SPINNER.name: Web Spinner
WEB_SPINNER.description: Your body produces and anchors webbing.  Too bad you can't seem to control the process.  There is a chance that you will leave webs in your wake.

msg_try.text: You try to sleep, but you feel exposed and your spinnerets keep twitching.

msg_hint.text: Maybe a nice thick web would help you sleep.

WEB_WEAVER.name: Web Weaver
WEB_WEAVER.description: You've developed the necessary anatomy and techniques to control your web-generation.  Activate this to start or stop weaving webs.

msg_try.text: You try to sleep, but you feel exposed and your spinnerets keep twitching.

msg_hint.text: Maybe a nice thick web would help you sleep.

WEB_RAPPEL.name: Web Diver
WEB_RAPPEL.description: Your webbing is strong enough to support your weight.  Activate to rappel down any drop you encounter, at the cost of nutrition.

WEB_ROPE.name: Rope Webs
WEB_ROPE.description: With spinnerets like THESE, who needs rope?!  Activate to produce rope.

spawn_item.message: You spin a rope from your silk.

ROT1.name: Weakening
ROT1.description: You feel as though you are slowly weakening and your body heals slower.

ROT2.name: Deterioration
ROT2.description: Your body is very slowly wasting away.

ROT3.name: Disintegration
ROT3.description: Your body is slowly wasting away!

VANITY.name: Highly Vain
VANITY.description: You know you're beautiful, and the world deserves to know it too.  You prefer to show off your stunningly good looks and will be unhappy if you cover up your face.

AMOG.name: Alpha Member of the Group
AMOG.description: You are the natural leader of any group.  It's just part of who you are, groups naturally form around you and you need these groups to energize you.  Sometimes however, you give in to your worst impulses and this trait will flip.

transform.msg_transform: You give in to your worst instincts.

DARK_TRIAD.name: Dark Triad
DARK_TRIAD.description: You are a god among mortals and they are all so very disappointing.  Why should you even bother to hide your disappointment in their failures?

transform.msg_transform: Maybe you can make better decisions this time.

ALPHA_COMPLEX.name: Superiority Complex
ALPHA_COMPLEX.description: You can't stand to prostrate yourself before your lessers and hate it when they don't immediately do what you say.  Persuasion is much more difficult, but you're better at lying and intimidating.

JEKYLL.name: Normal Human
JEKYLL.description: You're a normal human; there's nothing wrong with you.  No need to worry.

msg_on.text: Everything is terrible and this makes you so ANGRY!
Everything is terrible and this makes you so ANGRY!

HYDE.name: Violent Monster
HYDE.description: Anger clouds your mind; you can't think straight, but you feel strong.

msg_on.text: As the morning comes, you return back to normal.

NUMB.name: Numb
NUMB.description: Your ability to feel or express emotion has been greatly hampered.

STIMBOOST.name: Stimulant Psychosis
STIMBOOST.description: You have a unique history with stimulants (like coffee or amphetamines).  You can tolerate a lot more of them without overdosing, but if you indulge too much, you start seeing things…

PAINREC1.name: Pain Recovery
PAINREC1.description: You recover from pain slightly faster than normal.

PAINREC2.name: Quick Pain Recovery
PAINREC2.description: You recover from pain faster than normal.

PAINREC3.name: Very Quick Pain Recovery
PAINREC3.description: You recover from pain much faster than normal.

MASOCHIST_MED.name: Pain Junkie
MASOCHIST_MED.description: You've developed a serious appetite for pain, and take pride in your scars.

CENOBITE.name: Cenobite
CENOBITE.description: You positively adore pain, in all its varied forms.

NOPAIN.name: Deadened
NOPAIN.description: Nothing hurts anymore.  Those bites tickle and the wounds itch a bit, but that's it.

TOUGH_MEDICAL.name: Resilient Physiology
TOUGH_MEDICAL.description: Your body is well-adapted to resist trauma.  20% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

TOUGH2_MEDICAL.name: Solid Physiology
TOUGH2_MEDICAL.description: Your body is extremely well-adapted to resist trauma.  30% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

PARAIMMUNE.name: Parasite Immune
PARAIMMUNE.description: Your body is unusually inhospitable to parasitic lifeforms.  You will never become infested with internal parasites.

MUT_JUNKIE.name: Metallassomaiphile
MUT_JUNKIE.description: Just thinking of mutagen (such a lovely word!  'Mutagen'.  Perfect!) makes you thirsty.  And you so love your new parts.  You simply must have more mutagen!

TROGLO.name: Light Sensitive
TROGLO.description: Sunlight makes you uncomfortable.  If you are outdoors and the weather is Sunny, you suffer -1 to all stats.

TROGLO2.name: Very Light Sensitive
TROGLO2.description: Sunlight makes you very uncomfortable.  If you are outdoors during the day, you suffer -1 to all stats; -2 if the weather is Sunny.

TROGLO3.name: Troglobite
TROGLO3.description: Sunlight makes you extremely uncomfortable, resulting in large penalties to all stats.

SUNBURN.name: Solar Sensitivity
SUNBURN.description: Your skin simply cannot handle ultraviolet radiation, such as sunlight.  It will seriously burn you.

SUNBURN_INTERSTICE.name: Daylight Exclusion
SUNBURN_INTERSTICE.description: You cannot handle sunlight.  It will seriously burn you.

NIGHT_RAIDER.name: Night Raider
NIGHT_RAIDER.description: Your body is one with the night.  You make less noise when the moon is up in the sky, even when you cannot see it.

ALCMET.name: Alcohol Metabolism
ALCMET.description: So it's fermented?  Whatever, it's still good drinking.  You've developed the ability to metabolize alcohol as a food source.

PAINRESIST_TROGLO.name: Subterranean Fortitude
PAINRESIST_TROGLO.description: The aches and pains of living underground don't bother you as much.

STOCKY_TROGLO.name: Subterranean Build
STOCKY_TROGLO.description: Your frame has adapted for life in confined spaces.  You seem a little shorter and bulkier, trading mobility for muscle mass.  (+2 Strength, -2 Dexterity)

TUNNEL_FIGHTER.name: Tunnel Fighter
TUNNEL_FIGHTER.description: You know how to fight in cramped tunnels at risk of collapse.  You gain bonuses when fighting underground.

INFRARED.name: Infrared Vision
INFRARED.description: Your eyes have mutated to pick up radiation in the infrared spectrum.

REGEN.name: Regeneration
REGEN.description: Your flesh regenerates and your limbs mend incredibly quickly.

SLIMY.name: Slimy
SLIMY.description: Your body is coated with a fine slime which makes uncovered skin harder to grab and protects from long-term effects of acid, though not short-term ones.  Greatly increases wet benefits.

VISCOUS.name: Viscous
VISCOUS.description: Your body's slime output has become sticky and gel-like, making uncovered skin harder to grab and offering some protection from acid.  Greatly increases wet benefits.

SPOTS.name: Spots
SPOTS.description: Your skin is covered in a pattern of red spots.

SORES.name: Sores
SORES.description: Your extremities are covered in painful sores.  The pain is worse when they are covered in clothing.

AMORPHOUS.name: Amorphous Body
AMORPHOUS.description: Your flesh is a pleasing gel-like consistency.  Your bodily functions seem to be moving around, and your leg-equivalents flow comfortably - if a little slower than your old meat-legs.

SLIMESPAWNER.name: Omnicellular
SLIMESPAWNER.description: Your body is more or less one consistent whole: a single, giant, omni-cell that alters itself as needed.

FEYHEARING.name: Fey Hearing
FEYHEARING.description: You're not sure the shape of your ears is helping you any; regardless, you have become very sensitive to sounds.

ELFAEYES.name: Fey Eyes
ELFAEYES.description: Your eyes have turned… green.  It's tough to tell the exact shade, as it seems to shift.  The effect is… pleasant.

INTERSTICEEYES.name: Pale Eyes
INTERSTICEEYES.description: Your eyes have turned almost completely white.  The effect is unpleasant and intimidating.

INTERSTICEHEARING.name: Otherworldly Hearing
INTERSTICEHEARING.description: You hear so well that you could hear the whisper of a shadow.  And you do.  Everything speaks to you.  You have extremely good hearing, but -1 Intelligence.

ELFA_NV.name: Fey Vision
ELFA_NV.description: Your corneas have taken on the same weird green as your irises, and golden veins shift below the surface in a mesmerizing dance.  The shadows don't seem nearly as dark now.

ELFA_FNV.name: Fey Nightsight
ELFA_FNV.description: Your corneas have taken on the same weird green as your irises, and golden veins shift below the surface in a mesmerizing dance.  You have great low-light vision now, but it doesn't allow you to perform fine tasks such as crafting and reading in darkness.

ELFA_EARS.name: Pointed Ears
ELFA_EARS.description: Your upper earlobes have grown noticeably higher.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your headgear, much.  Unfortunately, they also don't seem to help your hearing any.

ANIMALEMPATH.name: Animal Empathy
ANIMALEMPATH.description: Peaceful animals will not run away from you, and even aggressive animals are less likely to attack.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

ANIMALEMPATH2.name: Animal Kinship
ANIMALEMPATH2.description: Something about your presence is calming to animals, and they will treat you with innate trust.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

ANIMALDISCORD.name: Animal Discord
ANIMALDISCORD.description: Most animals don't like you, and aggressive animals are more likely to attack you.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

ANIMALDISCORD2.name: Prey Animal
ANIMALDISCORD2.description: Natural animals like dogs and wolves see you as prey, and are liable to attack you on sight.

TERRIFYING.name: Terrifying
TERRIFYING.description: There's something about you that creatures find frightening, and they are more likely to try to flee.

THORNS.name: Thorns
THORNS.description: Your skin is covered in small, woody thorns.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive minor damage.  Your punches may also deal extra damage.

LEAVES.name: Leaves
LEAVES.description: All the hair on your body has turned to long, grass-like leaves.  Apart from being physically striking, these provide you with a minor amount of nutrients while in sunlight when your head is uncovered.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

LEAVES2.name: Lush Leaves
LEAVES2.description: Your leaves have grown in size and prominence, with additional leaves sprouting along your arms.  While your arms and head are uncovered, you will photosynthesize nutrients while in sunlight.  Reduces wet effects.

LEAVES3.name: Verdant Leaves
LEAVES3.description: Your leaves are vibrant, large, and green, and have become a major source of nutrients for your body.  Whenever your arms and head are uncovered you will gain a large amount of nutrients by standing in the sunlight.  Reduces wet effects.

FLOWERS.name: Flowering
FLOWERS.description: You've started blooming where your scalp used to be.  Your blossoms have a pleasant aroma, are visually striking, and are quite sensitive.

ROSEBUDS.name: Rosebuds
ROSEBUDS.description: The top of your head is blooming with rosebuds.  They're eye catching, and have a strong fragrance that makes you pleasant to be around.

PONDEROUS1.name: Ponderous
PONDEROUS1.description: Your muscles are generally slow to move.  You move 10% slower.

PONDEROUS2.name: Very Ponderous
PONDEROUS2.description: Your muscles are quite slow to move.  You move 20% slower.

PONDEROUS3.name: Extremely Ponderous
PONDEROUS3.description: Your muscles are very slow to move.  You move 30% slower.

VINES1.name: Vines
VINES1.description: You have developed several vines sprouting from your shoulder area.  They're bulky, and get in the way.

VINES2.name: Vine Limbs
VINES2.description: You've developed the ability to control your vines; they make good lashes.  You can even rappel down sheer drops using them, but disconnecting HURTS.

VINES3.name: Vine Sprouter
VINES3.description: You have full control of your vines, and can grow new ones and detach old ones more or less at will.

spawn_item.message: You detach a vine from your body.

HAIRROOTS.name: Hair Roots
HAIRROOTS.description: Roots have started growing from your leaf-like hair.  They don't seem to do much.

ROOTS1.name: Toe Roots
ROOTS1.description: Your toes have grown wriggly, and you can't imagine why you wear that stuff on your feet.  Take it off.  It's in the way.

ROOTS2.name: Roots
ROOTS2.description: It's about time you started developing a root system.  When reading, fishing, waiting, or otherwise being stationary for a while on diggable terrain, you'll extract nutrients and water from the soil.

ROOTS3.name: Rooter
ROOTS3.description: You find it difficult not to sink roots when able.  You extract nutrients and water whenever on diggable terrain, but move more slowly.

SUNLIGHT_DEPENDENT.name: Sunlight Dependent
SUNLIGHT_DEPENDENT.description: You feel very sluggish when not in direct sunlight.  You suffer a 5% drop in speed when in shade, and a 10% drop in speed when in the dark.

CHLOROMORPH.name: Chloromorphosis
CHLOROMORPH.description: Every inch of your skin is packed with chlorophyll and you have strong roots.  Sleeping on diggable soil will satisfy any hunger or thirst you might have.

msg_try.text: It's impossible to sleep in this wheeled pot!
The humans' furniture blocks your roots.  You can't get comfortable.
Your roots scrabble ineffectively at the unyielding surface.
You relax as your roots embrace the soil.
You relax as your roots embrace the soil.

TREE_COMMUNION.name: Mycorrhizal Communion
TREE_COMMUNION.description: You have gained the ability to commune with trees and comprehend their ancient wisdom.  Activate next to a tree to gradually gain overmap vision through connected forests.

TRANSPIRATION.name: Transpiration
TRANSPIRATION.description: Your body has begun moving nutrients via the evaporation of water.  This increases your thirst when it's hot, but reduces it when it's cold.

SAPROPHAGE.name: Saprophage
SAPROPHAGE.description: You prefer to sustain your nutritional needs using your roots and direct nutrient extraction/synthesis.  Your human parts still need the raw caloric bulk of 'food' to keep them going, though, and you handle it a lot easier if it's had time to… age a little.

ELDRITCH_IRE.name: Eldritch Ire
ELDRITCH_IRE.description: As if the apocalypse itself wasn't enough, you are constantly being at the ire of the zombies.  Zombies somehow can sense your presence from very far away and approach your general location.

INTERSTICE_PHYSIOLOGY.name: Unbound Physiology
INTERSTICE_PHYSIOLOGY.description: Your body is no longer constrained by the rules of this world.  You move deftly and quietly, but this forced existence is exhausting.

INTERSTICE_GROWING.name: Growing Shadowy Flesh
INTERSTICE_GROWING.description: The ends of your appendages are covered in an inky, shadowy substance.  It does not impede you at all, but you can feel it growing.

INTERSTICE_SHRINKING.name: Retreating Shadowy Flesh
INTERSTICE_SHRINKING.description: The ends of your appendages are covered in an inky, shadowy substance.  It does not impede you at all, and you can feel it slowly shrinking away.

RM13_ENVIRONMENTAL.name: Heatsink
RM13_ENVIRONMENTAL.description: Your armor makes you immune to many environmental threats.

THRESH_MARLOSS.name: Marloss Gateway
THRESH_MARLOSS.description: You get the feeling that you're on the cusp of becoming something greater than yourself.

MARLOSS.name: Marloss Carrier
MARLOSS.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss berry, you can't get its scent out of your nose, and you have a strong desire to try some seeds and… sap?

MARLOSS_BLUE.name: Marloss Vessel
MARLOSS_BLUE.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss seed, you can't get its taste off of your tongue, and you have a strong desire to try some berries and… sap?

MARLOSS_YELLOW.name: Marloss Vector
MARLOSS_YELLOW.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss jelly, you can't stop thinking of it, and you have a strong desire to eat some seeds and berries.

MARLOSS_AVOID.name: Marloss Rejection
MARLOSS_AVOID.description: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to that Marloss junk, you can't bear the thought of ever eating it again!

M_IMMUNE.name: Mycus Identity
M_IMMUNE.description: We have synchronized our local physiology with that of the Mycus.  Any spores we may encounter will not attempt to germinate inside the local system, and we may traverse Mycus biospheres easily, as native bioforms shift shape to accommodate us.

M_DEPENDENT.name: Mycus Feeder
M_DEPENDENT.description: We have streamlined our nutritional requirements.  We rely on the Mycus for sustenance, as it relies on us.  We may locate sources of sustenance in close proximity to Mycus core towers, and in forested areas that the Mycus has grown into.

M_PROVENANCE.name: Mycus Provenance
M_PROVENANCE.description: Local spore sacs and blossoms have merged into a single, symbiotic form.  Acting as one, they germinate together to cement rapid growth across a large area according to local guidance.  The Mycus must grow.

M_SKIN.name: Mycus Flesh
M_SKIN.description: We have begun adapting local physiology to Mycus physical structure, greatly reducing wet effects.

M_SKIN2.name: Mycus Fireproofing
M_SKIN2.description: We have spliced the dense, amphibole fibers from Mycus core towers with the resilient, adaptive flesh of local physiology.  This reduces our speed by a moderate amount, but provides powerful armor across our body, nullifies wet effects, and provides complete protection from fire.

M_SKIN3.name: Mycogenesis
M_SKIN3.description: Local physiology has been fully incorporated with that of Mycus silicate fibers.  In addition to benefits conferred by previous developments, we may join with Mycus fibers beneath us - sleeping on top of fungal areas places us into a dormant state, which spreads spores around us as we sleep and revitalizes our body much more quickly than regular sleep.

msg_try.text: Our fibers meld with the ground beneath us.  The gills on our neck begin to seed the air with spores as our awareness fades.

M_DEFENDER.name: Mycus Defender
M_DEFENDER.description: From time to time the Mycus requires protection from non-Mycus that, for whatever reason, wish it ill.  We have adapted to better carry out this task - our fibers will grow strong and resilient when such threats present themselves to us.

M_SPORES.name: Mycus Spores
M_SPORES.description: We have developed local spore sacs.  The Mycus must grow.

M_FERTILE.name: Mycus Sporogenesis
M_FERTILE.description: Local organisms seem to regard overt spore dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly, our local spore sacs remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures swift and effective growth.

M_BLOSSOMS.name: Mycus Blossoms
M_BLOSSOMS.description: We have developed local blossoms.  The Mycus must grow.

M_BLOOM.name: Mycus Bloom
M_BLOOM.description: Local organisms seem to regard overt spore dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly, our local blossoms remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures swift and effective growth.

HALLUCINATION.name: Hallucination
HALLUCINATION.description: NPC trait that makes them be hallucination.  It is a bug if you have it.

IGNORE_SOUND.name: Ignores Sounds
IGNORE_SOUND.description: NPC ignores sounds and does not investigate them.  If you see this, it's is a bug.

NO_BASH.name: Will Not Bash
NO_BASH.description: NPC will not bash to reach things.  If you see this, it's a bug.

RETURN_TO_START_POS.name: Returns to Start POS
RETURN_TO_START_POS.description: NPC will return to its spawn position on idle.

NPC_STASIS.name: In Stasis
NPC_STASIS.description: This NPC is in stasis and will not act, move, or accumulate needs until activated.

INTERCOM_OPERATOR.name: Intercom Operator
INTERCOM_OPERATOR.description: This NPC operates an intercom system.

TRADE_BACKEND.name: Trade Backend
TRADE_BACKEND.description: This NPC serves as a backend trade actor for delegated shopkeeping.

GETS_RANDOM_MISSION.name: Assign Random Mission
GETS_RANDOM_MISSION.description: This is an AI tag to give a static NPC a random mission.  If you see this, it's a bug.

GETS_RANDOM_MISSION_NOMOVE.name: Assign Random No-move Mission
GETS_RANDOM_MISSION_NOMOVE.description: This is an AI tag to give a static NPC a random mission that doesn't involve them following you.  If you see this, it's a bug.

BEE.name: Bee
BEE.description: NPC trait that makes monsters see it as a bee.  It is a bug (heh) if you have it.

MYCUS_FRIEND.name: Mycus friend
MYCUS_FRIEND.description: NPC trait that makes fungaloid monsters see this NPC as a friend.

NPC_MISSION_LEV_1.name: Has Level 1 Companion Missions
NPC_MISSION_LEV_1.description: New mission options have become available!

NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_1.name: Has Level 1 Construction Built
NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_1.description: New options may have become available!

NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_2.name: Has Level 2 Construction Built
NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_2.description: New options may have become available!

personality_ultra_selfish.name: Survivor at any cost
personality_ultra_selfish.description: <npc_name> is certainly a survivor.  You can only wonder how many they've abandoned to save themself.

personality_neg_aggressive.name: Timid
personality_neg_aggressive.description: <npc_name> tries to avoid conflict, even when they have good reason not to.

personality_aggressive_mixed.name: Hardass
personality_aggressive_mixed.description: <npc_name> loves to fight a good fight, but only for themself.

personality_aggressive_plus_mixed.name: Freedom fighter
personality_aggressive_plus_mixed.description: <npc_name> believes in fighting… mostly for others, even at risk to their own wellbeing.

personality_aggressive_plus.name: Volatile
personality_aggressive_plus.description: <npc_name> is just looking for an excuse.

personality_neg_bravery.name: Coward
personality_neg_bravery.description: <npc_name> flinches at the thought of fighting, whether it be other people or the undead.

personality_neg_bravery_plus.name: Craven
personality_neg_bravery_plus.description: <npc_name> is afraid of the dark, spiders, and unexplained sounds.  So are you, but only because you've lived through the apocalypse.  <npc_name> has always been like this.

personality_brave.name: Brave
personality_brave.description: <npc_name> knows the name of fear, but only as a long-defeated foe.  Little can shake them.

personality_brave_plus.name: Hero
personality_brave_plus.description: <npc_name> is an ideal ally to those they call friend, always willing to help others.

personality_collector.name: Miser
personality_collector.description: <npc_name> loves their trinkets, and hates giving them away.

personality_collector_plus.name: Scrooge
personality_collector_plus.description: <npc_name> collects trash like an RPG protagonist collects potions.

personality_neg_altruist.name: Self-centered
personality_neg_altruist.description: <npc_name> steers every interaction into discussing how it will help them.

PROF_POLICE.name: Police Officer
PROF_POLICE.description: You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether that means anything now is another question.

PROF_PD_DET.name: Police Detective
PROF_PD_DET.description: You are a duly sworn law enforcement investigator, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether your shield means anything now is another question.

PROF_SWAT.name: SWAT Officer
PROF_SWAT.description: You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether that means anything now is another question.

PROF_FED.name: US Marshal
PROF_FED.description: You are a duly sworn Federal marshal, with nationwide jurisdiction and the authority of the United States of America.

PROF_MED.name: MD
PROF_MED.description: You trained as a medical professional in a clinic or hospital.  You can put "Dr." in front of your name and everything.

PROF_SKATER.name: Skater
PROF_SKATER.description: You are skilled in maneuvering on skates.  You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while you're wearing rollerskates or rollerblades.

PROF_DICEMASTER.name: Dungeon Master
PROF_DICEMASTER.description: Weeks spent picking through manuals and researching topics you aren't versed in has taught you to find what you need to know more quickly.  You read slightly faster, and suffer no reading time penalty for books too complex for you to easily understand.

PROF_HUB01_ANCILLIARY.name: Hub 01 Ancillary
PROF_HUB01_ANCILLIARY.description: You are known to be a capable and resourceful mercenary at the employ of Hub 01.

PROF_FOODP.name: True Foodperson
PROF_FOODP.description: You are the true Foodperson, some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  You are Foodperson, the mask has become your face; you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

PROF_CHURL.name: Churl
PROF_CHURL.description: Thou art a lewede man, a lowly cowherd, though where thi catel been thou hast not ynn certain.

PROF_BOXER.name: Pugilist
PROF_BOXER.description: You are experienced in the Sweet Science of boxing.  You could've had a shot at a local boxing tournament, if the Cataclysm hadn't screwed that up.

PROF_KICKBOXER.name: Kickboxer
PROF_KICKBOXER.description: You have some training in the art of kickboxing.  It's just boxing with kicks, right?

PROF_MA_ORANGE.name: Martial Artist
PROF_MA_ORANGE.description: You were shaping up to be a pretty decent student of the martial arts before the Cataclysm struck.  Time to see just how good you really are.

PROF_MA_BLACK.name: Black Belt
PROF_MA_BLACK.description: You were competitive at national levels, and had considered teaching your art.  Defending against the entire town may still be a challenge, though.

MARTIAL_ARTS.name: Martial Arts Training
MARTIAL_ARTS.description: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, or Pankration.

MARTIAL_ARTS2.name: Self-Defense Classes
MARTIAL_ARTS2.description: You have taken some self-defense classes at a nearby gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Kickboxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.

MARTIAL_ARTS3.name: Shaolin Adept
MARTIAL_ARTS3.description: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.

MARTIAL_ARTS5.name: Melee Weapon Training
MARTIAL_ARTS5.description: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Bōjutsu, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pencak Silat, or Sōjutsu.

MARTIAL_FENCING.name: Competitive Fencer
MARTIAL_FENCING.description: You were an avid fencer, starting with foil and moving onto saber, then épée.  You competed nationally and dabbled with some of the historical fencing weapons afforded by HEMA's popularity.

PORTAL_DEPENDENT.name: Portal Dependent
PORTAL_DEPENDENT.description: You feel alien in your own body, as if part of you remained behind with the storm.  You will suffer severely when not exposed to portal storms unless you find a way to anchor yourself to the world again.

REALITY_GRASP.name: Stabilized in Reality
REALITY_GRASP.description: You have regained some substance and have stabilized somewhat, if not entirely.  Portal storm withdrawal will not affect you as strongly as before.

anti_shape.name: Extradimensional Comprehension
anti_shape.description: In the tunnel at LIXA, you were inside of an impossible shape, where the X, Y, and Z axis were mere suggestions.  When you put the shape out of its misery, (as much misery as a concept can have), you saw it for what it was; just a shape.  You can now visualize "impossible" shapes in your mind's eye, rendering them mundane to you.

HAS_NEMESIS.name: Hunted
HAS_NEMESIS.description: Something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.

TAINTED_SHADOW.name: Tainted Shadow
TAINTED_SHADOW.description: You shouldn't see this.  This makes you spawn tainted shadows.

NOT_GLASS.name: Comfortably Fluid
NOT_GLASS.description: You can hear your heartbeat in your ears, feel the blood sloshing around in your veins.  The uneven hitches in your breath, the aches in your joints, the rumbling of your stomach.  It's nasty and messy and ugly.  And you are extremely grateful for that.

EXODII_BODY_9.description: Your entire body is covered by a rectangular frame, that has numerous supporting arms and manipulators, with decent stability.  The price of this is that the weight of the entire frame is enormous, which causes the user to either use dedicated tracked treads to move around, or stay immobile for a large amount of time.

seer_mark.description: A strange occult symbol carved into your hand by Brigitte LaCroix.

HAS_RIGHT_LEG.name: right leg
HAS_RIGHT_LEG.description: Dummy mutation that keeps you from wearing prosthetics.

NO_RIGHT_LEG.name: No Right Leg
NO_RIGHT_LEG.description: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your right leg.  You can hobble around, but will likely need a wheelchair or other means of locomotion to get somewhere far.

NO_LEFT_LEG.name: No Left Leg
NO_LEFT_LEG.description: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your left leg.  You can hobble around, but will likely need a wheelchair or other means of locomotion to get somewhere far.

NO_LEFT_ARM.name: No Left Arm
NO_LEFT_ARM.description: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your left arm.  As such, you cannot use anything you normally could with it, like lifting with two hands.

NO_RIGHT_ARM.name: No Right Arm
NO_RIGHT_ARM.description: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your right arm.  As such, you cannot use anything you normally could with it, like lifting with two hands.

RIGHT_PROSTHETIC_LEG.name: Right Prosthetic Leg
RIGHT_PROSTHETIC_LEG.description: You have a prosthetic on your right leg.

LEFT_PROSTHETIC_LEG.name: Left Prosthetic Leg
LEFT_PROSTHETIC_LEG.description: You have a prosthetic on your left leg.

RIGHT_PEG_LEG.name: Right Peg Leg
RIGHT_PEG_LEG.description: You have a prosthetic on your right leg.

LEFT_PEG_LEG.name: Left Peg Leg
LEFT_PEG_LEG.description: You have a prosthetic on your left leg.

LEFT_PROSTHETIC_ARM.name: Left Prosthetic Arm
LEFT_PROSTHETIC_ARM.description: You have a prosthetic on your left arm.

RIGHT_PROSTHETIC_ARM.name: Right Prosthetic Arm
RIGHT_PROSTHETIC_ARM.description: You have a prosthetic on your right arm.

LEFT_NEUROPROSTHETIC_ARM.name: Left Neuroprosthetic Arm
LEFT_NEUROPROSTHETIC_ARM.description: You have a prosthetic on your left arm.

RIGHT_NEUROPROSTHETIC_ARM.name: Right Neuroprosthetic Arm
RIGHT_NEUROPROSTHETIC_ARM.description: You have a prosthetic on your right arm.

LEFT_COSMETIC_PROSTHETIC_ARM.name: Left Cosmetic Prosthetic Arm
LEFT_COSMETIC_PROSTHETIC_ARM.description: You have a prosthetic on your left arm.

RIGHT_COSMETIC_PROSTHETIC_ARM.name: Right Cosmetic Prosthetic Arm
RIGHT_COSMETIC_PROSTHETIC_ARM.description: You have a prosthetic on your right arm.

PLANT.name: Plant
PLANT.mutagen_message: You feel much closer to nature.  Your breath and thoughts slow.

INSECT.name: Insect
INSECT.mutagen_message: You hear buzzing, and feel your body harden.

SPIDER.name: Spider
SPIDER.mutagen_message: You feel insidious, and your vision fragments for a moment.
SPIDER.memorial_message: Found a place in the web of life.

SLIME.name: Slime
SLIME.mutagen_message: Your body loses all rigidity for a moment.
SLIME.memorial_message: Gave up on rigid human norms.

FISH.name: Fish
FISH.mutagen_message: You are overcome by an overwhelming longing for the ocean.

GASTROPOD.name: Gastropod
GASTROPOD.mutagen_message: Your split lower body starts to come back together.

BEAST.name: Beast
BEAST.mutagen_message: Your heart races and you see blood for a moment.

URSINE.name: Ursine
URSINE.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to… patrol?  The forests?

FELINE.name: Feline
FELINE.mutagen_message: Your back arches and the hair stands up on the back of your neck.

LUPINE.name: Lupine
LUPINE.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to mark your territory.  But then it passes.

CATTLE.name: Cattle
CATTLE.mutagen_message: Your mind and body slow down.  You feel peaceful.
CATTLE.memorial_message: Stopped worrying and learned to love the cowbell.

CEPHALOPOD.name: Cephalopod
CEPHALOPOD.mutagen_message: Your mind is overcome by images of eldritch horrors… and then they pass.

BIRD.name: Bird
BIRD.mutagen_message: Your body lightens and you long for the sky.

LIZARD.name: Lizard
LIZARD.mutagen_message: For a heartbeat, your blood cools down.

BATRACHIAN.name: Batrachian
BATRACHIAN.mutagen_message: Like a tadpole you must transform.

TROGLOBITE.name: Troglobite
TROGLOBITE.mutagen_message: You yearn for a cool, dark place to hide.

MEDICAL.name: Medical
MEDICAL.mutagen_message: You can feel the blood rushing through your veins and a strange, medicated feeling washes over your senses.

CHIMERA.name: Chimera
CHIMERA.mutagen_message: You need to roar, bask, bite, and flap.  NOW.

ELFA.name: Elf-A
ELFA.mutagen_message: Everything goes green for a second.  Nature is becoming one with you…
ELFA.memorial_message: Accepted a more natural way of life.

RAPTOR.name: Raptor
RAPTOR.mutagen_message: You're struck by a primordial flashback… and then it passes.

MOUSE.name: Mouse
MOUSE.mutagen_message: You feel a desire to curl up in a nice, warm pile of… shredded paper.

RABBIT.name: Rabbit
RABBIT.mutagen_message: Walking is overrated.  It's time to start hopping.

CRUSTACEAN.name: Crustacean
CRUSTACEAN.mutagen_message: You suddenly want to burrow under some sand or find some nice rocky alcove to hide behind.
CRUSTACEAN.memorial_message: Dreamed of walking along the sea floor.

CHIROPTERAN.name: Chiropteran
CHIROPTERAN.mutagen_message: Your ears ring and you taste iron.

INTERSTICE.name: Interstice
INTERSTICE.mutagen_message: You get a glimpse of the spaces between reality.  It's maddening.

name: Injected 76x-"Lore"
desc: You just took a shot of some weird stuff.  You feel sleepy, nauseous, and generally weak, but your wounds are closing up at an unnatural pace.
learning_serum_main.apply_message: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.

name: Injected Serum Crash
desc: Your enhanced focus has faded away, light seems too bright, and you're pretty tired.

name: Slowed Time
desc: Everything around you seems to be moving slower.
regen_serum_slow_time.apply_message: Everything seems to suddenly slow down!
regen_serum_slow_time.remove_message: The world around you speeds up.

name: Injected 09x-"Anaximander"
desc: You just took a shot of that strange vial you found.  The shadows don't seem so dark anymore.
night_ops_serum_main.apply_message: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.

name: Injected Serum Crash
desc: The light hurts your eyes and the shadows seem extra dark.  Who knows what could be in there?

name: Injected 48x-"Locutus"
desc: You just took a shot of some weird stuff.  You feel sleepy, nauseous, and generally weak, but your wounds are closing up at an unnatural pace.
regen_serum_main.apply_message: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.
regen_serum_main.remove_message: You feel your rapid regeneration fade away, but you still feel sick.

name: Injected Serum Crash
desc: Your body regeneration is not as fast as before, but you still feel some weakness.

name: Injected 16x-"Armus"
desc: You just took a shot of that strange vial you found.  You feel invincible.
resilience_serum_main.apply_message: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.
resilience_serum_main.remove_message: You feel increased resilience fade away with a sudden stab of pain.

name: Injected Serum Crash
desc: Your enhanced resilience has faded away, your skin is flushed, and everything hurts.

name: Injected 51x-"Landru"
desc: You just took a shot of that strange vial you found.  Time seems to have slowed down.
speed_serum_main.apply_message: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.
speed_serum_main.remove_message: The world around you speeds up.

descriptions.text: You sense something emitting electricity here.

name: Injected Serum Crash
desc: The world seems jittery and moving too quickly, your stomach hurts, and you're very tired.

name: Injected 29x-"Noonien"
desc: You just took a shot of that strange vial you found.  You feel like you could take on the entire world, but your stomach feels a bit odd.
super_soldier_serum_main.apply_message: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.
super_soldier_serum_main.remove_message: You feel your enhanced strength fade away, but your stomach still feels odd.

name: Injected Serum Crash
desc: Your enhanced strength has faded away, your body aches, and you're having a hard time concentrating.

name: Weak Player Venom
desc: Don't worry, you shouldn't get this.

name: Strong Player Venom
desc: Don't worry, you really shouldn't get this.

name: Mechanical Fluid Dripping
desc: AI tag used for robot monsters losing mechanical fluid.  This is a bug if you have it.

name: Shattered Armor
desc: Your armor has been shattered by a heavy attack.

name: Staggered
desc: You've been knocked off-balance by an attack.

name: Sneezing
desc: It's hard to pay attention to anything when you're in the middle of sneezing!

name: Charged Acid Glands
desc: Your acid glands are full and ready to burst.  Ew.

name: Maimed Acid Glands
desc: Your acid glands got all leaky.

name: Broken Appendage
desc: Your long grotesque throwing appendage has been compromised.

name: Charged Capacitor
desc: Your capacitors sizzle with bioelectricity.

name: Maimed Capacitor
desc: You can't deal with this charge.

name: Maimed Tail
desc: Your tail is broken.  You're not sure what to do with this information.

name: Maimed Claws
desc: Your claws broke.  Like a broken nail, but somehow worse.

name: Cracked Shell
desc: You feel exposed -and pretty buggy- without your shell.

name: Disarmed
desc: You have been forced to drop any wielded weapon.  You can wield them again if you manage to survive.

name: Broken Arm
desc: Your arms are broken.  Your imaginary monster arms, so this is probably a bug.

name: Maimed Mandibles
desc: Your mandibles are unusable.  What, you don't have mandibles?  Then it must be a bug if you have it.

name: Injured Tongue
desc: Cat got your tongue?  No?  Then it must have been a bug.

name: Maimed Legs
desc: Your bugged legs are maimed beyond recognition.  How will you leap now?

name: Maimed Stinger
desc: Your beautiful stinger is broken!  That must be a bug, right?

name: Maimed Wings
desc: Your wings are useless, robbing you of unlimited flight.

name: Stumbled Into Invisible Player
desc: This creature has stumbled into an invisible player and is now aware of their presence.

name: Milked
desc: The creature has been partially or fully milked.

name: Sheared
desc: The creature has been fully sheared.

name: Fragile Frog
desc: Applied by leap special attack of burned frog zombies, conditional for related spell.

name: Photophobia
desc: It burns!  Thankfully, this can't ever happen to you.  This is a bug if you have it.

name: SWOLE
desc: If you see this description it is a bug.

name: Grown of Fusion
desc: AI effect to increase stats after fusing with another critter.  1 stack means one absorbed max_hp.

name: Revealed
desc: The shadows no longer hide you!

name: Downed
desc: You're knocked to the ground.  You have to get up before you can move.

name: Overburdened
desc: You strain to move with all you're carrying.

name: Assisted
desc: You're receiving assistance to practice a surgery.

name: Masked Scent
desc: Your scent is masked by another one.

name: Got a Check-up
desc: Your received a complete check-up and are now aware of the state of your health.

name: Heated
desc: At least one of your bionics is producing heat and warming you.

name: Winded
desc: You're short of breath.  Running and fighting will be difficult until you recover.

name: Winded
desc: You're short of breath.  Your leg has impaired function until you recover.

name: Winded
desc: You're short of breath.  Your arm has impaired function until you recover.

name: Winded
desc: You're short of breath.  One of your crab legs has impaired function until you recover.

name: Winded
desc: You're short of breath.  One of your tentacles has impaired function until you recover.

name: Low Power
desc: You're low on power.  Your leg is operating in emergency mode and has limited function.

name: Low Power
desc: You're low on power.  Your arm is operating in emergency mode and has limited function.

name: Low Power
desc: You're low on power.  Your eyes are operating in emergency mode and have limited function.

name: Low Power (Bionic Treads)
desc: You're low on power.  Your bionic treads are operating in emergency mode and have limited function.

darkness.apply_message: Your vision flickers and goes gray!
darkness.remove_message: The world flickers back to normality.

effect_true_seeing.apply_message: Details stand out in stark relief!
effect_true_seeing.remove_message: The world returns to its normal appearance.

name: Immobilized
desc: You can't move!

name: Stunned
desc: Your movement is randomized.

name: Sensor scrambling
desc: Your artificial senses are scrambled and report false readings.

name: Dazed
desc: You're visibly shaken up, and are having a hard time focusing on what's going on around you.

name: Riding
desc: You are riding an animal.

name: On Fire
desc:
Loss of health - Entire Body
Your clothing and other equipment may be consumed by the flames.
onfire.apply_message: You're on fire!  Wait in place to attempt to put out the fire.

name: Unstable Footing
desc: Your footing is unstable.  It's more difficult to fight while standing here.
bouldering.apply_message: You try to keep your balance.

name: Blind
desc: Range of Sight: 0.  You cannot see anything.

name: Blind
desc: Range of Sight: 0.  You cannot see anything.  You shouldn't be able to see this description either!

name: Wearing Earphones
desc: You are wearing earphones and can't hear much from outside world.

name: Impaired Hearing
Ringing Ears
Deaf
desc: Your hearing is impaired.
You can barely hear anything and your ears hurt.
You can't hear anything and your head aches from all the noise.  You can't converse with NPCs.

glowy_led.apply_message: A bionic LED is glowing softly beneath your skin.

name: Staggered
desc: You've been knocked off-balance by an attack.

name: Poisoned
desc: You have been poisoned!
miss_messages: You feel bad inside.

name: Badly Poisoned
desc: You have been badly poisoned!
miss_messages: You feel bad inside.

name: Short of Breath
desc: The pollen makes it hard to breathe!
miss_messages: You cough out pollen.

name: Poisoned Wound
desc: The wound swells visibly and burns like hell.
venom_dmg.remove_message: The burning pain subsides, but the damage is done.

name: Weakening Poison
desc: You feel feeble.
venom_weaken.apply_message: The sting itself barely hurt, but suddenly you feel exhausted.
venom_weaken.remove_message: The weight on your chest lessens.

name: Distracted
Inattentive
Dissociated
desc: You find it hard to concentrate on your surroundings properly.
You're not even listening, are you?
Everything will be fine.  Just ignore all you see, and everything will be fine.
miss_messages: It was right here, wasn't it?
Are you sure there's something there?

name: Distracting Wound
Painful Wound
Searing Wound
desc: The wound throbs with sharp pain.
venom_pain.apply_message: A dull pain starts spreading from the wound!

name: Food Poisoning
desc: Your stomach is extremely upset, and you are quite nauseated.
miss_messages: Your stomach bothers you.

name: Slowed
Slowed
Slowed
Slowed
Slowed
Sluggish
Sluggish
Sluggish
Sluggish
Sluggish
Partially Paralyzed
Partially Paralyzed
Partially Paralyzed
Partially Paralyzed
Partially Paralyzed
Totally Paralyzed
Totally Paralyzed
Totally Paralyzed
Totally Paralyzed
Totally Paralyzed
desc: You are being slowed by a paralyzing poison!
miss_messages: You feel stiff.

name: Slightly Nauseous
Mildly Nauseous
Nauseous
Very Nauseous
Extremely Nauseous
desc: You are nauseous and may lead to vomiting.

name: Sleep Deprived
desc: Your sleep debt has been steadily increasing for a while.  You should get some rest.
sleep_deprived.apply_message: You feel weary, your body tired from lack of quality sleep.
sleep_deprived.remove_message: You have finally caught up with your lost sleep, and you feel refreshed and awake for a change.

name: Melatonin Supplements
desc: You took some melatonin supplements.  It makes you fall asleep more easily, and you sleep longer.

name: Changing
Warping
Mutagen Overdose
desc: You consumed mutagen.  It was probably a good idea.
You can feel your insides shifting.  It feels… nice.
Your innards churn in an unnatural fashion - if you survive this, you'll be a changed… something.
mutagen.remove_message: Your body is starting to feel normal again.

name: Mutagenic Slurry
desc: Your stomach feels like it's burning.  Hopefully that was a good idea…
mutagenic_slurry.remove_message: You're feeling a little better now.

name: Mutagen Chelator
desc: You took a dose of chelator.  Any mutagenic drugs in your body are being purged.

name: Alpha Mutation
Alpha Transformation
Alpha Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed alpha primer.
You feel better.  So much better.
The world needs you, surely this won't kill you.  It better not.

name: Frog Mutation
Frog Transformation
Frog Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed frog primer.
Now, to find a quiet pond and settle for the wait…
You feel like you're about to croak… if you don't keel over first.

name: Beast Mutation
Beast Transformation
Beast Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed beast primer.
There must be prey around.  Stay alert.
Primal instincts overwhelm your mind, and your saliva has turned to froth.

name: Bird Mutation
Bird Transformation
Bird Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed bird primer.
You feel the pull of the skies.
Goosebumps stand across your entire body.  You keep feeling that you're falling.

name: Cattle Mutation
Cattle Transformation
Cattle Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed cattle primer.
This pasture will grow barren soon.  Keep moving.
Dull fog clouds your mind, and you feel close to vomiting.

name: Cephalopod Mutation
Cephalopod Transformation
Cephalopod Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed cephalopod primer.
Become one with your surroundings.
Your skin crawls and your extremities twitch and jerk.

name: Chimera Mutation
Chimera Transformation
Chimera Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed chimera primer.  Why?
Your flesh is the clay of the new world.  You'll overcome all challenges.
Your body heaving and changing is a rough time, but what doesn't kill you makes you stronger.

name: Elf-A Mutation
Elf-A Transformation
Elf-A Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed Elf-A primer.
You must look after this world, if no one else will.
You see stars.  You see so many stars.

name: Feline Mutation
Feline Transformation
Feline Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed feline primer.
Quiet steps and sharp claws.  They'll never see it coming.
If this overdose kills you, you've got a few more lives… right?

name: Fish Mutation
Fish Transformation
Fish Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed fish primer.
The waters call to you.  Leave this exposed wasteland.
You feel clammy yet dry, absolutely parched no matter how much you drink.

name: Snail Mutation
Snail Transformation
Snail Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed snail primer.
Slow and steady wins the race.
You itch terribly, and your mouth feels salty and dry.

name: Human Purification
Human Reversion
Human Regression
desc: You consumed purifier.
You consumed a large amount of purifier.  Why does it feel so strange?
You consumed a huge amount of purifier, and you can tell that something isn't right.

name: Insect Mutation
Insect Transformation
Insect Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed insect primer.
You can't wait for your change.  It can't be long now.
You can't stop shivering and twitching.  Life is so short.

name: Lizard Mutation
Lizard Transformation
Lizard Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed lizard primer.
Your skin feels dry and too small.  You'll have to molt soon.
Your limbs slump, almost ready to tear right out of their sockets.

name: Lupine Mutation
Lupine Transformation
Lupine Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed lupine primer.
Where's your pack?  How will you survive without them?
You pant, unable to stop pacing and full of hunger.

name: Medical Mutation
Medical Transformation
Medical Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed medical primer.
You consumed medical primer.  You should do that again.
You're tearing yourself apart.  Need to get fixed back up.  Should put some stitches in you.

name: Mouse Mutation
Mouse Transformation
Mouse Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed mouse primer.
Your heart pounds, knowing that predators could approach at any second!
Your heart hammers away with a rapid, irregular beat.

name: Plant Mutation
Plant Transformation
Plant Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed plant primer.
All this running… why don't you just find a nice, fertile spot and bask in the sun?
Your processes are slowing.  You would make great fertilizer.

name: Raptor Mutation
Raptor Transformation
Raptor Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed raptor primer.
Sharpen your talons and clean your feathers.  Your prey won't give itself easily.
Delusions fill your head… is it true?  Did you die long ago?

name: Rabbit Mutation
Rabbit Transformation
Rabbit Metamorphosis
desc: You consumed rabbit primer.
So much to do!  Better hop to it!
Will you have a future?  Will any new generations be born… your pounding head is full of worry.

name: Rat Mutation
Rat Transformation
