The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 5x, Active: 4x, Brisk: 3x, Moderate: 2x

name: Extremely Weary
desc:
You've been extremely active for a while, and can't take much more activity.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x

name: Extremely Weary
desc:
You've been extremely active for a while, and really need to get some rest.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x

name: Extremely Weary
desc:
You've been extremely active for a while; it's time to stop.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x

name: Extremely Weary
desc:
You've been extremely active for a while, and can no longer keep pushing.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x

name: Full
desc: You feel quite full, and a bit sluggish.
hunger_full.apply_message: You feel quite full, and a bit sluggish.

name: Engorged
desc: Your stomach is full to bursting.  This was a mistake.
hunger_engorged.apply_message: Your stomach is full to bursting.  This was a mistake.

name: Weakened Inertia
desc: Your body moves strangely easily, as if it weighed less.
weakened_inertia.apply_message: Your inertia itself is damaged, but the outcome seems suspiciously beneficial.
weakened_inertia.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your inertia returns to normal.

name: Weakened Inertia
desc: Your body is strangely difficult to move, as if it weighted more.
strengthened_inertia.apply_message: Your inertia itself is damaged, but hopefully it's not permanent yet.
strengthened_inertia.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your inertia returns to normal.

name: Warped Viewpoint
desc: Space is warped around you such that you can see a wider arc and as if everything was closer.
warped_viewpoint.apply_message: Space around you is damaged but in the process your can see more and more easily than before.
warped_viewpoint.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your perspective returns to normal.

name: Narrowed Viewpoint
desc: Space is warped around you such that you can see less and as if everything was farther away.
narrow_viewpoint.apply_message: Space around you is damaged narrowing your perspective.
narrow_viewpoint.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your perspective returns to normal.

name: Weakened Gravity
desc: Something is wrong with local spacetime and everything near you seems to weigh less.
weakened_gravity.apply_message: Space around you is damaged and everything near you seems to weigh less.
weakened_gravity.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your gravity returns to normal.

name: Strengthened Gravity
desc: Something is wrong with local spacetime and everything near you seems to weigh more.
strengthened_gravity.apply_message: Space around you is damaged and everything near you seems to weigh more.
strengthened_gravity.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your gravity returns to normal.

name: Slowed Time
desc: Something is wrong with local spacetime and everything around seems to move faster than you.
slowed_time.apply_message: Time around you is damaged and everything near you seems to move faster.
slowed_time.remove_message: Reality reasserts itself and your time returns to normal.

name: Night Vision Goggles (Green)
desc: Your night vision goggles give a green tint to the world.

name: Glowing Gas
desc: You've inhaled a lungful of glowing nether parasite spores.  Thankfully, they don't seem adapted to the human physiology.
glowing_gas.apply_message: You inhale a lungful of the glowing gas, and you have an urge to violently cough.
miss_messages: Your lungs burn from the glowing gas.

name: Glowing
desc: You are covered in glowing nether spores!
glowing_gas_cover.apply_message: The glowing spores settle on you!

name: Molting
desc: You feel a strong urge to hide somewhere safe.
molting.apply_message: Your chitin plating itches against your body.

name: Imminent Molting
desc: Seek shelter, you will be helpless when it begins.
molting_imminent.apply_message: You can hardly move in your tightening exoskeleton, and you feel a strong impulse to hunker down somewhere safe.

name: Among Glass
desc: It is very peaceful here.

name: Hay Fever
desc: Your eyes are itchy and you've got a runny nose.

name: Drank blood
desc: The star vampire has drunk blood and is now visible.

name: Exsanguination
desc: The monster is drinking your blood, you vile feral!

name: Depleted ink
Deflated ink glands
Inky glands
Bulged ink glands
desc: Your ink glands are empty.  Given some time and hydration they will recharge.
Your ink glands are almost empty.  Given some time and hydration they will recharge.
Your ink glands have some ink inside.  Given some time and hydration, more ink will be generated.
Your ink glands are bulged and full.  No more ink is being created.

name: Cramped Space
desc: Your movements are restricted by the surroundings.
miss_messages: You don't have any room to move!
cramped_space.apply_message: Your movements are restricted by the surroundings.
cramped_space.remove_message: You are able to move freely again.

name: Gliding
desc: You are gliding through the air.

name: Slow Descent
desc: You are descending at a safe speed.

name: Mute
desc: You can't talk.

name: Good Company
desc: It feels good to spend time around others.

name: Lonely
Very Lonely
All Alone
desc: You feel a little lonely.
You could really use a friend right now.
What's the point of surviving if you're all alone?

name: Alone
desc: Being on your own makes you feel good.

name: Irritable
Annoyed
Crowded
desc: Being around others has left you feeling drained.
OK, that's enough social time.  You'd really rather be alone now.
Your nerves are frayed from all this socializing.  You need some alone time to recharge.

name: Natural Stance
desc: You are positioned to take advantage of your mutated anatomy, and will receive no penalties for crouching in melee combat.  Wielding a weapon will cause you to lose this effect.

name: Channeling
desc: You are channeling supernatural powers.

name: Subaquatic SONAR
desc: Every few seconds, an ultrasonic pulse is broadcast from your location.  If you're underwater and your hearing is good enough, you may be able to navigate by the pings that come back.

name: Uneasy stomach
Bloated stomach
Strained stomach
Overloaded stomach
desc: Your stomach constantly feels like it's full, even when you haven't eaten in awhile.
triffid_fiber_indigestion.apply_message: Your stomach starts to feel strange and bloated.
decay_messages: You feel the strain in your stomach lessen.

name: Sunscreen
desc: You applied sunscreen and should be protected from the sun rays for about two hours.

name: Unnatural Chill
desc: You are chilled to the bone.
effect_nether_shadow_unnatural_chill.remove_message: The chill in your bones finally fades away.

name: Crackling
desc: Sparks occasionally crackle across the monster's skin.

name: Out of Phase
desc: You are not entirely present in baseline reality.

name: Hound Ichor
desc: Your %s is stained with bluish ichor.
effect_hound_of_tindalos_slobber.remove_message: The bluish ichor boils away into nothingness.

name: Poisoned
desc: You have been poisoned!
miss_messages: You feel bad inside.

name: Uncomfortable
desc: The light is making you itchy and painful.
effect_hunting_horror_poison_light_sensi.apply_message: Your skin itches as the light falls on you.
effect_hunting_horror_poison_light_sensi.remove_message: The itching fades as the light does.

name: Food Poisoning
desc: Your stomach is extremely upset, and you are quite nauseated.
alienfoodpoison.apply_message: Your stomach is seized with cramps!
miss_messages: Your stomach bothers you.

name: Clumsy Fingers
desc: You're still getting used to these new paws.  Maybe you need some practice.

name: Nauseating Stench
desc: Something smells unbelievably foul.
nauseating_smell.apply_message: You are assaulted by one of the most vile smells you've ever smelled.
nauseating_smell.remove_message: The last traces of the foul stench leave your nostrils.

name: Out of phase
desc: Your body is partially out of phase with reality.  You move much more slowly, but you might be able to phase through some obstacles with ease.
nl_phase_goo.remove_message: Your body returns to its normal phase.

name: Scarlet Atmosphere
desc: You've been breathing in an alien atmosphere.  Breathing is difficult.

name: Drank Acrid Water
desc: That yellowish water isn't sitting right with you.
effect_scarlet_water.remove_message: The acrid taste in your mouth subsides, and your head clears.
miss_messages: Your guts feel awful.

name: Strange Lung Irritation
desc: You've been breathing strange mist and fog, and it doesn't feel quite right.
scarlet_storm_lungs.remove_message: You suddenly feel like you can breath again.

name: illuminated
desc: You're covered in congealed light!
LIXA_illuminated.apply_message: The sticky globs of light cover you, and begin to burn!

name: In Decompressed Space
desc: For an instant, every inch of this infinite space is itself infinite, slowing you drastically.
LIXA_decompressed.apply_message: Space unfolds and extends around you!
miss_messages: You cannot make any progress in all this vastness.

name: Unfolded
desc: There is no longer an inside or outside of you.  It is all one side; flat, infinite, and everything you have ever been.  You wonder if you're having no trouble understanding it because your brain works better spread out like this.

name: Strange Pressure
desc: You feel a strange force pressing you inwards and inside-out

name: Temporal Distortion
desc: A slight temporal distortion appears to be centered around you

name: Resonant
desc: You feel strangely detached from the here and now.
purple_incense_effect.remove_message: Things seem to stitch back together.

name: Ennervated
desc: You feel like you have one foot in the grave.
red_incense_effect.remove_message: The feeling of dread fades away.

name: Calm
desc: Something strange is happening but you can't quite feel worried about it.
yellow_incense_effect.remove_message: The feeling of calm fades away.

name: Supernatural burning
desc: Invisible flames lick at your skin.

name: Spatial Dissociation
desc: Distances around you don't seem to quite add up, it feels like you were walking in a dream.
green_incense_effect.remove_message: Things seem to stitch back together.

name: Golden Incense
desc: You can't shake off the smell of the golden incense.  It feels like small daggers pressing against your senses.

name: Had a Confessional
godco_confessed.apply_message: You finally got the weight off your chest.
desc: You decided to take responsibility for your actions.

name: Full
desc: This beggar in the refugee center has had something to eat recently.

name: Insulted
desc: Oh, you went there.

name: Relaxed with Alonso
al_relaxed.apply_message: You spent some pleasant time relaxing with someone.
miss_messages: You feel relaxed.

name: Spent Phenotype
Depleted Phenotype
Bankrupt Phenotype
desc: Mutation has left you with a persistent mild discomfort.  It seems harmless for now, but you can't predict if it'll get worse.
There's an enervating sense of dysmorphia throughout your whole body.  It waxes and wanes, but never quite goes away.  Mutating this much can't be good for you…
You're haunted by phantom pains across your entire body now.  Everything aches from an exhaustion that never seems to fade.  Any further mutation right now is very unlikely to have a happy ending.

name: Conjunctivitis
desc: Commonly known as pinkeye, this minor infection can be treated with antihistamines.  If it's bacterial, antibiotics may help, but you can't tell without a lab analysis.
conjunctivitis_viral.apply_message: Your itchy eye leaks a filmy discharge.
miss_messages: It feels like there's sand in your eye.

name: Conjunctivitis
desc: Commonly known as pinkeye, this minor infection can be treated with antihistamines.  If it's bacterial, antibiotics may help, but you can't tell without a lab analysis.
conjunctivitis_bacterial.apply_message: Your itchy eye leaks a filmy discharge.
miss_messages: It feels like there's sand in your eye.

name: Slick Surface
Slippery Terrain
Dangerously Slippery
desc: There's a slippery surface here, running may be a bad idea.
It's quite slippery, it may not be safe to stand here.
This area is extremely slippery.

name: Bile Splashed
desc: You're splattered with a greasy layer of liquified putrescence.

name: Hemorrhage
desc: The monster is sucking up your blood!

style_biojutsu.name: Bionic Combatives
style_biojutsu.description: A modern combat style for the post-modern human.  Nicknamed "Biojutsu", Bionic Combatives combines integrated weaponry, armor, and augments into a consolidated fighting discipline.
initiate: BEGINNING BIONIC COMBATIVES PROGRAM.  INITIATING COMBAT PROTOCOLS.
%s starts moving with swift robotic precision.

static_buffs.name: Biojutsu Stance

onblock_buffs.name: Binary Hardening
onblock_buffs.description:
player@CDDA:/root$ sudo apt install improved-armor
player@CDDA:/root$ sudo apt update

+3 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 4 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onkill_buffs.name: Optimization
onkill_buffs.description:
>10 LOCATE TARGET
>20 EXECUTE TARGET
>30 GOTO 10

+1 accuracy, +15% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

style_centipede.name: Centipede Kung Fu
style_centipede.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Zhang Xiaotian.  Centipede Style uses an onslaught of rapid strikes.  Each attack you land increases your attack speed.  Critical hits increase your damage further.
initiate: You ready yourself to attack as fast as possible.
%s assumes a centipede-like stance.

onhit_buffs.name: Centipede's Frenzy
onhit_buffs.description:
Your attacks are a blur of hands and legs that become faster as you strike your opponents without rest.

-4 move cost.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 4 times.

oncrit_buffs.name: Centipede's Venom
oncrit_buffs.description:
Your venom burns your opponents at the worst of times.

+15% damage.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_lizard.name: Lizard Kung Fu
style_lizard.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Pu Tianxia.  Lizard Style focuses on using walls to your advantage.  Standing near a wall enables stronger buffs and techniques.
initiate: You ready yourself to attack from any angle.
%s assumes a lizard-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Lizard's Cunning
static_buffs.description:
Through patience and observation, you know how to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

+2 accuracy, +2 blocking effectiveness.

static_buffs.name: Lizard's Haven
static_buffs.description:
Staying near a wall further improves your chances to hit and avoid damage.

+2 accuracy, +2 blocking effectiveness when near a wall.

onmove_buffs.name: Lizard's Leap
onmove_buffs.description:
By briefly pushing off a nearby wall and leaping, you can make yourself more dangerous and evasive.

+2.0 Dodging skill, +10% critical hit chance.
Lasts 2 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Lizard's Perch
onpause_buffs.description:
From your high vantage point, you can strike downward and deal more damage.

+10% damage while near a wall.
Lasts 3 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Lizard's Venom
onpause_buffs.description:
Your venom is a long-lasting pain that your opponents will never forget.

+15% damage.
Lasts 5 turns.

style_scorpion.name: Scorpion Kung Fu
style_scorpion.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Ding Jing.  Scorpion Style is a mysterious art which uses pincer-like hands and a stinger kick.  Moving enables a stunning pincer attack.  Critical hits do massive damage and knock your opponent back along with anyone your opponent comes in contact with.
initiate: You prepare to capture and sting your foes.
%s assumes a scorpion-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Scorpion's Venom
static_buffs.description:
Your venom is a constant threat that nothing can escape from.

+15% damage.

onattack_buffs.name: Scorpion's Intimidation
onattack_buffs.description:
Nothing is scarier than an angry scorpion.  Your attacks can keep others at bay.

+1 dodge attempt.
Lasts 1 turn.

onmove_buffs.name: Scorpion's Charge
onmove_buffs.description:
Rush forward and catch your prey!

+10% damage.
Enables "Pincer Fist" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

style_toad.name: Toad Kung Fu
style_toad.description: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Liang Sheng.  Masters of Toad Style can focus their Strength to protect against all attacks.  You have powerful armor against physical attacks, though you will lose focus when you move.  You can meditate by pausing, giving yourself more armor for a short time.
initiate: You pause for a moment and focus on your invincible body.
%s assumes a toad-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Toad's Iron Skin
static_buffs.description:
Your body is as strong as iron, but only if you don't move.

Bash, cut, and stab armor increased by 100% of Strength.

onmove_buffs.name: Iron Skin Dissipation
onmove_buffs.description:
Moving causes you to lose your iron skin.

Bash, cut, and stab armor reduced by 20% of Strength.
Lasts 5 turns.  Stacks 5 times.

onpause_buffs.name: Toad's Meditation
onpause_buffs.description:
By concentrating for a moment, you can bolster the strength of your iron skin.

Bash, cut, and stab armor increased by 50% of Strength.
Lasts 2 turns.

ongethit_buffs.name: Toad's Venom
ongethit_buffs.description:
Your venom is a harsh lesson about the strength of your iron body.

+15% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

style_venom_snake.name: Viper Kung Fu
style_venom_snake.description: A legacy of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Qi Dong.  Viper Style (originally called Snake Style) is punishing to stunned opponents.  Stunning a foe with a Viper Bite will allow you to finish them off with the legendary Viper Strike.
initiate: You prepare to strike your foes' weaknesses.
%s assumes a viper-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Viper's Patience
static_buffs.description:
Every snake waits for the perfect moment to strike.  Turn your opponents' mistakes into your opportunity to strike!

+1 dodge attempt, +1 accuracy, +5% critical hit chance.

oncrit_buffs.name: Viper's Venom
oncrit_buffs.description:
Your venom is a harsh reminder to never tease a predator.

+15% damage.
Lasts 4 turns.

onhit_buffs.name: Viper's Rattle
onhit_buffs.description:
You are a terrifying monster on the battlefield!  Opponents will have a harder time fighting back.

+1 accuracy, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

style_none.name: No style
style_none.description: Not a martial art, this is just plain old punching and kicking.
initiate: You decide to not use any martial arts.
%s enters a generic combat stance.

style_kicks.name: Force unarmed
style_kicks.description: Not a martial art, setting this style will prevent weapon attacks and force punches (with a free hand) or kicks.
initiate: You force yourself to fight unarmed.
%s decides to fight unarmed.

style_aikido.name: Aikido
style_aikido.description: Aikido is a Japanese martial art focused on self-defense, while minimizing injury to the attacker.  It uses defensive throws and disarms but its techniques lack offensive power.  Modern instruction in the United States tends to emphasize escaping assailants, and disengaging at the first opportunity.
initiate: You enter the hanmi stance.
%s enters a relaxed combat posture.

static_buffs.name: Aikido Stance
static_buffs.description:
By disregarding offense in favor of defense, you are better at protecting yourself.

You have +2 blocking effectiveness and +1.0 Dodging skill.

static_buffs.name: Intermediate Aikido
static_buffs.description:
You've learned the fundamentals of Aikido.  Your movement would be familiar to any practitioners in a pre-Cataclysm dojo.

Blocked damage reduced by 25% of Dexterity, +1 blocking effectiveness, +1 dodge attempt.

static_buffs.name: Advanced Aikido
static_buffs.description:
An advanced Aikido practitioner can protect themselves even against multiple opponents.

+1 dodge attempt, and one dodge each turn will not consume stamina.

onblock_buffs.name: Fluid Blocking
onblock_buffs.description:
After a smooth block, you prepare to counter your foe.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

ondodge_buffs.name: Fluid Dodging
ondodge_buffs.description:
After a dodge, you have an opportunity for a clean escape.

-50% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_bojutsu.name: Bōjutsu
style_bojutsu.description: Bōjutsu, "The Way of the Staff", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a staff.  Bōjutsu focuses on maintaining a good stance to effectively block and counterattack.
initiate: You position yourself into an agile stance.
%s enters an agile stance.

static_buffs.name: Bōjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
An agile stance that allows your blocks to reduce incoming damage.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity.

static_buffs.name: Skilled Striking
static_buffs.description:
As you get more skilled you're able to begin targeting striking points that allow for more damage.

Melee skill increases bash damage cap.

onmove_buffs.name: Rolling Staff
onmove_buffs.description:
As you move you begin to rapidly and fluidly roll your staff between your hands.

+10% bash damage.
Enables "Rolling Strike" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_barbaran.name: Barbaran Montante
style_barbaran.description: Barbaran Montante originated in 16th century Spain and focuses on overcoming thick armor with heavy weaponry and sweeping blows, transferring kinetic energy through armor and into vulnerable organs and bones.
initiate: You heft your weapon, stretch your shoulders, and slide into the Represa.
%s rolls their shoulders and prepares to duel.

static_buffs.name: Barbaran Represa
static_buffs.description:
Sliding footwork enhances the crushing continuity of your attacks.

Armor penetration increased by 75% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Reversing Destreza
onblock_buffs.description:
Blocking a key strike will turn the battle around.

-5% move cost.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

onkill_buffs.name: Movimiento Natural
onkill_buffs.description:
Formal victory is attained, and your mind is cleared to focus on your next moves.

+1 block attempt.
Lasts 5 turns.

onmove_buffs.name: Ricasso Step
onmove_buffs.description:
You switch or sturdy your grip mid-step to aid your blocking.

Blocked damage reduced by 40% of Strength.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onpause_buffs.name: Vulgar Preparation
onpause_buffs.description:
You prepare for the final crushing strike.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Strength, armor penetration increased by 225% of Strength.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_boxing.name: Boxing
style_boxing.description: Sport of the true gentleman, modern boxing has evolved from the prizefights of the Victorian era.  Strength reduces blocked damage and moving increase Dodging skill.
initiate: You lower your chin and raise your fists to eye level.
%s prepares to fight with raised fists.

static_buffs.name: Boxing Stance
static_buffs.description:
A solid stance allows you to block more damage than normal and deliver better punches.

+1 accuracy, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onmove_buffs.name: Footwork
onmove_buffs.description:
You make yourself harder to hit by bobbing and weaving as you move.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 2 times.

ondodge_buffs.name: Counter Chance
ondodge_buffs.description:
You've seen your chance.  Now strike back!

+25% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_brawling.name: Brawling
style_brawling.description: You're used to hand-to-creature fighting.  You know how to fight when unarmed or with any weapon to a certain extent.  It's not stylish or sporting, but it gets the job done.
initiate: You grit your teeth and prepare for a good fight.
%s gets ready to brawl.

static_buffs.name: Enhanced Blocking
static_buffs.description:
Combat experience has led to you being able to block multiple attacks at a time.

+1 block attempt.

onpause_buffs.name: Preparation to Hit
onpause_buffs.description:
You take a moment to prepare your stance before the enemy, allowing you to hit a little more accurately.

+1 accuracy.  Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

style_capoeira.name: Capoeira
style_capoeira.description: A dance-like style with its roots in Brazilian slavery, Capoeira is focused on fluid movement and sweeping kicks.  Moving briefly enables stronger techniques.  Missing an attack grants bonus damage for a short time.
initiate: You begin performing the ginga.
%s begins to rhythmically rock back and forth.

static_buffs.name: Capoeira Stance
static_buffs.description:
You never stop moving while performing the ginga.  This makes you very mobile while fighting.

+1.0 Dodging skill, +1 dodge attempt.

onattack_buffs.name: Capoeira Tempo
onattack_buffs.description:
Hit or miss, it's just part of the dance!  And the best part is about to start!

+5% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Capoeira Momentum
onmove_buffs.description:
You can feel the rhythm as you move.  You are harder to hit, and your kicks are even more amazing!

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Enables "Spin Kick" and "Sweep Kick" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.

style_crane.name: Crane Kung Fu
style_crane.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Crane uses intricate hand techniques and jumping dodges.  Dexterity determines your damage, rather than Strength; you have a higher chance to dodge and dodging unlocks strong techniques for a limited time.
initiate: You raise your leg slightly and balance like a crane.
%s assumes a crane-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Crane's Precision
static_buffs.description:
Your attacks strike at your opponents' weak spots with speed and precision instead of brute force.

Bash damage increased by 75% of Dexterity but decreased by 75% of Strength.

static_buffs.name: Crane's Stance
static_buffs.description:
Like the beautiful crane, you are very skilled at evading danger.

+2.0 Dodging skill.

static_buffs.name: Crane's Grace
static_buffs.description:
Masters of the Crane style can evade multiple foes with ease.

+2 dodge attempts.

ondodge_buffs.name: Crane's Flight
ondodge_buffs.description:
Much like the crane, you are quick to avoid danger and strike back.

+1 accuracy, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Enables "Crane Kick" and "Crane Strike" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.

style_dragon.name: Dragon Kung Fu
style_dragon.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Dragon uses fluid movements and hard strikes.  Intelligence improves your accuracy and damage instead of Dexterity and Strength.  Dodging and blocking increases your damage.  Pausing increases your defenses.  You can perform a powerful strike against a downed opponent.
initiate: You relax and patiently await conflict like the great dragon.
%s assumes a dragon-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Dragon's Knowledge
static_buffs.description:
You plan your attacks far in advance, relying on your intuition instead of your speed to strike true.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Intelligence but decreased by 25% of Dexterity, bash damage increased by 75% of Intelligence but decreased by 75% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Dragon's Vortex
onblock_buffs.description:
Life and combat are a circle.  An attack leads to a counter and to an attack once again.  Seek to complete this loop.

+10% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.

ondodge_buffs.name: Dragon Wing
ondodge_buffs.description:
Life and combat are a circle.  An attack leads to a counter and to an attack once again.  Seek to complete this loop.

+10% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Dragon Power
onpause_buffs.description:
You take a moment to reflect on battles past and to come.  This insight will protect you from future harm.

+2 blocking effectiveness, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Intelligence, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_eskrima.name: Eskrima
style_eskrima.description: Eskrima, also known as Kali, is a Filipino martial art.  It emphasizes rapid strikes with knife and baton weapons, along with a variety of improvised substitutes.
initiate: You enter an open guard stance and prepare to strike.
%s enters an open stance.

static_buffs.name: Eskrima Stance
static_buffs.description:
You are skilled at getting the most out of your weapons.  The term 'weapon' might be very subjective.

+2 accuracy.

oncrit_buffs.name: Eskrima Combination
oncrit_buffs.description:
You can follow up a critical hit with a stronger attack if the opportunity presents itself.

+15% damage.
Enables "Combination Strike" technique.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

style_fencing.name: Fencing
style_fencing.description: The noble art of fencing is taught with flexible competition blades, but the techniques are derived from (and applicable to) more functional examples.  Skilled fencers can take advantage of blocks and feints to deliver accurate strikes.
initiate: You move into the en-garde stance.
%s moves into a fencing stance.

static_buffs.name: Fencing Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your side stance reduces the chance that you will be harmed in combat.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Dexterity.

onblock_buffs.name: Parry
onblock_buffs.description:
Your next strike will find its mark much easier after your parry.

+1 accuracy.
Lasts 1 turn.

onmiss_buffs.name: Remise
onmiss_buffs.description:
Your feint is the perfect setup for a devastating followup attack!

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Compound Attack" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

onpause_buffs.name: Counter Time
onpause_buffs.description:
You fake an attack and prepare yourself to unleash a Compound Attack.

+2 blocking effectiveness.
Enables "Compound Attack" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_medievalpole.name: Fior Di Battaglia
style_medievalpole.description: Medieval Europe's martial techniques for fighting with hooked weapons.  The "Flower of Battle" places great focus on countering one's opponent and knocking them down before landing a killing blow.
initiate: You hold your weapon in a firm grip, ready to block any attack.
%s grips their weapon tightly.

static_buffs.name: Stand Your Ground
static_buffs.description:
You are stalwart and will not budge against any threat.

+2 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, -1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onmove_buffs.name: Tactical Retreat
onmove_buffs.description:
You moved and nullified the effects of Stand Your Ground!

-2 blocking effectiveness, -1 block attempt, +1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage increased by 50% of Strength.
Prevents "High Round Strike" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.

onmiss_buffs.name: Tactical Feinting
onmiss_buffs.description:
They fell for your feint!

Enables "Hook and Drag" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

onblock_buffs.name: Defense Break
onblock_buffs.description:
Each successful block reveals an opening in your opponent's guard.

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Displace and Hook" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.

style_judo.name: Judo
style_judo.description: Judo is a martial art that focuses on grabs and throws, both defensive and offensive.  You are resistant to most effects that can knock you down and can counter grab and takedown attacks with a strong judo throw.
initiate: You prepare yourself for a grapple.
%s prepares for a grapple.

static_buffs.name: Judo Stance
static_buffs.description: Your knowledge of grappling allows you to recover from knockdown effects instantly.  In addition, you can counter grabs and takedown attacks with a judo throw.

ondodge_buffs.name: Perfect Position
ondodge_buffs.description:
You've moved into a perfect position to counter attack!

+30% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_karate.name: Karate
style_karate.description: Karate is a popular martial art, originating from Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise attacks, blocks, and fluid movement.  A successful hit allows you an extra dodge and an extra block on the following round.
initiate: You adopt a classic karate stance.
%s adopts a classic karate stance.

static_buffs.name: Karate Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your no-nonsense stance allows you hit more accurately.

+2 accuracy.

onhit_buffs.name: Karate Kata
onhit_buffs.description:
Landing a hit allows you to perfectly position yourself for maximum defense against multiple opponents.

+1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -10% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_kickboxing.name: Kickboxing
style_kickboxing.description: A martial art that combines western boxing with elements of Karate, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, and Savate, particularly in the use of kicks.  American Kickboxing in particular focuses on high kicks without knee or elbow strikes.
initiate: You bring your fists up and stay light on your feet.
%s brings their fists up and stays light on their feet.

static_buffs.name: Kick stance
static_buffs.description:
You have adopted a stance which allows for greater mobility and stability.  Your hands are in a guard position with elbows forward to protect yourself.

Blocked damage reduced by 25% of Strength.
+1.0 Dodging skill.

style_krav_maga.name: Krav Maga
style_krav_maga.description: Originating in Israel, Krav Maga is based on taking down an enemy quickly and effectively.  It focuses on applicable attacks rather than showy or complex moves.  Popular among police and armed forces everywhere.
initiate: You assume a practical combat stance.
%s assumes a practical combat stance.

static_buffs.name: Krav Maga Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training makes it easier to land hits and fight multiple opponents.

+1 accuracy, +1 block attempt.

onblock_buffs.name: Strike Vitals
onblock_buffs.description:
Like a fool, your opponent has left themselves wide open.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_leopard.name: Leopard Kung Fu
style_leopard.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Leopard focuses on rapid, strategically-planned strikes.  Dexterity determines your damage rather than Strength, and also increases your critical hit chance.
initiate: You prepare to pounce like a leopard.
%s assumes a leopard-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Leopard's Strategy
static_buffs.description:
You fight by overwhelming your opponents with speedy strikes that are much harder to defend against.

Bash damage increased by 75% of Dexterity but decreased by 75% of Strength.

static_buffs.name: Leopard's Ambush
static_buffs.description:
Go for the throat and take out your foes immediately!

Critical hit chance increased by 100% of Dexterity.

oncrit_buffs.name: Leopard's Agility
oncrit_buffs.description:
Just like a cat, you are quick, agile, and hard to pin down.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_swordsmanship.name: Medieval Swordsmanship
style_swordsmanship.description: The art of the longsword and sword & buckler, preceding the later development of fencing.  Designed for combat both unarmored and in armor, it includes grappling as well as defensive and offensive sword techniques.  This style is a combination of the Italian and German traditions.
initiate: You take on a knightly stance.
%s takes on a knightly stance.

static_buffs.name: Swordsman's Stance
static_buffs.description:
Through chivalry and vigilance, your defense with a blade has increased.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Mastercut
onblock_buffs.description:
You parry and return the attack with greater vigor!

+10% damage, -10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

onhit_buffs.name: Conserve Momentum
onhit_buffs.description:
You maintain the momentum from your last strike to move more quickly.

-20% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Half Swording
onpause_buffs.description:
You grip the blade partway down for greater control.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -1 accuracy.
Enables "Grab" and "Lethal Strike" techniques.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_muay_thai.name: Muay Thai
style_muay_thai.description: Also referred to as the "Art of 8 Limbs," Muay Thai is a popular fighting technique from Thailand that uses powerful strikes.  Your Strength decreases blocked damage.  Blocking attacks or getting hit will increase your damage and blocked damage further.
initiate: You perform a short wai khru in honor of your teachers.
%s performs a short war-dance.

static_buffs.name: Muay Thai Stance
static_buffs.description:
Strength is everything in Muay Thai and you know how to make the most of yours.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

ongethit_buffs.name: Determination
ongethit_buffs.description:
Taking a hit will not slow you down.  You will outlast your opponent and win this fight.

Bash damage increased by 25% of Strength, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
Lasts 5 turns.

style_ninjutsu.name: Ninjutsu
style_ninjutsu.description: Ninjutsu is a martial art and set of tactics used by ninja in feudal Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise, silent strikes.  Ninjutsu is almost entirely silent and you have a higher chance to critically hit on your first attack.  It also provides small combat bonuses every time you move.
initiate: You perform a kuji-in mantra with your hands.  Rin, Kai, Jin!
%s performs a series of intricate hand signs.

static_buffs.name: Ninjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training allows you to make no noise when attacking and less noise when moving around.

Melee and unarmed attacks generate 0 noise, moving generates 1/2 as much noise.

static_buffs.name: Sneak Attack
static_buffs.description:
To a true shinobi, the first strike and the last strike are one and the same.

+25% critical hit chance.

onattack_buffs.name: Loss of Surprise
onattack_buffs.description:
Your intentions are known!  It will take you a few moments to sneak attack again.

Disables "Sneak Attack" buff and "Assassinate" and "Ninjutsu Takedown" techniques.  Enables "Swift Strike (crit)" technique.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

onmove_buffs.name: Momentum Shift
onmove_buffs.description:
Ninja are trained to be extremely agile and mobile.

+1.0 Dodging skill, accuracy increased by 20% of Dexterity.
Lasts 1 turn.

onkill_buffs.name: Escape Plan
onkill_buffs.description:
Your target has perished.  It is time to leave and plan your next attack.

+2 dodge attempts, +10 movement speed.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

style_niten.name: Niten Ichi-Ryu
style_niten.description: Niten Ichi-Ryu is an ancient school of combat, transmitting a style of classical Japanese swordsmanship conceived by the warrior Miyamoto Musashi.  Perception increases damage and reduces blocked damage.  Moving and attacking reduces dodging and damage until you pause.  Pausing for a moment increases Dodging skill.
initiate: You clear your mind as you prepare yourself for combat.
%s relaxes and prepares for combat.

static_buffs.name: Niten Ichi-Ryu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Cautious watchful eyes,
measure and display your skill.
Practice makes perfect.

Armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Perception.

onmove_buffs.name: Waning Moon
onmove_buffs.description:
Blackened like darkness,
nightmares approach from all sides.
Flee at any cost!

-5.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.

onattack_buffs.name: Falling Leaf
onattack_buffs.description:
A sharp sword cuts true.
Although, all things fade with time.
Restraint hones your skills.

-1.0 Dodging skill, -5% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 5 times.

ondodge_buffs.name: Moonlight
ondodge_buffs.description:
Luck be the light,
on a dark and cloudy night,
as the moon shines down.

Enables "In-One Timing" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.

onpause_buffs.name: Stillness
onpause_buffs.description:
The eye of the storm,
a fleeting moment of peace,
gone without a trace.

+2 accuracy, Dodging skill increased by 50% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.

style_pankration.name: Pankration
style_pankration.description: An ancient Greek martial art once used by the Spartans.  It combines boxing and wrestling techniques to create a brutal sport, though the modern revival of the art is more restrained and rules-based.
initiate: You crouch slightly and prepare to rush forward.
%s crouches slightly, ready to rush forward.

ondodge_buffs.name: Counter Chance
ondodge_buffs.description:
The enemy has presented an opening in their defense.

+10% damage.
Enables "Close Combat" buff.
Lasts 1 turn.

onhit_buffs.name: Close Combat
onhit_buffs.description:
You have your opponent right where you want them!

+20% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_silat.name: Silat
style_silat.description: Pencak Silat, of Indonesian origin, is a fighting style that covers the use of short blades and bludgeons.  Fighters stay low and mobile to avoid attacks, then unleash deadly critical hits.
initiate: You give a salute of respect as you prepare for combat.
%s gives a combat salute.

static_buffs.name: Silat Stance
static_buffs.description:
You try to stay as loose as possible when fighting to have more chances to dodge.

+1 dodge attempt.

ondodge_buffs.name: Silat Appraisal
ondodge_buffs.description:
Each time you dodge an attack, you learn a bit more about your opponent's fighting style.  This allows you to make more precise attacks against them.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Dexterity.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Silat Ambush
onmove_buffs.description:
You stay low as you move, making it harder for enemies to defend against you.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_snake.name: Snake Kung Fu
style_snake.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Snake focuses on sinuous movement and precision strikes.  Perception determines your accuracy and damage, rather than Dexterity and Strength.  Standing still increases the accuracy and critical hit chance of your next few attacks.
initiate: You adopt a fluid stance, ready to strike like a snake.
%s assumes a snake-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Snake's Sight
static_buffs.description:
You are patient and know where to hit your opponent for best results.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Perception but decreased by 25% of Dexterity, bash damage increased by 75% of Perception but decreased by 75% of Strength.

onhit_buffs.name: Snake Bite
onhit_buffs.description:
Each snake bite is more painful than the last.

Armor penetration increased by 25% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 4 times.

oncrit_buffs.name: Snake Fang
oncrit_buffs.description:
You hit a weakpoint!  Your next attack will be extra painful.

Armor penetration increased by 100% of Perception.
Lasts 1 turn.

onpause_buffs.name: Snake's Coil
onpause_buffs.description:
Every snake waits for the perfect moment to strike.  Aim as your opponents approach and attack their weak spots without mercy!

+1 accuracy, +1 blocking effectiveness, +5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 4 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

style_sojutsu.name: Sōjutsu
style_sojutsu.description: Sōjutsu, "The Way of the Spear", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a spear.  Sōjutsu focuses on keeping opponents at a distance in order to maintain the advantage in combat.  Standing still gives you an extra block attempt but moving will briefly increase your damage.
initiate: You prepare to defend against all that approach you.
%s assumes a wide, defensive stance.

static_buffs.name: Sōjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training grants better defense while using a polearm.

+1 block attempt, +2 blocking effectiveness.

onmove_buffs.name: Superior Positioning
onmove_buffs.description:
You have given up your defenses for a moment to increase the damage of your attacks.

+10% damage, -1 block attempt.
Lasts 1 turn.

style_taekwondo.name: Taekwondo
style_taekwondo.description: Taekwondo is the national sport of Korea, and was used by the South Korean army in the 20th century.  Focused on kicks, it does not benefit from wielded weapons.  It also includes strength training; your blocks absorb extra damage and your attacks do more damage if you are not holding anything.
initiate: You adopt a narrow fighting stance.
%s adopts a narrow fighting stance.

static_buffs.name: Taekwondo Stance
static_buffs.description:
Using your legs to attack keeps your hands free for better defense.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

static_buffs.name: Unhindered
static_buffs.description:
Your attacks are stronger if you are not holding anything in your hands.

+33% damage when not using a weapon.

style_tai_chi.name: Tai Chi Chuan
style_tai_chi.description: Though Tai Chi is often seen as a form of mental and physical exercise, it is a legitimate martial art, focused on self-defense.  Its ability to absorb the force of an attack makes your Perception decrease damage further on a block.  Pausing for a moment enables powerful palm strike techniques.
initiate: You settle into a gentle stance and prepare to defend yourself.
%s settles into a gentle stance.

static_buffs.name: Tai Chi Stance
static_buffs.description:
You are focused on defense and predicting your opponents' attacks.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 100% Perception.

onblock_buffs.name: Repulse the Monkey
onblock_buffs.description:
By perfectly positioning yourself and your opponent, you have become more accurate and can bypass your opponent's defenses.

Accuracy increased by 20% of Perception, armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Cross Hands
onpause_buffs.description:
By taking a moment to prepare yourself, you are able to use your entire body fully for attacking and defending.

+2 blocking effectiveness, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Perception.
Enables "Palm Strike" and "Double Palm Strike" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.

style_tiger.name: Tiger Kung Fu
style_tiger.description: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Tiger focuses on relentless attacks above all else.  Your Strength determines your accuracy, and your attacks do increasing damage as you continue attacking.
initiate: You clench your hands into ferocious, tiger-like claws.
%s assumes a tiger-like stance.

static_buffs.name: Tiger's Strength
static_buffs.description:
You do not need defense.  You do not need a plan.  You need strength.  Strength will break your opponents' defenses and overwhelm them completely.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Strength but decreased by 25% of Dexterity.

onhit_buffs.name: Tiger Fury
onhit_buffs.description:
You attack with an endless barrage of strikes.  The more you hit, the stronger you become.

+1 accuracy, +5% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

style_wingchun.name: Wing Chun
style_wingchun.description: Wing Chun is a Chinese martial art that began by selecting the easiest-to-learn effective techniques from the various Shaolin animal forms.  It has a high stance, with one's weight resting entirely on the rear leg.  Wing Chun focuses on sensitivity to the opponent's direction of force, and flowing around it to create opportunities for attack.
initiate: You take your stance and prepare to receive the gift of violence.
%s patiently assumes a curiously pigeon-toed stance.

static_buffs.name: Chi-Sao Sensitivity
static_buffs.description:
You have a greater understanding of balance and technique.  This gives you a better chance to avoid your opponent's attacks.

Dodging skill increased by 25% of Perception, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Perception.

onhit_buffs.name: Chain Punch
onhit_buffs.description:
Your punches are properly timed to give your opponent no rest from your strikes.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onpause_buffs.name: Biu Ji
onpause_buffs.description:
Through the perfect application of the Thrusting Fingers form, you can strike your opponents' weak points, force them away, and follow!

Accuracy increased by 20% of Perception
Enables "Straight Punch (Knockback)" and "L-Hook (Knockback)" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.

style_zui_quan.name: Zui Quan
style_zui_quan.description: AKA "drunken boxing," Zui Quan imitates the movement of a drunk to confuse the enemy.  You gain a passive Dodging skill bonus based on Intelligence and dodge attempts.  Dodging increases your damage and accuracy based on Intelligence for a short time.  Moving gives you an additional dodging bonus.
initiate: You begin to sway to and fro with a confident swagger.
%s stumbles as if pretending to be drunk.

static_buffs.name: Zui Quan Stance
static_buffs.description:
Others might think you stumble about at random, but you know better.  Each movement is calculated to evade harm with ease.

+2 dodge attempts, Dodging skill increased by 20% of Intelligence.

onmove_buffs.name: Drunken Stumble
onmove_buffs.description:
With a few quick steps, you can completely change your orientation and dodge attacks easier.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 2 times.

ondodge_buffs.name: Drunken Dodging
ondodge_buffs.description:
Each time you dodge, your positional advantage increases against your opponents.  This makes your attacks hit harder with each successful dodge.

+20% damage, accuracy increase by 20% of Intelligence.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.

style_debug.name: Debug Mastery
style_debug.description: A secret martial art used only by developers and cheaters.
initiate: You get ready pwn some zeds!
%s prepares to cheat at martial arts!

static_buffs.name: Elemental Resistance
static_buffs.description:
You are a walking tank!

Bash armor increased by 100% of Strength, cut armor increased by 100% of Dexterity, electric armor increased by 100% of Intelligence, and fire armor increased by 100% of Perception.

oncrit_buffs.name: Lightning Strike
oncrit_buffs.description:
Lightning strikes twice.

Electric damage equal to 100% of Perception.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

onmiss_buffs.name: Getting Angry
onmiss_buffs.description:
When I get my hands on you…

+2 bash damage.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 5 times.

onkill_buffs.name: On Fire
onkill_buffs.description:
YOU ARE ON FIRE!

+5 fire damage.
Lasts 5 turns.

speech.name: social
speech.description: Your skill in speaking to other people.  Covers ability in boasting, flattery, threats, persuasion, lies, bartering, and other facets of interpersonal communication.  Works best in conjunction with a high level of intelligence.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You probably don't care about talking to other people much.
You know how to communicate.
You're a good communicator.
You know effective communication methods and sales tactics.
You're possibly a psychologist.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You're not used to talking to people.
You rarely offend people by accident.
You can communicate your ideas well.
You can make friends easily and drive a hard bargain.
You could sell ocean water to a hermit crab.

computer.name: computers
computer.description: Your skill in accessing and manipulating computers.  Higher levels can allow a user to navigate complex software systems and even bypass their security.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You barely know the minimum of how to use a computer.
You knew how to surf the web back when that was possible.
You're aware what a "command prompt" is.
You know how to write code in a few scripting languages.
You have an in–depth knowledge of code and how computers function.
You have probably read the entire SICP.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You can navigate to the "phone" app on your smartphone and likely "hunt and peck" to type.
You can probably touch-type.
You can debug a mod conflict for a video game.
You can make your own mods for a video game.
You can code your own video game.
You could get paid to bounty-hunt vulnerabilities in government databases, if any government was still around.

firstaid.name: health care
firstaid.description: Your skill in effecting medical treatment.  Higher levels allow better use of medicines and items like bandages and first aid kits, and reduce the failure and complication rates of medical procedures.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You barely have any idea how your own body works.
You're at least aware the blood should stay inside you.
You have a decent idea of first aid.
You're well-trained in first aid.
You know a lot about how the body works and how to deal with many injuries.
You may know how to do simple surgeries.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You might be able to put a Band-Aid on a minor cut without passing out.
You can do basic first-aid techniques without panicking too much.
You're used to using a first-aid kit.
Dealing with injuries is becoming routine for you.
You could probably work in the ER.
You almost certainly can perform a simple surgery.

mechanics.name: mechanics
mechanics.description: Your skill in engineering, maintaining and repairing vehicles and other mechanical systems.  This skill covers the craft of items with complex parts, and plays a role in the installation of bionic equipment.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know that cars are supposed to be able to go forward.
You know how to check your oil.
You know the basic ideas of how a car works.
You know how to fix most issues a car could have.
You know how to build a car from scratch.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You can change a wheel.  Potentially.
You can do the basics of car maintenance.
You can fix most common issues your car could have.
You can install an engine.
You're a skilled enough mechanic you can install a second engine.

traps.name: devices
traps.description: Your skill in manipulating fine devices like security systems, traps, locks and other precision tasks.  This skill does not affect the evasion of traps that are triggered.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know keys go in locks and traps go off if you step on them.
You know how to set basic traps.
You know how to set most traps and how most locks function.
You're a knowledgeable trapper and locksmith.
You have an intricate understanding of traps and locks.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You shouldn't try disarming anything, you'll only hurt yourself.
You might be able to pick the simplest locks and can disarm basic traps.
You can easily disarm most traps and pick some locks.
Lockpicking shouldn't be a problem for you.
You can disarm a landmine.  It's still extremely unsafe.  But you can.  Probably.

driving.name: vehicles
driving.description: Your skill in operating and steering a vehicle in motion, from cars and boats to helicopters and hot air balloons.  A higher level allows greater control over vehicles at higher speeds, and reduces the penalty of shooting while driving.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know what a car looks like.
You know the basics of driving a car.
You know how to drive a car.
You probably know how to drive larger vehicles like a truck or bus.
You know how to drive even in difficult conditions.
You know tricks even racecar drivers use.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You don't even have a driver's license.
You were good enough to get a driver's license.
You've driven a car enough for it to become routine.
You're better than most drivers on the road.  Well, not that any are left.
You can keep control of most vehicles even in awkward conditions.
You could compete on a race track.

swimming.name: athletics
swimming.description: Your athletic ability, including swimming endurance and ability to swim with weight.  Athletic skill also improves your overall cardio fitness and stamina.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You don't even let people tell you that you should be more active.
You're at least aware exercise is good and that you should do it more.
You know how to exercise.
You know proper form and stretches.
You could be a personal trainer.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You're a couch potato.
You might be able to doggy paddle.
You're reasonably active and a decent swimmer.
You're active and a good swimmer.
You're very active and a great swimmer.
You could swim across the English Channel.

fabrication.name: fabrication
fabrication.description: Your skill in working with raw materials and shaping them into useful objects.  This skill plays an important role in the crafting of many objects.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You barely know which side of the hammer you should hold.
You know how to hold a hammer.
You're a decent DIYer and know how to craft a variety of wooden items or very basic metalworking.
You're a fairly skilled DIYer and know how to craft a variety of metal items.
You're an exceptionally skilled DIYer and know how to smith basic tools and weapons.
You know the ins and outs of making almost anything you can think of.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You can only craft the most basic things.
You can craft a few basic things.
You can craft a variety of useful stuff without much issue.
You can easily craft useful, if junky, weapons and armor, but nothing too complex.
You can craft even complex objects without fail.
You have created many things with your hands and you should have little issue crafting anything.

cooking.name: food handling
cooking.description: Your skill in combining food ingredients to make other, tastier food items.  Also includes food preservation and safety, brewing, butchery, and more.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You probably lived on takeout.
You know the basics of how not to burn your house down.
You know how to cook reasonably.
You know how to cook a wide variety of food.
You know how to cook the most advanced and complex dishes.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You'd burn a PB&J, somehow.
You can boil an egg.
You can cook a variety of recipes.
You can cook most recipes with ease.
You'd win a neighborhood bake-off.
You'd be an excellent chef, too bad all the zombies want to eat is you.

tailor.name: tailoring
tailor.description: Your skill in the craft and repair of clothing, bags, blankets and other textiles.  Affects knitting, sewing, stitching, weaving, and nearly anything else involving a needle and thread.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know nothing about tailoring.
You know the very basics of how to sew a patch over a small hole.
You know how to sew.
You know how to sew well.
You know how to sew with non-standard materials.
You're a very knowledgeable tailor.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You can put a shirt on without ripping it, at least.
You've held a sewing needle once or twice.
You can repair or sew simple clothing.
You can repair or sew more complex clothing.
You're skilled at working with non-standard materials like Kevlar.
You can sew anything you could dream of.

survival.name: survival
survival.description: Your skill in surviving the wilderness, and in crafting various basic survival items.  This also covers your ability to skin and butcher animals for meat and hides.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You're aware the outdoors is gross.
You know the very basics of camping.
You know how to craft a fire drill to start fires without lighters.
You probably memorized most of the Scouting handbook.
You're exceptionally knowledgeable in all things outdoorsy.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You need to touch grass.
You've touched grass.
You might've been a cub scout as a kid.
You're a skilled scout and can pitch a tent with ease.
You could likely be dropped into a forest with nothing and thrive.

electronics.name: electronics
electronics.description: Your skill in dealing with electrical systems, used in the craft and repair of objects with electrical components.  This skill is an important part of installing and managing bionic implants.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You don't know the first thing about how electricity works.  It might as well be magic to you.
You have a very rudimentary knowledge on how electricity works.
You have some idea of how electricity works.
You have a good understanding of how electricity works and were possibly an electrician.
You have an intricate understanding of electronics and how they function.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You can turn a light switch on or off.
You can craft extremely basic electronics like flashlights.
You can craft some electrical gadgets and set up an at-home power grid without major fire hazards.
You can craft a variety of useful electronics.
You can craft any electrical device you can think of.

archery.name: archery
archery.description: Your skill in using bow weapons, from hand-carved self bows to complex compound bows.  Quiet and effective, they require strength of body and sight to wield, and are not terribly accurate over a long distance.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know what a bow looks like.
You know how to nock an arrow.
You know the basics of archery.
You're knowledgeable about archery.
You have a wealth of knowledge about archery.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You're lucky if the arrow doesn't spin sideways.
You can usually get the arrow to fly straight-ish.
You can usually hit an archery target.
You're a fairly skilled archer.
You're a skilled archer and might've done well in some competitions.
You'd've been a terror at the Battle of Agincourt.

gun.name: marksmanship
gun.description: Your overall skill in using bows and firearms.  With higher levels, this general experience increases accuracy with any bows or firearms, but is secondary to practice with the type of ranged weapon in question.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You don't even know how to aim a gun.
You know where the iron sights on a gun are.
You know the basics of aiming.
You know how to aim most ranged weapons fairly well.
You know how to aim even at long distances taking into account bullet drop and wind speed.

level_descriptions_practice.description: Your hands shake, your aim is shit, and you close your eyes before each shot.  You could aim at the ground and somehow miss.
Holding a gun steady is difficult for you.
You've been to the range a few times and can usually hit the target.
Your aim is pretty good even at medium ranges.
You have good aim even at fairly long ranges.
You're a veritable sniper.

launcher.name: launchers
launcher.description: Your skill in using heavy weapons like rocket, grenade or missile launchers.  These weapons have a variety of applications and may carry immense destructive power, but they are cumbersome and hard to manage.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know nothing about launchers, cannons, or anything similar.
You've at least read about cannons or flamethrowers.
You probably built a spud launcher at some point.
You're skilled with various types of launchers.
You're a rare expert in knowledge about various types of launchers.

level_descriptions_practice.description: Rather understandably, you have never fired any kind of launcher before.
You may have fired a spud cannon at some point.
You have experience firing launchers or flamethrowers, somehow.
Your growing level of experience with rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or cannons is worrying.
You just want to watch the world burn, and you're really damn good at making sure it will.

pistol.name: handguns
pistol.description: Handguns have poor accuracy compared to rifles, but are usually quick to fire and reload faster than other guns.  They are very effective at close quarters, though unsuited for long range engagement.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You can't tell a revolver from a semiautomatic.
You can tell a revolver from a semiautomatic.
You know the basics of handguns and their usage.
You're knowledgeable about handguns and their uses.
You know every trick and technique for firing handguns accurately and effectively.

level_descriptions_practice.description: Hopefully it won't fly out of your hands when you fire one.
Handguns feel awkward to use for you.
You're comfortable with the usage of handguns.
You're quite skilled and accurate with handguns.
You could win a duel at high noon.
You're a deadeye with pistols and can likely hit someone at 20 yards from the hip with ease.

rifle.name: rifles
rifle.description: Classic rifles have terrific range and accuracy compared to other firearms, but may be slow to fire and reload, and can prove difficult to use in close combat.  Short-barreled rifles and carbines are more like SMGs and perform well in close combat.

level_descriptions_theory.description: Rifles are complicated weaponry and you don't know anything about them.
You at least have rudimentary knowledge of rifles.
You can maintain your average standard-issue rifle.
You have an intricate knowledge of all the parts of a rifle and their use.
You can probably disassemble and reassemble your rifle in the dark with your hands tied together.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You've never fired a rifle before.
You can at least shoulder a rifle.
You're at least as competent as the average soldier straight out of boot camp.
Rifles feel familiar in your hands.
You're a genuinely good shot.
You could be a career sniper.

shotgun.name: shotguns
shotgun.description: Shotguns are easy to shoot and can inflict massive damage, but their effectiveness and accuracy decline rapidly with range.  Slugs can be loaded into shotguns to provide greater range, though they are somewhat inaccurate.

level_descriptions_theory.description: "Shot-guns?"  But all guns are shot?
You know what a shotgun is.
You know enough about shotguns to get mad about unrealistic pellet spread in video games.
You're knowledgeable about the handling and maintenance of shotguns.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You couldn't hit the broad side of a barn.
You can usually hit a clay pigeon if it's just sitting there.
You probably have experience skeet shooting.
You're a very skilled skeet shooter.
You could snipe with most shotguns if you weren't limited by the spread.

smg.name: submachine guns
smg.description: Comprised of an automatic rifle carbine designed to fire a pistol cartridge, submachine guns can reload and fire quickly, sometimes in bursts, but they are relatively inaccurate and may be prone to mechanical failures.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You don't know the first thing about submachine guns.
You know very little about SMGs.
You know a decent bit about firing SMGs accurately.
You're knowledgeable about the tactics used with SMGs.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You've never held an SMG before.
You have minimal experience with SMGs.
You have some experience with SMGs.
You're fairly experienced with SMGs.
You're very experienced with SMGs.
You're a CQB expert with SMGs.

throw.name: throwing
throw.description: Your skill in throwing objects over a distance.  Skill increases accuracy, and at higher levels, the range of a throw.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You've managed to avoid gym class your whole life and barely know how to throw a rock.  Impressive.
You know how to throw things.  Which is good, since that's an inherent skill of being human.
You know how to throw stuff with reasonable accuracy.
You know proper form and methods for throwing accurately.
You could teach sports.  The ones that involve throwing stuff anyway.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You're lucky if you don't drop the thing you're throwing at your feet.  Be extra careful with grenades.
You can usually throw a rock at a person if they're not too far away, or moving.
You can accurately throw a dodgeball at someone.
You can pitch a baseball across home plate into the strike zone reliably.
You've got a good fastball.
You could've become a professional pitcher.  At least beaning zombies doesn't give them a free walk to first base.

melee.name: melee
melee.description: Your skill and finesse in personal combat, both with and without a weapon.  Higher levels can significantly increase the accuracy and effectiveness of your physical attacks.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You have no idea how to do anything other than vaguely swing in their direction.
You can theoretically fight.
You've learned enough to avoid overswinging and falling off balance if you miss.
Whether self-taught or trained, you've learned quite a lot about fighting.
You could teach a platoon of medieval soldiers how to fight in a war.

level_descriptions_practice.description: Any fighting you do is mostly just panicked flailing.
Your panicked flailing has become somewhat more determined flailing.
Your fighting now actually resembles proper form and is far less clumsy.
You're a proper fighter and can use most techniques.
You're a skilled man-at-arms that wouldn't look out of place fighting on a medieval battlefield.
In a world with guns you've dedicated yourself to mastering melee combat, and you're damn good at it too.

bashing.name: bashing weapons
bashing.description: Your skill in fighting with blunt weaponry, from rocks and sticks to baseball bats and the butts of rifles.  Skill increases damage, and higher levels will improve the accuracy of an attack.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You don't even know how to swing a baseball bat properly.
You at least know how to swing a baseball bat.
You have a decent idea how to maneuver blunt weapons without falling off balance.
You've learned how to leverage blunt weapons best to get powerful, accurate hits.
You could teach a class on fighting with maces and hammers.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You've somehow gone through life without even swinging a stick for fun.  How awful.
You can swing a baseball bat.
You can reliably hit a pitch while at bat.
You're a decently skilled batter and good at using all sorts of bludgeons, improvised or otherwise.
You can hit zombies over the head even with random junk and still make it look good.
You can swing a heavy, poorly-weighted sledgehammer with pinpoint accuracy even against a moving target.

cutting.name: cutting weapons
cutting.description: Your skill in fighting with weaponry designed to cut, hack and slash an opponent.  Lower levels of skill increase accuracy and damage, while higher levels will help to bypass heavy armor and thick hides.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You don't even know how to play-swordfight.
You at least know which part of the sword you're supposed to hold.
You've learned how to cut properly with draw cuts and similar techniques.
You've learned how to fight with swords effectively.
You've studied the blade.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You'd probably hit with the flat of the blade more than the edge.
You can usually get a decent cut when chopping.
You can reliably keep good edge alignment when slicing.
You're a fairly skilled swordsman.
With your skill, in another life you could duel a samurai.

dodge.name: dodging
dodge.description: Your ability to dodge an oncoming threat, be it an enemy's attack, a triggered trap, or a falling rock.  This skill is also used in attempts to fall gracefully, and for other acrobatic feats.  The first number shown includes modifiers, and the second does not.

level_descriptions_theory.description: For most people, jumping out of the way of danger is instinct, and you barely have that.
You might know how to dodge.
You've learned how to minimize your movement with dodging to avoid overexerting yourself.
You have a good grasp on various dodging techniques and ways to avoid being grabbed.
You know how to do a dodge, duck, dip, dive, and how to win every game of dodgeball.

stabbing.name: piercing weapons

level_descriptions_theory.description: You might not even be aware you're supposed to stab with a spear.
You understand the gist of thrusting weapons.
You know some of the techniques involved with thrusting weapons.
You're well-learned in fencing or spearmanship.
You could open a fencing school or start your own spear lessons.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You have a hard time spearing steak with a fork.

You're a decent fencer or spearman.
You're a skilled fencer or spearman.
You're a commando with a knife, a fencing expert, and an accomplished spearman.

unarmed.name: unarmed combat
unarmed.description: Your skill in hand-to-hand fighting.  For the unskilled, it's a good way to get hurt, but those with enough practice can perform special blows and techniques to quickly dispatch enemies.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You've never had any interest in learning to fight.
You can theoretically throw a punch.
You know how to throw down.
You really know how to throw down.
You could probably teach your own martial art.

level_descriptions_practice.description: Punching someone is more likely to hurt you than them.
You can throw a punch.  Not well, but you can throw one.
You're enough of a scrapper to fight with your fists if you have to.
You could win most bar fights.
You'd have your black belt if any dojos were still open.
You could have multiple black belts or box in the major leagues.

chemistry.name: applied science
chemistry.description: Your skill in general 'bench science', applying any of a wide range of precision techniques based on your overall understanding of scientific principles.  This is not a research skill, but about using the results of others' research.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You're not even theoretically a physicist.
You have the basic understanding of science on par with a high schooler.
You have a decent understanding of science on par with a college graduate.
You have a deep understanding of the scientific method and possibly have a degree in a scientific field.
You likely have a PhD in a scientific field.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You skipped all your science classes.
You've at least done high school chemistry classes.
You've worked with a few chemicals and can follow simple procedures.
You can follow some more complicated procedures and likely took advanced chemistry courses.
You can do some advanced chemistry, or just make drugs.

ap_workbench_with_recharger.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things, when unfolded.  It also has a built-in battery charger for your phone.

ap_oven.description: A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It's plugged in and ready to go.

ap_water_purifier.name: stationary water purifier
ap_water_purifier.description: This device effectively sterilizes water.  Activate it to clean all water in a connected tank, at the cost of some electricity.

ap_arcade_machine.description: A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Ready to be played.

ap_arc_furnace.name: arc furnace
ap_arc_furnace.description: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_stereo.description: A stereo system.  When turned on, it plays music, improving your mood.

ap_kiln.description: An electric kiln for baking brick or clay.  When plugged in and powered you could use this to harden bricks or clay.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a kiln, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
ap_kiln.name: vehicle electric kiln

ap_drill_press.name: drill press
ap_drill_press.description: A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects, from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_power_hammer.name: power hammer
ap_power_hammer.description: A self-contained pneumatic power hammer using compressed air from an integrated compressor to strike repeatedly with great force.  Used for efficiently shaping and working metal.  Plugged in and ready to smash!

f_steel_kiln.name: tempering kiln
f_steel_kiln.description: A very long electric kiln made for heat treating metal.  Unlike a forge, it can't get extremely hot, but its temperature is completely programmable.

ap_tablesaw.name: table saw
ap_tablesaw.description: A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table.  Used for making straight, measured cuts, it's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_mitresaw.name: mitre saw
ap_mitresaw.description: A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_bandsaw.name: band saw
ap_bandsaw.description: A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_router.name: router table
ap_router.description: This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_planer.name: planer
ap_planer.description: A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_jointer.name: jointer
ap_jointer.description: A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it nice and smooth.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_hydraulic_press.description: If you really want to squash something a lot, this is exactly the right industrial tool for you.  Plugged in and ready to go.

ap_ammonia_machine_reactor.description: A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  It has a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

ap_ammonia_machine_pipework.name: makeshift ammonia machine pipework
ap_ammonia_machine_pipework.description: A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via the Haber-Bosch process, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

ap_nitrogen_generator.name: makeshift nitrogen generator
ap_nitrogen_generator.description: A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.

Move a single tile wide vehicle so that all of that vehicle's tiles are next to bike racks, and then 'e'xamine any bike rack to mount that vehicle onto the bike rack.  'e'xamine the bike rack to unmount the carried vehicle.

mounted_spare_tire.description: Spare tire stored on an external carrier rig.

nose_plate.name: nose plate
nose_plate.description: An L-shaped aluminum plate with straps and skid runners.  This could help you move furniture or appliances more safely, but Jevons' Paradox also applies to throwing your back out.

diesel_engine_i6.description: An industrial-sized 6-cylinder diesel engine, commonly called a straight-six.  About as powerful as a V6 engine but significantly larger for use in heavy equipment.

diesel_engine_inline4.description: A four-cylinder diesel engine, commonly found in small passenger cars and light trucks.
