diesel_engine_v6.description: A powerful 6-cylinder diesel engine, typical of a bus, RV, large van, or armored personnel carrier.

diesel_engine_v8.description: A large 8-cylinder diesel engine, powerful enough for a semi truck, armored car, or Humvee.

engine_1cyl.description: A 50 cc gasoline engine, suitable for a lawnmower, golf cart or moped.

engine_1cyl_large.description: A high-compression, 200 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine, suitable for a dirt bike or scooter.

engine_1cyl_med.description: A high-compression, 150 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine, suitable for a dirt bike, scooter or generator.

engine_1cyl_diesel_large.description: A high-compression, 200 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke diesel combustion engine, suitable for a dirt bike, scooter, or generator.

engine_1cyl_small.description: A small 25 cc gasoline engine, suitable for a hedge trimmer or installing on a bicycle.

engine_aero_light.description: An air-cooled, 4-cylinder, horizontally opposed internal combustion engine, rated for 150 horsepower.  Commonly used on light aircraft.

engine_inline4.description: A 1600 cc four-cylinder gasoline engine, commonly found in small passenger cars.

engine_v12.description: A massive and extremely powerful 12-cylinder combustion engine, usually built into high-end sports cars.

diesel_engine_v12.description: A massive and extremely powerful 12-cylinder diesel engine, usually built into heavy trucks.

engine_v6.description: A powerful 6-cylinder gasoline engine strong enough for a pickup truck, SUV, or full-size van.

engine_v8.description: A heavy-duty 8-cylinder gasoline engine, like you might find in a fire truck, ambulance, or tow truck.

engine_vtwin.description: A 600 cc, two-cylinder, gas engine for a fast motorcycle or very small car.

engine_steam_makeshift.description: A small, primitive steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

engine_steam_small.description: A small steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

engine_steam_medium.description: A medium-sized steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

engine_turbine_small.description: A small gas turbine engine, suitable for powering a small one or two-seat helicopter.

engine_turbine_medium.description: A large gas turbine engine, usually used for military helicopters.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.

engine_turbine_large.description: A massive gas turbine engine, used to power the V-22 Osprey.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.

xedra_genset.description: A spartan, prototype engine-generator made to burn all fuels.

crane_medium.name: boom crane
crane_medium.description: A rigid steel boom crane.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.

crane_medium_internal.name: internal boom crane
crane_medium_internal.description: A rigid steel boom crane.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.

crane_small.name: telescopic crane
crane_small.description: An extendable cantilever crane.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.

crane_tiny.description: A small pallet lifter.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.

forklift_fork.name: forklift arms
forklift_fork.description: A pair of forklift arms.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.

rockwheel.description: A large metal disc, powered by the vehicle's engines.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it will stop the vehicle unless it has a strong engine.  When turned on, it will dig a shallow pit in dirt.  Mount it on the edge of your vehicle.

air_jack.description: An extendable metal pylon used to replace a portable jack.  If mounted to a vehicle, it could be used to lift it up.

motorcycle_kickstand.description: A kickstand to keep a bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean a small vehicle forward or backward to change a tire.

solar_reflector.name: solar reflector
solar_reflector.description: A faceted reflector dish that concentrates sunlight for cooking.  Only works outdoors in strong direct sunlight.

folding_frame.description: A light metal framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.

folding_wooden_frame.description: A light wooden framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.

frame.description: A metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

frame_wood.description: A wooden framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and nail construction means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools.

frame_wood_deck.description: A small skateboard frame made of thin layers of wood glued together.  Other skateboard components can be mounted on it.

frame_wood_light.description: A small frame made of a few pieces of wood, held together by rope.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and rope constructions means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools or nails.

hdframe.description: A large, reinforced steel frame, used in military vehicle construction.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Increased mass makes it more resistant to damage in collisions.

xlframe.description: A small, lightweight frame made from pipework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

foldxlframe.description: A small, lightweight frame made from pipework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.
foldxlframe.name: foldable extra-light frame

frame_concrete_mix.description: A metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

light_blue.description: A blue light from the top of an emergency services vehicle.

light_red.description: A red light from the top of an emergency services vehicle.

foot_pedals.description: A set of bicycle-style foot pedals attached to a crank.  If mounted on the same tile as a seat, they allow you to use your stamina to produce engine power, using your legs.  Provides more power the stronger you are.

hand_rims.name: hand rims
hand_rims.description: A set of wheelchair-style hoop hand rims, often attached directly to the wheels.  If mounted on the same tile as seat, they allow you to use your stamina to produce engine power, using your arms.  Provides more power the stronger you are.

reins_tackle.description: A set of leather bindings to control a mountable creature.

wing_mirror.name: wing mirror
wing_mirror.description: A small mirror, mounted outside the vehicle.  If you see the mirror, your vision is expanded as though you were standing where the mirror is.

inboard_mirror.name: inboard mirror
inboard_mirror.description: A small mirror, mounted inside the vehicle.  If you see the mirror, your vision is expanded as though you were standing where the mirror is.

veh_tools_kitchen.description: A table rig with a faucet for water tank access, fume hood, drawers and fixtures for storing tools, low power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.

veh_tools_workshop.description: A table rig with drawers and fixtures for storing tools, wiring for high power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.

engine_electric_tiny.description: A tiny electric motor just the right size for providing a gentle boost for a bicycle, or similarly light vehicles.

engine_electric_small.description: A light-duty electrical motor, strong enough for an electric mopeds, golf carts, and electric mopeds posing as electric bicycles.

engine_electric.description: A medium-duty electrical motor, suitable for powering ultra-light vehicles, or as part of a hybrid gas-electric drivetrain.

engine_electric_large.description: A heavy-duty electrical motor, capable of propelling a full-size car or SUV through electric power alone, provided you have the battery capacity.

engine_electric_enhanced.description: A powerful high-performance electric motor, as found in those consumer electric sports cars with ridiculous, ludicrous, or similarly hyperbolic acceleration options.  It needs a lot of battery power.

engine_electric_super.description: A massive and extremely powerful electric motor, delivering high torque at the cost of significant power drain, this would be well suited to an electric racing car.

engine_electric_train.description: A 1,300 horsepower 3-phase 60 Hz electric engine.  Normally used in trains.

Upon doing so, the circular blades of this device will rotate rapidly; anything in front of it is likely to be ripped to shreds.  It is sturdy enough to withstand multiple impacts, and is designed to detach if it would take a hit that would break it.

blade.description: A blade, welded to the vehicle, for cutting up zombies.

spike.description: A metal spike, welded to the vehicle, to increase injury when crashing into things.

spike_wood.description: A wooden spike, attached to the vehicle, to increase injury when crashing into things.

veh_forge.name: vehicle electric forge

veh_kiln.description: A electric kiln for baking brick or clay, powered by the vehicle's batteries.  You could use this to harden bricks or clay.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a kiln, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
veh_kiln.name: vehicle electric kiln

drum_concrete_mix.description: A plastic 100-liter drum of a portable concrete mixer.

veh_mobile_weather_station.description: A mobile weather station.  Its instruments are deployed on its tall telescoping stand.

veh_robofac_mobile_weather_station.name: mobile HEW-NRE station
veh_robofac_mobile_weather_station.description: A mobile hazardous environment weather station.  Its instruments are deployed on its tall telescoping stand.

yoke_harness.description: A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.

yoke_harness_heavyduty.description: A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.

cart_handle.name: cart handle
cart_handle.description: A metal handle, a creature with hands could use it to push a vehicle.

frame_handle.name: handle
frame_handle.description: A pair of handles.  You can mount other items on top of it.

frame_wood_handle.name: wooden handle
frame_wood_handle.description: A pair of handles.  You can mount other items on top of it.

frame_wood_light_handle.name: light wooden handle
frame_wood_light_handle.description: A pair of handles.  You can mount other items on top of it.

trunk_floor.name: floor trunk
trunk_floor.description: An aisle.  A hatch lets you access a cargo space beneath it, keeping items stored here out of the way.

programmable_autopilot.description: A computer system hooked up to the steering and engine of a vehicle to allow it to follow simple paths.

storage_battery_mount.description: A battery case for storage batteries.  It has a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.  Allows quick removal or addition of a storage battery to a vehicle's power grid, if you can lift the battery.

handheld_battery_mount.description: A mount for batteries usually used in handheld tools.  It has a power converter, a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.  Allows quick removal or addition of such batteries to a vehicle's power grid.

black_box.description: An armored black box, a device meant to record and preserve data of a military vehicle in the field in case it gets destroyed.

minifridge.name: minifridge
minifridge.description: A small fridge.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.

big_portable_fridge.name: food truck fridge
big_portable_fridge.description: A heavy, portable fridge.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.

minifreezer.name: minifreezer
minifreezer.description: A small freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.

chest_minifreezer.name: chest minifreezer
chest_minifreezer.description: A small chest freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.

big_portable_freezer.name: food truck freezer
big_portable_freezer.description: A heavy, portable freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.

washing_machine.description: A small washing machine.  With detergent, water, and some electrical power, you could clean a lot of clothes.  'e'xamine the tile with the washing machine to use it.

dishwasher.description: A small dishwasher.  With detergent, water, and some electrical power, you could clean your dishes… or something more useful like a CBM dripping with zombie gore.  'e'xamine the tile with the dishwasher to use it.

autoclave.description: This is an autoclave.  It's useful for sterilizing things like CBMs.  'e'xamine the tile with the autoclave to use it.

veh_table.description: A very fancy table for those with fancy lives.  If times were better, it might be useful for something other than firewood.

workbench.name: workbench
workbench.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.

workbench_with_recharger.name: workbench with battery recharger
workbench_with_recharger.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things, when unfolded.  It also has a built-in battery charger for your phone.

controls.description: A steering wheel, accelerator, and brake pedals.

hand_controls.description: A pair of adjustable rods with a simple trigger.  They easily can be easily installed on top of vehicle controls and will allow a car or similar vehicle to be driven by those who can't use their legs to do so, whether due to disability or small stature.  These are designed for automobiles and will not work on bicycle style foot pedals.

pedal_extenders.description: These thick rubber pads can clamp securely onto a vehicle's gas and brake pedals, allowing even very short people to drive a car.

pedal_extenders_makeshift.description: Blocks of wood, taped to the pedals to allow vehicle controls to be used even by people who are very short.

dashboard.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.

mountable_heater.description: Set of tubes, that move heat from the engine into the vehicle cabin, heating it up.

mountable_heater_small.description: Set of tubes, that move heat from the engine into the vehicle cabin, heating it up.

integrated_heater_small.description: Set of tubes, that move heat from the engine into the vehicle cabin, heating it up.
integrated_heater_small.name: small integrated heater

mountable_cooler.description: A vehicle-mounted area cooler.  Install a muffler in another part of the vehicle to direct the exhaust heat to that location.

controls_electronic.description: Some switches and knobs to control the vehicle's electrical systems.

muffler.description: A metal pipe that somewhat reduces engine noise.  Also vents heat from an installed vehicle cooler.

seatbelt.description: A length of synthetic fiber weaved into a flat band, usually used to securely fasten passenger inside vehicles.

vehicle_alarm.name: security system
vehicle_alarm.description: A bunch of electronics that make it difficult to start the vehicle without the proper key, and that will sound an alarm if you try.  The alarm can be disabled.

smart_engine_controller.name: smart engine controller
smart_engine_controller.description: Electronic module that automatically switches combustion and electric engines on and off minimizing fuel consumption and optimizing power output and battery charge rate.  Must be turned on to work.  Simplified ruleset: 1. When throttling, maximize acceleration.  2. Keep battery at 90%.  3. Minimize fuel consumption.

seatbelt_heavyduty.description: A harness made of five belts meant to be mounted on vehicle to fasten a passenger securely to their seat.

reinforced_solar_panel.description: A solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal panel.

solar_panel_v2.description: An electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a high-performance type made with monocrystalline silicon cells.

reinforced_solar_panel_v2.description: An advanced solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal advanced panel.

compact_ASRG_containment.name: advanced Stirling radioisotope generator
compact_ASRG_containment.description: A rather heavy brick of metal housing an ASRG, formerly designed by NASA and repurposed for terrestrial use.  Will provide about 130 W, basically forever as far as you're concerned.  Even though the alpha radiation these run off of isn't very dangerous in case of a breach, this unit appears to be armored to take a beating and is a good deal heavier owing to its composite plating.

water_faucet.description: A water faucet.  You can use it to access the water from vehicle tanks.

towel_hanger.description: A towel hanger with towels.  You can use it to dry yourself.

horn_bicycle.description: A simple bulb horn found on many bicycles.  Honk honk.

horn_car.description: A car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.

horn_big.description: A very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.

beeper.description: An electronic noise maker.  It will automatically make noise when you drive in reverse, alerting things behind you to move out of the way.

livestock_stall.description: A cargo space for carrying livestock.

animal_compartment.description: A large locker for transporting smaller animals.

recharge_station.description: A universal recharging station designed to operate on vehicle power.  While on, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  The system can only be installed onto existing storage compartments, and is controlled from a dashboard or electronics control unit.

battery_charger.description: A small device for recharging batteries, given a source of electricity.  It will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  It can only be installed onto existing vehicle's storage compartments, and is controlled from a dashboard or electronics control unit.

stereo.description: A stereo system.  When turned on, it plays music, improving your mood.

chimes.description: A stereo system with loudspeakers and a built-in set of simple melodies that it will play.  Commonly used by ice cream trucks to draw the attention of children in the days when children wanted ice cream more than brains.  When turned on, it makes noise, attracting neighborhood children.

door_motor.name: door motor
door_motor.description: A small electric motor.  Installed on the same frame as a door or curtain, it will allow you to remotely open the door or curtain from the vehicle controls.

drive_by_wire_controls.description: A sophisticated set of electronic controls that allow you to control the vehicle from a vehicle remote while you are not in it.

cam_control.description: An LCD attached to one or more cameras.  When turned on, it lets you see from the cameras, but drains power from the vehicle's batteries.  You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the controls, or use the vehicle control key (default '^').

omnicam.description: A security camera you could connect to a display.  Image quality is quite low, but the field of vision is great.

omnicamera_reinforced.description: A security camera with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

robot_controls.description: A set of servos, microcontrollers, and other devices, to allow a vehicle to drive itself, or you to drive it remotely using a controller.  Its AI is not functional, but it should still have some sort of maintenance mode.

vehicle_clock.name: makeshift clock
vehicle_clock.description: A clock, so you know what time it is.

leather_funnel.description: A funnel that will collect rainwater into the tank beneath it.

birchbark_funnel.description: A funnel that will collect rainwater into the tank beneath it.

makeshift_funnel.description: A funnel that will collect rainwater into the tank beneath it.

funnel.description: A funnel that will collect rainwater into the tank beneath it.

metal_funnel.description: A funnel that will collect rainwater into the tank beneath it.

vehicle_scoop.description: An assembly of motors and sheet metal that allows a vehicle to clean the road surface by removing debris and contaminants.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it will scoop up loose items that it travels over until it's full.

water_purifier.name: water purifier
water_purifier.description: A water purifier, powered by the vehicle's batteries.  You can use it to purify water in a container or in the vehicle's tanks.  'e'xamine the tile with the purifier to use it.

plow.description: A plow.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it will create a furrow in any dirt it travels over, making it suitable for planting seeds.  It should be placed in front of any seed drills on the vehicle.

seed_drill.description: A seed drill.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  You can load it with seeds by examining it.  When turned on, it will drop seeds as the vehicle moves, or plant them in furrowed dirt.  It should be placed behind any plows on the vehicle, and any wheels should be placed so they won't run over the plants.

seed_drill_advanced.description: A seed drill.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  You can load it with seeds by examining it.  When turned on, it will drop seeds as the vehicle moves, or plant them in furrowed dirt.  It should be placed behind any plows on the vehicle, and any wheels should be placed so they won't run over the plants.

reaper.description: An automatic reaper.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When on, it will cut down plants that it travels over.  It should be placed in front of any plows in the vehicle for efficient operation.  It does not include cargo space, so harvested plants will end up on the ground.

reaper_advanced.description: An automatic reaper.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When on, it will cut down plants and store them in the vehicle's cargo.  It should be placed in front of any plows in the vehicle for efficient operation.  It has internal cargo space for collecting the harvest.

turret_mount.description: A rotating, universal mount for a weapon.  If your hands are empty, you can stand on the same tile as a turret mount and 'f'ire the weapon.

controls_turret.description: A set of motors, cameras, and various electronic modules banded together to allow for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.

plugged_3in_ordnance_rifle.name: plugged 3-inch ordnance rifle
plugged_3in_ordnance_rifle.description: Unfortunately, some responsible killjoy poured concrete in the barrel of this historic cannon to make it safe for display.

wheel_mount_wood.description: A piece of wood with holes suitable for a bike wheel.

wheel_mount_wood_steerable.description: A piece of wood with holes suitable for a bike wheel.
wheel_mount_wood_steerable.name: wooden wheel mount (steerable)

wheel_mount_light.description: A piece of metal with holes suitable for a bike or motorbike wheel.

wheel_mount_light_steerable.description: A piece of metal with holes suitable for a bike or motorbike wheel.
wheel_mount_light_steerable.name: light wheel mount (steerable)

wheel_mount_medium.description: A metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel onto a car.  Fit for a car wheel.

wheel_mount_medium_steerable.description: A metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel onto a car.  Fit for a car wheel.
wheel_mount_medium_steerable.name: medium wheel hub assembly (steerable)

wheel_mount_heavy.description: A heavy metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel onto a car.  Fit for a large car wheel.

wheel_mount_heavy_steerable.description: A heavy metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel onto a car.  Fit for a large car wheel.
wheel_mount_heavy_steerable.name: heavy wheel hub assembly (steerable)

rail_wheel.description: A strong rail wheel.  A flange helps keep it on a rail, but makes it perform terribly when not on a rail.

rail_wheel_steerable.description: A strong rail wheel.  A flange helps keep it on a rail, but makes it perform terribly when not on a rail.
rail_wheel_steerable.name: rail wheel (steerable)

rail_wheel_small_pair.description: A pair of small rail wheels.  It fits small railroad rails found in places like amusement parks.  Mostly for hobby purposes rather than transportation.  You can't steer it.
rail_wheel_small_pair.name: small rail wheels (pair)

roller_drum.description: A large cylinder fashioned out of plates of hardened steel, normally found on road rollers.  Its massive weight is meant to, slowly, roll over asphalt and other surfaces, levelling them out.

wheel_slick.description: A wide, smooth wheel intended for racing.  The slick surface provides better speed on pavement but penalizes off-road speed.

wheel_barrow.description: A small wheel from a common garden wheelbarrow.

wheel_bicycle_or.description: A wide, studded bicycle wheel intended for off-road biking.

wheel_caster.description: A set of small wheels mounted on pivots, like you'd find on a rolling office chair.

wheel_caster_large.description: A set of medium wheels mounted on pivots, like you'd find on a shopping cart.

wheel_10.description: A set of solid-rubber wheels, like you'd find on small industrial equipment.

wheel_skateboard.name: skateboard wheels
wheel_skateboard.description: A set of four small wheels, for a skateboard.

wheel_mount_skateboard.name: skateboard trucks
wheel_mount_skateboard.description: A pair metal skateboard trucks, for attaching wheels to.

wheel_motorbike.description: A small wheel from a motorcycle.

wheel_motorbike_or.description: A motorbike wheel, studded for improved off-road performance.

wheel_small.description: A pretty small wheel.  Probably from one of those Segway things.  It is not very menacing.

wheel_tricycle.description: A set of hard plastic wheels with one larger than the other two.  Proudly made in the USA by Double Dango Productions.

wheel_wheelchair.name: wheelchair wheels
wheel_wheelchair.description: A pair of wheels for a wheelchair.

wheel_wide.description: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  Provides more traction and better off-road performance.

wheel_wide_or.description: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.

wheel_wood_b.description: A handmade wooden cart wheel with metal bands for durability.

wheel_mount_concrete_mix.description: A set of two small wheel mounts from a concrete mixer.

wheel_set_concrete_mix.description: A set of two small wheels from a concrete mixer.

windshield.description: A sheet of glass that lets you see outside the vehicle.
windshield.name: windshield

reinforced_windshield.description: A sheet of glass that lets you see outside the vehicle.  Reinforced with wire to make it harder to break than normal glass.
reinforced_windshield.name: reinforced windshield

center.name: Center
center.desc: Above the frame and below the roof

bio_adrenaline.name: Adrenaline Pump
bio_adrenaline.description: A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

bio_ads.name: Active Defense System
bio_ads.description: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of your bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks and those in turn more than bashing attacks.

bio_alarm.name: Alarm System
bio_alarm.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.

bio_ankles.name: Squeaky Ankles
bio_ankles.description: In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.

bio_ar.name: Integrated AR System
bio_ar.description: Extremely thin lenses provide user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.

bio_armor_arms.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Arms
bio_armor_arms.description: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your arms and hands, protecting them from physical trauma.

bio_armor_eyes.name: Protective Lenses
bio_armor_eyes.description: Your eye sockets have been surgically sealed with highly protective mirrored lenses and your tear ducts have been re-routed to your mouth.  When you cry, you must spit out or swallow your tears.

bio_armor_head.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Head
bio_armor_head.description: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your head and jaw region, protecting your skull from physical trauma.

bio_armor_legs.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Legs
bio_armor_legs.description: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your legs and feet, protecting them from physical trauma.

bio_armor_torso.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Torso
bio_armor_torso.description: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your torso, protecting it from physical trauma.

bio_batteries.name: Battery System
bio_batteries.description: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

bio_blade.name: Monomolecular Blade
bio_blade.description: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

bio_shotgun.name: Shotgun Arm
bio_shotgun.description: Concealed in your left arm is a single shot 12 gauge shotgun.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the shotgun.

bio_blindfold.name: Optical Dampers
bio_blindfold.description: A pair of lenses surgically installed over your eyes that can be tinted to block out incoming light.

bio_blood_anal.name: Blood Analysis
bio_blood_anal.description: Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

bio_blood_filter.name: Blood Filter
bio_blood_filter.description: A filtration system near your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.

bio_cable.name: Cable Charger System
bio_cable.description: You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.

bio_carbon.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament
bio_carbon.description: Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This has no impact on blunt trauma but will protect you against deep cuts.

bio_chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
bio_chain_lightning.description: Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

bio_claws.name: Bionic Claws
bio_claws.description: Vicious claws have been surgically installed inside your fingers, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

bio_climate.name: Internal Climate Control
bio_climate.description: Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.

bio_cloak.name: Cloaking System
bio_cloak.description: This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

bio_cqb.name: Close Quarters Battle
bio_cqb.description: Bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs, are surgically integrated into your nervous system.  While active, the CQB module will improve your hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents you from improving them through combat experience.

bio_deformity.name: Bionic-Induced Deformity
bio_deformity.description: A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.

bio_dex_enhancer.name: Wired Reflexes
bio_dex_enhancer.description: Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity while powered.  However, you will suffer penalties while unpowered.

bio_digestion.name: Expanded Digestive System
bio_digestion.description: You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.
bio_digestion.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's digestive organs and cannot be removed.

bio_dis_acid.name: Acidic Discharge
bio_dis_acid.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.

bio_dis_shock.name: Electrical Discharge
bio_dis_shock.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.

bio_drain.name: Electrical Drain
bio_drain.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.

bio_earplugs.name: Sound Dampeners
bio_earplugs.description: When this bionic is active, you can block hearing completely.

bio_ears.name: Enhanced Hearing
bio_ears.description: When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear over three times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.

bio_mp3.name: WearMan
bio_mp3.description: Surgically implanted into your skull near the eardrums are two speakers, as well as a small port behind the left earlobe.  They can pick up local radio waves and play downloaded music in concert hall quality.  It came pre-installed with "Rubik's Mickse".

bio_voice_b.name: AudioVox
bio_voice_b.description: Hailing from a world choked with neon smog, and appreciated by Exodii artists, the AudioVox implant allows you to change, remodulate, and even autotune your voice.  It also causes vocalizations (such as shouts and singing) to be much louder.  It consists of an electronic voice box, synthetic larynx and multiple speakers implanted throughout your throat.

bio_emp.name: Directional EMP
bio_emp.description: Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.

bio_emp_armgun.name: EMP Projector
bio_emp_armgun.description: A ranged EMP generator system is implanted in your right arm and the palm of your right hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.

bio_ethanol.name: Ethanol Burner
bio_ethanol.description: You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.

bio_lampoil.name: Oil Generator
bio_lampoil.description: Slowly generates bionic power out of kerosene or motor oil.

bio_evap.name: Aero-Evaporator
bio_evap.description: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.

bio_eye_enhancer.name: Ocular Amplifiers
bio_eye_enhancer.description: Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception while powered.  However, you suffer penalties while unpowered.

bio_eye_optic.name: Telescopic Eyes
bio_eye_optic.description: Much of the material in your inner eye has been surgically removed and replaced with an array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses.  They function as integrated binoculars, letting you see much farther than before, and any vision problems you might have had are now gone.
bio_eye_optic.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has completely replaced %1$s eyes now.  Removing them would leave %2$s blind.

bio_face_mask.name: Facial Distortion
bio_face_mask.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

bio_faraday.name: Dielectric Capacitance System
bio_faraday.description: Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

bio_fingerhack.name: Fingerhack
bio_fingerhack.description: One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.

bio_fitnessband.name: Calorie Tracker
bio_fitnessband.description: A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.

bio_flashbang.name: Flashbang Generator
bio_flashbang.description: Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.

bio_flashlight.name: Cranial Flashlight
bio_flashlight.description: Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.

bio_flashlight_highmode.name: Ultrabright Flashlight
bio_flashlight_highmode.description: You can greatly intensify the power of your bionic flashlight to be much brighter at a much higher power cost.

bio_tattoo_led.name: LED Tattoo
bio_tattoo_led.description: A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light to comfortably read or craft, but it can suffice if you have nothing else.

bio_glowy.name: Glowy Thing
bio_glowy.description: You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

bio_geiger.name: Integrated Dosimeter
bio_geiger.description: Small radiation sensors have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

bio_gills.name: Respirator
bio_gills.description: A complex respiration augmentation system.  Improves respiration ability in air and allows breathing water.  Will automatically activate when drowning.  Turn on to recharge stamina faster, at moderate power cost.  Asthmatics may also use it to stop asthma attacks.

bio_ground_sonar.name: Terranian Sonar
bio_ground_sonar.description: Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

descriptions.text: You sense some creature moving underground here.

bio_heat_absorb.name: Heat Drain
bio_heat_absorb.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.

bio_heatsink.name: Thermal Dissipation
bio_heatsink.description: Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are surgically woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.

bio_hydraulics.name: Hydraulic Muscles
bio_hydraulics.description: While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, setting your strength to 20.

bio_infrared.name: Infrared Vision
bio_infrared.description: Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.

bio_int_enhancer.name: Cerebral Booster
bio_int_enhancer.description: Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence while powered.  However, you suffer penalties if unpowered.
bio_int_enhancer.cant_remove_reason: The bionic is now critical to the continued functionality of the user's brain.

bio_itchy.name: Itchy Metal Thing
bio_itchy.description: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.

bio_laser.name: Finger-Mounted Laser
bio_laser.description: One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

bio_leaky.name: Leaky Bionic
bio_leaky.description: This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

bio_leukocyte.name: Leukocyte Breeder System
bio_leukocyte.description: You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

bio_lighter.name: Finger Lighter
bio_lighter.description: The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.

bio_lockpick.name: Fingerpick
bio_lockpick.description: One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

bio_magnet.name: Electromagnetic Unit
bio_magnet.description: Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

bio_membrane.name: Nictitating Membrane
bio_membrane.description: Your eyes are equipped with thin membranes that cover your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

bio_memory.name: Enhanced Memory Banks
bio_memory.description: Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you forget skills you've learned slower.
bio_memory.cant_remove_reason: Removing this CBM would cause severe amnesia and neurological issues.

bio_metabolics.name: Metabolic Interchange
bio_metabolics.description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

bio_meteorologist.name: Weather Reader
bio_meteorologist.description: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you the local air temperature.

bio_nanobots.name: Repair Nanobots
bio_nanobots.description: Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, repairing damage at 1 HP per minute and stopping bleeding at the cost of extra power and stored calories.  No power is consumed if there is nothing to heal.

bio_night.name: Artificial Night Generator
bio_night.description: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.

bio_night_vision.name: Implanted Night Vision
bio_night_vision.description: When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.

bio_noise.name: Noisemaker
bio_noise.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.

bio_nostril.name: Bionic Nostril
bio_nostril.description: You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.

bio_ods.name: Offensive Defense System
bio_ods.description: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

bio_painkiller.name: Sensory Dulling
bio_painkiller.description: Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.

bio_pokedeye.name: Bionic Visual Impairment
bio_pokedeye.description: Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.

bio_power_storage.name: Power Storage
bio_power_storage.description: Upgrades your bionic power capacity by 100 kJ.  It can be recharged via other CBMs that function as power supplies.

bio_power_storage_mkII.name: Power Storage Mk. II
bio_power_storage_mkII.description: Upgrades your bionic power capacity by 250 kJ.  It can be recharged via other CBMs that function as power supplies.

bio_power_weakness.name: Power Overload
bio_power_weakness.description: Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

bio_probability_travel.name: Probability Travel
bio_probability_travel.description: Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.

bio_purifier.name: Air Filtration System
bio_purifier.description: Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

bio_radio.name: Infolink
bio_radio.description: A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.

bio_radio_pat.name: Modified Infolink
bio_radio_pat.description: A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.  This one has custom software for communicating with your pal Pat.

bio_radscrubber.name: Radiation Scrubber System
bio_radscrubber.description: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.

bio_razors.name: Fingertip Razors
bio_razors.description: You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered.

bio_recycler.name: Recycler Unit
bio_recycler.description: Your digestive system has been outfitted with a series of filters and processors, allowing you to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.

bio_remote.name: Remote Controller
bio_remote.description: A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

bio_resonator.name: Sonic Resonator
bio_resonator.description: Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.

bio_scent_mask.name: Olfactory Mask
bio_scent_mask.description: While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.

bio_shakes.name: Bionic Short Circuit
bio_shakes.description: A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.

bio_synaptic_regen.name: Synaptic Regeneration System
bio_synaptic_regen.description: An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although you may still feel sleepy; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.

bio_shock.name: Electroshock Unit
bio_shock.description: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

bio_shockwave.name: Shockwave Generator
bio_shockwave.description: You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.

bio_sleepy.name: Endocrine Enervator
bio_sleepy.description: Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause sleepiness.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

bio_spasm.name: Motor Control Overstimulator
bio_spasm.description: One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.

bio_speed.name: Synaptic Accelerator
bio_speed.description: Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.

bio_stiff.name: Wire-Induced Stiffness
bio_stiff.description: Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.

bio_str_enhancer.name: Muscle Augmentation
bio_str_enhancer.description: Your muscular system has been surgically enhanced with myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength while powered.  However, you will suffer penalties if unpowered.

bio_surgical_razor.name: Autonomous Surgical Scalpels
bio_surgical_razor.description: A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

bio_sunglasses.name: Anti-Glare Compensators
bio_sunglasses.description: Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.

bio_synlungs.name: Synthetic Lungs
bio_synlungs.description: You have highly efficient artificial lungs which greatly increase your oxygen intake.  If they are not powered you will suffocate, and they weaken your immune system somewhat.
bio_synlungs.cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's lungs and cannot be removed.

bio_targeting.name: Targeting System
bio_targeting.description: Your eyes are surgically equipped with range finders, and their movement is synced with that of your arms, to a degree.  Shots you fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long range.

bio_sonar.name: Subaquatic Navigation System
bio_sonar.description: While active, a tiny device in your inner ear periodically generates ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided you are underwater and able to hear.

bio_taser.name: Super Stun Gun
bio_taser.description: You have a powerful stun gun built into your hand.  Activate to zap an adjacent enemy.

bio_teleport.name: Teleportation Unit
bio_teleport.description: This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

bio_thumbs.name: Self-Locking Thumbs
bio_thumbs.description: Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.

bio_time_freeze.name: Time Dilation
bio_time_freeze.description: At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.

bio_tools.name: Integrated Multitool
bio_tools.description: Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.

bio_multimeter.name: Integrated Multimeter
bio_multimeter.description: Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

bio_electrokit.name: Integrated Circuitry Toolset
bio_electrokit.description: Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

bio_torsionratchet.name: Joint Torsion Ratchet
bio_torsionratchet.description: Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move, even when turned off.  Whilst this is toggled on, moving will require more effort, but more power will be generated.  This system is actively detrimental to fully mechanical limbs; the additional joint resistance it relies on causes a net loss of bionic power.

bio_jointservo.name: Joint Servo
bio_jointservo.description: Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online.  However, when it's offline it will hamper your movement, as you struggle against its moving parts.

bio_trip.name: Visual Disruptor
bio_trip.description: A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.

bio_uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
bio_uncanny_dodge.description: Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.

bio_ups.name: Unified Power System
bio_ups.description: You have a Unified Power System wired into your power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now draw directly from your bionic power supply.

bio_voice.name: Voice Remodulator
bio_voice.description: You will likely spend the rest of your days serving as a walking testament to why you don't opt for the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package'.  A remodulator unit jammed down your throat has given you a creepy robot voice.

bio_watch.name: Internal Chronometer
bio_watch.description: You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.

bio_water_extractor.name: Water Extraction Unit
bio_water_extractor.description: Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.name: Gasoline Fuel Cell
bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.description: A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.

bio_syringe.name: Intravenous Needletip
bio_syringe.description: The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

bio_weight.name: Titanium Skeletal Bracing
bio_weight.description: Titanium bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds, and you receive slightly less bashing damage to your arms, legs and torso.

bio_taste_blocker.name: Taste Modifier
bio_taste_blocker.description: A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth, and a small yet sophisticated analyzer is installed in the cavity of your skull.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.

bio_soporific.name: Soporific Induction
bio_soporific.description: An electrode has been implanted into your brain's ventrolateral preoptic nucleus.  It turns on whenever you're trying to fall asleep, creating an artificial but effective sensation of sleepiness.

bio_faulty_electromagnetic_leak.name: Electromagnetic Leak
bio_faulty_electromagnetic_leak.description: A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants' capacity to store charge.

bio_faulty_grossfood.name: Taste Fouler
bio_faulty_grossfood.description: A malfunctioning processor haphazardly interfaced with your taste receptors has given everything you consume a horrid bitter taste.  Food and drink will severely harm your morale.

bio_radleak.name: Radioactive Leak
bio_radleak.description: This damaged CBM occasionally leaks radiation.

bio_recoil.name: Recoil Compensators
bio_recoil.description: Reactive shock absorbers installed in your wrists and elbows which greatly reduce felt recoil.

bio_sleep_shutdown.name: Sleep Mode Shutdown
bio_sleep_shutdown.description: For better or worse, this CBM suppresses stimuli while asleep, preventing you from waking up until the end of your natural sleep cycle.

bio_pitch_perfect.name: Throwing Assist
bio_pitch_perfect.description: Taken from a world that embraced cybernetics in their sports, this CBM links the eyes to a series of nerve stimulators along the arms and hands.  The result is a significant increase to throwing distance and accuracy, and it turns out it works great with fragmentation grenades.

bio_robofac_xmleg.name: Hub 01 XM-LEG Interface
bio_robofac_xmleg.description: Your legs house chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Lower Extremity Gaitframes.

bio_robofac_xmarm.name: Hub 01 XM-ARM Interface
bio_robofac_xmarm.description: Your arms and hands houses chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Arm Reinforcement Motionframes.

bio_robofac_xmback.name: Hub 01 XM-BACK Interface
bio_robofac_xmback.description: Your shoulders and back house chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Biomechanical Assisted Carrying Kinetoframes.

bio_robofac_xmlens.name: Hub 01 XM-LENS Interface
bio_robofac_xmlens.description: Your scalp houses chip-free electronics that allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with compatible Hub 01 Low-latency ExoNeural Sensory headgear.

bio_nl_dimensional_anchor.name: Dimensional Anchor
bio_nl_dimensional_anchor.description: Your body has been wired with advanced technology that locks you into your native dimensionality, protecting you from unwanted teleportation and some other phase altering effects.

bio_nl_laser_reader.name: Laser-Assisted Reading Device
bio_nl_laser_reader.description: Your head is implanted with a low-power reading light and a short-distance laser scanner, allowing you to upload digital images of books straight into your brain's optic lobe and language centers.  When active, you read slightly faster, and can read in the dark.

bio_nl_psyshield.name: Cranial EMF Shielding
bio_nl_psyshield.description: Your skull is coated in a microscopically thin layer of some non-newtonian fluid.  It can protect you from some types of electromagnetic fields.  Is it useful?  Maybe.  It slightly encumbers the head.

bio_nl_hair.name: Artificial Hair
bio_nl_hair.description: Your hair follicles have been replaced with mechanical sphincters that control the extrusion and retraction of advanced nanotube hair technology.  Activate this to change the style or color of your artificial hair.

bio_nl_blood_factory.name: Bone Marrow Bio-Factory
bio_nl_blood_factory.description: Your bone marrow is now home to several specialized nanorobots.  Activating them will increase blood cell production at the cost of stored calories and bionic energy.

bio_nl_antigravity_jump.name: Antigravity Leap Assist
bio_nl_antigravity_jump.description: Your legs have been implanted with an antigravity device.  While it doesn't allow you to float or fly, it does allow you to make superhuman long jumps.

bio_exodii_cyberframe_1a.name: Cyberframe 1a
bio_exodii_cyberframe_1a.description: Your body is integrated into a bulky Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, are encased in a solid metal core.  While there is clearly a head and torso, it is difficult to tell where one starts and the other ends.  It will be difficult or impossible to squeeze through tight spaces, or to wear normal-sized clothing and armor.  The frame greatly increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is highly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso are still affected by temperature, you can still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.
bio_exodii_cyberframe_1a.cant_remove_reason: Cyberframes cannot be removed, only swapped via specialized surgery.  Removing it would kill you.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_left.name: Cyberframe 1a: Bionic Left Leg
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_left.description: You have a bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_righ.name: Cyberframe 1a: Bionic Right Leg
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_righ.description: You have a bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_treads.name: Cyberframe 1a: Bionic Treads
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_treads.description: In place of legs and feet you have sturdy treads.  They are in fact two side-by-size triangular mechanisms, split in the middle, and independently operated.  Your former ankles and associated anatomy are now a part of the internal servomotors, and your knees are capable of minor telescoping and bending, to facilitate lifting one tread at a time for carefully passing over obstacles, or climbing stairs or ladders.  Unlike bipedal human legs, these move faster over most terrain, but will severely hinder travel over obstacles and through water.  They are immune to temperature and pain and don't bleed.  While they are highly resistant to damage, their external moving parts are less well protected than a standard bionic leg with similar plate thickness.  Due to their size and heft, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_left.name: Cyberframe 1a: Bionic Left Arm
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_left.description: You have a bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_righ.name: Cyberframe 1a: Bionic Right Arm
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_righ.description: You have a bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_cyberframe_1b.name: Cyberframe 1b
bio_exodii_cyberframe_1b.description: Your body is integrated into a very human-like Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, are encased in a frame that resembles a robotic human.  The frame increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is modestly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso are still affected by temperature, you can still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.
bio_exodii_cyberframe_1b.cant_remove_reason: Cyberframes cannot be removed, only swapped via specialized surgery.  Removing it would kill you.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_left.name: Cyberframe 1b: Bionic Left Leg
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_left.description: You have a bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_right.name: Cyberframe 1b: Bionic Right Leg
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_right.description: You have a bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_left.name: Cyberframe 1b: Bionic Left Arm
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_left.description: You have a bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_right.name: Cyberframe 1b: Bionic Right Arm
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_right.description: You have a bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_nl_collar.name: Mysterious collar implant
bio_nl_collar.description: You can feel something implanted in the nape of your neck, but you're not sure what it is.  The whole thing makes you feel a little stiff.
bio_nl_collar.cant_remove_reason: You know there's an implant there, but it doesn't show up on the scanners?

bio_nl_collar_deactivated.name: Mysterious collar implant
bio_nl_collar_deactivated.description: You can feel something implanted in the nape of your neck, but you're not sure what it is.  The whole thing makes you feel a little stiff.

prof_parkour.name: Parkour Expert
prof_parkour.description: You're skilled at clearing obstacles; terrain like railings or counters are as easy for you to move on as solid ground.

prof_athlete_basic.name: Athlete's Form
prof_athlete_basic.description: You've spent some time developing your general fitness.  When operating muscle-powered vehicles, you know how to get more power out of each stroke.

prof_athlete_expert.name: Athlete's Form (Expert)
prof_athlete_expert.description: With considerable practice, you've honed your athletic fitness and form.  You know how to get the most out of your effort, when manually powering a muscle-driven vehicle.

prof_athlete_master.name: Athlete's Form (Master)
prof_athlete_master.description: You've honed your athletics to at least a professional level.  When it comes to making vehicles move under your own power, your body is a well-oiled machine.

prof_butchering_basic.name: Principles of Butchering
prof_butchering_basic.description: You know how to pick up most of the meat from the animal body.

prof_butchering_adv.name: Butchering Expert
prof_butchering_adv.description: There is very little meat left after your skillful knife movements.

prof_skinning_basic.name: Principles of Skinning
prof_skinning_basic.description: You stopped making holes in the skin of animals you butcher.

prof_skinning_adv.name: Skinning Expert
prof_skinning_adv.description: You really know how to skin the animal.

prof_intro_chemistry.name: Principles of Chemistry
prof_intro_chemistry.description: You are beginning to grasp a general idea of how elements and compounds react with each other.

prof_gross_anatomy.name: Gross Anatomy
prof_gross_anatomy.description: You've identified the key organs within several creatures and their locations with the goal of attacking them in combat.

prof_intro_biology.name: Principles of Biology
prof_intro_biology.description: You are beginning to gain a general idea of how various living beings function.

prof_organic_chemistry.name: Organic Chemistry
prof_organic_chemistry.description: Knowledge of the branch of chemistry that studies and uses carbon-containing compounds.

prof_inorganic_chemistry.name: Inorganic Chemistry
prof_inorganic_chemistry.description: Knowledge of the branch of chemistry that studies and uses compounds not containing carbon.

prof_mycology.name: Mycology
prof_mycology.description: Knowledge of the esoteric biology of fungi.

prof_mycology_advanced.name: Doctorate of Mycology
prof_mycology_advanced.description: Extensive and detailed knowledge of the esoteric biology of fungi, to an extremely nerdy degree.

prof_biochemistry.name: Biochemistry
prof_biochemistry.description: The understanding of the chemistry of living things.

prof_physiology.name: Physiology
prof_physiology.description: An in-depth understanding of how humans and animals operate.

prof_xenology.name: Xenology
prof_xenology.description: You are beginning to grasp a general idea of how alien and post-Cataclysm mutated creatures function and operate.

prof_intro_chem_synth.name: Principles of Chemical Synthesis
prof_intro_chem_synth.description: You're beginning to grasp the basics of chemical production.

prof_chem_synth.name: Complex Chemical Synthesis
prof_chem_synth.description: The proper understanding of safe chemical synthesization and how to clean your tools used for the next batch.

prof_distilling.name: Distillation
prof_distilling.description: The process of separating two mixed liquids by their different boiling points.

prof_metallurgy.name: Metallurgy
prof_metallurgy.description: An understanding of the chemistry of metalworking and alloys.

prof_pharmaceutical.name: Pharmaceutical Production
prof_pharmaceutical.description: An understanding of how to produce various natural and chemical substances pure enough for human consumption.

prof_food_prep.name: Food Preparation
prof_food_prep.description: You've done enough cooking to know the basics about how to quickly and efficiently sort your ingredients.

prof_knife_skills.name: Knife Skills
prof_knife_skills.description: You're quite skilled at culinary knife work, making you noticeably faster at preparing meals that involve a lot of chopping.

prof_baking.name: Principles of Baking
prof_baking.description: You know the basics of baking - proportions, leavening, and things - and are less likely to make a dramatic mistake when working from memory.

prof_baking_bread.name: Breadmaking
prof_baking_bread.description: You've baked enough bread to consider yourself an expert.  May your yeast be ever frothy.

prof_baking_desserts_1.name: Dessert Baking
prof_baking_desserts_1.description: Anyone can make a cookie, but you can make it look amazing.  Cakes and other fluffies are also no longer a barrier.

prof_baking_desserts_2.name: Patisserie Expert
prof_baking_desserts_2.description: You could have been a professional baker before the Cataclysm.  Your profiteroles are the envy of the wastelands.

prof_frying.name: Principles of Frying
prof_frying.description: Anyone can toss stuff into deep fryer oil.  You know more about selecting oil, keeping the food from burning, and the like.

prof_frying_bread.name: Breading & Battering
prof_frying_bread.description: You know enough about deep frying breads and batters to do it easily without thinking about it.

prof_frying_dessert.name: Fried Desserts
prof_frying_dessert.description: You know the vaunted secrets of creating delicious deep fried sweets.

prof_fermenting.name: Culinary Fermentation
prof_fermenting.description: The basics of fermenting for human consumption, including sanitary technique, avoiding harmful molds, and identifying common problems.

prof_beverage_distilling.name: Beverage Distillation
prof_beverage_distilling.description: Applying the science of distillation to alcoholic beverages to get something tasty.

prof_brewing.name: Brewing
prof_brewing.description: The fine art of brewing grains into beers.

prof_winemaking.name: Winemaking
prof_winemaking.description: The knowledge of how to turn sugary fruits, and occasionally vegetables, into fermented beverages.

prof_lactofermenting.name: Lactofermentation
prof_lactofermenting.description: The microbiology of most non-alcoholic fermented edibles, from sauerkraut to sourdough.

prof_cheesemaking_1.name: Principles of Cheesemaking
prof_cheesemaking_1.description: The basics of curdling and coagulating milk and similar things without the wrong kinds of bacteria and mold winning out.

prof_cheesemaking_2.name: Cheesemaking Expert
prof_cheesemaking_2.description: Taking the basics of curdled milk and making it delicious.

prof_preservation.name: Food Preservation
prof_preservation.description: The basic knowledge of ways to keep food safe for long periods of time in a post-refrigeration world.

prof_food_curing.name: Curing and Drying Food
prof_food_curing.description: Using salt, smoke, and similar agents to cure or dehydrate food.

prof_food_canning.name: Canning Food
prof_food_canning.description: Using pressure canning or tinning to safely store food in sealed containers.

prof_scav_cooking.name: Scavenger Cooking
prof_scav_cooking.description: You know the secrets of cooking tasty food using strange substitutions and weird things you found in a cabinet in an abandoned house.

prof_forage_cooking.name: Forager Cooking
prof_forage_cooking.description: Cooking with foraged ingredients that you wouldn't find in most cookbooks.

prof_elec_soldering.name: Electronics Soldering
prof_elec_soldering.description: An understanding of the skills and tools needed to create durable, effective soldered electrical connections.

prof_elec_circuits.name: Electrical Circuits
prof_elec_circuits.description: Practical experience building electrical circuits, and a grasp of the principles of electrical continuity, current, voltage, and resistance.
