prof_elec_semiconductors.name: Semiconductors
prof_elec_semiconductors.description: Basic working knowledge of using semiconductors such as diodes and transistors in electrical circuits, for switching or amplifying electrical signals.

prof_elec_integrated_circuits.name: Integrated Circuits
prof_elec_integrated_circuits.description: Familiarity with the role of IC chips in circuit design, and ability to identify many common pre-Cataclysm ICs and understand how to use them in functional circuits.

prof_electromagnetics.name: Electromagnetics
prof_electromagnetics.description: A practical working knowledge of electromagnetic fields and their creation and application.

prof_shock_weapons.name: Electroshock Weapons
prof_shock_weapons.description: An understanding of how to use high voltage, low-current devices to cause debilitating muscle spasms.  Includes some theoretical knowledge of how to protect yourself from these.

prof_gunsmithing_basic.name: Principles of Gunsmithing
prof_gunsmithing_basic.description: A basic understanding of how guns are put together and what tools and materials are needed for the job.

prof_gunsmithing_improv.name: Improvised Gunmaking
prof_gunsmithing_improv.description: You've become an expert at putting together guns and launchers from makeshift parts.

prof_gunsmithing_antique.name: Antique Gunsmithing
prof_gunsmithing_antique.description: You're specifically skilled at building and repairing antique guns.

prof_gunsmithing_spring.name: Spring-powered Guns and Crossbows
prof_gunsmithing_spring.description: Similar to bowyery, the art of making guns that are powered by elastic mechanisms.

prof_gunsmithing_revolver.name: Revolver Gunsmithing
prof_gunsmithing_revolver.description: You've got the know-how to make a classic Western revolver, and its many variants.

prof_gun_cleaning.name: Firearm Cleaning
prof_gun_cleaning.description: You know how to quickly disassemble guns, clean them, and reassemble them in the field.

prof_wound_care.name: Wound Care
prof_wound_care.description: You know how to bandage wounds and understand basic principles of wound care.

prof_wound_care_expert.name: Wound Care Expert
prof_wound_care_expert.description: Your extensive field experience in bandaging and wound care is on par with that of a paramedic.

prof_burn_care.name: Burn Care
prof_burn_care.description: You have some basic understanding of how burns work and (potentially) how they could be treated.

prof_dissect_humans.name: Human Autopsies
prof_dissect_humans.description: You have been trained such that you are desensitized to the sight of a human's innards, and can dissect human corpses without penalty.

prof_high_pressure_systems.name: High Pressure Systems
prof_high_pressure_systems.description: You know how to safely and efficiently build, repair, maintain and use various appliances that make use of high pressure.

prof_chemical_engineering.name: Chemical Engineering
prof_chemical_engineering.description: You know how to safely and efficiently build, repair, maintain and use various complex machinery that makes use of chemical processes.

prof_pneumatics.name: Pneumatics
prof_pneumatics.description: Maintaining and building compressed-air powered machines.

prof_aircraft_mechanic.name: Airframe and Powerplant Mechanic
prof_aircraft_mechanic.description: You've been trained and certified to repair aircraft.  You're not really sure how that could help you survive now.

prof_auto_rifles_familiar.name: Long Gun CQC Familiarity
prof_auto_rifles_familiar.description: You're familiar with how to grip a long gun correctly while striking someone with it.

prof_auto_rifles_pro.name: Long Gun CQC Proficiency
prof_auto_rifles_pro.description: You're proficient in striking with your rifle, both with and without a bayonet.

prof_auto_rifles_master.name: Long Gun CQC Mastery
prof_auto_rifles_master.description: You've mastered the art of the bayonet charge and know how to handle the gun itself as a weapon.

prof_auto_pistols_familiar.name: Handgun CQC Familiarity
prof_auto_pistols_familiar.description: You're able to use your handgun effectively as a melee weapon without shooting yourself.

prof_auto_pistols_pro.name: Handgun CQC Proficiency
prof_auto_pistols_pro.description: You're proficient in striking with your handgun and can do so precisely.

prof_auto_pistols_master.name: Handgun CQC Mastery
prof_auto_pistols_master.description: You're able to precisely strike your opponent with your handgun where it hurts the most.

prof_knives_familiar.name: Knife Familiarity
prof_knives_familiar.description: You've got a handling on gripping knives so they don't slip out of your hand.

prof_knives_pro.name: Knife Proficiency
prof_knives_pro.description: You handle your knife like a butcher, and are ready to prove it.

prof_knives_master.name: Knife Mastery
prof_knives_master.description: Your knife is like an extension of yourself, you wield it effortlessly.

prof_shivs_familiar.name: Shiv Familiarity
prof_shivs_familiar.description: You know how to stab someone with something not typically intended to stab them with.

prof_shivs_pro.name: Shiv Proficiency
prof_shivs_pro.description: You're pretty good at shanking your enemy, if you do say so yourself.

prof_shivs_master.name: Shiv Mastery
prof_shivs_master.description: You've mastered the ancient and ignoble art of sticking someone with something small and pointy.

prof_batons_familiar.name: Baton Familiarity
prof_batons_familiar.description: You've learned to swing a baton without spraining your wrists.

prof_batons_pro.name: Baton Proficiency
prof_batons_pro.description: You know how to strike with your baton so you get the most out of every blow.

prof_batons_master.name: Baton Mastery
prof_batons_master.description: You've mastered the use of all kinds of batons, and the fine art of beating someone with a stick.

prof_medium_swords_familiar.name: Medium Sword Familiarity
prof_medium_swords_familiar.description: You have enough practice not to cut yourself with your own blade.

prof_medium_swords_pro.name: Medium Sword Proficiency
prof_medium_swords_pro.description: The weight of your weapon feels as natural to you as if it were your own limb.

prof_medium_swords_master.name: Medium Sword Mastery
prof_medium_swords_master.description: Your body has grown accustomed to the rigors of sword fighting, and can handle it for longer.

prof_short_swords_familiar.name: Short Sword Familiarity
prof_short_swords_familiar.description: You understand how to swing a short blade around.  In theory, at least.

prof_short_swords_pro.name: Short Sword Proficiency
prof_short_swords_pro.description: You've trained your body against the strain of fighting with a short sword.

prof_short_swords_master.name: Short Sword Mastery
prof_short_swords_master.description: You're able to cut through zombies with the same ease you cut through foliage.

prof_quarterstaves_familiar.name: Quarterstaff Familiarity
prof_quarterstaves_familiar.description: You're familiar with how to handle your staff and can use it without knocking yourself out.

prof_quarterstaves_pro.name: Quarterstaff Proficiency
prof_quarterstaves_pro.description: You're used to the balance of a staff and know how to handle it.

prof_quarterstaves_master.name: Quarterstaff Mastery
prof_quarterstaves_master.description: You've mastered the use of quarterstaves.  Donatello would be proud.

prof_fencing_weapons_familiar.name: Fencing Weapon Familiarity
prof_fencing_weapons_familiar.description: You've got the basics of lunging and parrying your opponent.

prof_fencing_weapons_pro.name: Fencing Weapon Proficiency
prof_fencing_weapons_pro.description: You strike forth with ease after many hours of training.

prof_fencing_weapons_master.name: Fencing Weapon Mastery
prof_fencing_weapons_master.description: Before the Cataclysm, you could have been an Olympic fencer.

prof_claws_familiar.name: Claw Weapon Familiarity
prof_claws_familiar.description: You've learned how to use claw weapons in combat.

prof_claws_pro.name: Claw Weapon Proficiency
prof_claws_pro.description: You're quite experienced with your claws by now.

prof_claws_master.name: Claw Weapon Mastery
prof_claws_master.description: You feel as dangerous as a tiger with your claws.

prof_hooking_familiar.name: Hooking Weapon Familiarity
prof_hooking_familiar.description: You're getting a hang of hooking your opponents with your weapon.

prof_hooking_pro.name: Hooking Weapon Proficiency
prof_hooking_pro.description: You could probably unhorse someone with your weapon with your skills.

prof_hooking_master.name: Hooking Weapon Mastery
prof_hooking_master.description: You've mastered the art of knocking someone to the ground with your weapon.

prof_polearms_familiar.name: Polearm Familiarity
prof_polearms_familiar.description: Dominant hand on the grip, the other on the haft, you're familiar with how to hold most polearms.

prof_polearms_pro.name: Polearm Proficiency
prof_polearms_pro.description: You know how to keep your enemies at a distance with a polearm, and are able to defend yourself with one.

prof_polearms_master.name: Polearm Mastery
prof_polearms_master.description: You can handle the awkward balance of a polearm well, like it's an extension of your body.

prof_bionics_familiar.name: Bionic Weapon Familiarity
prof_bionics_familiar.description: Your body is getting used to the stress your bionic weapons put on it.

prof_bionics_pro.name: Bionic Weapon Proficiency
prof_bionics_pro.description: You've become accustomed to the motions of your bionic weapons in combat.

prof_bionics_master.name: Bionic Weapon Mastery
prof_bionics_master.description: Your bionic weapon feels as natural to you as your heartbeat.

prof_spears_familiar.name: Spear Familiarity
prof_spears_familiar.description: Non-dominant leg forward, you know the basics of impaling someone on a spear.

prof_spears_pro.name: Spear Proficiency
prof_spears_pro.description: Whether you're hunting boar or hunting zombies, you know how to stab with your spear.

prof_spears_master.name: Spear Mastery
prof_spears_master.description: You're in touch with your inner hunter-gatherer, able to keep up the hunt for longer.

prof_thrusting_swords_familiar.name: Long Thrusting Sword Familiarity
prof_thrusting_swords_familiar.description: You're no stranger to thrusting your sword through zombies.

prof_thrusting_swords_pro.name: Long Thrusting Sword Proficiency
prof_thrusting_swords_pro.description: You're able to gore someone on your sword like a pro.

prof_thrusting_swords_master.name: Long Thrusting Sword Mastery
prof_thrusting_swords_master.description: You're a virtuoso with your sword, ready to deliver a swift and deadly thrust.

prof_long_swords_familiar.name: Long Sword Familiarity
prof_long_swords_familiar.description: You know how to swing a longsword without chopping off your own foot.

prof_long_swords_pro.name: Long Sword Proficiency
prof_long_swords_pro.description: You're proficient with the use of long swords, and are deadly with one in your hands.

prof_long_swords_master.name: Long Sword Mastery
prof_long_swords_master.description: You are a blade master of unparalleled skill.  And they said anime wasn't real.

prof_bionic_swords_familiar.name: Bionic Sword Familiarity
prof_bionic_swords_familiar.description: You are able to operate your bionic sword without incident.

prof_bionic_swords_pro.name: Bionic Sword Proficiency
prof_bionic_swords_pro.description: Your bionic sword proficiency is satisfactory.  You are able to use it without discomfort.

prof_bionic_swords_master.name: Bionic Sword Mastery
prof_bionic_swords_master.description: Your capabilities with your bionic sword is the epitome of combat efficiency.

prof_flails_familiar.name: Flail Familiarity
prof_flails_familiar.description: You've learned how to hit your opponent instead of yourself with your flail.

prof_flails_pro.name: Flail Proficiency
prof_flails_pro.description: You're able to swing your flail with deadly precision, crushing through ribs and skulls alike.

prof_flails_master.name: Flail Mastery
prof_flails_master.description: You can make your flail dance like a ballerina, and hit like a truck.

prof_maces_familiar.name: Mace Familiarity
prof_maces_familiar.description: You've got the gist of bludgeoning your enemies.

prof_maces_pro.name: Mace Proficiency
prof_maces_pro.description: You swing your mace with dead efficiency.

prof_maces_master.name: Mace Mastery
prof_maces_master.description: Your strikes with a mace shatter skulls and pulp brains.

prof_great_swords_familiar.name: Great Sword Familiarity
prof_great_swords_familiar.description: You're not afraid to lift a heavy sword nor bring it down on someone's head.

prof_great_swords_pro.name: Great Sword Proficiency
prof_great_swords_pro.description: You are not afraid to swing big with a heavy sword.

prof_great_swords_master.name: Great Sword Mastery
prof_great_swords_master.description: You wield your blade like it was a modern day Caliburn.

prof_great_hammers_familiar.name: Great Hammer Familiarity
prof_great_hammers_familiar.description: You can handle a big ol' hammer without dropping it on your toes.

prof_great_hammers_pro.name: Great Hammer Proficiency
prof_great_hammers_pro.description: You're not afraid to put some muscle into it when you're swinging a hammer.

prof_great_hammers_master.name: Great Hammer Mastery
prof_great_hammers_master.description: You're a hammering juggernaut, ready to smash it all.

prof_great_axes_familiar.name: Great Axe Familiarity
prof_great_axes_familiar.description: You're not quite a professional lumberjack, but you can handle an axe.

prof_great_axes_pro.name: Great Axe Proficiency
prof_great_axes_pro.description: You chop through bodies as easily as you chop through trees.

prof_great_axes_master.name: Great Axe Mastery
prof_great_axes_master.description: You're a post-apocalyptic Paul Bunyan, but it's not just wood you're chopping.

prof_hand_axes_familiar.name: Hand Axe Familiarity
prof_hand_axes_familiar.description: You know the proper technique to use with a hand axe.

prof_hand_axes_pro.name: Hand Axe Proficiency
prof_hand_axes_pro.description: You know how to use a hatchet safely and effectively.

prof_hand_axes_master.name: Hand Axe Mastery
prof_hand_axes_master.description: You're more than capable of using a hand axe to protect yourself.

prof_unarmed_familiar.name: Unarmed Technique Familiarity
prof_unarmed_familiar.description: You know how to punch someone and make it hurt.

prof_unarmed_pro.name: Unarmed Technique Proficiency
prof_unarmed_pro.description: You're able to pace yourself when you've got nothing else to fight with.

prof_unarmed_master.name: Unarmed Technique Mastery
prof_unarmed_master.description: You're used to fighting with nothing and can fight unarmed for longer.

prof_whips_familiar.name: Whip Familiarity
prof_whips_familiar.description: You can crack a whip without hurting yourself.

prof_whips_pro.name: Whip Proficiency
prof_whips_pro.description: You can use a whip to snuff out a candle from across the room without touching the wax.

prof_whips_master.name: Whip Mastery
prof_whips_master.description: Your skill at hunting the living dead with a whip is unparalleled.  Make the Belmonts proud.

prof_metalworking.name: Principles of Metalworking
prof_metalworking.description: A basic understanding of the properties of metal as a material, and the concepts behind smithing, die casting, and other metalworking techniques.

prof_welding_basic.name: Principles of Welding
prof_welding_basic.description: A basic understanding of the different types of welding, welding tools and fuels, how to weld different materials, and more.

prof_blacksmithing.name: Blacksmithing
prof_blacksmithing.description: The craft of working metal into tools and other items of use.

prof_redsmithing.name: Principles of Redsmithing
prof_redsmithing.description: A basic understanding of the techniques required to work with copper and bronze, soft metals require a somewhat different kind of skill set than blacksmithing.

prof_redsmithing_adv.name: Advanced Redsmithing
prof_redsmithing_adv.description: You can now easily work with the more ductile copper-containing metals and could probably make a living in the Bronze Age.

prof_fine_metalsmithing.name: Fine Metalsmithing
prof_fine_metalsmithing.description: How to make jewelry from precious metals like gold and silver.

prof_armorsmithing.name: Armorsmithing
prof_armorsmithing.description: How to make articulated armor from pieces of metal.

prof_bladesmith.name: Bladesmithing
prof_bladesmith.description: How to fabricate sharp and reliable blades from scratch.

prof_toolsmithing.name: Manual Tooling
prof_toolsmithing.description: How to make high-quality tools and parts by hand.  Includes techniques like threading, durable articulation points, and using appropriate metals for appropriate tasks.  Also applies to making blunt instruments that can withstand a severe beating without distortion.

prof_wiremaking.name: Wire Making
prof_wiremaking.description: How to turn raw ingots and metals into usable wire.  Includes both drawing and extruding.

prof_hardening.name: Quenching & Hardening
prof_hardening.description: Heating steel to critical temperature, and using a variety of techniques including differential hardening techniques like slack quenching, and case hardening techniques for armor, to achieve a hardening of the steel while minimizing the brittleness.

prof_tempering.name: Tempering
prof_tempering.description: Tempering involves thorough-hardening the steel then holding it at a constant temperature to increase metal durability.

prof_machining_basic.name: Principles of Machining
prof_machining_basic.description: A basic understanding of the operation of various metalworking machinery, such as lathes and mills.

prof_knapping.name: Basic Knapping
prof_knapping.description: You know the basic principles of turning stones into more useful tools.

prof_knapping_speed.name: Speed Knapping
prof_knapping_speed.description: You've banged rocks together so much and for so long, you've become extremely fast at it.

prof_glassblowing.name: Glassblowing
prof_glassblowing.description: Working with glass and heat without poisoning or perforating yourself.

prof_plumbing.name: Plumbing
prof_plumbing.description: Working with pipes and pipe fittings to transport fluids without leakage.

prof_pottery.name: Pottery
prof_pottery.description: Basic pottery, from shaping to working with slip to fuse pieces.

prof_bowyery.name: Bowyery
prof_bowyery.description: The ability to make durable, effective bows.

prof_fletching.name: Fletching
prof_fletching.description: The skill involved in making arrows that fly true.

prof_pottery_glazing.name: Pottery Glazing
prof_pottery_glazing.description: Adding glazes to pottery to make them waterproof.

prof_plasticworking.name: Plastic Working
prof_plasticworking.description: Working with plastic using your hands, including carving, molding, and gluing it.  You know how to identify thermoplastics that are suitable for mold casting, and how to identify the right plastic for the right job.

prof_carving.name: Carving
prof_carving.description: Shaping wood, bone, and similar materials with a cutting implement.

prof_gem_setting.name: Gem Setting
prof_gem_setting.description: How to add gemstones to jewelry.

prof_handloading.name: Handloading
prof_handloading.description: You know how to accurately measure powder and projectile weights for reloading firearm cartridges.

prof_appliance_repair.name: General Appliance Repair
prof_appliance_repair.description: A base knowledge of how to put together and take apart common appliances, diagnose problems, and replace parts.

prof_articulation.name: Joint Articulation
prof_articulation.description: Making flexible items out of hard materials is tricky.  You've done enough of it to understand how to make smoothly articulated joints out of rigid or semi-rigid materials.

prof_closures.name: Garment Closures
prof_closures.description: You are familiar with the adjustments and tricks needed to make properly functional buttons, zippers, and other closures on garments.

prof_closures_waterproofing.name: Fabric Waterproofing
prof_closures_waterproofing.description: You know how to make garments and fabric containers sealed against water.

prof_elastics.name: Stretch Fabric
prof_elastics.description: Making elastic bands is easy enough, but making a whole garment from stretchy cloth takes a bit of finesse.  You're good at it.

prof_cobbling.name: Cobbling
prof_cobbling.description: Like a magical elf, you've learned how to construct footwear by hand.

prof_spinning.name: Spinning
prof_spinning.description: The art of spinning fiber into thread.

prof_weaving.name: Weaving
prof_weaving.description: You've learned how to use a loom to produce sheets of fabric from thread.

prof_millinery.name: Millinery
prof_millinery.description: Like a solitary mouse, you've learned how to construct hats by hand.

prof_knitting.name: Skilled Knitting
prof_knitting.description: Knitting, one of the oldest ways of making loops in fiber until it is fabric.

prof_knitting_speed.name: Speed Knitting
prof_knitting_speed.description: You have knitted and knitted and knitted some more, and have the consistent string tension to show for it.  When you get going, the clicking of your needles is like a metronome.

prof_leatherworking_basic.name: Principles of Leatherworking
prof_leatherworking_basic.description: You've got a basic familiarity with how to work with leather, furs, hides, and similar materials.

prof_leatherworking.name: Skilled Leatherworking
prof_leatherworking.description: Working with leather requires a specific set of skills and tools… a set you are familiar with.

prof_furriery.name: Furriery
prof_furriery.description: Working with fur and faux fur is a skill all its own.

prof_chitinworking.name: Chitinworking
prof_chitinworking.description: It seems unlikely that anyone prior to the Cataclysm knew how to work with the shells of giant bugs as well as you do now.

prof_chain_armour.name: Chain Garments
prof_chain_armour.description: Turning sheets of chain links into effective, wearable clothing that doesn't bind up.

prof_polymerworking.name: Advanced Polymer Sewing
prof_polymerworking.description: You know the tricks for working with Kevlar, Nomex, and other advanced polymer cloth.

prof_quilting.name: Fabric Quilting
prof_quilting.description: You know how to sew stacks of sheets together efficiently to create sturdier armor.  It's also a nice way to sew something pretty!

prof_lockpicking.name: Lockpicking
prof_lockpicking.description: You know how to pick a lock, at least in theory.

prof_lockpicking_expert.name: Locksmith
prof_lockpicking_expert.description: You can pick a lock in the dark, blindfolded.  Although that doesn't make it all that much harder.  You're good at locks, OK?

prof_safecracking.name: Safecracking
prof_safecracking.description: Opening safes is an exacting skill, one that you are proficient at.

prof_traps.name: Principles of Trapping
prof_traps.description: You know the basics of setting and taking down traps safely.

prof_trapsetting.name: Trap Setting
prof_trapsetting.description: You're specifically quite skilled at setting effective traps.

prof_disarming.name: Trap Disarming
prof_disarming.description: You know how to take down a trap safely.

prof_spotting.name: Spotting and Awareness
prof_spotting.description: You are skilled at spotting things out of the ordinary, like traps or ambushes.

prof_helicopter_pilot.name: Helicopter Piloting
prof_helicopter_pilot.description: Before the Cataclysm, you were a helicopter pilot.  Now, you just hope you can fly again.

prof_boat_pilot.name: Boat Piloting
prof_boat_pilot.description: You're familiar with the control and operation of marine vehicles, like boats.

prof_driver.name: Driving
prof_driver.description: You're comfortable with the basic controls of cars, and land vehicles in general.

prof_debug_weakpoint.name: Debug Weakpoint
prof_debug_weakpoint.description: Basic improvement on the chance of hitting the Weakpoint Monster's weak points.

prof_debug_weakpoint_expert.name: Expert Debug Weakpoint
prof_debug_weakpoint_expert.description: Expert improvement on the chance of hitting the Weakpoint Monster's weak points.

prof_wp_zombie.name: Principles of Zombie Biology
prof_wp_zombie.description: Very basic familiarity with various types of undead creatures.

prof_wp_demihuman.name: Principles of Near Human Biology
prof_wp_demihuman.description: Very basic familiarity with various types of demihuman creatures.

prof_wp_amalgamation.name: Anatomy of Amalgamations
prof_wp_amalgamation.description: You are familiar with the common anatomy of these purpose-built abominations, as far as they have one.

prof_wp_syn_armored.name: Synthetic Armors
prof_wp_syn_armored.description: Understanding of man-made armors and ways to exploit them.  You're able to find openings in certain kinds of body armor.

prof_wp_nat_armored.name: Natural Armors
prof_wp_nat_armored.description: You're somewhat familiar with naturally armored creatures.  You're able to find openings in certain kinds of hardened shells and thick hides.

prof_wp_cyborg.name: Cyborg Anatomy
prof_wp_cyborg.description: You're somewhat familiar with cybernetic creatures.  You're able to find openings and gaps that aren't as hardened.

prof_wp_basic_amphibian.name: Amphibian Biology
prof_wp_basic_amphibian.description: Basic familiarity with various types of frogs and salamanders.

prof_wp_basic_bird.name: Bird Biology
prof_wp_basic_bird.description: Basic familiarity with various types of birds.

prof_wp_canine.name: Canine Anatomy
prof_wp_canine.description: Basic familiarity with the anatomy of various canines.

prof_wp_ungulate.name: Ungulate Anatomy
prof_wp_ungulate.description: Basic familiarity with the anatomy of various ungulates.

prof_wp_bear.name: Bear Anatomy
prof_wp_bear.description: You are familiar with the anatomy of bears and ways of putting them down easier.

prof_wp_basic_bug.name: Invertebrate Biology
prof_wp_basic_bug.description: Basic familiarity with various types of insects, arachnids, and worms.

prof_wp_beetle.name: Beetle Anatomy
prof_wp_beetle.description: You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated beetles - bypassing their thick armor should be easier.

prof_wp_centipede.name: Centipede Anatomy
prof_wp_centipede.description: You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated centipedes, letting you target their less-deadly parts with ease.

prof_wp_hymenoptera.name: Hymenopteran Anatomy
prof_wp_hymenoptera.description: Familiarity with the comparative anatomy of mutant Hymenopterans - ants, bees, and wasps of all kinds.  You find it easier to exploit their weak points, and possibly disable their natural weaponry.

prof_wp_spider.name: Arachnid Anatomy
prof_wp_spider.description: You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated spiders of all shapes and sizes.

prof_wp_flying.name: Creatures of Flight
prof_wp_flying.description: Basic understanding of what's needed for certain creatures to fly, as well as ways of preventing it.

prof_wp_skeleton.name: Ossified Exoskeletons
prof_wp_skeleton.description: You're familiar with creatures presenting unsettling bones on their outer structure.

prof_wp_child.name: Small Humanoids
prof_wp_child.description: You have some practice in fighting small humanoids like children.  You don't necessarily feel good about it.

prof_wp_hulk.name: Giant Humanoids
prof_wp_hulk.description: You have some practice in fighting large, hulking humanoids.  You're better at reaching certain weak points.

prof_wp_netherium_abomination.name: Netherium Abominations
prof_wp_netherium_abomination.description: You have extensive experience with netherium abominations which provides you with a vague sense of where more vulnerable spots might be.

prof_wp_mi-go_basic.name: Mi-go basic anatomy
prof_wp_mi-go_basic.description: You have studied mi-go sufficiently to get a sense for where some sensitive points might be.  However, its biology remains too different from life originating on Earth to be understood to any extent.

prof_wp_mi-go_advanced.name: Mi-go detailed anatomy
prof_wp_mi-go_advanced.description: Your understanding of the mi-go body is advanced enough to have a decent idea of where it is more sensitive to harm.  This does not mean you have any significant understanding of how it works internally; if anything, your dissections have just left you more confused.

prof_wp_fungaloid_basic.name: Fungaloid basic anatomy
prof_wp_fungaloid_basic.description: You have studied fungaloids sufficiently to get an idea of which parts are the more sensitive ones.  While seeming to be a weird mixture of fungus and animal, it at least has a structure with commonalities between different types of fungaloids.

prof_wp_fungaloid_advanced.name: Fungaloid detailed anatomy
prof_wp_fungaloid_advanced.description: You have advanced your understanding of the fungaloid body sufficiently to have a pretty good idea of where you can harm it and where it's better protected.  You don't really understand it's biological functions, although it seems it would be possible for someone with much more time than you have to glean some insight into it, but you've gotten an understanding of how to hurt it, and that's what's important here.

prof_wp_power_leech_basic.name: Power leech basic anatomy
prof_wp_power_leech_basic.description: Your observations of the power leech anatomy is starting to pay off.  You now have a basic idea of where their more sensitive structures are located.  These creatures exhibit traits that seem to be a mix between animal and plant ones.

prof_wp_power_leech_advanced.name: Power leech detailed anatomy
prof_wp_power_leech_advanced.description: The extensive experience with power leeches have given you a good understanding of their weaknesses and strengths.  A rather different set of skills would be needed to actually understand their biology, though, and you probably don't have the time to study that anyway.

prof_wp_triffid_basic.name: Triffid basic anatomy
prof_wp_triffid_basic.description: Study of triffids has given you insights into their anatomy that allows you to aim for some weak spots.

prof_wp_triffid_advanced.name: Triffid detailed anatomy
prof_wp_triffid_advanced.description: Extensive study of triffids has provided you with a good understanding of their strengths and weaknesses when it comes to combat.  A scientific study of them might yield further biological insights, but you don't have the time to spend years cooped up in a lab.

prof_fibers.name: Fiber Twisting
prof_fibers.description: You've got a basic grasp of the theory of how to twist and arrange fibers into a more durable cord.

prof_fibers_rope.name: Ropemaking
prof_fibers_rope.description: Making twisted fibers into durable and useful rope.

prof_tanning_basic.name: Basic Tanning
prof_tanning_basic.description: You're familiar with the theory behind turning raw hides into leather.

prof_tanning.name: Skilled Tanning
prof_tanning.description: You have a lot of practice and experience with processing hides to leather, as well as related techniques like making boiled leather.

prof_bow_basic.name: Archer's Form
prof_bow_basic.description: You have grasped some basic understanding on archery, and find handling bows easier.

prof_bow_expert.name: Archer's Form (Expert)
prof_bow_expert.description: After significant practice, you have become experienced in the movements used in drawing and firing a bow, and have strengthened those muscles considerably.

prof_bow_master.name: Archer's Form (Master)

fault_gun_blackpowder.name: Blackpowder fouling
fault_gun_blackpowder.description: Firing blackpowder loads from a gun fouls it, which reduces reliability and, if left uncleaned, leads to rust.  It fouls the gun much faster than the use of modern smokeless powder cartridges.  Fouling is only a significant impact on reliability at high levels, but black powder fouling accumulates quickly.

fault_gun_unlubricated.name: Unlubricated
fault_gun_unlubricated.description: Either this gun is brand new and came without lubrication or it was recently cleaned with a solvent without oiling afterwards.  Either way, it's not lubricated and will not cycle properly, and can even be damaged.

fault_gun_dirt.name: Fouling
fault_gun_dirt.description: Fouling is caused by firing gunpowder loads repeatedly, which reduces reliability and can eventually cause damage to the gun.  Fouling accumulates slowly (unless blackpowder is used) due to the design of modern smokeless powder found in the vast majority of retail cartridges and it is not a significant problem until high levels of fouling are reached due to firing thousands of rounds without cleaning your firearm.

fault_overheat_venting.name: Emergency venting

fault_overheat_forced_safety.name: Overheat Protection

Risk of delirium tremens.

Strength - 1;   Perception - 1;   Dexterity - 1;
Depression and physical pain to some degree.  Frequent cravings.  Vomiting.

Strength - 1;   Intelligence - 1;
Movement rate reduction.  Depression.  Weak immune system.  Frequent cravings.

mutagen.description: You've gotten a taste for mutating and the chemicals that cause it.  But you can stop, yeah, any time you want.

ROBOFAC_ROBOT_SMALL.info: A small drone sold by Hub 01.

VOLTMETER.info: This tool can test for voltage.

SUNBURN_SUPERNATURAL.info: You burn in the sunlight like a vampire.  Probably because you're a vampire.

SUNBURN_SUPERNATURAL_REDUCTION.info: You burn in the sunlight like a vampire, but not quite as badly.

DISTRIBUTED_DAMAGE.info: Damage you take is split evenly between your limbs

SINGLE_USE.info: This item is removed after use.

BIONIC_FUEL_SOURCE.info: Contents of this item are used for fueling bionics.

AFS_CS_EXOBAY_CARD.info: ID card granting access to the crashing ship's exobay.

PAPR_BLOWER.info: This item functions as a powered air purifying respirator blower.

OLD_GUN.info: An old gun, WWII or earlier.

ETHEREAL.info: You feel like you would keep all your items if you somehow became incorporeal.

CLIMB_FLYING.info: You can ascend straight up even with no physical surface to climb on.

HERITAGE.info: You have nonhuman ancestry or are not human

BLOCK_HUGE_ATTACKS.info: You are capable of blocking attacks from targets of any size

SUFFOCATION_IMMUNE.info: You are immune to being crowd-crushed

INHALED_TOXIN_IMMUNE.info: You are immune to gaseous toxins

INFECTION_RECOVERY.info: You have greater odds to recover from infections (equivalent to taking antibiotics)

TREE_COMMUNION_PLUS.info: You gain greatly enhanced effects from the Mycorrhizal Communion mutation

ROOTS3.info: The character has extensive roots, which helps with the TREE_COMMUNION mutation.

VINE_RAPPEL.info: The character can use vines to safely rappel down sheer drops.

ANIMALDISCORD.info: The character is disliked by natural animals.

ANIMALDISCORD2.info: The character is intensely disliked by natural animals.

ANIMALEMPATH.info: The character is liked by natural animals.

TRUE_SEEING.info: The character can see through CAMOUFLAGE, NIGHT_INVISIBILITY, or the invisibility effect.

SUPPRESS_INVISIBILITY.info: If you're invisible, now you're not

PAUSE_INFECTIONS.info: Prevents all infections from progressing to death, though does not relieve symptoms

PAUSE_BODYPART_INFECTION.info: Prevents infection on a bodypart with this flag from progressing to death, though does not relieve symptoms

ANIMALEMPATH2.info: The character is intensely liked by natural animals.

UNRESTRICTED.info: This clothing is able to <info>accommodate even mutated anatomy</info>.

LIXA_SCIENCE_CARD.info: This grants access to the LIXA facility.

LIXA_SCIENCE_CARD_2.info: This grants access to the experiment chamber of the LIXA facility.

LIXA_SCIENCE_CARD_3.info: This grants access to the experiment chamber and PPE lockup for the LIXA facility.

LIXA_MILITARY_CARD.info: This grants access to locked-down areas of the LIXA facility.

DECAYS_IN_AIR.info: This will eventually <bad>go bad</bad> if left in the open air too long.

IRRITANT_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>skin irritants</info>.

ITEM_WATERPROOFING.info: Something is preventing your worn and carried items from being effected by water.

WATERWALKING.info: You can walk across the surface of water.

CRAFT_IN_DARKNESS.info: You can craft at 100% speed in any level of light.

CHIP.name: Chip
CHIP.info: A paint chipper can be used to remove paint from this.

DIGGABLE.name: Diggable
DIGGABLE.info: A hole can be dug here.

SUPPORTS_ROOF.name: Supports roof
SUPPORTS_ROOF.info: A roof can be built above this without other support.

MWS_PORTAL_STORM_DATA.name: Odd recordings
MWS_PORTAL_STORM_DATA.info: This ongoing report has a series of odd recordings, as if the instruments malfunctioned.

ROBOFAC_ARM.info: This item is a Hub 01 ARM exoskeleton.  It requires an implanted XM-ARM interface to function.

ROBOFAC_LEG.info: This item is a Hub 01 LEG exoskeleton.  It requires an implanted XM-LEG interface to function.

ROBOFAC_BACK.info: This item is a Hub 01 BACK exoskeleton.  It requires an implanted XM-LEG interface and it must be worn with ARM and LEG exoskeletons to function.

ROBOFAC_LENS_ACCESSORY.info: This item is an accessory for a Hub 01 LENS helmet, and can only be worn with that helmet.

ROBOFAC_LENS_HELMET.info: This item allows you to wear Hub 01 LENS accessories.

CANNOT_GAIN_WEARINESS.info: You have a seemingly inexhaustible supply of energy.

ALTERNATOR.info: When mounted on an engine and the engine is on it will provide up to <color_green>%dW</color> of electrical power to the vehicle.

AISLE.info: You can move through this vehicle frame without being slowed down.

AISLE_LIGHT.info: A bright light that illuminates several squares inside the vehicle.

ARMOR.info: Armor plate.  Will partially protect other components on the same frame from damage from direct attacks but not from the shock damage of a distant collision.

BELTABLE.info: You can install a seat belt or five part harness here to help keep you in your seat during a collision.

CABLE_PORTS.info: You can connect electrical cables to this part.

CTRL_ELECTRONIC.info: You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the electronic controls.  If there are vehicle controls installed in the same spot, you can also use the vehicle control key (default '^').

CONTROLS.info: With a seat or saddle, you drive from here.  You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the controls, or use the vehicle control key (default '^').

EOC_ACTIVATION.info: Enables an associated EOC to be triggered from the vehicle control menu.

SMART_ENGINE_CONTROLLER.info: When active, turns engines on and off automatically.

COVERED.info: Illuminated items in this space will not illuminate nearby squares.

CURTAIN.info: Closed, it prevents people from seeing through the curtain.  A door motor allows you to remotely open or close it from the vehicle controls.

DOOR.info: When open, this part lets you move from inside the vehicle to outside or vice versa.  When closed, it prevents people from entering or leaving the vehicle.

ENABLED_DRAINS_EPOWER.info: When turned on, this device drains <color_red>%dW</color> from the vehicle's batteries.

SOLAR_PANEL.info: Provides up to <color_green>%dW</color> of electrical power to the vehicle when exposed to the sun.  Weather and clouds will affect power generation.

ENGINE.info: Provides motive power to move the vehicle if the vehicle has sufficient wheels.  Requires controls to turn on.  If it drains power, also requires a charged battery to start.

E_ALTERNATOR.info: An alternator can be attached, and it will generate electrical power while the engine is on at the cost of some motive power.

EXTRA_DRAG.info: When turned on, it will stop the vehicle unless it has a strong engine.

FLOATS.info: Each boat hull will reduce the draft of your vehicle and increase the height sealed against water.  If the draft is less than the sealed height, your vehicle will float if placed in water.

FRAGILE_COMPONENTS.info: Some components of this part are <color_red>fragile</color> and might be damaged even if the part itself isn't.

FURNITURE_TIEDOWN.info: You can tie down a furniture here.

FURNITURE_LIFT_ASSIST.info: It's much easier to tie down a furniture here.

NO_LEAK.info: Causes a boat hull to float even when damaged.

NONBELTABLE.info: There's no place to attach a seat belt, so you get thrown from the vehicle in a crash.

ROOF.info: Keeps the rain out of the interior of the vehicle.

SEAT.info: You need to be in a seat or saddle to operate vehicle controls.

ENHANCED_VISION.info: Can be used to <color_cyan>scout things far away</color> when seated.

SEATBELT.info: This part will help prevent you from being thrown from the vehicle in a collision.  You will automatically enable this part when you move into a tile with it.

SHOCK_ABSORBER.info: Armor plate.  Will partially protect other components on the same frame from the shock damage of a distant collision but not from direct attacks.

STABLE.info: If your vehicle consists of a single tile, this wheel is enough to allow it to move.

UNSTABLE_WHEEL.info: This wheel requires another wheel to be installed to be functional.

STEERABLE.info: Your vehicle needs at least one set of steerable wheels to turn.

TURRET.info: This weapon is mounted in a turret.  It can be fired from the vehicle controls.

WHEEL.info: If the center of balance of your vehicle is between all the wheels, the vehicle will be able to move, provided it has an active engine or motor with enough power to move the vehicle.

WIND_TURBINE.info: Provides <color_green>%dW</color> of electrical power to the vehicle for every 1 m/s of wind the vehicle is exposed to.

WATER_WHEEL.info: Provides up to <color_green>%dW</color> of electrical power to the vehicle when built over shallow moving water.

FLAT_SURF.info: This has a flat surface.  It would be a nice place to eat.

CARGO_LOCKING.info: Attached to a suitable cargo space, it will prevent other people from accessing the cargo and taking your stuff.

DOOR_LOCKING.info: Attached to a door or a hatch, it can be used to lock it.

CAPTURE_MONSTER_VEH.info: You can 'e'xamine it to capture an animal next to you, or to release the animal currently contained.  When selecting an animal to capture, choose its tile relative to you, not the part.

CIRCLE_LIGHT.info: A bright light that <color_yellow>illuminates a circular area</color> outside the vehicle when turned on.

CONE_LIGHT.info: A bright, directed light that <color_yellow>illuminates a narrow cone</color> outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light.

E_DIESEL_FUEL.info: Burns diesel or JP8 fuel from a tank in the vehicle.  Can also burn biodiesel or kerosene, though somewhat less efficiently.

FLUIDTANK.info: If filled with the <color_light_red>appropriate fuel</color> for the vehicle's engine, the engine will automatically draw fuel from the tank when the engine is on.  If filled with <color_light_blue>water</color>, you can access the water from a water faucet, if one is installed in the vehicle.  You can also use a rubber hose to siphon liquids out of a tank.

HALF_CIRCLE_LIGHT.info: A bright, directed light that <color_yellow>illuminates a half-circular area</color> outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light.

HEATED_TANK.info: When turned on, it will <color_light_cyan>prevent the content from freezing</color>.

HORN.info: Use the vehicle controls and select the honk option to make noise.

LOCKABLE_DOOR.info: This can be locked if equipped with a locking mechanism, preventing access from outside the vehicle.

MWS.info: This part functions as a mobile weather station.

ADVANCED_MWS.info: This part functions as an advanced mobile weather station.

VEH_TOOLS.info: You can 'e'xamine the tile to <color_cyan>connect tools</color> to the vehicle's batteries and tanks.

WIDE_CONE_LIGHT.info: A bright, directed light that <color_yellow>illuminates a wide cone</color> outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light.

CARGO_PASSABLE.info: Items stored here won't get in the way of any passengers.

HUGE_OK.info: Even when roofed, this part is roomy enough to comfortably admit very large creatures, like cows and horses.

NEED_LEG.info: Operating this part will require at least one working leg.

INOPERABLE_SMALL.info: People who are very short may be unable to make use of this part.

NL_BOILER.info: This part functions as a boiler from the nether.

<CHANGING_FAILED>: You feel a shift in your body, but it quickly reverts.
Your flesh has taken on an impatient wriggling sensation.
Your skin feels like wax.  Or wet clay.
You feel as though you're on the cusp of something, if you just give it a bit more time…
Your vision swims.  You feel dizzy.
It won't be long now.  Your innards flex and twist in anticipatory contortions.
<CHANGING_SUCCESS>: You begin to feel a sickeningly beautiful ache, the feeling of your cells tearing apart and recombining in strange new patterns.
Your body is slowly reshaping itself!
Every muscle you have begins to minutely spasm and cramp as your body starts morphing, slowly, in unearthly new ways.
You feel your chest wriggle and begin to palpitate.  Here we go.
Tiny ripples begin appearing in your skin and radiating outward like waves.  It is indescribably uncomfortable.
<CHANGING_ENDS>: You can palpably feel the churning sensation within fade, your mutation cut short by a lack of nutrients.
The strain of mutation fades, leaving a throbbing sensation like a bad headache.  Or an afterglow.
You're pulled back to reality as your body stops warping, leaving you in your current state for the time being.
Your mutation abruptly ends from a lack of nutrients.  Back to Earth for now.

Shadow_Warnings_Snippets_early:
Even out here you can still see the burning cities lighting up the horizon.  What scares you most is not the gunshots you sometimes hear in the far distance, but the idea of what people keep shooting at.  Tonight you hear automatic gunfire winding down into single shots.

Just what could make them shoot that much, all the way out here?

You suddenly realize this area seems almost devoid of life.  The few bits of blackened grass you can see are barely recognizable as grass, even discounting the night.  Sure the zombies might be tearing people apart, but what happened to the grass?  What, is the grass coming to life to eat people too?
You snort at the idea, but it doesn't feel safe out here.
You have a vague feeling of being watched.
Your ears perk up as something rustles, but it just turns out to be unnaturally withered and blackened vegetation you stepped on.  Wait, this can not have happened on its own.
The night feels longer than usual.
You suddenly yearn for a beautiful sunrise.
The wind faintly cries into the night.
Shadow_Warnings_Snippets_late: The nights are mostly calm and lonely nowadays, but you could almost swear it's been getting darker since the Cataclysm.  Every once in a while you feel like the darkness is creeping up on you when you turn your back.
The wind sure is howling tonight.  It almost sounds like something is out there.  Out here.  With you.

In the distance you think you saw something …skitter?  Crawl?  It didn't move like anything you've seen before.  Whatever it was, it's probably a bad idea to let it surprise you in unfamiliar terrain in the darkness.
You gut tells you that something is right around the corner.
You narrowly avoid stepping into a black tangle of withered, blackened vegetation.  A trail of weird soot leads away from it.
The night feels like it is dragging on for eternity.
You suddenly long for a bright and beautiful morning, almost as in desperation.
Suddenly, there are some vague, but threatening shapes in the distance you do not recognize.
For a moment, the wind picks up and whistles an eerie song.
Reclaimer_Warnings_Snippets: Some of the nearby gore shake for a moment.
The zombie you just killed twitches once, then stops.
You could swear the splattered zombie blood puddles inched towards each other.
A small chunk of meat emerges from the ground before sinking back into it.
The ground shakes a little, as if something was waiting beneath you.
You hear a faint sound from below as you kill this zombie.
You hear a noise akin to someone punching a wall from nearby.
hint: Squirrels are pretty yummy, but if you shoot them with a high-powered gun you'll probably be left with no meat!  Use a BB gun or maybe a .22 rifle.
Squirrels really ain't such a bad snack if you don't blast them all to hell.
Ever run into those big worm things?  If you see trails of churned-up dirt, you can be sure they're around.
Try to stay on the roads as much as you can.  Giant worms can't cross them!
Don't relax after killing a giant worm.  Little bits of them can break off and still attack!
If you see a big mob of zombies coming, RUN!  Trying to fight them all is impossible unless you have a big tactical advantage.
If you see a big mob of zombies coming, you better run.  Trying to fight them all is suicide!
When you see a swarm of zombies coming it's time to run!
If you're getting chased by a horde of zombies, try ducking into the subways and traveling a block or two before coming back up.
Watch out for those zombies that shriek; they'll let other zombies know where you are, and will attract them from all over.
Those acid-spitting zombies are pretty nasty, but if you're smart, you can get other zombies to wade through the acid.
If there's a pool of acid blocking your way, trying tossing a junk item into it.  Eating up items will help neutralize the acid faster.

Rubber boots aren't as tough as combat boots and you don't run very fast in them.  But I've seen zombies vomiting puddles of acid, and I'd hate to have my feet melt off, so I'd consider having a pair of those.
There's this type of zombie that can shoot bolts of lightning!  Stay away from walls and stuff when they do… the electricity can travel along solid surfaces.
Zombie hulks are NASTY, but they're easy to outsmart.  If there's other monsters between you and them, they'll kill the monster for you!

If you run into a zombie hulk, it's probably a good idea to run.  They're fast as hell, but pretty dumb; they'll try to smash through obstacles rather than going around, and that slows them down a lot.

Zombie brutes and hulks have really tough hide, but skeletal juggernauts with their bone plates are the worst.  Don't bother shooting at them with lower-caliber guns, the bullet will bounce right off!
Try not to kill a boomer if it's standing right next to you.  They tend to explode when they die, and that pink goop will get all over you.
Skeletons are a tough target for a gun.  They're so skinny and full of holes that it's hard to make a good hit.  And those big ones are hard as nails too.

Small skeletons are too delicate to smash through doors or windows.  Big ones can walk in through a wall.  At least they can't smell you, unlike zombies, so if you turn your light off at night you can sneak right past.
Don't try to take on a skeleton with a bladed weapon… you'll just leave scratch marks.  You've got to shatter those bones with a hammer or something.
It's a good idea to butcher corpses if you have the time.  I've seen these weird zombies bring their friends back from the dead!

I have a buddy who was sleeping in this cabin way out in the woods, when he suddenly woke up to trees and vines growing right up through the floor and walls!  He said it was some kind of huge tree beast…
Oh man, have you gone down into the old subway systems?  I'd be careful… there's these things down there that are like zombies, but tougher.
There's snakes down in most of the old sewer systems.  They're slow on land, but boy, those suckers can swim fast!
If you're planning on wandering around the sewers--not that you'd have a reason too--watch out for those fish.  Those suckers are fast, and vicious too!
Ever go toe-to-toe with a manhack?  Tiny little helicopters covered in knives.  Best be packing a shotgun!
They're rare, but demining bots are nasty things.  They bore through the ground, then pop up to stab ya.  Still, you're safe from them if you stay on pavement…
Don't fire your gun if you can help it - the noise attracts monsters.  If you could get a silencer, or make one, it would give you some advantage.
Standing behind a window is a good tactic.  It takes zombies a long time to crawl through, giving you lots of opportunities to hit them.
Zombies are pretty dumb… heck, most monsters are!  If you can get a fire going between you and them, they'll just run straight through it.
I know it's tempting to just go full-auto and unload as many bullets as possible, but don't except as a last resort.  It's inaccurate and wastes ammo.
If there's a bunch of zombies in a straight line, try unloading a burst from your gun.  Be sure to aim at the zombie furthest away; you'll hit more of them that way.
If you shoot a zombie, but don't quite kill it, try to finish it off with a punch or something instead of wasting a bullet.
If you're in a corridor or something, and there's a bunch of zombies chasing you down it, try to wound the guy in front badly.  He'll start moving slow and cause a serious traffic jam!

Here's a trick for taking care of a huge swarm of zombies chasing you: head into a liquor store, shoot out as many bottles as you can, then light the alcohol on fire.  Then duck out the back door, and watch the zombies run into a burning building!
Sledge hammers may seem like a great weapon, but swinging them is really slow, and you won't do much damage unless you're really strong.
For a good melee weapon, you can't beat a machete.  I've seen a guy take down a zombie brute with one!  Of course, if you can find a katana, that might be even better…
A spike on a stick makes a good weapon in a pinch, but a spike strapped to a stick isn't the sturdiest construction.  At least you can strap the spike back on when it comes off.
You know, a glass bottle can make a good weapon in a pinch.  If you break it over someone's head, the shattering glass will hurt them extra.  Of course, it might hurt your hands, too…
You know what makes a nice weapon?  Take a plank, or a baseball bat or something, and stick a bunch of nails through the end!
BB guns may seem like a joke, but they've got their uses.  They're good for hunting small game, or getting to know the basics of rifles.
Crossbows are a great weapon for long term use.  Most of the time, you can retrieve the bolt after shooting it, so running out of ammo is less of a concern.
Consider going Robin Hood, if you have the strength to pull the string of a bow.  Those larger ones need significant muscle power, but they hit hard, and are silent.
I hid in a dumpster once or twice.  I may smell bad, but I'm not dead, as they say.
It's good to keep a pistol handy, in case your main gun runs out of ammo or something.  They're also better than most guns at short range.
Shotguns are nice; you can take out lots of baddies with a single shot.  Just remember that they're noisy as hell, and you might end up attracting more than you kill.
A good submachine gun can't be beat.  Most of them use common ammo, they're good at short and long range, and you can burst-fire if you need to!
Hunting rifles are great at long range, but suck close up.  Plus, most of them don't carry many rounds.  Keep a pistol as a sidearm if you use a rifle.
You know, you don't have to go full auto with an assault rifle.  Firing single shots is more accurate and efficient!
I wish we had laser guns like in those sci-fi stories.  They'd be the perfect weapon: quiet, accurate, and deadly.
When it comes to footwear, you've got two basic choices as far as I see it; sneakers, for running extra fast, or boots for durability.  Depends on your style, I guess.
You don't really need to wear gloves most of the time, but once in a while they'll really come in handy.
I wish I could still use those rollerblades.  I would be so fast.  But I took an arrow to the knee, and all that.
It's good to keep a filter mask or gas mask handy.  You never know when you'll have to go into a smoke-filled room or something.
There's basically no reason not to wear safety glasses… nothing is worse than taking a hit to the eyes and getting blinded for a few seconds.
Ski goggles are a great choice if you're worried about getting stuff in your eyes.  Perfect for dealing with boomers!

If you get a pair of night vision goggles, hold on to them!  A flashlight will give you away, but with goggles you can be sneaky.  Beware that some types of zombies are camouflaged against it, and require proper light to be visible.
I know they look dumb, but wearing a fanny pack gives you that extra bit of storage without encumbering you.
Backpacks let you carry lots of stuff, but they limit your movement a lot.  If you have to fight a zombie at close range, don't wear one, or at least drop it on the ground before the fight.
Don't underestimate a good book.  Not only will it keep you company on lonely nights, but you can learn a hell of a lot from some of them.
It's a good idea to carry around a couple of empty bottles.  You can fill them up with water, gasoline, or whatever!
First aid 101 for you.  Always bandage your wounds, they will heal faster that way.  Bandages are plenty and you can make makeshift ones easily, so there is no reason not to.
I can bandage you if you are wounded, so give me some spare bandages, if you have any.
If you have extra antiseptic, use it to disinfect your wounds, even if they aren't infected.  They will recover faster that way.
Treat your infected wounds as soon as possible.  If the infection spreads only antibiotics may help you, but it will take time, and you may still die from it if it's too serious.
If you need a bunch of rags for making Molotov cocktails, take a pair of scissors to an old t-shirt or something.
Carrying a lighter is something all veterans do.  It takes up almost no space, and can easily save your life.
If you can spare the space, you might want to carry a fire extinguisher along.  Nothing is worse than being trapped in a burning building!
Crowbars not only make a pretty good weapon, they're also useful for opening locked doors and lifting manhole covers.

If you're spending the night in an area you're not sure is safe, laying traps at the entrance(s) to the area you choose to sleep in could save your life by injuring and alerting you to any stragglers that find their way in.
A chainsaw may seem like a great weapon, but remember that they're slow, unwieldy, and very noisy.
Bubble wrap is pretty harmless, but setting it up around you before going to sleep will keep you from waking up to a zombie punching you.
Bear traps are a nice way to cover an escape.  If you place one in a doorway, the first zombie through will get stuck, and the rest won't be able to get past!
Smoke grenades aren't really offensive weapons, but they'll cover up your scent and hide you from view--perfect for making a quick escape.
Don't use Molotovs indoors.  Especially in a liquor store.
If you're going to be playing with Molotov cocktails around a gas station, just make sure you're a long way from those pumps.
I once knew a guy who figured he'd survive a night in the subway by setting fires blocking off the tunnel in both directions and sleeping between them.  He wound up asphyxiating on the smoke.
Don't light a Molotov until you're ready to throw it.  Not only can they go out, but if you accidentally drop it or something, you're in trouble.
If you're weak or clumsy, it might be a good idea not to mess with Molotovs or grenades.  Accidentally dropping them when you meant to throw them could be deadly.
If you're not particularly agile it might be good not to mess with Molotovs or grenades.  Accidents involving these sort of items tend to be grievous.
If you're wandering in the wilderness, or following a road, keep an eye out for wild strawberries, blueberries and other gifts of nature.
Be careful eating wild mushrooms.  Some are poisonous, and others can make you hallucinate.
Try to go around swamps, if you can.  Some of them have sinkholes that can pull you right underground.
I heard about this group that raided a bee hive a while ago.  Everyone got massacred but one, and he came home with this weird, magic honey stuff.
If you need to, you can swim across a river to escape; some monsters can't swim.  Just make sure you drop as much stuff as possible first, and maybe strip naked, or you'll sink like a rock.
Houses can be a surprisingly good resource for all kinds of stuff; clothing, medication, food, books, and more.  People kept all the odd things around, especially in basements.
While there's not much to loot, gas stations are a good source for gasoline, to power tools or to make Molotov cocktails.
It's not like in the movies; shooting a gas pump won't make it explode.  But it WILL make it leak all over the place, which is a definite fire hazard.
I know grocery stores and stuff are full of fruit, but be careful, it's probably rotten.
Next time you visit a grocery store, load up on canned goods.  They never go bad!
Load up on canned goods if you ever find a grocery store.  Cans never go bad!
I've found more good weapons in hardware stores than anywhere else.  Except gun stores, of course.
Liquor stores are a great place to pick up non-alcoholic beverages, too.  Not that I mind alcohol!
Most gun stores follow pretty similar layouts.  The restricted stuff - SMGs, assault rifles, and most importantly ammo - are always behind the counter.
I've spent many nights in the changing rooms at the back of clothing stores.  Walls on four sides, far from the store's entrance, a corridor for easy defense… it's perfect!
Have you seen those weird science labs out in the middle of nowhere?  I think you need some kind of special ID card to get in.
I have a dream of raiding a military bunker, but zombies and armor are a scary mix.  And the sheer thought of being sprayed with bullets by a turret is giving me the shivers.
I've thought about raiding an ant hill before, but I realized it wasn't worth the risk.  I doubt they have any loot beyond some scraps of food, you know?
This guy I know was walking through the subway when he came across a giant rift in the earth, with lava far below.  Weird, huh?
In a lot of places, there's little hallways connecting the subways with the sewers, with heavy metal doors on both ends.  It's a perfect place to sleep!
Be careful of drinking water from rivers and stuff, it's a good way to get sick.  But if you have a water purifier, it'll make it safe.
Autodocs are probably your best bet to install bionics - if you can find one!  However, I heard they won't work if you don't bring anesthetics to put you in a sleep.
Be wary of anything deeper than your average basement.  Some folks heard scary screams from the ventilation shafts of mines and labs.  Very unsettling screams.
A screwdriver a day keeps the scurvy away!
Hungrier than usual?  Natural oils can help.  Not tasty at all, but who cares when eating your leg is the second option?
Terrain can turn the tide of a battle.  Make sure you use it against your enemies, lest it be used against you.
Folks that passed by the mine said something about foul smell.  If you plan a visit there consider taking a gas mask with you.
Knowledge is power.  Seriously, just pick up a book.
Knowledge is power.  And books are power you can read.
Knowledge is power.  But not every book you find contains true knowledge.
Some days are full of sadness.  Reading can help, if you have the right book.
Nothing can kill you if everything is already dead.  Well, except cold, hunger, and… never mind.
I met a girl that insisted that she saw a land shark boring through rock, walls, and dirt alike.  I'd consider it a fable, but I've seen things, and can't just say it's a lie.
Boil first, then drink.  Ten men caravan once drank from a spring, and they are now known as a three man caravan.
I've once seen a full duffel bag pass hands five times in a week.  Having a lot of stuff is a moot point if you can't run from zombies.
Tim says you can drive a car through a horde of zombies.  Tim is now a zombie.  Any questions?
They said: go solar, save the environment and yourself.  Well… there is no environment to save now, but one can still save thyself I guess.
What's the difference between a good and a bad choke point?  The good one has another back door behind you.
You'd be surprised how many items can be disassembled into their components.  A guy around here, McSomething whatever his name is, is a master at this.
A soldering iron can be an aspiring mechanic's best friend.
I'm fed up with smoked meat, but it lasts so long.  Well… if I had more heart for learning cooking I guess I'd be able to diversify my food without sacrificing its shelf life.
Tricky Joe was hanged for his inventive ways of killing zombies.  Yeah, burning down a building to smoke few hordes is ok, but burning a whole town with all the loot certainly is not.

Mr. Tombstone always said: take nothing with you for the raids, save the space for loot.  He was known as Joe then and he rightfully earned his nickname as the first tombstone 'owner' around this place.
When the whole town is one big supermarket, a shopping cart becomes your best friend.
A friend is a second mouth to fill, but when it comes to work four hands are always better than two.
I was against drugs until I was almost killed by a zombie.  I was hauling my sorry ass away from the horde, with nothing more but some white powder I got from that zombie.  Saved me that time.
I knew an elementary school teacher who had to fight his way out of school.  He had to kill a dozen crazed children.  I can't imagine what that does to a person.
A thought about explosives: If you can still run, and the explosive hasn't detonated yet, run some more.  No amount of caution is excessive when handling a grenade.
Avoid using launchers in narrow hallways, you might miss.
Met a mad chemist once.  She made a battery from a potato… or was it lemon?
Met a mad chemist once.  She made a battery from a potato, and then nobody was willing to eat the potato.
Is it dead yet?  How can you tell if it was dead before and it's dead now?  I prefer asking: are?  *smash*  you?  *smash*  dead?  *smash*  yet?  *smash smash smash*
I hear there's strange big berries around, but why don't I hear first hand if they are filling for their size or not?
I've heard of a gang called The Doctors.  You know, bank robbers wearing stethoscopes.  What are they trying to achieve?  I use paper money to start fires now.
You can hole up on a roof if you need to.  Yeah, the rain will fall on your head, but it's harder for the dead to get you there.  Get a tent, a rollmat, a sleeping bag and you're set.

I thought about putting a bag on my dog to carry some of my stuff.  It didn't work, because it was a chihuahua, and it was eaten by a rottweiler.  Should have put some Kevlar on it like those Z9.  Oh well…
Stuff from zombies is filthy but perfectly fine otherwise.  Using soap or other detergents won't hurt you.  Quick wash and you're equipped for days.

Civilization has made a step back in time, so let's learn from the past.  No fridges?  Build a root cellar or keep food cool in the basement.  No guns?  Make a pointy stick or a cudgel, and work from there.  The end of the world is not the end, it seems.
Hey, if you happen to find a set of two two-way radios, give one to me and we will be able to talk while being away from each other.
If I had the skill to do it, I'd build a boat and sail down the river.  Maybe even towards the ocean.  Or make an amphibious vehicle that could drive on land too.  That would be useful.
I sink like a rock in water, but I once used a scuba tank to cross a river that had no bridge nearby.
Can you imagine?  I've heard of people digging graves for loot.  Whole cities lay dead for the taking and they dig graves!  Madness!

When I broke a leg few years ago they had this great machine at the hospital that set the bones in place.  I'd hate to break a limb in this apocalypse, but it's something to remember.  You never know.
You, me, and another pair of hands and we might even think of settling down.  Making a base of our own.  A bastion of hope in the apocalypse.  Think of it.
Hey if you are leading, just tell me what to do.  You want me to shoot, go melee, use grenades?  I can adjust to your style of fighting.
Everything seems to mutate nowadays.  Even survivors.  I wonder if I would look good with bunny ears?  Would I hear better?
Everything seems to mutate nowadays.  Even survivors.  Do you think I'd still look good if I had piranha teeth?
Everything seems to mutate nowadays.  Even survivors.  You think I'd look good with thorns growing from my face?
Everything seems to mutate nowadays.  Even survivors.  If my eyeballs began shooting lasers do you think I would still be able see?
Everything seems to mutate nowadays.  Even survivors.  I wonder how I would look with antlers?  Hats would be out of the question…
Winter is a harsh lady.  You need fire to survive, to heat yourself and your water and food.  Keep a cooking device to melt what is frozen, and a thermos for the liquids.
There is not much gas left for the vehicles.  If I'd plan for the long run, I'd consider learning about steam engines, or maybe making biodiesel.

Heard a rumor that few cities were evacuated to a place that's not on the maps.  Tough luck finding them now.  But perhaps they don't want to be found.  Or worse - perhaps you don't know that you don't want to find them either, if you catch my drift.

Heard a rumor about a lady on rollerblades with a fire extinguisher strapped to her back.  Zipping around, hardly wearing no clothes, smashing cannibals in the face with a baseball bat.  Don't that beat all?

Ok, some weird shit now.  Before we met I saw a knight.  No, I'm fine under the hood.  A guy in a full medieval armor was cornered by some zombies.  Much to be said, but half an hour later, he was still alive.  Guess you can take a punch being a walking tin can.
If you're into electronics, you may try to make a noise emitter from a talking doll, or something that has a speaker.  Why?  To distract the zombies, of course.

A friend of mine was a hunter and showed me once how to butcher properly.  You need a flat clean surface to place the products, a rack to hang the carcass in the air, and a good knife.  If you're in a forest you may use a tree and a rope.  Big game might require a saw too.
A friend of mine was a hunter and told me, that if you field dress a corpse, it will stay fresh a bit longer.

Look at the sky before you go for adventure.  You will know what weather to expect.  It's nothing compared to the old meteorology and satellite pictures, but at least you may know if you need the umbrella.
Be extra careful on roads.  They are easy to travel on, but occasional road blocks can make you feel sorry in an instant.

I know it's not best of times, but try to sleep well.  You're not yourself if you're sleep deprived.  Grab a pillow and a blanket.  If you can't, even a teddy bear under your head and a pile of clothes to keep you warm can make a difference.  And pick a spot well, even a chair or a bench is better than a cold ground.
There's no rule against wearing more than one set of pants.  Well, I mean, there probably is, but nothing stopping you from breaking it!

There are two ways of throwing grenades.  The smart one is throwing from behind a corner.  The less smart one involves getting shot while throwing in the open and being torn apart by the resulting explosion.
<ANCILLA_barkeep_suggestion>: Ahh but if you want suggestions and are one for craft beers, I certainly suggest having some old world brew before it all goes flat or sour.
Speaking off, Cranberry here brought me a whole cask of Cabernet a few days ago.  So if red wines are your thing I can offer that by the gallon.
Just bought some of this new "Free Whiskey" from the caravaneer up above.  It's vile if you ask me, but it packs a good punch.  A real drink of the apocalypse I suppose.
The water I boiled from a pool by the rails, so I don't suggest you get some.
And you can also try chatting with some of the other patrons if networking is your thing.
Also have some old world sodas if alcohol isn't your kind of thing.
Not much fruit juice to make fancy drinks, but I can scrounge up some still.
Can also sell some dry foods if you want to stock for a trip somewhere.
Also good for a chat if you don't want anything.

amigara1:
ENTRY 47:
Our normal mining routine has unearthed a hollow chamber.  This would not be out of the ordinary, save for the odd, perfectly vertical faultline found.  This faultline has several odd concavities in it which have the more superstitious crew members alarmed; they seem to be of human origin.
ENTRY 48:
The concavities are between 10 and 20 feet tall, and run the length of the faultline.  Each one is vaguely human in shape, but with the proportions of the limbs, neck and head greatly distended, all twisted and curled in on themselves.
amigara2:
ENTRY 49:
We've stopped mining operations in this area, obviously, until archaeologists have the chance to inspect the area.  This is going to set our schedule back by at least a week.  This stupid artifact-preservation law has been in place for 50 years, and hasn't even been up for termination despite the fact that these mining operations are the backbone of our economy.
ENTRY 52:
Still waiting on the archaeologists.  We've done a little light inspection of the faultline; our sounding equipment is insufficient to measure the depth of the concavities.  The equipment is rated at 15 miles depth, but it isn't made for such narrow tunnels, so it's hard to say exactly how far back they go.
amigara3:
ENTRY 54:
I noticed a couple of the guys down in the chamber with a chisel, breaking off a piece of the sheer wall.  I'm looking the other way.  It's not like the eggheads are going to notice a little piece missing.  Fuck em.
ENTRY 55:
Well, the archaeologists are down there now with a couple of the boys as guides.  They're hardly Indiana Jones types; I doubt they been below 20 feet.  I hate taking guys off assignment just to babysit the scientists, but if they get hurt we'll be shut down for god knows how long.
ENTRY 58:
They're bringing in ANOTHER CREW?  Christ, it's just some cave carvings!  I know that's sort of a big deal, but come on, these guys can't handle it?

log_immersion27:
IMMERSION LOG: 27A

INCIDENT REPORT:

SUMMARY:
Unforeseen EM interference source forced the team to remain in-phase between prime and sub-scape 27.  Expedition members reported observing a spheroid-entity ('PE-01') moving beneath the typically opaque t-substrate.  Interference readings and expedition testimony implies the PE-01 was a potent EM radiation source, and the origin of the interference.  After 30 min, PE-01 receded and the expedition was aborted in accordance of procedure EMER-12.  The expedition team suffered no injuries during the incident.

It's become clear we have greatly underestimated the risk posed by phase immersions.  Engineering has been tasked with designing a new, improved protection suite, and has shown promising advances.  Updated emergency procedures are in-progress.

Refer to file EXO-I-271 for full report.

DESIGNATION AI-012-PA
"Bakelite Phone"

CONTAINMENT PROCEDURE:
The object should be kept within an anechoic chamber.  Chamber should be actively monitored in case of ████████ emission leakage.

DESCRIPTION/PARATRONICS:
An Ericsson ED 702 Bakelite phone, red variant.  The original rotary dial has been replaced by a Bakelite copy of a Yage Y103d spherical doorknob.
The phone remains fully operational, and even when unconnected to a functional landline, █████████████████████ █████████████████████████████████ ████████████.
Organic matter reacts adversely to such emissions, and the following effects have been observed during live tests: disorientation and fugue states, ████████████████████████████████, disintegration, ████████████████ followed by death.

BACKGROUND:
Recovered during immersion ███ within a manifested copy of ███ █████ office.  The object appearance and paratronic effects are believed to be an imprint of the popular perception surrounding the ██████████/██████ ███████, even although such ███████ never existed in this shape.

DESIGNATION AI-017-PA
"Golden Comb"

CONTAINMENT PROCEDURE:
The object should be kept within a sealed chamber, procedure AI-G-12 should be followed while handling the object.

DESCRIPTION/PARATRONICS:
Handle-less comb.  Dimensions: 9 by 4 cm.  Weight: 650g.  Surface lustre indicates a covering of 18-22 karat gold.  The comb's shaft is engraved with faded-rectangular patterns.  The possibility of such engravings representing an unknown language has been explored to inconclusive results.

Resonant frequencies produced by stroking the █████ █████ can leak into ███ █████████ which might then produce time-spatial alterations within prime.

BACKGROUND:
Found during immersion ███ by Agent Id.  ███ who kept a plastic comb of similar dimensions within their lab locker.  Original manifestation of the object might have been a synchronistic phenomenon.

DESIGNATION AI-021-PA
"Rubik's Cube"

CONTAINMENT PROCEDURE:
The object should be kept within a sealed chamber and away from sight.

DESCRIPTION/PARATRONICS:
Solid t-substrate cube.  The dimensions and engravings of the object match those found on a Rubik's Cube.

Prolonged observation of the cube might produce ███████ ████████████ in sensitive individuals.  Direct interaction with the object will reproduce the effects with greater consistence.

BACKGROUND:
Found within the quarters of away team ███ after immersion ███.  Interrogative procedures confirmed the claims that the object █████████████ ██████████.  The implementation of M█████████ assisted isolation protocols have prevented similar incidents.
